translation: 回答，回应；作出反应，响应
original_sentence: I was so angry that I avoided her during school all day, and I still don't feel like responding to any of her online messages.
readingExamples: I was so angry that I avoided her during school all day, and I still don't feel like responding to any of her online messages.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to say or write something as a reply to someone or something
(2) vi. to do something as a reaction to something that has happened or been said
(3) vi. (of a patient or condition) to improve as a result of a particular medical treatment
(4) vt. to say something in reply

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (病情、身体)对治疗有反应、见好【respond to treatment】
uncommonMeanings.example: On the fourth morning the frail old man finally began to respond to the treatment, and a faint colour returned to his cheeks. （读后续写·亲情·转危为安）

posExamples.sentence: When the frightened puppy whimpered beneath the collapsed shelf, Tom knelt down and called its name softly; to his relief, it responded with a feeble wag of its tail. （读后续写·救助动物·温情）
I would be truly grateful if you could respond to this letter at your earliest convenience, as the registration for the summer camp closes at the end of this week. （应用文·询问信）
How a society responds to its most vulnerable members is, in my view, the truest measure of its civilisation. （议论文·社会责任）
"I never meant to hurt you," she responded, her voice trembling as she searched his face for a trace of forgiveness. （读后续写·和解·对话）

wordForms.noun: response (n. 回应,反应) / respondent (n. 回答者,答辩人)
wordForms.adjective: responsive (adj. 反应积极的,敏感的) / responsible (adj. 负责的)
wordForms.other: 构词法:re-(回)+spond(词根,'承诺、许诺')→respond'回应'。派生:respond(v.)→response(n.)→responsive(adj.)。辨析:responsive'反应积极的'≠ responsible'负责的',勿混。搭配:动词 respond to sth = 名词 in response to sth(以回应……);make no response(未作回应)。

collocations.example: On hearing the bad news, the man responded by hitting his hand hard against the wall. 听到坏消息，那人以用力捶墙作出反应。 （课件Reading·slide18-19·respond to sth with/by·填空原题）
When asked about the plan, she responded that she needed more time to think. 被问及这个计划时，她回答说自己需要更多时间考虑。 （课件Reading·slide18·respond + that 从句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】作为对……的答复/反应（response n.回答；反应）
collocations.example: In response to the students' concerns, the school set up a hotline. 为回应学生们的担忧，学校设立了一条热线。 （课件Reading·slide18·in response to）
The company was slow to make a response to the complaints. 公司迟迟未对投诉作出回应。 （课件Reading·slide18·make a response to）

collocations.translation: 回复某人的(在线)消息（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I still don't feel like responding to any of her online messages. （课文原句）
The moment the fire alarm rang, the trained staff responded to the emergency with remarkable calm. （读后续写·突发事件·镇定）
Rescue teams responded promptly to the distress call. （读后续写·救援·紧迫）
The community responded warmly to our appeal for donations. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: respond to a question / an email / a message
collocations.example: Still smarting from the quarrel, Amy could not bring herself to respond to any of the messages. （读后续写·矛盾·心理）
The vet assured us that the injured crane was responding well to treatment. （读后续写·保护野生动物）
She greeted every newcomer with kindness, and, touched by her warmth, they responded in kind. （读后续写·善意·感染）
The school responded to the students' concerns by setting up a mental-health hotline. （应用文·报道）
When repeated calls for help failed to respond, the villagers realised they would have to face the flood on their own. （读后续写·灾难·孤立无援）

synonyms.example: "Are you still angry with me?" he asked, and she took a long breath before she replied. （读后续写·对话·迟疑）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:最日常的'回答',多指口头或书面的直接回复;句法:reply to sb/sth(不及物需加to),reply that...。respond 更正式,且能指对情形、刺激的'反应',不限于言语,respond to sth。

synonyms.example: Everyone waited to see how the stern coach would react to the team's defeat. （读后续写·比赛·悬念）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:强调不假思索、本能或情绪化的反应,常含负面或即时意味;react to sth。respond 更中性、可控,也可指有意识的答复;两者均接 to,但 react 侧'本能反应',respond 侧'有意回应'。

synonyms.example: The child looked up and answered every question with surprising confidence. （读后续写·考试·成长）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:侧重针对具体问题给出'答案',及物,直接接宾语 answer the question/the phone/the door(无需to);范围较窄。respond 覆盖答复、反应、见效多重含义,且须 respond to。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致【课件Reading slide20-23】
advancedExpressions.expression: 时间/距离/金额作整体看作单数（eight years is a long time）；a number of + 复数名词谓语用复数，the number of + 复数名词谓语用单数；the rest/the remaining 修饰不可数用单数、修饰可数复数用复数；many a + 单数名词谓语用单数
advancedExpressions.example: Eight years is a long time; a number of students are against the plan, but the number of supporters is growing; the rest of the money is hidden under the pillow, while the rest of the boys are football fans; many a student and many a teacher is watching the match. （课件slide20-23·主谓一致要点合一）

advancedExpressions.expression: respond to sb/sth / respond promptly·warmly·positively / respond in kind / respond by doing sth / respond well to treatment
advancedExpressions.example: The community responded promptly and warmly to our appeal, and many responded by volunteering. （课堂枚举:对象、方式、'以同样方式'、'以做某事'四类一次记牢）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'回应/回复'(按对象可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: respond to ↔ reply to ↔ answer(及物) ↔ react to ↔ get back to sb(口语:回复某人)
advancedExpressions.example: She didn't respond to / reply to / answer his message. （功能:回复消息三者可换;react to 强调本能反应,answer 后不加to）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·动名词转换 respond→response
advancedExpressions.expression: respond to sth (v.) = in response to sth (n.); make a response
advancedExpressions.example: The government responded to public anger; in response, it launched a review. （动词短语与名词短语等值转换,写作换句常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: before sb. could respond, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before she could respond, he had already turned and walked away, leaving her words hanging in the cold night air. （'before+主句'制造错失感,渲染遗憾）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely hope you will respond to this call by doing ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely hope you will respond to this call by joining our tree-planting campaign this Sunday. （倡议书结尾发出行动号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: the way a person responds to ... reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: The way a person responds to failure, rather than the failure itself, ultimately reveals the strength of his character. （用'回应方式'切入品格论证,句式对比鲜明）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She didn't respond to his message.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His message glowed on the screen for what felt like hours, yet she let it sit there unanswered — for once, silence seemed the only response her wounded pride would allow. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境细节(glowed on the screen) + 时间夸张(what felt like hours) + 以"沉默即回应"的反讽收束心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should respond to their needs.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is incumbent upon every one of us to respond promptly and wholeheartedly to the needs of those less fortunate, for a community that turns a deaf ear to suffering forfeits its very soul. （议论文·社会责任）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb. to do 正式主句 + 副词并列(promptly and wholeheartedly) + for 引导因果 + 隐喻(forfeits its very soul)

classPractice.type: 介词填空（课件·slide19·语境应用）
classPractice.question:
用适当的介词填空：
1) On hearing the bad news, the man responded ____ hitting his hand hard against the wall.
2) When the teacher asked Tom to respond ____ the question, he only stood there saying nothing.
3) After she received my message, she responded ____ a phone call in order to discuss the problem as soon as possible.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】respond by doing sth（以做某事作出反应）/ respond to sth（对……作出回应）/ respond with sth（以……回应）；课件 slide19 语境应用原题原答案

classPractice.question: I still don't feel like ____ (respond) to any of her online messages.
classPractice.note: 考点:feel like doing sth'想做某事',like后接动名词;还原课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 respond / react / answer 填空:When the phone rang, she quickly ____ it; but when asked about the accident, she ____ angrily and refused to ____ to any further questions.
classPractice.note: 考点:answer the phone(及物,接电话) / react angrily(本能情绪反应) / respond to questions(有意回应,须加to)。

classPractice.question: The company responded to the complaints. → In ____ ____ the complaints, the company issued an apology.（用respond的名词形式改写）
classPractice.note: 考点:respond to(v.)=in response to(n.),动词短语转名词短语。

translation: 失去，丧失；亏损；去世；损失
original_sentence: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next.
readingExamples: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the fact of no longer having something, or of having less of it than before
(2) n. the disadvantage caused when someone leaves or when a useful or valuable object is taken away
(3) n. the death of a person, or the sorrow felt because of it
(4) n. money that a person or business loses, i.e. spending more than is earned

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (比赛、竞选的)失利、败北
uncommonMeanings.example: The narrow loss in the final robbed them of the trophy, yet the young players held their heads high. （读后续写·体育·虽败犹荣）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (人的)去世,亡故;因此产生的悲痛
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole village mourned the loss of the old doctor who had served them for fifty years. （读后续写·哀悼）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 亏损,赔钱(与 profit 相对)
uncommonMeanings.example: The small café ran at a loss all winter. （读后续写·创业·困境）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at her grandmother's graveside, Lucy felt the loss settle over her like a heavy fog, and for the first time she understood that some absences never truly fade. （读后续写·亲情·丧亲之痛）
On behalf of the whole club, I am writing to express our deep sorrow at the loss of our beloved coach, whose warmth and wisdom shaped a generation of players. （应用文·慰问信）
The loss of biodiversity is not merely an environmental concern; it is a warning that the delicate web sustaining all life is beginning to unravel. （议论文·环境保护）
Despite months of hard work, the small café ran at a loss all winter, and by spring the owner faced the painful decision of closing its doors. （读后续写·创业·困境）

wordForms.noun: loss (n. 损失,丧失,亏损,去世)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶:lose(v.,不规则:lose-lost-lost)→loss(n.)→lost(adj./过去式过去分词)→loser(n. 失败者)。拼写辨析:动词 lose(一个o,/luːz/)≠形容词/松的 loose(两个o,/luːs/),高频易错。搭配:at a loss(不知所措)、a sense of loss(失落感)、run at a loss(亏本);profit(利)↔loss(亏)反义对。

idioms.example: Realising the venture was doomed, the wise old merchant advised his son to cut his losses and start afresh elsewhere. （读后续写·经商·智慧）

idioms.translation: 毫无用处的人/物;全然的损失
idioms.example: Everyone had written the stubborn old bicycle off as a dead loss, but Grandpa restored it, gear by rusty gear, into a gleaming machine. （读后续写·祖孙·匠心）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss what to do (next)
collocations.translation: 【课件】不知所措，不知（下一步）该怎么办
collocations.example: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next. 这种处境的压力快把我压垮了，我不知道下一步该怎么办。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss what to do·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss for words
collocations.example: His comments left me at a (complete) loss for words. 他的评论让我完全哑口无言。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss for words·原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss to do sth
collocations.example: I was at a loss to understand what had happened. 我不明白究竟发生了什么。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss to do·原句）

collocations.phrase: (be) at a loss what to do next
collocations.translation: 不知下一步该怎么办（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next. （课文原句）
When the interviewer switched to fluent French, the nervous candidate was momentarily at a loss. （读后续写·面试·窘迫）
When her closest friend moved abroad, a quiet sense of loss followed Emma everywhere. （读后续写·友情·离别）
The loss of her eyesight did not dim Helen's spirit. （读后续写·励志·身残志坚）
The flood-stricken village suffered a heavy loss, yet neighbours rushed in with food and hope. （读后续写·灾难·守望相助）

collocations.phrase: make a loss / run at a loss
collocations.example: Rather than raise prices, the honest grocer chose to run at a loss. （读后续写·善良·坚守）

collocations.phrase: weight loss / memory loss / job loss
collocations.translation: 体重下降/记忆丧失/失业
collocations.example: The sudden job loss shook him to the core, yet it freed him to chase a buried dream. （读后续写·转折·重生）
One harsh remark triggered a loss of confidence that took months to overcome. （读后续写·成长·挫折）
Weighing the profit and loss coolly, the manager valued long-term trust over short-term gain. （议论文·商业道德）

synonyms.example: The bitter defeat taught the team a lesson no victory ever could. （读后续写·体育·成长）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:特指竞赛、战斗、竞选中'被击败',含对抗色彩,可作可数名词 a heavy defeat;loss 更泛,可指失去、去世、亏损等各种'失',体育语境二者近义(a loss/defeat)。

synonyms.example: The storm caused severe damage to the coastal town's fishing fleet. （应用文·新闻报道）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:强调对物体或事物造成的'破坏、损伤',多为物质层面,常不可数(do/cause damage to sth);loss 强调'失去、缺少'这一结果本身。

synonyms.example: Sleep deprivation gradually eroded her focus, and the brilliant student fell behind. （议论文·健康）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:书面、正式,强调'被剥夺'重要事物,含被动与匮乏意味(sleep/sensory deprivation);loss 更中性通用,不强调'被夺走'。

advancedExpressions.expression: at a loss / a sense of loss / the loss of sth / suffer a heavy loss / run at a loss / profit and loss
advancedExpressions.example: At a loss and filled with a sense of loss, she watched the café she had run at a loss finally close. （课堂枚举:茫然、失落感、丧失、损失、亏本一次记牢）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'损失/失去'(按语境可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: loss ↔ defeat(赛事失利) ↔ damage(物质损害) ↔ deprivation(被剥夺) ↔ bereavement(丧亲)
advancedExpressions.example: They suffered a great loss / defeat / damage. （功能:表'失、损';赛事用 defeat,物损用 damage,丧亲用 loss/bereavement,不可随意混）

advancedExpressions.expression: lose(v., lost-lost) → loss(n.) → lost(adj.) → loser(n.)；lose≠loose
advancedExpressions.example: Don't lose heart over one loss — a good player is never a lifelong loser. （动→名→形，一句串起词族并区分 lose/loose）

advancedExpressions.expression: out of loss came ...
advancedExpressions.example: Out of loss came an unexpected gift: a tenderness towards every fleeting moment she had once taken for granted. （倒装+抽象化,将'失去'转化为成长感悟）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly express our sorrow at the loss of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly express our sorrow at the loss of such a devoted teacher. （慰问信开头,情真意切）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true loss lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true loss lies not in the failure itself but in the courage we surrender the moment we stop trying. （对比结构重新定义'损失',深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very sad about the loss of her dog.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The loss of her old collie left a silence in the house so profound that even the ticking of the clock seemed to mourn, and Grace found herself listening, night after night, for a bark that would never come again. （读后续写·失去宠物·哀伤）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(the clock seemed to mourn) + 环境烘托(silence) + 细节想象(bark that would never come) 强化悲伤

sentenceUpgrade.original: The loss of forests is a big problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The relentless loss of forests, far from being a distant concern, strikes at the very foundation on which our shared future is built, silencing countless species and stealing the breath from generations yet unborn. （议论文·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: far from being 插入让步 + strike at the foundation 隐喻 + 现在分词并列(silencing... stealing...)递进升华

classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be at a loss (what to do)'不知所措';课件 slide17·还原课文原句。

他的评论让我完全哑口无言。

classPractice.question: 用 loss / defeat / damage 填空:The team accepted the ____ gracefully; though the storm's ____ to the pitch was severe, the greater ____ was to their confidence.
classPractice.note: 考点:赛事失利用 defeat(或loss);物质破坏用 damage;抽象'信心的丧失'用 loss。

classPractice.question: A quiet sense of ____ (lose) followed Emma into every corner of the empty classroom after her best friend moved away.
classPractice.note: 考点:sense of + 名词,lose 的名词形式为 loss;不规则词族 lose-lost-loss。

original_sentence: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next.
readingExamples: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. so confused or uncertain that you do not know what to do or say
(2) phr. (at a loss for words) unable to think of anything to say, especially because of surprise or strong emotion
(3) phr. (of a business) making less money than is spent; not making a profit

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (做生意)亏本地,赔钱地【at a loss=below cost】
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than dump the surplus, the kind-hearted farmer sold his apples at a loss so that the orphanage could taste fresh fruit that autumn. （读后续写·善良·奉献）

posExamples.sentence: When the examiner asked a question she had never anticipated, Mia stood there utterly at a loss, her carefully rehearsed answers scattering like leaves in the wind. （读后续写·面试·慌乱）
If you ever find yourself at a loss about how to settle a quarrel with a friend, please do not hesitate to drop by our student counselling centre. （应用文·倡议/建议信）
Confronted with the sheer scale of the crisis, even seasoned experts confessed they were at a loss, a reminder that humility must accompany all human knowledge. （议论文·科技与人性）
So overwhelmed was she by the surprise party that, for a long moment, this normally eloquent girl was completely at a loss for words. （读后续写·惊喜·感动）

idioms.translation: 一时语塞,不知说什么好
idioms.example: When the shy boy handed her the flowers he had grown himself, the teacher was so moved that she was at a loss for words. （读后续写·师生·温情）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss what to do (next)
collocations.translation: 【课件】不知所措，不知（下一步）该怎么办
collocations.example: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next. 这种处境的压力快把我压垮了，我不知道下一步该怎么办。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss what to do·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a (complete) loss for words
collocations.example: His comments left me at a (complete) loss for words. 他的评论让我完全哑口无言。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss for words·原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss to do sth
collocations.example: I was at a loss to understand what had happened. 我不明白究竟发生了什么。 （课件Reading·slide17·at a loss to do·原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss what to do next
collocations.translation: 不知下一步该怎么办（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm at a loss what to do next. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss what to do
collocations.example: Stranded at the deserted station past midnight, the traveller was at a loss what to do. （读后续写·陌生人善意）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss to explain / understand
collocations.example: Scientists were at a loss to explain why the migrating birds had changed their ancient route. （议论文·自然之谜）

collocations.phrase: be at a loss for words
collocations.example: Reading her late mother's final letter, she was at a loss for words. （读后续写·亲情·遗物）
Newly arrived in the bustling city, the country boy often found himself at a loss. （读后续写·进城·迷茫）
Determined to keep his workers employed, the owner sold his stock at a loss all winter. （读后续写·企业·担当）

synonyms.example: The confused tourist turned the map upside down, only to grow more bewildered. （读后续写·旅途·迷路）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:普通形容词,泛指'思维混乱、弄不明白',作表语/定语(a confused look);at a loss 是介词短语,只作表语/状语,更强调'茫然到不知如何行动或开口'。

synonyms.translation: 迷惑不解的，不知所措的
synonyms.example: Bewildered by the sudden applause, the modest volunteer had no idea her small act had touched so many. （读后续写·意外·感动）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:书面且情绪更强,突出被复杂情形'弄糊涂',常作过去分词形容词;at a loss 侧重'无计可施、无言以对'的状态。

synonyms.example: Watching the flood swallow her family's field, the little girl felt utterly helpless. （读后续写·灾难·无力）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:强调'无力改变、得不到帮助';at a loss 更偏'一时想不出办法'的心理空白,可互为补充。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·at a loss 后接结构【课件Reading slide17】
advancedExpressions.expression: be at a loss + what/how to do（接疑问词+不定式）/ + to do sth（接不定式）/ + for words（接 for words），不接 that 从句
advancedExpressions.example: He was at a loss what to say, at a loss to understand what had happened, and finally at a loss for words. 他不知说什么好，弄不明白发生了什么，最后哑口无言。 （课件slide17·三种固定接法合一）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·at a loss 固定搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: be at a loss what to do / be at a loss to explain·understand / be at a loss for words / find oneself at a loss / sell·trade at a loss
advancedExpressions.example: Utterly at a loss what to do, and at a loss for words, she could only stare. （课堂枚举:接what to do、to do sth、for words、find oneself、亏本五种用法一次记牢）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'不知所措'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: at a loss ↔ be confused ↔ be bewildered ↔ not know what to do ↔ be at one's wits' end(智穷计尽)
advancedExpressions.example: Faced with the crisis, she was at a loss / didn't know what to do / was at her wits' end. （功能:表茫然无措,程度递增,写作换用避免重复 didn't know what to do）

advancedExpressions.expression: at a loss, sb. could only ...
advancedExpressions.example: At a loss, she could only stand frozen at the threshold, her heart pounding against a swallowing silence. （短语前置+could only 刻画茫然瞬间的定格感）

advancedExpressions.expression: whenever you are at a loss, remember that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whenever you are at a loss about your future, remember that even the longest journey begins with a single, trembling step. （建议信中给出鼓励,句式温暖有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: being at a loss is not weakness but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Being at a loss, far from a sign of weakness, is often the honest starting point from which genuine wisdom begins to grow. （重新定义'茫然',赋予积极意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He didn't know what to do.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For a heartbeat he stood at a loss, the shouts of the crowd fading into a distant hum, his mind a blank page on which no plan would write itself. （读后续写·危急时刻·心理留白）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: at a loss 替换 didn't know + 环境虚化(fading into a hum) + 比喻(blank page)呈现思维空白

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many young people are at a loss about their careers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That so many young people today find themselves at a loss about their careers is less a personal failing than a reflection of an age drowning in choices yet starved of direction. （议论文·青年成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 从句作主语 + less...than 对比重估归因 + 反义并列(drowning in choices yet starved of direction)升华

classPractice.question: 这种处境的压力快把我压垮了,我不知道下一步该怎么办。The stress of this situation is killing me, and I'm ____ ____ ____ what to do next.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be at a loss what to do'不知所措,不知怎么办';课件 slide17·还原课文原句。

classPractice.question: 他的评论让我完全哑口无言。His comments left me ____ ____ (complete) ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: at a complete loss for words
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be at a loss for words'哑口无言、语塞';课件 slide17 原句，complete 修饰 loss。

classPractice.question: I was at a loss ____ (understand) what had happened.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be at a loss to do sth'无法做某事,不知如何……';课件 slide17 原句，后接不定式 to understand。

classPractice.question: She didn't know what to say when she heard the news. → On hearing the news, she was ____ ____ ____ ____.（用at a loss短语,表示'语塞'）
classPractice.note: 考点:be at a loss for words=不知说什么好、语塞,等于 didn't know what to say。

classPractice.question: Faced with such an unusual case, even the experienced doctors were at a loss ____ (explain) the strange symptoms.
classPractice.note: 考点:be at a loss to do sth'无法做某事';后接不定式 to explain。

translation: 评价，(尤指)批评；判断，认为 | n. 法官；裁判员
original_sentence: Don't be so quick to judge your friend.
readingExamples: Don't be so quick to judge your friend.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to form or give an opinion about someone or something after careful thought
(2) vt. & vi. to decide the result of a competition, or to act as a referee
(3) vt. to criticize someone, especially in an unfair or hasty way
(4) n. an official who makes decisions in a court of law
(5) n. a person who decides the winner in a competition, or who can give a valued opinion

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】法官
uncommonMeanings.example: There is no doubt that the judge's final decision is fair. 毫无疑问，裁判的最终决定是公平的。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】判断力；看法（judgement）
uncommonMeanings.example: He achieved his aim more by luck than judgement. 他达到目的主要是靠运气而不是靠判断力。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 法官
uncommonMeanings.example: The judge listened carefully before giving his decision. 法官仔细聆听后才作出裁决。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 裁判员，评委
uncommonMeanings.example: The judge raised her hand to signal the winner. 裁判举手示意获胜者。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 行家，鉴赏家(a good judge of sth)
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather was a shrewd judge of character, and one glance at the smiling stranger was enough to make him tighten his grip on my hand. （读后续写·长辈·识人）

posExamples.sentence: Don't judge the timid new boy too harshly, Amy told herself; behind his silence might lie a story far heavier than her own. （读后续写·校园·包容）
I am honoured to invite you to judge our annual English speech contest, as your rich experience would lend great authority to the event. （应用文·邀请信）
We should never judge a person's worth by the clothes they wear or the accent they speak with, for true character lies far beneath the surface. （议论文·平等与偏见）
As the final note faded, the head judge rose to her feet, and the thunderous applause told everyone the verdict before she spoke a word. （读后续写·比赛·高潮）

idioms.idiom: don't judge a book by its cover
idioms.example: Ragged and mud-stained, the old man was ignored by everyone until he sat down and played the piano like a master — truly, one should never judge a book by its cover. （读后续写·反转·偏见）
Judging by the dark clouds massing over the mountains, we quickened our pace toward the shelter. （读后续写·徒步·天气）

idioms.idiom: as far as I can judge
idioms.example: As far as I can judge, the plan is both practical and fair, and I sincerely hope the committee will approve it. （应用文·建议信）

collocations.translation: 【课件】从……来判断（现在分词独立成分）
collocations.example: Judging from her look, she seemed to be tired. 从她的神情判断，她似乎累了。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: judge sb to be / as sth
collocations.example: I judge them to be / as the best plays I have ever read. 我断定它们是我读过的最好的剧作。（课件原句；课件原文 met 与 plays 搭配不当，此处按正确搭配改为 read）

collocations.phrase: as far as I can judge
collocations.example: As far as I can judge, the plan is both practical and fair. 据我判断，这个计划既实用又公平。（课件）

collocations.phrase: Don't judge a book by its cover.
collocations.example: Don't judge a book by its cover. 勿以貌取人。（课件原句）
Don't be so quick to judge your friend. 不要急于评判你的朋友。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make a judgement about / on / of sth
collocations.example: He refused to make a judgement about the situation. 他拒绝对形势作出判断。（课件原句）
It was, in my judgement, the wrong thing to do. 在我看来，那样做是错误的。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】主要靠运气而非判断力
collocations.example: He achieved his aim more by luck than judgement. 他达到目的主要是靠运气而不是靠判断力。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 评判你的朋友（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Don't be so quick to judge your friend. 不要那么急着评判你的朋友。（课文原句）
Never judge a person by their looks. 千万别以貌取人。
Judging from her smile, the news was good. 从她的微笑判断，消息是好的。
Come and judge for yourself. 你来自己评判吧。
It is unfair to be so quick to judge her. 这么急着评判她是不公平的。

collocations.phrase: a good / poor judge of sth
collocations.example: He is a good judge of character. 他很善于看人。
Three teachers were invited to judge the contest. 三位老师受邀为比赛当评委。
The captain judged that the storm would soon pass. 船长判断风暴很快就会过去。
He quickly judged the distance and jumped. 他迅速判断距离后一跃而过。
Judging by appearances alone can mislead us. 单凭外表判断会误导我们。

synonyms.example: The teacher carefully assessed each project not just for its result but for the effort behind it. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: 正式、中性，强调依据标准"衡量、估价"，多用于能力、价值、风险；judge 更口语，也含"评断、批评"意味

synonyms.example: It is far easier to criticize others than to examine our own faults with the same honesty. （议论文·自省）
synonyms.usage: 特指"挑毛病、指责"，含明显负面色彩；judge 表"批评"义时多指仓促、片面的评断，语气略缓

synonyms.example: Before we condemn a new policy, we ought to evaluate its long-term effects with a cool head. （议论文·理性思考）
synonyms.usage: 书面且系统，强调"综合分析后作出评价"；judge 可以是瞬间、直觉的判断，也可指法律裁决

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·Judging from/by（独立分词状语）
advancedExpressions.expression: Judging from / by sth, 主句 = 从……来判断（现在分词短语作状语，逻辑主语无需与主句一致，为独立成分）
advancedExpressions.example: Judging from her look, she seemed to be tired. 从她的神情判断，她似乎累了。（课件·独立主格类结构，勿与主句主语强行一致）

advancedExpressions.expression: judge sb / sth to be sth = judge sb / sth as sth（断定某人/物是……）
advancedExpressions.example: I judge them to be / as the best plays I have ever met. 我断定它们是我读过最好的剧作。（课件·to be 与 as 两种补语都可）

advancedExpressions.expression: judge (v.) → judgement / judgment (n. 判断力/看法) → make a judgement about/on/of；in my judgement
advancedExpressions.example: In my judgement it was the wrong thing to do, but he refused to make any judgement about it at all. （课件·名词搭配群）

advancedExpressions.expression: judge sb / judge sb by sth / judge from(by) / judge for oneself / be a good judge of sth
advancedExpressions.example: Don't be so quick to judge your friend by one careless act; judging from her past kindness, there must be an explanation. （课文 judge sb 延展为搭配群）

advancedExpressions.expression: judge = assess / evaluate / criticize（挑毛病时）
advancedExpressions.example: We should evaluate a plan carefully before we judge it, and never rush to criticize what we do not understand. （三词功能相近，语体由口语到正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: judge → judgement/judgment (n.) → judgemental (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: Her judgement proved sound, yet she was never judgemental of those who erred. （动词加 -ment 变名词，加 -al 变形容词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·祈使句 + be quick to do
advancedExpressions.expression: Don't be so quick to do sth = 别那么急于做某事
advancedExpressions.example: Don't be so quick to judge your friend — pause and listen first. （课文即祈使句，be quick to do 后接动词原形）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. learned never to judge ... by ...
advancedExpressions.example: That day Amy learned never to judge a friend by a single careless act, for one moment can never sum up an entire heart. （用"学会不轻易评判"点出成长主题，续写主旨句）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would be greatly honoured if you could judge ...
advancedExpressions.example: We would be greatly honoured if you could judge our charity art show, as your discerning eye would mean the world to these young artists. （邀请信正式而恳切）

advancedExpressions.expression: before we rush to judge, we ought to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we rush to judge others for their choices, we ought to walk, if only for a moment, in the shoes they have worn. （"评判前先换位"，呼吁包容，句式含条件插入语）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Don't judge people too quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before you let a single glance harden into judgement, pause and remember that every face you pass conceals a battle you know nothing about. （读后续写/议论文·换位思考）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Before you...祈使前置 + 抽象名词化(a glance harden into judgement) + conceals a battle 隐喻唤起共情

sentenceUpgrade.original: The judges chose her as the winner.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the judges, after a long and thoughtful silence, finally declared her the winner, the trembling girl who had once been laughed at now stood bathed in a light she had only dared to dream of. （读后续写·逆袭·高光时刻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: after a long silence 插入营造悬念 + 定语从句回溯过往(once been laughed at) + bathed in a light 光影隐喻升华

classPractice.question: 毫无疑问，裁判的最终决定是公平的。There is no doubt that ____________.
classPractice.answer: the judge's final decision is fair
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】judge=裁判/法官(n.)；There is no doubt that + 从句。

classPractice.question: 他达到目的主要是靠运气而不是靠判断力。
classPractice.answer: He achieved his aim more by luck than judgement.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】more...than... 结构；judgement=判断力(n.)，不可数。

classPractice.question: 他拒绝对形势作出判断。
classPractice.answer: He refused to make a judgement about the situation.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】make a judgement about sth=对……做出判断。

classPractice.question: 在我看来，那样做是错误的。It was, ____________, the wrong thing to do.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】in my judgement=在我看来/依我判断，作插入语。

classPractice.question: Don't be so quick to ____ (judge) your friend before you know the whole story.
classPractice.note: 祈使句/不定式 to 后用动词原形；呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 从她进门时的表情判断，她似乎有什么烦心事。____ (judge) her expression, she seemed to have something on her mind.
classPractice.note: judging by/from 为独立成分（现在分词短语作状语），逻辑主语无需与主句一致。

classPractice.question: 别以貌取人。（用 judge... by...）
classPractice.answer: Don't judge a book by its cover. / Don't judge people by their appearance.
classPractice.note: judge sb/sth by sth 表"凭……评判"；谚语 judge a book by its cover=以貌取人。

original_sentence: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
readingExamples: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. responsible for a mistake, an accident, or a quarrel; being the one who has done something bad or incorrect
(2) phr. mistaken in one's actions or judgement; at fault (opposite of 'in the right')

posExamples.sentence: Halfway through her furious speech, Amy suddenly realised she was in the wrong, and the words died in her throat as shame crept up her cheeks. （读后续写·争吵·悔悟）
If, after reading this letter, you still feel our club is in the wrong, we sincerely apologize and promise to make things right at once. （应用文·道歉信）
A truly big-hearted person is willing to admit being in the wrong, for humility, not stubbornness, is the mark of real strength. （议论文·品格）
Perhaps she knew she was in the wrong and longed to say sorry, yet pride kept sealing her lips each time she reached for the phone. （读后续写·矛盾·心理挣扎）

idioms.translation: (使)显得某人有错，把责任推给某人
idioms.example: By twisting my innocent remark, he cleverly put me in the wrong before the whole class. （读后续写·校园·委屈）

collocations.example: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize. 也许她知道自己错了，想要道歉。（课件·课文原句）
I got the last question wrong. 我最后一题答错了。（课件·拓展）
Don't get me wrong — I only meant to help. 别误解我，我只是想帮忙。（课件·拓展）
Something went wrong with the plan at the last minute. 计划在最后关头出了岔子。（课件·拓展）
He knew he had done wrong and could not meet her eyes. 他知道自己犯了错，不敢正视她。（课件·拓展）
She felt the world had done her wrong. 她觉得世界亏待了她。（课件·拓展）

collocations.translation: 知道自己有错、理亏（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize. 也许她知道自己错了，想要道歉。（课文原句）
The moment he saw her tears, he knew he was in the wrong. 一看到她的眼泪，他就知道自己错了。

collocations.phrase: admit (that) one is in the wrong
collocations.example: It takes courage to admit you are in the wrong. 承认自己有错需要勇气。

collocations.phrase: know / feel one is in the wrong
collocations.example: Deep down she felt she was in the wrong. 内心深处她觉得自己错了。
The party in the wrong should apologize first. 有错的一方应先道歉。

collocations.phrase: prove sb (to be) in the wrong
collocations.example: The video clearly proved him to be in the wrong. 录像清楚地证明他有错。

synonyms.example: When the vase shattered, everyone assumed the cat was at fault, but the real culprit was the gust from the open window. （读后续写·误会·真相）
synonyms.usage: 与 in the wrong 近乎同义，都指"负有责任、有过错"；at fault 稍中性，常用于事故、失误的归责，语气略客观

synonyms.example: No single person was entirely to blame for the misunderstanding; both had spoken in anger. （读后续写·矛盾·反思）
synonyms.usage: 强调"该受责怪、担责"，常与 be 连用(be to blame)；in the wrong 更侧重"处于错误、理亏的一方"这一状态

synonyms.example: I was mistaken about her intentions, and I have regretted my hasty words ever since. （读后续写·误解·愧疚）
synonyms.usage: 指"判断、看法有误"，偏认知层面，未必涉及道德过错；in the wrong 常含"理亏、该道歉"的责任意味

advancedExpressions.expression: be in the wrong(n. 有错/理亏) / get sth wrong(adj. 答错、理解错) / get sb wrong(误解某人) / sth goes wrong(出问题) / sb does wrong(犯错) / do sb wrong(n. 冤枉某人)
advancedExpressions.example: Don't get me wrong: I'm not saying you did wrong on purpose, but something clearly went wrong, and if you're in the wrong you owe her an apology. （课件·六个 wrong 搭配一网打尽，注意 the wrong/do sb wrong 中 wrong 作名词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in the wrong 中 wrong 为名词
advancedExpressions.expression: be in the wrong / do sb wrong 中 wrong 是名词（错误/过错）；get sth wrong / go wrong 中 wrong 是形容词
advancedExpressions.example: He was in the wrong (n.), so he shouldn't get the facts wrong (adj.) as well. （课件·同一 wrong 词性随搭配而变）

advancedExpressions.expression: be in the wrong / admit one is in the wrong / put sb in the wrong；反义 be in the right
advancedExpressions.example: She knew she was in the wrong, not in the right, and had the grace to admit it. （课文 in the wrong 与反义 in the right 成对记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·有错、该负责
advancedExpressions.expression: be in the wrong = be at fault = be to blame = be mistaken（认知有误）
advancedExpressions.example: When something goes wrong, admitting you are at fault—that you are to blame and in the wrong—is the first step to making peace. （四种表达功能相近，可替换）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in the wrong 固定搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: in + the + wrong（形容词前加 the 表"处于……境地"，无名词）
advancedExpressions.example: Being in the wrong is not a shame; refusing to admit it is. （the wrong / the right 为固定习语，不可换成 a wrong）

advancedExpressions.expression: only when ... did sb. realise sb. had been in the wrong
advancedExpressions.example: Only when she saw the letter, unsent and tear-stained, did Amy realise how badly she had been in the wrong. （倒装 + 细节实证(tear-stained letter)，续写悔悟段的高光句）

advancedExpressions.expression: on reflection, I admit that we were in the wrong, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: On reflection, I admit that we were in the wrong, and I would like to offer both my sincerest apology and a concrete plan to put things right. （道歉信主体，态度诚恳、行动跟进）

advancedExpressions.expression: admitting one is in the wrong is not a defeat but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Admitting that one is in the wrong is not a defeat but a quiet triumph of conscience over pride. （否定+对比结构，重估"认错"的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She knew she was wrong and wanted to apologize.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Somewhere beneath her stubborn silence, Amy knew she was in the wrong, and a small, insistent voice kept urging her to pick up the phone and simply say sorry before it was too late. （读后续写·心理挣扎）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境化心理(beneath her stubborn silence) + in the wrong 替换 wrong + 拟人(a small insistent voice) + before it was too late 制造紧迫

sentenceUpgrade.original: The person who is in the wrong should apologize first.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is the one who is truly in the wrong, rather than the one who shouts the loudest, who ought to have the humility to apologize first and mend what anger has broken. （议论文·和解与担当）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...who 强调句 + rather than 对比(错的人 vs 嗓门大的人) + 定语从句 + mend what anger has broken 隐喻收尾

classPractice.type: 选词填空(课件·wrong 短语)
classPractice.question: 用 in the wrong / get sth wrong / get sb wrong / go wrong / do sb wrong 的适当形式填空：(1) Don't ____ me ____; I never meant to hurt you. (2) He finally admitted he was ____ ____ ____ and said sorry. (3) Something has ____ ____ with the printer again.
classPractice.answer: (1) get; wrong (2) in the wrong (3) gone wrong
classPractice.note: 【课件延展】get sb wrong=误解某人；be in the wrong=有错/理亏；go wrong=出问题。

classPractice.question: 用 in the wrong / in the right 填空：After a calm talk, he realised he had been ____ all along and said sorry.
classPractice.note: in the wrong=有错、理亏；其反义为 in the right=有理。由 said sorry 定答案。

classPractice.question: 也许她知道自己错了，想要道歉。（用 in the wrong）
classPractice.answer: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文；know one is in the wrong=知道自己理亏。

classPractice.question: 真正大度的人乐于承认自己有错。A truly big-hearted person is willing to ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (承认自己有错).
classPractice.note: 五空对应 admit being in the wrong（admit 后接动名词 being）；亦可说 admit (that) he is in the wrong（后接从句，词数不同）。

original_sentence: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
readingExamples: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to tell someone that you are sorry for having done something that has caused them harm, trouble, or inconvenience
(2) vi. to make a formal statement of regret, especially in speech or writing (also spelled 'apologise' in British English)

posExamples.sentence: Swallowing her pride, Amy walked up to her friend and apologized in a trembling voice, and to her surprise, all it took was two small words to melt a week of frost between them. （读后续写·和解·释怀）
I am writing to apologize sincerely for missing the group meeting last Friday, as a sudden family emergency left me no chance to inform you in advance. （应用文·道歉信）
A society that teaches its children to apologize when they err is nurturing not weakness, but the moral courage on which trust and harmony depend. （议论文·品德教育）
"I should never have shouted at you," the old man apologized, his weathered hands shaking as he reached out to the grandson he had wronged. （读后续写·祖孙·愧疚）

collocations.example: She wanted to apologize to her friend for the quarrel. 她想为那场争吵向朋友道歉。（课件原句）
If there is someone in your life to whom you need to say sorry, go ahead and make an apology. 如果你生命中有需要说对不起的人，那就去向他道歉吧。（课件原句）
The customer demanded an apology from the manager. 顾客要求经理道歉。（课件·apology 搭配）
She sent an apology for missing the meeting. 她为缺席会议致歉。（课件·apology 搭配）
Deep down, Tom knew he owed his sister an apology. 内心深处，汤姆知道他欠妹妹一个道歉。（课件·apology 搭配）
With a smile she accepted his apology. 她微笑着接受了他的道歉。（课件·apology 搭配）

collocations.translation: 想要道歉（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize. 也许她知道自己错了，想要道歉。（课文原句）
He apologized for being late. 他为迟到道歉。
The waiter apologized profusely for the spilt soup. 服务员为洒了汤一再道歉。
He chose to apologize in person rather than by text. 他选择当面而非发短信道歉。
She made a sincere apology to the whole class. 她向全班真诚地道歉。
She apologized to her mother for the harsh words. 她为那些刺耳的话向母亲道歉。
With a smile she accepted his apology. 她微笑着接受了他的道歉。

synonyms.example: Sometimes the hardest thing in the world is to look someone in the eye and simply say sorry. （读后续写·成长·勇气）
synonyms.usage: 最口语、直白，多用于日常和对话；apologize 更正式，适用于书面、公开或郑重场合

synonyms.example: The headmaster expressed deep regret over the incident and pledged that such carelessness would never happen again. （应用文·正式声明）
synonyms.usage: 书面且正式，突出"表达遗憾、抱歉之情"，语气庄重；apologize 更直接明确地承认过错并致歉

synonyms.example: Words were not enough, so he spent the whole weekend rebuilding the fence to make amends for his carelessness. （读后续写·行动·补过）
synonyms.usage: 强调"用行动补救"，重在弥补而非言语；apologize 侧重"用言语致歉"，二者常前后呼应

advancedExpressions.expression: apologize to sb for sth / make an apology for sth / demand an apology / send an apology / owe sb an apology / accept an apology
advancedExpressions.example: She apologized to her friend for the quarrel and, when he owed her an apology in turn, she was glad to accept his apology. （课件·动词 apologize 与名词 apology 搭配群）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·apologize 为不及物动词（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: apologize to sb for sth（不可 apologize sb），道歉对象用 to，事由用 for
advancedExpressions.example: I must apologize to you for the delay, not "apologize you". （课件·不及物动词后接介词）

advancedExpressions.expression: apologize = say sorry（口语）= express regret（正式）；用行动弥补 = make amends
advancedExpressions.example: Words are not enough: he said sorry, then made amends by rebuilding the fence. （由口语到正式，功能相近可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: apologize (v.) → apology (n.) → apologetic (adj.) → apologetically (adv.)；英式拼写 apologise
advancedExpressions.example: He looked apologetic and, apologising softly, offered a sincere apology. （动、名、形、副全家桶；-ise/-ize 英美拼写差异）

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had sb. apologized than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had she apologized than the tears she had held back all week finally broke free, and the two friends fell into a long, forgiving embrace. （倒装 no sooner...than + 情感爆发，续写高潮和解段）

advancedExpressions.expression: please accept my sincere apology, and rest assured that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please accept my sincere apology for the inconvenience, and rest assured that I have taken every measure to prevent it from happening again. （道歉信收尾，致歉 + 保证的黄金结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: to apologize is not to lose face but to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To apologize is not to lose face but to reveal a strength of character that stubbornness could never afford. （不定式作主语 + not...but 对比，重估"道歉"的价值）

advancedExpressions.expression: apologize to sb for sth / apologize for doing / make(offer) an apology / owe sb an apology / accept an apology
advancedExpressions.example: She wanted to apologize to her friend for the quarrel and finally made a heartfelt apology. （课文 apologize 延展动词、名词搭配群）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·apologize 为不及物动词
advancedExpressions.expression: apologize to sb for sth（不可 apologize sb），道歉对象用 to，事由用 for
advancedExpressions.example: I must apologize to you for the delay, not "apologize you". （常见错误纠正：不及物动词后接介词）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He apologized to her and she forgave him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last he apologized, his voice barely above a whisper, she felt the anger drain from her like water through open fingers, and with a nod that spoke louder than any words, she forgave him. （读后续写·宽恕·细腻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: his voice barely above a whisper 伴随状语 + 明喻(like water through open fingers) + a nod that spoke louder than words 以动作代言语

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should learn to apologize.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If every one of us could learn to apologize with honesty and grace, countless quarrels would dissolve before they ever hardened into lasting wounds. （议论文·人际和谐）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If 引导虚拟条件 + with honesty and grace 方式状语 + before they hardened into wounds 时间状语 + 隐喻升华

classPractice.question: 如果在你生命中你需要对一个人说对不起，那就去向他道歉吧。（用 apology）If there is someone in your life to whom you need to say sorry, go ahead and ____________.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】make an apology (for sth)=道歉(名词搭配)。

classPractice.question: She wanted to apologize ____ her friend ____ the misunderstanding.
classPractice.note: apologize to sb for sth：向某人（to）为某事（for）道歉；apologize 为不及物动词。

classPractice.question: 用 apology 的搭配填空：Deep down, Tom knew he ____ his sister an apology.
classPractice.note: owe sb an apology=欠某人一个道歉；此处用一般过去时 owed。

classPractice.question: 我写信是为上周五缺席小组会议真诚地道歉。（用 apologize for doing）
classPractice.answer: I am writing to apologize sincerely for missing the group meeting last Friday.
classPractice.note: apologize for doing sth；介词 for 后接动名词。

original_sentence: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
readingExamples: Perhaps she knows she's in the wrong and wants to apologize, or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the way that someone behaves, especially towards other people
(2) n. the way in which a person, animal, substance, machine, etc. acts in a particular situation or under particular conditions
(3) n. (technical) the way in which a system, chemical, or material naturally works or reacts

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (物质、系统的)运作方式，反应特性
uncommonMeanings.example: The physics teacher was fascinated less by the numbers than by the strange behaviour of light as it bent around the edge of the eclipse, refusing to travel in the straight lines the textbook had promised. （读后续写·科学探究·反常现象）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the new boy slammed his desk lid and stormed out, the whole class fell silent; such violent behaviour was so unlike the gentle friend they thought they knew that even the teacher hesitated at the door. （读后续写·同学冲突）

I am writing to appeal to every member of our community to reflect on our own behaviour in public places, for a single careless act of littering can undo the collective efforts of hundreds of volunteers. （应用文·倡议书）

Rather than punishing children for poor behaviour, wise educators guide them to understand the consequences of their choices, for genuine self-discipline can never be beaten into a person from the outside. （议论文·教育）

wordForms.other: 拼写差异：behaviour(英式) / behavior(美式)；behave (v. 举止、表现)；well-behaved (adj. 有教养的) / badly-behaved (adj. 行为不端的)；misbehave (v. 行为不端)；behaviour 为不可数名词，一般不加 -s

idioms.translation: (尤指在他人面前)表现得规规矩矩
idioms.example: Knowing that his grandmother's opinion could make or break the family reunion, Tom was on his best behaviour all afternoon, offering tea and holding his tongue even when his cousins teased him. （读后续写·家庭聚会）

collocations.translation: 对她行为的解释（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ...or maybe she has a simple explanation for her behaviour. ……或者也许她对自己的行为有个简单的解释。（课文原句）
The prisoner was released early for good behaviour. 那名囚犯因表现良好获得提前释放。
His cold behaviour towards the new student slowly thawed. 他对新同学冷淡的态度慢慢缓和了。
Teachers are trained to spot aggressive behaviour early. 老师们受过及早发现攻击性行为的训练。
Every athlete must sign a strict code of behaviour. 每名运动员都须签署严格的行为准则。
The environment profoundly shapes a child's behaviour. 环境深刻地塑造孩子的行为。
The parents chose to reward honest behaviour. 父母选择奖励诚实的行为。

collocations.translation: 反社会行为，妨害公共秩序的行为
collocations.example: The council launched a campaign to tackle antisocial behaviour, from graffiti on walls to noise that kept neighbours awake at night. （应用文·社区通知）
The scientist's increasingly erratic behaviour in the final weeks alarmed his colleagues, who had never seen him miss a single experiment before. （读后续写·人物变化）

synonyms.example: The committee praised the students' exemplary conduct throughout the international exchange, noting that they had been true ambassadors of their country. （应用文·表彰）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更书面，多指有道德或规则评判意味的行为，常见于议论文和正式通知；behaviour 更口语、覆盖面更广

synonyms.translation: 举止，态度(单数)；礼貌(manners 复数)
synonyms.example: There was something in the quiet, unhurried manner of the old gardener that put every anxious visitor instantly at ease. （读后续写·人物刻画）
synonyms.usage: manner(单数)指做某事的方式或神态，manners(复数)指礼貌；behaviour 更强调可观察到的一贯行为表现

synonyms.example: A positive attitude towards failure, rather than a fear of it, is what separates lifelong learners from those who give up. （议论文·成长心态）
synonyms.usage: 侧重内在的想法和心理倾向；behaviour 侧重外在可见的举动，二者常互为因果

advancedExpressions.expression: good/bad behaviour / behaviour towards sb / on one's best behaviour / an explanation for one's behaviour
advancedExpressions.example: She had a simple explanation for her behaviour, and after that day she was on her best behaviour. （课文 behaviour 延展搭配群）

advancedExpressions.expression: behaviour = conduct（较正式、含品行评判）= manner（举止神态）；态度倾向 = attitude
advancedExpressions.example: The committee praised the students' exemplary conduct, whose gentle manner reflected a respectful attitude. （由口语到正式，功能相近可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: behave (v.) → behaviour (n.) → behavioural (adj.)；well-behaved / misbehave
advancedExpressions.example: A well-behaved child who behaves kindly usually grows into a considerate adult—behaviour is learned, not born. （动、名、形词族＋复合词）

advancedExpressions.expression: behaviour 作"行为、举止"讲通常不可数，前不加 a，也不加 -s
advancedExpressions.example: Her behaviour was strange (√); a behaviours (✗). 用 much/such/his 修饰，不用 a。

advancedExpressions.expression: his behaviour betrayed the turmoil (that) his words tried to hide
advancedExpressions.example: His steady voice claimed he was fine, but his trembling hands and restless behaviour betrayed the turmoil his words tried to hide. （用行为反衬语言，制造反差张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: let our behaviour speak louder than our slogans
advancedExpressions.example: As we launch this environmental drive, let our behaviour speak louder than our slogans: bring your own cup, refuse plastic bags, and switch off idle lights. （呼吁段落，以行动号召收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: behaviour is not born but shaped by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Human behaviour is not born but shaped by the countless invisible influences of family, culture and circumstance — a truth that should make us slow to judge and quick to understand. （先破后立，引出宽容主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His behaviour surprised everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His behaviour that afternoon — so gentle where we had expected fury, so patient where we had braced for scorn — left the entire room speechless, as though a familiar stranger had suddenly stepped out from behind the boy we thought we knew. （读后续写·反差+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入语制造对比(so...where...) + 明喻(a familiar stranger) + 悬念铺垫

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should improve students' behaviour.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that lasting improvement in students' behaviour springs not from ever-stricter rules, but from a school culture in which respect is modelled, kindness is celebrated, and every child feels genuinely seen. （议论文·观点段）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...主句 + not from...but from...对比结构 + 三项被动排比(modelled, celebrated, seen)

classPractice.question: Maybe she has a simple explanation for her ____ (behave).
classPractice.note: 动词 behave → 名词 behaviour(英)/behavior(美)；此处为名词，不可数，呼应课文。

classPractice.question: 用 behaviour / behave 填空：Children who ____ well in class should be praised for their good ____.
classPractice.note: 第一空需动词 behave（举止表现），第二空需名词 behaviour；behaviour 不可数不加 -s。

classPractice.question: 他对新同学的冷淡态度慢慢缓和了。His cold ____ ____ (对……的态度) the new student gradually thawed.
classPractice.note: behaviour towards sb=对某人的态度／举止；towards 表对象。

translation: 具体情况，事例；案件；容器
original_sentence: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
readingExamples: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular situation or example of something
(2) n. a matter that is being officially investigated, especially by the police; a legal action decided in a court of law
(3) n. an instance of a disease or of someone having a disease
(4) n. a container or protective covering used for storing or carrying something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 案件；官司(a court case)
uncommonMeanings.example: The judge finally closed the murder case. 法官终于结了那桩谋杀案。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 箱子，盒子，容器(a suitcase / bookcase)
uncommonMeanings.example: She clutched the violin case to her chest. 她把小提琴盒紧紧抱在胸前。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (疾病的)病例，病案(a case of flu)
uncommonMeanings.example: Three new cases of flu were reported that week. 那周报告了三例新的流感病例。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (语法)格(如主格、宾格)
uncommonMeanings.example: Latin had baffled her for months, until the morning it finally clicked that every ending, every case, was simply the word quietly announcing its own job in the sentence. （读后续写·学习顿悟·语言）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 论据，理由，(支持某观点的)论证
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing before the school board, she laid out her case for a longer lunch break so calmly and so logically that even the sternest teacher found himself nodding. （读后续写·据理力争）

posExamples.sentence: In most cases the missing wallet turned up under a sofa cushion within the hour, but this time the whole house was turned upside down and still it seemed to have vanished into thin air. （读后续写·寻物悬念）
I would like to draw your attention to a specific case in our neighbourhood where the broken streetlight has already caused two elderly residents to trip in the dark. （应用文·投诉信）
The case for reading widely is overwhelming: it enlarges our vocabulary, sharpens our reasoning and, above all, teaches us to see the world through eyes other than our own. （议论文·阅读的价值）
She clutched the violin case to her chest as the train jolted forward, guarding the instrument that held a lifetime of her mother's dreams. （读后续写·物件与情感）

wordForms.other: casing (n. 外壳，套子), bookcase (n. 书架), staircase (n. 楼梯), suitcase (n. 手提箱)

idioms.example: The weather looked threatening, but in any case we had come too far to turn back now. （读后续写·坚持）
Take an umbrella in case it rains — the sky over the mountains can change its mind in minutes. （应用文·提醒）
She backed up every file twice, just in case; years of hard work were not something she was willing to gamble on. （读后续写·谨慎性格）
The prize will be awarded to the best essay or the best poem, as the case may be, depending on the quality of the entries. （应用文·比赛规则）
Perseverance often matters more than talent; the marathon runner who finished last but never stopped is a case in point. （议论文·举例）
"The library closes at five." "In that case, we'd better hurry." （读后续写·对话）

collocations.example: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her. 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。（课件·课文原句）
It may rain. You'd better take an umbrella (just) in case. 可能会下雨，你最好带把伞以防万一。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在这种情况下（引出结果）
collocations.example: You don't like your job? In this case, why don't you leave? 你不喜欢这份工作？既然这样，为什么不辞职呢？（课件·in this case/in that case 引出结果）
"The library closes at five." "In that case, we'd better hurry." “图书馆五点关门。”“既然那样，我们最好快点。”（课件）
In case of fire, ring the alarm bell. 万一失火，请按响警铃。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: in no case (= on no account)
collocations.translation: 【课件】在任何情况下决不（位于句首要部分倒装）
collocations.example: In no case should we prevent the students from exploring new ideas. 我们决不应该阻止学生探索新想法。（课件原句，in no case 置句首，主句部分倒装）

collocations.phrase: in the case of sb / sth
collocations.example: The rule applies to all, but in the case of children an exception is made. 规则适用于所有人，但就儿童而言有例外。
In most cases a sincere apology can mend a friendship. 在多数情况下，真诚的道歉能修复友谊。
It was a mild case of flu. 那是一次轻度流感。
The young lawyer won her first case. 那位年轻律师打赢了她的第一场官司。
The students made a strong case for planting more trees. 学生们为多种树提出了有力的论证。
The economics class devoted a whole week to a case study of how one small town revived its dying high street. （应用文·报告）

collocations.translation: 有力的／站不住脚的论据
collocations.example: However passionately he spoke, his weak case crumbled the moment his opponent asked for a single piece of evidence. （议论文·辩论）
You say you have no time to read; if that is the case, perhaps it is time we asked how those hours actually disappear. （议论文·反问）

synonyms.example: This is yet another instance of how a small act of kindness can ripple outward far beyond what its giver could ever imagine. （议论文·善举）
synonyms.usage: 更书面，纯指‘一个例子’；case 含义更广，还可指案件、病例、情况等

synonyms.example: Faced with an impossible situation, she took a deep breath and did the only thing she could — she asked for help. （读后续写·困境）
synonyms.usage: 指整体的‘处境、局面’，范围较大；case 更指某一具体的‘事例或情形’

synonyms.example: This is a serious matter that concerns the safety of every passenger and must not be brushed aside. （应用文·正式信函）
synonyms.usage: 泛指‘需处理的事情’；case 更常指‘一起具体的、可被调查或分析的事例’

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case 无论如何 / in case 以防万一 / in this case 在这种情况下 / in that case 既然那样 / in case of + n. 万一遇到 / in no case = on no account 在任何情况下决不
advancedExpressions.example: In any case, take an umbrella in case it rains; in that case you won't catch cold, and in no case should you get soaked. （课件·六个 case 短语一起辨析，in no case 置句首需部分倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in no case 置句首部分倒装（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: in no case = on no account（在任何情况下决不），位于句首时其后主句用部分倒装
advancedExpressions.example: In no case should we give up. 我们决不应该放弃。（课件·否定副词短语提前，助动词提到主语前）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in case vs in case of
advancedExpressions.expression: in case + 从句(句子)；in case of + 名词(短语)；in case 亦可用于虚拟(should)
advancedExpressions.example: In case you forget = 以防你忘记(接句子)；In case of fire, break the glass = 万一失火(接名词)。

advancedExpressions.expression: case = instance / situation / matter（据语境选用）
advancedExpressions.example: This is a clear case—indeed an instance—of how one small kindness can change a whole situation. （功能相近，case 覆盖面最广）

advancedExpressions.expression: case → suitcase(手提箱) / bookcase(书架) / staircase(楼梯) / briefcase(公文包) / casing(外壳)
advancedExpressions.example: He packed his suitcase, took a book from the bookcase, and climbed the staircase. （合成词记忆链）

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case, there was no turning back now
advancedExpressions.example: The bridge behind them had collapsed into the flood; in any case, there was no turning back now, and something in her hardened into resolve. （用固定短语推动情节、强化破釜沉舟感）

advancedExpressions.expression: in case ..., it would be wise to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In case the outdoor venue is rained out, it would be wise to reserve the school hall in advance so that the charity concert can go ahead regardless. （建议信中体现周全考虑）

advancedExpressions.expression: a case in point is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Great discoveries often spring from idle curiosity rather than grim ambition; a case in point is Fleming, whose careless glance at a mouldy dish gave the world penicillin. （引出典型论据，衔接自然）

advancedExpressions.expression: in case 以防 / in any case 无论如何 / in case of 万一(遇到) / in that case 既然那样 / in the case of 就……而言
advancedExpressions.example: In any case, take a coat in case of rain; in that case you won't catch cold. （课文 in any case 与四个易混短语一起辨析）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Anyway, we decided to go.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In any case, whatever doubts still gnawed at us, we shouldered our packs and stepped onto the misty trail — for some decisions, once made in the heart, refuse to be unmade by the mind. （读后续写·下定决心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in any case 短语开头 + 让步状语(whatever...) + 破折号哲理升华 + for引导原因从句

sentenceUpgrade.original: There are many reasons to protect the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The case for protecting our environment could hardly be stronger: every forest we save is a lung for the planet, every river we cleanse a lifeline for generations we shall never meet. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: make a case 的名词化(The case for...) + 冒号展开 + 隐喻(lung, lifeline) + 排比对称

classPractice.type: 语境应用·case 短语填空(课件)
classPractice.question: 用 case 短语填空：(1) You don't like your job? ____, why don't you leave? (2) It may rain. You'd better take an umbrella (just) ____ (it does). (3) I don't see why I couldn't do it. ____, I'm going to try. (4) We should ____ prevent the students from exploring new ideas. (5) ____ fire, ring the alarm bell.
classPractice.answer: (1) In that case (2) in case (3) In any case (4) in no case (5) In case of
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】in that case=既然那样；in case=以防万一（接从句）；in any case=无论如何；in no case=在任何情况下决不（此处非句首，故不倒装）；in case of=万一遇到（接名词）。

classPractice.question: 用 in case / in any case / in case of / in that case 各填一处：(1) Take an umbrella ____ it rains. (2) ____, we had come too far to turn back. (3) ____ fire, break the glass. (4) "The train is delayed." "____, let's have coffee."
classPractice.answer: (1) in case (2) In any case (3) In case of (4) In that case
classPractice.note: in case+从句(以防)；in any case=无论如何；in case of+名词(万一遇到)；in that case=既然那样。

classPractice.question: In any ____ (case), find a chance to talk with her honestly.
classPractice.note: in any case=无论如何，固定短语；呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 case 的合适义项判断：The doctor confirmed it was a mild ____ of flu, so there was no need to worry.
classPractice.note: a case of + 疾病=一例（某病）；此处 case 表"病例"。

original_sentence: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
readingExamples: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. whatever happens or is true; regardless of other considerations
(2) phr. used to add a further point that supports or strengthens what you have just said
(3) phr. used to say that a previous statement is unimportant because the situation is different from what was expected

posExamples.sentence: The old ferryman warned us that the crossing might be rough, but in any case we had a train to catch on the far shore, so we climbed aboard and gripped the rail. （读后续写·冒险抉择）
The trip has been carefully planned; in any case, our teacher will be with us at every stage, so parents need not worry about their children's safety. （应用文·致家长信）
Talent may open a door, but in any case it is discipline that decides how far one walks through it. （议论文·努力与天赋）

collocations.phrase: In any case, find an opportunity to ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】无论如何，找个机会去……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her. 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: in any case (= whatever happens or may have happened)
collocations.example: I don't see why I couldn't do it. In any case, I'm going to try. 我不明白为什么我做不了。无论如何，我都要试试。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 无论如何，……(句首引出结论)
collocations.example: In any case, I had made up my mind to walk the whole route. 无论如何，我已下定决心走完全程。
It was too late to change the plan, in any case. 反正现在改计划也太晚了。

collocations.phrase: in any case, it is worth ...
collocations.example: In any case, it is worth trying. 无论如何，这值得一试。

synonyms.example: The forecast promised rain, but we set off anyway, laughing at the grey sky as if daring it to spoil our day. （读后续写·乐观）
synonyms.usage: 更口语、更随意，多用于日常对话和续写叙事；in any case 略正式，议论文和应用文中都能用

synonyms.example: I may have failed the interview, but at any rate I walked out of that room braver than I walked in. （读后续写·自我安慰）
synonyms.usage: 语气与 in any case 相近，常用来引出一个确定的、退而求其次的结论，稍偏书面口语

synonyms.example: Her parents disapproved, her friends doubted her, yet she pursued her dream regardless. （读后续写·坚持自我）
synonyms.usage: 更强调‘不顾一切、不受影响’，常单独置于句末或接 of；in any case 侧重‘无论前提如何，结论不变’

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case 无论如何 / in case 以防万一 / in this case、in that case 既然/在这种情况下 / in case of 万一遇到 / in no case = on no account 决不
advancedExpressions.example: In any case we will go early, in case it rains; in that case we can shelter indoors, but in no case will we cancel. （课件·in any case 与同族短语一并辨析）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·辨析 in any case vs in case（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: in any case=无论如何(让步、下结论)；in case=以防(引出预防措施)，二者含义不同
advancedExpressions.example: In any case we will go（无论如何都去）≠ We'll go early in case it rains（早点走以防下雨）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in any case（位置灵活）
advancedExpressions.expression: 句首 In any case, ... / 句末 ..., in any case（均为插入语，用逗号隔开）
advancedExpressions.example: In any case, we set off; the weather was clearing, in any case. （课文用句首式，句末式亦常见）

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case = anyway（口语）= at any rate = regardless / whatever happens
advancedExpressions.example: The forecast promised rain, but we set off anyway; at any rate, in any case, we refused to waste the day. （功能相近可替换，语体由口语到书面）

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case, the decision was made
advancedExpressions.example: In any case, the decision was made, and there was a strange lightness in her chest now that the endless wavering was finally over. （用短语一锤定音，收束犹豫段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: in any case, you can rest assured that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In any case, you can rest assured that every safety measure has been put in place, and an experienced guide will accompany the group throughout. （通知／回信中安抚对方）

advancedExpressions.expression: opinions may differ, but in any case ...
advancedExpressions.example: Opinions on technology may differ sharply, but in any case one truth remains: it is how we use a tool, not the tool itself, that shapes our future. （承认分歧后亮出核心观点）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·辨析 in any case vs in case
advancedExpressions.expression: in any case=无论如何(让步、下结论)；in case=以防(引出预防措施)，二者含义不同
advancedExpressions.example: In any case we will go（无论如何都去）≠ We'll go early in case it rains（早点走以防下雨）。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Anyway, I decided to help her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In any case, whatever the others whispered behind their hands, I crossed the room and offered her my seat — some kindnesses are too simple to need a reason. （读后续写·善意选择）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in any case 提升语域 + 让步状语从句(whatever...) + 具体动作(crossed, offered) + 破折号点题

sentenceUpgrade.original: In any case, we should try our best.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In any case, whether victory or defeat awaits us at the finish line, we owe it to ourselves to give everything we have — for effort, unlike outcome, is the one thing entirely within our power. （议论文·尽力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in any case + 二选一让步(whether...or...) + owe it to oneself 表达责任 + for引导哲理升华

classPractice.type: 语境应用·case 短语填空(课件)
classPractice.question: 用 case 短语填空：I don't see why I couldn't do it. ____, I'm going to try.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】in any case=无论如何（让步、下结论），作句首插入语。

classPractice.question: 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。（用 in any case）
classPractice.answer: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文；in any case 置于句首作插入语，后接祈使句。

classPractice.question: 用 in any case / in case 填空：Bring some cash ____ the shop doesn't take cards; ____, cash is always handy.
classPractice.note: 第一空 in case=以防（接从句）；第二空 in any case=无论如何（下结论）。

classPractice.question: We were tired, but we finished the job anyway. → We were tired, but we finished the job ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: in any case ≈ anyway，表"无论如何、反正"，此处置于句末。

original_sentence: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
readingExamples: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. honest and direct in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like
(2) adj. (of a look, expression, etc.) open and showing what you really think or feel
(3) adj. (of a situation or fact) clear and obvious, not hidden

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (在信件上)盖免费邮资印记，免费邮寄
uncommonMeanings.example: Back when he served in the army, every letter home was franked at the post office, and his mother kept each stamped envelope in a shoebox as if it were made of gold. （读后续写·家书·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: To be perfectly frank, I had never trusted the smiling stranger, and when he vanished with the charity box that evening, a bitter I-told-you-so rose in my throat. （读后续写·识人）
I would like to offer you my frank opinion of the proposed timetable, in the sincere hope that a few honest words now will spare us much confusion later. （应用文·建议信）
A frank acknowledgement of one's mistakes, far from being a sign of weakness, is in truth the surest mark of a mature and confident mind. （议论文·诚实与成长）

idioms.example: To be frank with you, the plan is far too risky, and I would rather lose your favour now than lead the whole team into disaster later. （读后续写·忠言）
Frankly speaking, no amount of last-minute cramming can replace the quiet, patient study of an entire term. （议论文·学习方法）

collocations.translation: 【课件】坦白讲，说实话（常用作插入语）
collocations.example: To be frank with you, I don't think she's the person for the job. 坦白说，我认为她不是这份工作的合适人选。（课件原句）
In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her. 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一次开诚布公的谈话（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and frank talk with her. 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。（课文原句）
Father and son finally sat down for a frank talk. 父子俩终于坐下来坦诚交谈。
I promised to be frank with my best friend. 我保证对我最好的朋友坦诚相待。
The manager was frank about the company's difficulties. 经理对公司的困难直言不讳。
The editor gave her a frank assessment of the manuscript. 编辑对她的稿子给出了坦率的评价。
The two class representatives held a frank exchange of views before the debate, agreeing to disagree without letting rivalry poison their friendship. （应用文·活动纪要）
In a good friendship, being frank and honest matters far more than always saying what the other person hopes to hear. （议论文·真诚）
His frank admission that he had cheated in the qualifier surprised the judges, but it also earned him a respect that a stolen victory never could. （读后续写·诚实的代价）

synonyms.example: An honest answer, however uncomfortable, is a gift; a flattering lie is only a debt to be repaid later. （议论文·诚实）
synonyms.usage: 范围最广，泛指‘不撒谎、正直’；frank 更强调‘直率、直说不隐瞒’，可能因太直白而刺耳

synonyms.example: In a rare candid moment, the champion admitted that fear, not confidence, had driven every one of her early victories. （读后续写·内心独白）
synonyms.usage: 书面、正式，与 frank 意思几乎相同，但更典雅，常修饰 admission、interview、moment

synonyms.translation: 直言不讳的，敢于直言的
synonyms.example: She was the most outspoken student in the class, never afraid to challenge a teacher when she believed a mistake had been made. （读后续写·性格）
synonyms.usage: 侧重‘公开、大胆地表达(尤指有争议的)看法’，带勇气色彩；frank 侧重‘诚实不掩饰’，语气更中性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·不定式作插入语(独立成分)——课件重点
advancedExpressions.expression: to be frank (with you) 作插入语；同类不定式插入语：to tell the truth = to be honest（说实话）/ to be exact（确切地说）/ to conclude（总而言之）/ to be brief（简言之）/ to be specific（具体来说）
advancedExpressions.example: To be frank, the plan won't work; to be exact, it lacks a budget; and to conclude, we need a fresh start. （课件·此类不定式作句子状语，逻辑主语无需与主句一致，用逗号与主句隔开）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达·to be frank = frankly speaking（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: to be frank (with you) = frankly speaking = to be honest = to tell the truth（坦白/老实说，均作插入语）
advancedExpressions.example: Frankly speaking / To be frank, I had never trusted him from the very start. （课件·插入语可互换，语气略有正式与口语之别）

advancedExpressions.expression: a frank talk / be frank with sb / be frank about sth / to be frank (with you) / frankly speaking
advancedExpressions.example: To be frank with you, we need a full and frank talk about what went wrong. （课文 a frank talk 延展搭配群）

advancedExpressions.expression: frank = honest（诚实，最广）= candid（正式典雅）= outspoken（敢于直言，带勇气色彩）
advancedExpressions.example: In a rare candid moment she was honest and outspoken, giving me her frank opinion at last. （功能相近，语气由中性到大胆）

advancedExpressions.expression: frank (adj.) → frankly (adv.) → frankness (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: Her frankness moved me, for she spoke frankly where others only flattered. （形容词加 -ly 变副词、加 -ness 变名词）

advancedExpressions.expression: with a frankness that surprised even herself, she admitted ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a frankness that surprised even herself, she admitted that jealousy, not concern, had made her cruel — and the confession lifted a weight she had carried for years. （用抽象名词 frankness 前置，刻画心理松动）

advancedExpressions.expression: may I be frank and suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: May I be frank and suggest that, however popular the idea seems, a two-day trip may leave us too little time to enjoy any single place properly? （建议信中礼貌地提出不同意见）

advancedExpressions.expression: to be frank costs courage, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: To be frank costs courage, yet it is precisely this courage — the willingness to speak an unwelcome truth — that friendship, and indeed society, most desperately needs. （承认代价后强化观点）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·to be frank 作独立成分
advancedExpressions.expression: to be frank (with you) / frankly speaking 为句子状语，与主句主语无需一致，置于句首用逗号隔开
advancedExpressions.example: To be frank, I disagree. / Frankly speaking, the idea won't work. （独立成分，不做谓语）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He told me the truth honestly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He looked me straight in the eye and, with a frankness I had rarely met, told me the very thing I most dreaded and most needed to hear — and in that painful honesty I found, unexpectedly, a friend for life. （读后续写·真诚打动人心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作细节(looked me straight in the eye) + with a frankness 状语 + most dreaded and most needed 对照 + 破折号情感升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should be frank with each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my conviction that only when we dare to be frank with one another — trading comfortable silence for honest words — can a friendship grow deep enough to weather any storm. （议论文·坦诚的价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my conviction that...主句 + only when...倒装强调 + 破折号对比(silence vs words) + weather any storm 隐喻

classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ with you, I don't think she's the person for the job.（用 frank 完成插入语）
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】to be frank (with you)=坦白说，作插入语，frank 用原级形容词。

classPractice.question: 无论如何，找个机会和她开诚布公地谈一谈。In any case, find an opportunity to have a full and ____ ____ (坦诚的谈话) with her.
classPractice.note: a frank talk=坦诚的谈话；呼应课文 full and frank talk。

classPractice.question: To be ____ (frank), I think the plan needs a lot more work.
classPractice.note: to be frank=老实说，固定独立成分，frank 用形容词原级。

classPractice.question: 用 frank 的词族填空：She spoke ____ (frank) about her mistakes, and such ____ (frank) won everyone's respect.
classPractice.note: 第一空修饰动词 spoke 用副词 frankly；第二空作主语用名词 frankness。

original_sentence: I definitely understand how you feel.
readingExamples: I definitely understand how you feel.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. without any doubt; certainly (used to emphasize that something is true or that you are sure about it)
(2) adv. in a way that is certain to happen or has been firmly decided
(3) adv. (in reply) yes, certainly (used to give a strong, enthusiastic answer)

posExamples.sentence: As the last runner crossed the line, the coach knew definitely, beyond the faintest shadow of doubt, that these ordinary boys had just done something extraordinary. （读后续写·比赛高潮）
I can definitely assure you that every donation, however small, will go directly to the flood-stricken families and not a single cent will be lost along the way. （应用文·募捐信）
Reading widely is definitely one of the most reliable paths to a rich inner life, for it lets us live a thousand lives within the span of one. （议论文·阅读）

wordForms.noun: definiteness (确定性) / definition (定义，清晰度)
wordForms.adjective: definite (明确的，确定的) / indefinite (不确定的)
wordForms.other: 词族链：define (v.) → definition (n.) → definite (adj.) → definitely (adv.)；注意拼写 defin-i-tely（无 a）；反义前缀 in-：indefinite / indefinitely

collocations.translation: 完全理解你的感受（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I definitely understand how you feel. 我完全理解你的感受。（课文原句）
"Would you give up now?" "Definitely not." "你现在会放弃吗？""绝对不会。"
I will definitely repay your kindness one day. 总有一天我一定会报答你的恩情。
The sunrise was definitely worth the long climb. 那日出绝对值得这一路的攀登。
Hiring a guide is definitely the safest choice. 请一位向导肯定是最安全的选择。
It was definitely one of my best summers. 那绝对是我最美好的夏天之一。
Nobody knew definitely what lay beyond the misty ridge, and it was that very mystery that made the boys' hearts race. （读后续写·探险悬念）

synonyms.example: Certainly, no one expected the quiet boy at the back to deliver the finest speech of the whole afternoon. （读后续写·出人意料）
synonyms.usage: 与 definitely 意思接近，语气略正式、稍柔和；definitely 更口语、更强调‘毫无疑问、板上钉钉’

synonyms.example: Undoubtedly, the greatest lesson that year taught me was that failure is not the opposite of success but a step towards it. （议论文·失败）
synonyms.usage: 书面、正式，多用于议论文开篇亮明确定观点；definitely 更多用于口语和续写的坚定语气

synonyms.example: "Are you sure about this?" "Absolutely," she replied, her voice steady as stone. （读后续写·斩钉截铁）
synonyms.usage: 语气最强，常单独作答，表‘百分之百肯定’；definitely 也可作答，但 absolutely 更绝对、更有力

advancedExpressions.expression: definitely not / will definitely do / definitely worth doing / definitely one of the ...
advancedExpressions.example: "Give up?" "Definitely not." This trip was definitely one of the best decisions I had ever made. （课文 definitely 延展强调搭配群）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·肯定地、无疑地
advancedExpressions.expression: definitely = certainly（略正式柔和）= undoubtedly（书面）= absolutely（语气最强，可单独作答）
advancedExpressions.example: "Sure?" "Absolutely." Reading is definitely—indeed undoubtedly—one of life's great pleasures. （功能相近，语体由口语到书面）

advancedExpressions.expression: define (v.) → definition (n.) → definite (adj.) → definitely (adv.)；反义 indefinite / indefinitely
advancedExpressions.example: The rules were definite and clearly defined, so nobody was left in indefinite doubt. （动、名、形、副全家桶）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·definitely 强调副词的位置
advancedExpressions.expression: definitely 多置于实义动词前、系动词/助动词后，用于加强肯定语气
