advancedExpressions.example: I definitely understand（实义动词前）；It is definitely true（系动词后）；I will definitely go（助动词后）。（课文即"助动词/情态省略 + definitely + 动词"）

advancedExpressions.expression: one thing was definitely certain: ...
advancedExpressions.example: The road ahead was a blur of unknowns, but one thing was definitely certain: whatever it cost her, she would not abandon the dog she had promised to save. （用 definitely 强化决心，制造与不确定的对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: I can definitely assure you that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I can definitely assure you that the funds will be handled with complete transparency, and a detailed report will be sent to every contributor. （回信中给出可靠保证）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and this is definitely no exaggeration
advancedExpressions.example: A single inspiring teacher can redirect the whole course of a child's life, and this is definitely no exaggeration. （论证后加固语气，增强说服力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was sure I could win.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I stared down the empty track, one thought burned definitely bright in my mind, silencing every whisper of doubt: this race, at long last, was going to be mine. （读后续写·赛前决心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境铺垫(stared down the track) + definitely 强化确信 + 冒号引出内心宣言 + 拟人(whisper of doubt)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Honesty is very important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Honesty, I would argue, is definitely the foundation on which all lasting trust is built — for once a lie cracks that foundation, no amount of charm can ever make it whole again. （议论文·诚实的根基）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I would argue 插入语 + definitely 加强断言 + 隐喻(foundation) + for引导因果+ 强化对比(cracks vs whole)

classPractice.question: I ____ (definite) understand how you feel, so please don't blame yourself.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 understand 需副词 definitely；由形容词 definite 加 -ly；呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 definite / definitely 填空：We need a ____ answer, and I can ____ promise to give you one by Friday.
classPractice.note: 第一空修饰名词 answer 用形容词 definite；第二空修饰动词 promise 用副词 definitely。

classPractice.question: 那次辛苦的攀登绝对值得。（用 definitely worth）
classPractice.answer: The tough climb was definitely worth it.
classPractice.note: definitely worth doing/worth it=绝对值得；definitely 加强肯定语气。

translation: 欺骗，欺诈 | n. 诡计，花招；戏法
original_sentence: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt and let go of our friendship.
readingExamples: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt and let go of our friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to deceive someone in order to get something from them or to make them do something
(2) n. something you do to deceive someone or to make someone believe something that is not true
(3) n. a clever or skilful action or scheme that achieves a particular result, especially an unexpected one
(4) n. an act of skill performed to entertain, such as a magic trick or an acrobatic feat

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】窍门，诀窍（常作 the trick）
uncommonMeanings.example: The trick is to pick the animal up by the back of its neck. 窍门是抓住动物脖子后部把它拎起来。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 诀窍，窍门(常作 the trick)
uncommonMeanings.example: The old carpenter smiled and showed the boy the trick of it: not brute force, but a patient wrist and a listening ear for the grain of the wood. （读后续写·师徒传艺·诀窍）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (牌戏中)一圈牌，一墩
uncommonMeanings.example: With the very last card she won the final trick, and the quiet triumph in her grandfather's eyes was worth more to her than the game itself. （读后续写·亲情·打牌）

posExamples.sentence: When I realised the smooth-talking salesman had tricked my grandmother into buying a useless machine, a hot wave of anger rose in me, and I vowed to get her money back. （读后续写·维护家人）
I am writing to warn all fellow students of a common online trick in which fraudsters pose as teachers to steal login details and personal information. （应用文·警示通知）
There is no magic trick to mastering a language; steady, daily effort, however dull it may seem, is the only reliable road to fluency. （议论文·学习）
The street performer's final trick left the crowd gasping, for the coin that had vanished from his empty palm reappeared, impossibly, behind a child's ear. （读后续写·街头表演）

wordForms.noun: trick, trickery (n. 欺骗，骗术), trickster (n. 骗子)
wordForms.adjective: tricky (adj. 棘手的；狡猾的), trickish

idioms.translation: 行业诀窍，做某事的窍门
idioms.example: Over thirty years at the market stall, the old woman had learned every one of the tricks of the trade, and she passed them on to her granddaughter one patient morning at a time. （读后续写·传承）
The coach tried every trick in the book to lift the exhausted team's spirits before the final quarter. （读后续写·激励）
Spreading that rumour was a dirty trick, and it left a stain on their friendship that no apology could fully wash away. （读后续写·背叛）

idioms.idiom: play a trick / tricks on sb
idioms.example: His classmates loved to play tricks on the new boy, until the day he laughed hardest of all and, just like that, became one of them. （读后续写·融入集体）
A cup of hot ginger tea and an early night usually did the trick whenever a cold threatened to ruin her exams. （读后续写·生活智慧）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(v.) 欺骗，欺诈（以巧妙的方式）骗某人做某事（to deceive sb in order to get sth）
collocations.example: He tricked me into lending him £100. 他骗我借给了他100英镑。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: play a trick / tricks on sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】(n. 诡计，花招) 捉弄某人，耍花招
collocations.example: The kids are always playing tricks on their teacher. 孩子们总是捉弄他们的老师。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: play tricks on sb (记忆紊乱)
collocations.translation: 【课件】(记忆等) 紊乱起来，捉弄某人
collocations.example: One of the problems of old age is that your memory can start to play tricks on you. 老年人的问题之一是记忆可能紊乱起来。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: the trick is to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】(n. 窍门，诀窍) 诀窍就是……
collocations.example: The trick is to pick the animal up by the back of its neck. 窍门是抓住动物脖子后部把它拎起来。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(tricky adj.) 微妙的局势，棘手的情况（difficult to deal with）
collocations.example: They had to handle a tricky situation with great care. 他们不得不非常小心地处理这一微妙的局势。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 被某人欺骗（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt. 当我发现自己被他骗了时，我真的很受伤。（课文原句）
A cup of hot ginger tea usually does the trick. 一杯热姜茶通常就管用了。

collocations.translation: 陷阱问题，故意误导人的问题
collocations.example: Be careful — that was a trick question. 小心，那是个陷阱问题。
She could hardly believe that a stranger's smile had tricked her out of a month's wages in a single afternoon. （读后续写·受骗）
The birthday party lit up the moment the magician pulled off a magic trick that turned an empty hat into a fluttering white dove. （读后续写·节日）
Winning an argument with a cheap trick may feel clever for a moment, but it costs you the one thing worth having — respect. （议论文·辩论道德）
She discovered a clever trick for remembering long lists: turning each item into a vivid picture in an imaginary house. （应用文·学习分享）
His only party trick was balancing a spoon on his nose, yet somehow it never failed to break the ice with strangers. （读后续写·社交）
Do not underestimate the quiet old gardener — after fifty springs among these roses, he knows a trick or two that no book can teach. （读后续写·人物）

synonyms.example: He had deceived everyone around him for years, but the one person he could never deceive, in the end, was himself. （读后续写·良心）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，泛指‘用谎言使人相信假象’；trick(v.)更口语，强调‘用花招骗人做某事或骗取某物’，常接 into / out of

synonyms.example: You may fool some people for a while, but a lie, like smoke, always finds its way out into the open at last. （议论文·诚实）
synonyms.usage: 口语，强调‘使人上当、显得愚蠢’；与 trick 意思相近，但 trick 更突出‘用计谋、有具体手段’

synonyms.example: Rather than cheat his way to an easy victory, he chose the harder road of honest effort and slept soundly for it. （议论文·诚信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重‘为私利而违反规则或坑骗他人(尤指钱财、考试)’；trick 更侧重‘用巧计诱使’，不一定涉及规则

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·tricky 微妙的/棘手的
advancedExpressions.expression: trick(v./n.) → tricky(adj. 微妙的，棘手的，狡猾的)：a tricky situation / question
advancedExpressions.example: It was a tricky situation, and one careless word could have ruined everything. （课件 tricky = difficult to deal with 微妙的、难处理的）

advancedExpressions.expression: be tricked by sb / play a trick on sb / do the trick / trick sb into doing sth
advancedExpressions.example: He was tricked by a false friend; they played a trick on him; a kind word did the trick; she tricked him into signing. （一词打包：受骗、戏弄、奏效、诱骗）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·欺骗（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: trick / deceive / fool / cheat sb
advancedExpressions.example: The salesman tricked / deceived / fooled / cheated the old lady out of her savings. （四词均可表"欺骗"，语体与侧重不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: trick(v./n.) → tricky(adj. 棘手的/狡猾的) → trickery(n. 骗术) → trickster(n. 骗子)
advancedExpressions.example: The tricky problem was clearly a trickster's clever trickery. （同根派生一起记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·find out that + 从句
advancedExpressions.expression: When I found out that I was tricked by him, ...
advancedExpressions.example: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt. （课文句式：find out that 引导宾语从句 + 被动 be tricked）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment I realised I had been tricked, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment I realised I had been tricked, the warm glow of the afternoon curdled into cold fury, and I set off after him with a determination I did not know I possessed. （用被动 be tricked 引爆情绪转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: do not be tricked by ...; always ...
advancedExpressions.example: Do not be tricked by messages promising easy money or free prizes; always verify the sender and, when in doubt, tell a trusted adult at once. （警示信中给出具体建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no trick, no shortcut — only ...
advancedExpressions.example: When it comes to earning genuine respect, there is no trick, no shortcut, no clever scheme — only the slow, honest accumulation of deeds that speak for themselves. （否定排比，强调无捷径）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I found out he had tricked me and felt hurt.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last I pieced the truth together and understood that the friend I had trusted most had tricked me all along, something inside me quietly broke — and in the silence that followed, I let go of the friendship I had once believed unbreakable. （读后续写·失望与放手）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语层层推进(When at last...) + trick 的被动过去完成时 + quietly broke 心理描写 + 破折号+对比(unbreakable) 收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: There is no easy way to succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Let us be honest: there is no magic trick to success, no secret shortcut hidden from the crowd — only the unglamorous, day-after-day discipline that the impatient are never willing to pay. （议论文·成功无捷径）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Let us be honest 呼告 + no...no...only 否定排比 + magic trick / shortcut 具象化 + 破折号强调核心观点

classPractice.question: 他骗我借给了他100英镑。He ____ me ____ ____ him £100.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；trick sb into doing sth 骗某人做某事，into 后接动名词

classPractice.question: 老年人的问题之一是记忆可能紊乱起来。One of the problems of old age is that your memory can start to ____ ____ ____ you.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；play tricks on sb 此处指"(记忆)紊乱、捉弄"，tricks 用复数

classPractice.question: 窍门是抓住动物脖子后部把它拎起来。The ____ is to pick the animal up by the back of its neck.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；the trick is to do sth 诀窍/窍门就是……，此处 trick 意为"窍门"

classPractice.question: 当我发现自己被他骗了时，我真的很受伤。When I found out that I ____ ____ by him, I was really hurt.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；trick 作动词的被动语态 be tricked "被欺骗"

classPractice.question: A good night's sleep and a hot meal usually ____ the ____ when he feels run down.
classPractice.note: do the trick 奏效、管用；主语第三人称单数用 does，此处 sleep and meal 复数用 do

classPractice.question: The clever thief ____ (trick) the old man into giving away his bank card, which shocked the whole neighbourhood.
classPractice.note: trick sb into doing sth 骗某人做某事；句意为过去，用一般过去时

original_sentence: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt and let go of our friendship.
readingExamples: When I found out that I was tricked by him, I was really hurt and let go of our friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to stop holding something or someone with your hands
(2) phr. v. to stop trying to keep, control, or possess something
(3) phr. v. to accept that a relationship, feeling, or period of your life is over and move on emotionally
(4) phr. v. to give up or abandon (an idea, grievance, or attachment)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 解雇，辞退（=let sb. go）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the factory finally had to let go of a third of its workforce, the old foreman shook each man's hand at the gate, unable to meet their eyes. （读后续写·经济困境·人物尊严）

posExamples.sentence: Her fingers, white with strain, refused to let go of the rope, even as her arms trembled and the cliff edge crumbled beneath her feet — she would not fall, not today. （读后续写·危机时刻·动作描写）
I have come to realise that in order to grow, we must sometimes let go of the resentment we cling to, for it poisons the one who carries it far more than the one who caused it. （应用文·感悊信/回信）
Those who cannot let go of past failures are doomed to be imprisoned by them; genuine progress begins only when we release our grip on what we can no longer change. （议论文·成长与释怀）
As the balloon slipped from the little girl's hand and drifted skyward, she did not cry; instead she waved, having chosen to let go of it with a smile rather than a scream. （读后续写·童年·情感成长）

idioms.example: Standing before his father's grave, he finally let go of the past — the years of silence, the words unsaid — and whispered a long-overdue goodbye. （读后续写·和解·情感升华）

collocations.translation: 【课件】放弃，摒弃；松手，放开（一词四义，据语境辨析）
collocations.example: Let go of my hand, you're hurting me! 放开我的手，你弄疼我了！（松手/放开）| You need to let go of the past and forgive those who have hurt you. 你需要放下过去，原谅那些伤害过你的人。（放弃/摒弃）（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: let go of (松手·具体) / let go of (放弃摒弃·抽象)
collocations.translation: 【课件·含义辨析】同一短语在不同语境的四层含义
collocations.example: 1) Let go of my hand! 放开（松手）2) She refused to let go of her bag. 她不肯松开她的包。（放开）3) Hold on tight and don't let go! 抓紧，别松手！（松手）4) You need to let go of the past. 你需要放下过去。（放弃，摒弃）（课件【语境应用】原题四句）

collocations.translation: 放弃、摒弃这段友谊（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I was really hurt and let go of our friendship. 我真的很受伤，于是放弃了我们的友谊。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: let go of the rope / handle / rail
collocations.example: "Don't let go of the rail!" the guide shouted over the roar of the waterfall, but by then it was too late. （读后续写·探险·紧张场面）
Reluctantly, the mother let go of her son's small hand at the school gate, watching him disappear into a new chapter of his life. （读后续写·亲情·离别）

collocations.phrase: let go of a dream / an idea
collocations.example: Despite years of rejection, she refused to let go of her dream of becoming a novelist, and one grey morning a publisher's letter finally proved her right. （读后续写·励志·坚持）

collocations.phrase: let go of anger / resentment / grudges
collocations.example: Learning to let go of anger is not a sign of weakness but of remarkable inner strength. （议论文·情绪管理）
The moment she let go of the fear that had held her back for years, her voice rang out clear and steady across the silent auditorium. （读后续写·演讲·突破自我）
Good parents must learn to let go, allowing their children the freedom to stumble, fail, and ultimately find their own path. （应用文·家庭教育·观点）
A truly effective leader knows when to let go of control and trust the team to rise to the occasion. （议论文·领导力）

collocations.phrase: find it hard to let go of
collocations.example: Even after decades abroad, he found it hard to let go of the accent, the recipes, and the small rituals of his hometown. （读后续写·乡愁）

synonyms.example: With a deep breath, she released the tension in her shoulders and the grip on her worn suitcase, ready at last to begin again. （读后续写·释然）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面；既可指松开物体，也可指释放情绪，续写中比 let go of 更凝练

synonyms.example: He was tempted to give up halfway through the marathon, but the cheers of the crowd carried him across the finish line. （读后续写·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 侧重停止努力或戒除，含消极意味；let go of 更强调情感上的释怀与放手，不必然消极

synonyms.example: The retiring chairman gracefully relinquished his authority, confident that a new generation would carry the company forward. （议论文·交接与传承）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式，多指放弃权力、地位、权利；议论文/正式文体用之显得高级

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·let go (of) 一词四义辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: let go of + 具体物体(松手/放开) vs let go of + 抽象名词(放弃/摒弃)；let go 不带 of 作不及物(松手)
advancedExpressions.example: Let go of my hand!（松手）| She refused to let go of her bag.（放开）| Don't let go!（松手，不及物）| Let go of the past.（放弃，摒弃）（课件同一短语按宾语抽象/具体辨义）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·let go of 一词多用
advancedExpressions.expression: let go of the rope（松手·具体）/ let go of the past / anger（释怀·抽象）/ let go of sb（解雇）
advancedExpressions.example: She let go of the rope; he let go of the past; the firm had to let go of some staff. （从"松开物体"到"情感释怀"到"解雇"一起记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·放开/放弃（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: let go of / release / give up / relinquish
advancedExpressions.example: It was time to let go of / release / give up the plan she had clung to for years. （四者均含"放开、放弃"，正式度递增）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·let go of 后接名词
advancedExpressions.expression: let go of + n.（宾语），不说 let go of to do
advancedExpressions.example: I let go of our friendship. （固定短语 let go of 后直接跟名词宾语；"松手"义也可只说 let go）

advancedExpressions.expression: only by letting go of ... could sb. finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only by letting go of the guilt she had carried for so long could she finally look at her reflection and forgive the girl staring back. （倒装+抽象名词具象化，续写结尾释怀升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would gently encourage you to let go of ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would gently encourage you to let go of the blame you place upon yourself, for the accident was never within your power to prevent. （劝慰信，语气温和+原因状语从句）

advancedExpressions.expression: to let go of ... is not to ..., but to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To let go of a cherished plan is not to admit defeat, but to make room for a wiser and worthier path. （否定对比结构，辨证论证，升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She let go of the rope.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For one endless heartbeat she clung on; then, drawing a shuddering breath, she let go of the rope and surrendered herself to the churning water below — trusting, for the first time in her life, that she would surface. （读后续写·抉择+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: for one endless heartbeat 时间凝滞 + 分词状语(drawing a shuddering breath)描写细节 + 破折号补充心理 + surrender/surface 押头韵

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should let go of the past.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that only when we summon the courage to let go of past grievances can we free ourselves from their invisible chains and stride, unburdened, towards the future. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + only when 引导倒装强调 + invisible chains 比喻 + unburdened 插入语+ stride 动词升级

classPractice.question: 说出下列句中 let go (of) 的含义：Let go of my hand, you're hurting me!
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题①；此处指具体地"松开手"，宾语为手（具体物体）

classPractice.question: 说出下列句中 let go (of) 的含义：She refused to let go of her bag and kicked her attackers several times.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题②；宾语 her bag 为具体物体，指"松开、放开"

classPractice.question: 说出下列句中 let go (of) 的含义：Hold on tight and don't let go!
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题③；let go 不带 of 作不及物用法，指"松手"

classPractice.question: 说出下列句中 let go (of) 的含义：You need to let go of the past and forgive those who have hurt you.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题④；宾语 the past 为抽象名词，指情感上"放下、摒弃"

classPractice.question: 我真的很受伤，于是放弃了我们的友谊。I was really hurt and ____ ____ ____ our friendship.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；let go of 放弃、摒弃，此处 and 并列过去动作，let 用过去式仍为 let

classPractice.question: Good parents must learn ____ let go, allowing their children the freedom to make their own mistakes.
classPractice.note: learn to do sth 学会做某事；let go 松手、放手（此处不带 of，作不及物用法）

classPractice.question: 只有放下过去的怨恨，我们才能重新开始。(用 let go of 和 only)
classPractice.answer: Only by letting go of past resentment can we start again. / Only when we let go of past resentment can we start again.
classPractice.note: only + 状语置于句首，主句部分倒装；let go of 后接名词

original_sentence: However, if your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship.
readingExamples: However, if your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to deliberately pay no attention to someone or something
(2) vt. to behave as if you have not heard or noticed someone or something
(3) vt. to fail to consider something important when making a decision or judgement
(4) vt. to take no notice of a rule, warning, or fact

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·同根辨析】ignorance 无知，愚昧（a lack of knowledge or information about sth）；ignorance of sth 对……的不了解
uncommonMeanings.example: There is so much ignorance of mental illness. 人们对精神疾病很不了解。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·同根辨析】ignorant 无知的；be ignorant of sth 不了解某事；an ignorant person/question 无知的人／问题
uncommonMeanings.example: At that time I was ignorant of events going on elsewhere. 那时我并不了解其他地方发生的事情。（课件原句）

posExamples.sentence: She swept past him in the corridor, chin held high, choosing to ignore the outstretched hand and the apology trembling on his lips — pride, she would later learn, is a lonely companion. （读后续写·冷战·人物心理）
I sincerely hope that you will not ignore the safety instructions posted at the entrance, as they are designed to protect every visitor during the exhibition. （应用文·通知/须知）
To ignore the warnings of scientists on climate change is not merely unwise; it is a reckless gamble with the future of generations yet unborn. （议论文·环境·论证）
For weeks the boy had ignored the stray dog shivering by the gate, but one snowy evening his conscience would let him ignore it no longer. （读后续写·善良·转折）

wordForms.other: ★易混提示：ignore(v. 故意忽视) ≠ ignorant(adj. 无知的) ≠ ignorance(n. 无知)——三者同根却意义各异，别把"无视"错写成"无知"；ignoramus (n. 无知的人)

collocations.translation: 【课件】故意忽视，对……不予理会（to deliberately pay no attention to）
collocations.example: She ignored him and carried on with her work. 她不理他，继续做自己的工作。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 无视某人的感受（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship. 如果你的朋友无视你的感受或让你痛苦，就该重新审视这段关系了。（课文原句）
Had he not ignored his coach's advice about pacing, he might have finished the race on his feet rather than in an ambulance. （读后续写·教训）
We cannot ignore the fact that excessive screen time is quietly eroding the concentration of our young people. （议论文·科技·论证）
Those who habitually ignore the rules of the road put not only themselves but also countless strangers at risk. （议论文·公共安全）
He deliberately ignored her calls for three whole days, and the silence widened between them like a river no bridge could span. （读后续写·关系疏远·比喻）
Ignoring the problem will not make it disappear; it will only allow it to fester until it becomes impossible to solve. （议论文·问题应对）
The role of mental health in academic success is far too important to ignore. （应用文·倡议·呼吁）
The new student sat alone at lunch, ignored entirely by the noisy circles around her, until one quiet girl slid a tray across the table. （读后续写·善意·校园）

synonyms.example: In his obsession with success, he had neglected the very people who loved him most. （读后续写·反思·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 【辨析核心】neglect 侧重"因疏忽、未尽责任而忽略"，含责备意味，常接人/职责/健康（neglect one's duty/children/health）；ignore 是"明知却主动、故意不理会"。【课件同根辨义】ignore(v. 故意忽视) ≠ ignorant(adj. 无知的) ≠ ignorance(n. 无知)，切勿混淆

synonyms.example: In our rush to praise the winners, we often overlook the quiet perseverance of those who never made the podium. （议论文·公平）
synonyms.usage: 多指"无意中看漏、没注意到"，也可指"宽容地不追究(小错)"；ignore 更强调明知却故意不理，句法上二者都直接跟宾语

synonyms.example: The committee chose to disregard the objections and pushed the controversial plan through. （议论文·决策）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面语，语气比 ignore 更强，常接规则、意见、事实、危险；ignore 更中性、更口语通用

synonyms.example: Teachers who turn a blind eye to bullying unwittingly become accomplices to it. （议论文·校园·论证）
synonyms.usage: 习语，强调明知有错却故意装作没看见，带道德批评色彩；后接 to + 名词，比单词 ignore 更生动

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·ignor- 词族辨义(课件重点)
advancedExpressions.expression: ignore(v. 故意忽视) / ignorance(n. 无知，愚昧) / ignorant(adj. 无知的)：ignorance of sth；be ignorant of sth
advancedExpressions.example: There is so much ignorance of mental illness; at that time I was ignorant of events going on elsewhere. （课件原句串记：ignore 无视 ≠ ignorance 无知 ≠ ignorant 无知的）

advancedExpressions.expression: ignore one's feelings / a warning / the rules / the fact that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Never ignore your friend's feelings, a doctor's warning, the school rules, or the fact that time is running out. （课文宾语 feelings 打头，一串常见搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·忽视（可替换，语气渐强）
advancedExpressions.expression: overlook / ignore / disregard / turn a blind eye to sth
advancedExpressions.example: We cannot overlook, let alone ignore or turn a blind eye to, such a serious problem. （从无意漏看到故意无视，一句排出层次）

advancedExpressions.expression: ignore(v. 忽视) / ignorant(adj. 无知) / ignorance(n. 无知) / ignoramus(n. 无知者)
advancedExpressions.example: Out of sheer ignorance, the ignorant tourist ignored every safety sign on the trail. （同根三兄弟一句串记，含义不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: try as sb. might to ignore ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: Try as she might to ignore the ticking of the clock, each second seemed to hammer against her racing heart. （倒装让步状语+拟物，营造紧张感）

advancedExpressions.expression: we can no longer afford to ignore ...
advancedExpressions.example: As members of this community, we can no longer afford to ignore the mountains of waste piling up behind our school. （倡议书，呼吁行动，afford 表"承担得起"）

advancedExpressions.expression: to ignore ... is to invite ...
advancedExpressions.example: To ignore the lessons of history is to invite the repetition of its darkest chapters. （不定式主语对称结构，警示式论断）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He ignored her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He walked straight past her as though she were made of glass — transparent, weightless, unworthy of even a flicker of recognition — and something inside her quietly broke. （读后续写·冷落+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as though 虚拟比喻(made of glass) + 三个形容词递进(transparent, weightless, unworthy) + 破折号插入 + quietly broke 抽象情感具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not ignore this problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be nothing short of irresponsible to turn a blind eye to a problem that, if left unaddressed, threatens to undermine the very foundation of our society. （议论文·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be nothing short of + 形容词 强调 + turn a blind eye to 习语替换 + if left unaddressed 省略状语从句 + the very foundation 强调

classPractice.question: 她不理他，继续做自己的工作。She ____ him and ____ ____ with her work.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；ignore = deliberately pay no attention to 故意忽视；carry on with sth 继续做某事

classPractice.type: 【课件·单句语法填空】同根辨形
classPractice.question: There is so much ____ (ignore) of mental illness among the general public.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；ignorance of sth 对……的无知/不了解，此处需名词 ignorance，不是动词 ignore

classPractice.type: 【课件·单句语法填空】同根辨形
classPractice.question: At that time I was ____ (ignore) of events going on elsewhere.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be ignorant of sth 不了解某事，此处需形容词 ignorant

classPractice.question: 如果你的朋友无视你的感受或让你痛苦，就该重新审视这段关系了。If your friend ____ your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；条件状语从句主语 your friend 第三人称单数，ignore 加 -s

classPractice.question: 在 ignore / neglect 中选择：Busy with his career, he had ____ his own health for years until he collapsed one morning.
classPractice.note: 此处强调"因疏忽、未尽责"而忽略健康，用 neglect；ignore 指故意不理会

classPractice.question: Out of pure ____ (ignore), the newcomer broke almost every local custom without ever realising it.
classPractice.note: 考同根词辨形：out of ignorance 出于无知，需名词 ignorance，不是动词 ignore，也不是形容词 ignorant

translation: 受苦，受折磨；变差 | vt. 遭受，蒙受
original_sentence: However, if your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship.
readingExamples: However, if your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to experience physical or mental pain, distress, or hardship
(2) vt. to experience or be subjected to something unpleasant (an injury, loss, defeat, etc.)
(3) vi. to become worse in quality or performance; to be badly affected
(4) vi. suffer from — to have a particular illness, problem, or condition over a period of time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （古／正式）容忍，忍受（=tolerate）
uncommonMeanings.example: "Suffer the little children to come unto me," the old preacher read, and for a moment the restless village fell utterly still. （读后续写·乡村教堂·庄重氛围）

posExamples.sentence: Night after night the widow suffered in silence, her tears soaking the pillow long after the house had fallen dark, yet each dawn she rose and smiled for her children. （读后续写·坚韧·母爱）
I am writing to inform you that our football team suffered a narrow defeat in the final, yet the players' spirit never wavered throughout the match. （应用文·报道/来信）
When students are deprived of adequate sleep, both their health and their academic performance inevitably suffer. （议论文·作息·因果论证）
Grandpa suffered from a weak heart, yet he insisted on climbing the hill each morning to watch the sun spill gold over the valley he had farmed all his life. （读后续写·祖辈·热爱生活）

wordForms.other: sufferer (n. 受苦者，患者)

idioms.example: The old professor was brilliant but did not suffer fools gladly, dismissing lazy answers with a single raised eyebrow. （读后续写·人物刻画）
Rather than suffer in silence, she finally found the courage to speak up about the injustice she had endured. （读后续写·觉醒·维权）

collocations.phrase: suffer from + 疾病/长期困扰
collocations.translation: 【课件】(vi.) 患……病，苦于（be affected by an illness, a lack of sth）
collocations.example: Many companies are suffering from a shortage of skilled staff. 许多公司苦于缺乏熟练员工。| suffer from a cold / heart disease / stress 患感冒／患心脏病／有精神压力（课件原句及搭配）

collocations.phrase: suffer a heart attack / huge losses / great pain
collocations.translation: 【课件】(vt.) 遭受（不好的经历：伤害、失败、损失）
collocations.example: He suffered a massive heart attack. 他的心脏病发作很严重。| The company suffered huge losses in the last year. 公司去年遭受巨额亏损。| She was seriously ill, suffering great pain. 她病得很重，遭受着巨大的痛苦。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】(n.) 痛苦，疼痛（physical or mental pain）
collocations.example: Death finally brought an end to her suffering. 死亡终于结束了她的痛苦。| This war has caused widespread human suffering. 这场战争给许许多多的人带来了苦难。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 使某人痛苦、受折磨（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: If your friend ignores your feelings or makes you suffer, it's time to rethink your relationship. 如果你的朋友无视你的感受或让你痛苦，就该重新审视这段关系了。（课文原句）
Having suffered one setback after another, the young inventor refused to abandon the design that would one day change lives. （读后续写·励志·坚持）
Several passengers suffered minor injuries when the bus skidded on the icy road, but the quick-thinking driver prevented a far greater tragedy. （应用文·新闻报道）
Those who cheat their way to success will sooner or later suffer the consequences of their dishonesty. （议论文·诚信）
No child should be left to suffer in silence; a single caring adult can change everything. （应用文·关爱倡议）
The refugees had suffered greatly on their long journey, yet gratitude, not bitterness, shone in their weary eyes. （读后续写·苦难·人性光辉）
When a company chases profit at the expense of its workers, the quality of its products inevitably suffers. （议论文·商业伦理）
Millions of teenagers today suffer from anxiety, a silent epidemic that deserves far more attention than it receives. （议论文·心理健康）

synonyms.example: For three long winters the explorers endured hunger and biting cold, sustained only by the dream of reaching the pole. （读后续写·探险·坚韧）
synonyms.usage: 强调有意志地坚持忍受，含褒义的坚韧色彩；suffer 更侧重被动地承受痛苦

synonyms.example: The patient bravely underwent a series of painful treatments, buoyed by the unwavering support of his family. （读后续写·病痛·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 中性词，指经历（尤指困难或变化的过程），不必然含痛苦；suffer 明确带痛苦义

synonyms.example: She bore the weight of the family's expectations with a quiet dignity that moved everyone who knew her. （读后续写·责任·尊严）
synonyms.usage: 指承担、忍受重负或痛苦，常搭配 pain/burden；suffer 更强调痛苦的体验本身

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·It's time (for sb) to do / It's time (that) sb did (虚拟)
advancedExpressions.expression: It's time (for sb) to do sth 是时候该做某事；It's time (that) sb did sth 从句用虚拟语气(过去式)表与现在事实相反
advancedExpressions.example: It's time for bed. 该睡觉了。| It's (about) time (that) our team won. 是时候我们队该赢了。| It's (high) time (that) you went to bed. 是时候你该睡觉了。（课件原句；that 从句谓语用过去式虚拟）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·suffer 用法辨析(课件重点)
advancedExpressions.expression: vi. suffer from + 疾病/长期困扰 vs vt. suffer + 一次性遭受(a heart attack / huge losses / great pain)
advancedExpressions.example: Many companies are suffering from a shortage of skilled staff; he suffered a massive heart attack. （from 后接慢性病/长期问题；直接接宾语指遭受具体的损失、伤害）（课件原句）

advancedExpressions.expression: suffer(v.) → suffering(n. 痛苦，疼痛，苦难：physical or mental pain)
advancedExpressions.example: Death finally brought an end to her suffering. 死亡终于结束了她的痛苦。（课件原句；suffering 作名词，可数指一次痛苦，不可数指苦难总称）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·suffer 及物 vs suffer from
advancedExpressions.expression: suffer from (疾病/长期困扰) vs suffer a loss/defeat/injury (一次性遭受)
advancedExpressions.example: He suffers from asthma but never let it stop him; last week he suffered a heavy defeat yet smiled all the same. （from 后接慢性病/长期问题；直接接宾语指遭受具体损失）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·遭受/忍受（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: suffer / endure / undergo / bear (hardship, pain)
advancedExpressions.example: For years they suffered / endured / underwent / bore unspeakable hardship without a word of complaint. （四词均可表"经受苦难"，坚韧色彩与语体不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: suffer(v.) → suffering(n. 痛苦) → sufferer(n. 受苦者/患者) → insufferable(adj. 难以忍受的)
advancedExpressions.example: Every cancer sufferer's suffering deserves respect; his insufferable arrogance, however, did not. （同根派生一起记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·make sb + 动词原形
advancedExpressions.expression: make sb suffer / do sth（使役动词后接不带 to 的不定式）
advancedExpressions.example: ...makes you suffer... （课文句式：make 作使役动词，后跟 sb + 动词原形，无 to）

advancedExpressions.expression: having suffered so much, sb. had learned that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Having suffered so much, she had learned that scars are not marks of shame but silent testaments to survival. （分词状语+格言式升华，续写结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: no one should have to suffer ... alone
advancedExpressions.example: No one should have to suffer the burden of illness alone, which is precisely why our volunteer team exists. （倡议书，which 引导非限定强调宗旨）

advancedExpressions.expression: when ..., it is invariably ... that suffer(s) most
advancedExpressions.example: When budgets are slashed, it is invariably the most vulnerable who suffer most. （强调句式+因果论证，凸显社会关切）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She suffered a lot but did not give up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though she had suffered blow after blow — the loss, the loneliness, the endless nights of doubt — she clenched her fists, lifted her chin, and refused to let despair have the final word. （读后续写·坚韧+动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though 让步状语 + blow after blow 反复强调 + 破折号列举三重苦难 + 三个动作(clenched, lifted, refused)递进 + have the final word 拟人

sentenceUpgrade.original: If we ignore the environment, we will suffer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Should we continue to turn a deaf ear to the cries of our dying planet, it is future generations who will suffer the bitterest of consequences. （议论文·环境·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Should 引导倒装虚拟条件 + turn a deaf ear to 习语 + the cries of our dying planet 拟人比喻 + it is...who 强调句 + the bitterest of consequences 最高级

classPractice.question: 许多公司苦于缺乏熟练员工。Many companies are ____ ____ a shortage of skilled staff.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；suffer from + 名词，表"苦于、患……"，此处进行时表当前持续状态

classPractice.question: 公司去年遭受巨额亏损。The company ____ ____ ____ in the last year.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；suffer 作及物动词，直接接宾语 huge losses 表"遭受损失"，一般过去时

classPractice.question: 是时候你该睡觉了。It's (high) time (that) you ____ (go) to bed.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；It's (high) time (that) sb did sth，从句用一般过去时表虚拟，与现在事实相反

classPractice.question: 是时候我们队该赢了。It's (about) time (that) our team ____ (win).
classPractice.note: 课件原句；It's time that 从句谓语用过去式虚拟，win 变 won

classPractice.question: 如果你的朋友让你痛苦，就该重新审视这段关系了。If your friend makes you ____, it's time to rethink your relationship.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；make sb suffer 使役结构，make 后接动词原形 suffer

classPractice.question: Grandpa has ____ ____ a weak heart for years, yet he still climbs the hill every morning.
classPractice.note: suffer from + 疾病/长期困扰，表"患有、深受……之苦"；现在完成时表持续到现在

classPractice.question: When students are deprived of adequate sleep, both their health and their academic ____ (perform) inevitably suffer.
classPractice.note: suffer 此处作不及物动词表"变差、受损"；空格需名词 performance 作主语一部分

original_sentence: Amy misunderstood me.
readingExamples: Amy misunderstood me.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to fail to understand someone or something correctly
(2) vt. to form a wrong idea about a person's words, actions, or intentions
(3) vi. to interpret a situation, statement, or meaning incorrectly

posExamples.sentence: She had misunderstood his silence as indifference, never guessing that behind those quiet eyes lay a love too deep to put into words. （读后续写·误会·情感反转）
I am writing to apologise sincerely, for I now realise that I completely misunderstood your kind intentions at yesterday's meeting. （应用文·道歉信）
People often misunderstand tolerance as weakness, when in truth it takes far greater strength to forgive than to retaliate. （议论文·宽容·论证）
"Don't misunderstand," he said hurriedly, reaching for her hand as she turned to leave, "I never meant to hurt you." （读后续写·澄清·对话）

wordForms.other: ★构词法：mis-（前缀，表"错误地"）+ understand → misunderstand "误解"；同类：misuse(误用)、mislead(误导)、misread(误读)、mistake(弄错)。★不规则变化：misunderstand - misunderstood - misunderstood（随 understand-understood-understood 变）

collocations.translation: 误解某人（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Amy misunderstood me. 埃米误解了我。（课文原句）
It pained him deeply to realise that his best friend had misunderstood his intentions all along. （读后续写·友谊·遗憾）
The two nations had completely misunderstood each other's signals, and the crisis deepened with every passing hour. （议论文·沟通·反面例证）
The scientist's revolutionary theory was widely misunderstood in her lifetime and only celebrated long after her death. （议论文·创新·历史例证）
Many students misunderstand the true meaning of success, equating it solely with money and fame. （议论文·价值观）
A short text message, stripped of tone and expression, is easily misunderstood. （应用文·沟通建议）
For years the father and son had misunderstood each other, each too proud to take the first step towards reconciliation. （读后续写·亲情·和解铺垫）

synonyms.example: The audience misinterpreted the artist's silence as arrogance, when it was, in fact, crippling shyness. （读后续写·人物·反转）
synonyms.usage: 侧重错误地解释或理解信息、艺术、数据的含义；misunderstand 更口语、更泛用，可指对人或事的整体误会

synonyms.example: In the dim hallway she mistook a coat on the rack for an intruder and let out a startled cry. （读后续写·紧张·情节）
synonyms.usage: 指把一个人／物错认成另一个；misunderstand 侧重对意思、意图的错误理解

synonyms.example: "Don't get me wrong — I admire your courage; I just worry it may lead you into danger," she said gently. （读后续写·关切·对话）
synonyms.usage: 非常口语化的表达，多用于对话中澄清；misunderstand 语气更中性、更书面

advancedExpressions.expression: mis-（错误地）+ understand → misunderstand；类推 misuse / mislead / misread / misjudge
advancedExpressions.example: Do not misunderstand, misjudge or misread a person before you truly know their story. （mis- 前缀一次记一串"错误地"动词）

advancedExpressions.expression: misunderstand sb / sb.'s intentions / the meaning of sth / misunderstand each other
advancedExpressions.example: Amy misunderstood me; she misunderstood my intentions; we misunderstood each other for years. （课文 misunderstand sb 打头，一串搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·误解（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: misunderstand / misinterpret / misread / get sb wrong
advancedExpressions.example: Please don't misunderstand / misinterpret / misread my silence, or get me wrong — I was simply thinking. （四者均可表"理解错"，语体与对象不同）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·misunderstand 的时态与被动
advancedExpressions.expression: misunderstand - misunderstood（过去式/过去分词同形）；常用被动 be misunderstood
advancedExpressions.example: Amy misunderstood me. / His kindness was easily misunderstood. （主动过去时 + 被动"被误解"）

advancedExpressions.expression: how badly sb. had misunderstood ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only when she read the letter did she grasp how badly she had misunderstood the man she had spent years resenting. （Only when 倒装+how 感叹从句，续写顿悟时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: I fear I may have given you the wrong impression / been misunderstood
advancedExpressions.example: I fear my hasty words may have been misunderstood, and for any offence caused I offer my most heartfelt apology. （道歉信，委婉表达+正式道歉）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being ..., ... is often misunderstood as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a flaw, sensitivity is often misunderstood as fragility, when it is in fact a rare form of strength. （far from 强调对比+纠正误解）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Amy misunderstood me and got angry.

translation: (愤怒等感情)爆发，迸发；爆炸 | vt. 使爆炸
original_sentence: When Amy found out, she exploded with anger.
readingExamples: When Amy found out, she exploded with anger.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to burst suddenly and violently, often with a loud noise, causing damage
(2) vt. to cause something (such as a bomb) to burst violently
(3) vi. to suddenly express a strong emotion, especially anger, in a violent way
(4) vi. to increase very quickly and suddenly in number, size, or intensity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 推翻，戳穿（谎言、理论、迷思）

translation: 宽宏大量的，仁慈的；慷慨的
original_sentence: Amy is a generous person.

(3) adj. larger or more plentiful than usual or than is expected

synonyms.example: Far from being mean or stingy, she gave away half of what little she had. 她非但不吝啬小气，反而把仅有的一半都送了出去。
synonyms.usage: generous 的反义词：mean(英式常用，吝啬)与 stingy(小气)都表"不愿给"；记 generous 时连反义一起记，作文对比更出彩

advancedExpressions.expression: be generous with sth · be generous to sb · a generous donation · it is generous of sb to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: She is generous with her time, generous to strangers, and it was generous of her to give up her seat. （介词 with 接所给之物、to 接对象）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·慷慨/善良（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: generous / kind / charitable / big-hearted
advancedExpressions.example: A generous / kind / charitable / big-hearted soul, she never turned a beggar away. （四者均含"待人宽厚"，侧重不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: generous(adj.) → generosity(n.) → generously(adv.)；反义 mean / stingy
advancedExpressions.example: His generosity moved everyone; he gave generously, never once acting mean. （形容词、名词、副词一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·It is + adj. + of sb + to do
advancedExpressions.expression: It is generous of sb to do sth（形容词表人的品性，用 of 不用 for）
advancedExpressions.example: It was generous of him to donate his savings. （generous/kind/nice 等评价人品性的形容词后用 of sb）

advancedExpressions.expression: generous to a fault, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Generous to a fault, the old cobbler mended the orphans' shoes for free, never once counting the coins he would never earn. （形容词短语前置刻画人物，to a fault 强化"慷慨到近乎吃亏"的可敬）

advancedExpressions.expression: your generous ... has enabled us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Your generous support has enabled us to bring warmth and hope to over two hundred left-behind children this winter. （感谢信主体，具体成果 + 情感呼应，诚意十足）

advancedExpressions.expression: true generosity lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True generosity lies not in giving what we can easily spare, but in sharing what we can hardly bear to part with. （not...but 对比结构重新定义"慷慨"，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very generous and gave the poor boy some food.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a word, she knelt down and pressed her own warm bun into the ragged boy's frozen hands — a small, generous act that would glow in his memory long after the winter had passed. （读后续写·善良·细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作细节化(knelt down, pressed) + 破折号总结升华 + would glow in his memory 时间延展点出善意的长远影响

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should be generous to others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If each of us learned to be generous not only with our money but with our patience and our praise, the world would grow measurably kinder, one small gesture at a time. （议论文·社会公德）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If 引导虚拟条件 + not only...but 递进(从物质到精神) + one small gesture at a time 收束，以小见大

classPractice.question: Amy is a generous person, and her ____ (generous) towards strangers has touched everyone in the village.
classPractice.note: 课文原句延伸；空格前有形容词性物主代词 her，需名词 generosity（注意拼写无 u）

classPractice.question: 他把积蓄全捐了出来，真是太慷慨了。It was very ____ ____ him to donate all his savings.
classPractice.note: It is + adj.(品性) + of sb to do；generous 评价人品性，用 of 不用 for

classPractice.question: 在 generous / stingy 中选择：Far from being ____, Amy always shares whatever she has with those in need.
classPractice.note: far from being + 反义词，构成对比；stingy/mean 是 generous 的反义词"吝啬的"

original_sentence: A real friend is someone whose support we can count on.
readingExamples: A real friend is someone whose support we can count on.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to depend on someone or something with confidence; to rely on
(2) phr. v. to expect something to happen and make plans based on it
(3) phr. v. (count on doing sth) to feel sure that something will happen or that someone will do something

posExamples.sentence: When the whole town turned its back on him, Jack found that the one person he could still count on was the quiet old librarian who had never once judged him. （读后续写·友情·患难见真情）
As the leader of our volunteer team, I want every member to know that you can always count on me, whether the task is large or small. （应用文·倡议/招募信）
A society that truly cares for its people ensures that, in times of crisis, the most vulnerable always have someone to count on. （议论文·社会保障）
Don't count on the weather staying fair, the old sailor warned, tightening the ropes; the calmest sea often hides the fiercest storm. （读后续写·航海·未雨绸缪）

collocations.example: A real friend is someone whose support we can count on. 真正的朋友是我们能够依靠其支持的人。（课件例·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: count on sb to do sth
collocations.example: You can count on Tom to lend a hand whenever you are in trouble. 你无论何时有困难都可以指望汤姆伸出援手。（课件例）
There were fifty-two persons present, counting in the babies. 算上婴儿在内，共有五十二人在场。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】不把……考虑或计算在内；逐一数出
collocations.example: If you are too busy that day, we'll count you out. 如果你那天太忙，我们就不把你算进去。（课件例）

collocations.phrase: someone whose support we can count on
collocations.translation: 我们能够依靠其支持的人（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: A real friend is someone whose support we can count on. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: count sb in / count sb out
collocations.translation: 把某人算上 / 不把某人算在内
collocations.example: "There's a hiking trip this Sunday." "Count me in!" she said at once. （对话·热情响应）
New to the city and short of friends, she found she could count on her kindly landlady for advice on almost everything. （读后续写·陌生环境·温暖）
We had counted on finishing the hike before dark, but the sudden landslide forced us to change our plans entirely. （读后续写·徒步·意外）

collocations.phrase: someone / something you can count on
collocations.example: In a world of fleeting online friendships, a friend you can truly count on is a treasure rarer than gold. （议论文·友谊本质）
"Maybe he'll apologize first," she muttered, though her tone made it clear she didn't count on it. （读后续写·矛盾·失望）
Throughout the long campaign, the young candidate counted on the tireless support of the students who believed in her vision. （应用文·致谢/报道）

synonyms.example: In the darkest months of her illness, she learned to rely on the small kindnesses of neighbours she had barely known before. （读后续写·患难·温情）
synonyms.usage: 与 count on 几乎同义，都指"信赖依靠"；rely on 略正式，可用于人、物、系统；count on 更口语，且更强调"有信心地指望"

synonyms.example: The success of the whole rescue depended on whether the exhausted climbers could hold on until dawn. （读后续写·救援·悬念）
synonyms.usage: 既指"依赖"，也指"取决于"(结果由某因素决定)；count on 只表"信赖指望"，不含"取决于"这层意思

synonyms.example: The team was banking on their star striker to turn the game around in the final minutes. （读后续写·比赛·孤注一掷）
synonyms.usage: 口语，带"下注、押宝"意味，暗示结果不确定、风险较高；count on 语气更笃定，更强调对人品或可靠性的信任

advancedExpressions.expression: count on / count in / count out / count up / count for
advancedExpressions.example: You can count on me — count me in for the whole trip; just don't count on the weather. (count for nothing: 毫无价值) （count 短语群一网打尽：依靠/算上/别指望）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"依靠指望"
advancedExpressions.expression: count on = rely on = depend on = bank on = lean on
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever happened, she knew she could count on / rely on / depend on / lean on her oldest friend. （功能相同、可互替，语气从口语到书面递进）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·whose 引导定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: someone whose support we can count on (whose + 名词作先行词的定语)
advancedExpressions.example: A real friend is someone whose support we can count on. （whose 引导定语从句，count on 的宾语 support 前移，从句末尾无宾语——考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: no matter what happened, sb. knew he could count on ...
advancedExpressions.example: No matter how fiercely the storm of life raged, Ben knew he could always count on that one steady hand on his shoulder — his grandfather's. （no matter 让步 + 破折号揭示对象，续写点明精神支柱）

advancedExpressions.expression: you can count on me / us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Should you ever need a helping hand, you can count on our volunteer team to be there, rain or shine. （招募信/回复信中作出郑重承诺，rain or shine 强化可靠）

advancedExpressions.expression: a friendship worth having is one you can count on when ...
advancedExpressions.example: A friendship worth having is not one that thrives in easy times, but one you can count on when the whole world seems to turn away. （对比结构定义"真友谊"，呼应单元主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I knew my friend would help me, so I felt better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mere knowledge that I could count on her, whatever storms the day might bring, settled over me like a warm blanket and quieted every fear. （读后续写·友情·安心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词化(the knowledge that...) + whatever 让步插入 + 明喻(like a warm blanket) 化"依靠"为可感的安全感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Real friends are people you can rely on.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age when a thousand "friends" are a mere click away, a real friend is measured by one quiet truth: whether, in your hour of need, you can count on them at all. （议论文·友谊本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age when... 时代背景铺垫 + 冒号引出核心 + in your hour of need 正式短语 + 反问收束，紧扣单元主旨

classPractice.question: There were fifty-two persons present, ____ ____ the babies. (把婴儿算在内)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】count in "把……算在内"；现在分词作伴随状语 counting in the babies

classPractice.question: 真正的朋友是我们能够依靠其支持的人。A real friend is someone ____ ____ we can ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：whose 引导定语从句 + count on 依靠；whose support 作 count on 的逻辑宾语

classPractice.question: "We're planning a charity walk this weekend." "Sounds great — ____ me ____!" (把我算上)
classPractice.note: count sb in "把某人算上"，反义为 count sb out；口语高频，与 count on 区分

classPractice.question: In a crisis, the most vulnerable should always have someone to ____ (count on / count in).
classPractice.note: count on "依靠指望"；count in "算上"不合语境，抓固定搭配 have someone to count on

original_sentence: Yet these days, the modern tools that keep us connected are eating away at the meaning of friendship.
readingExamples: Yet these days, the modern tools that keep us connected are eating away at the meaning of friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to gradually destroy or wear away something by chemical action, water, or constant pressure
(2) phr. v. to gradually reduce the amount of something until little remains
(3) phr. v. to make someone feel more and more anxious or upset over a period of time

posExamples.sentence: Night after night, the guilt of the lie he had told his best friend ate away at him, until he could no longer meet his own eyes in the mirror. （读后续写·内疚·心理煎熬）
I am writing to warn residents that the untreated waste from the factory is slowly eating away at the riverbank, threatening the homes built along it. （应用文·投诉/呼吁信）
The constant comparison bred by social media quietly eats away at young people's self-worth, replacing genuine confidence with restless envy. （议论文·社交媒体·青少年心理）
Year after year, the relentless waves ate away at the ancient cliff, until one grey morning the old lighthouse finally surrendered to the sea. （读后续写·时间与自然·苍凉）

collocations.translation: 【课件】逐渐破坏、侵蚀某物（= reduce or destroy sth gradually）
collocations.example: His constant criticism ate away at her self-confidence. 他不断的批评使她逐渐丧失了自信心。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be eating away at the meaning of friendship
collocations.example: Yet these days, the modern tools that keep us connected are eating away at the meaning of friendship. 然而如今，让我们保持联系的现代工具正在侵蚀友谊的意义。（课件原句·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: eat away at sth (物理侵蚀)
collocations.example: The salty sea air had been eating away at the iron gate for decades, leaving it a fragile lace of rust. （读后续写·环境·时光痕迹）

collocations.phrase: eat away at sb (心理折磨)
collocations.example: The unspoken quarrel ate away at her all week, souring every meal and stealing every hour of sleep. （读后续写·矛盾·煎熬）

collocations.phrase: eat away at one's confidence / savings / trust
collocations.translation: 逐渐侵蚀信心/积蓄/信任
collocations.example: One failure after another slowly ate away at his confidence, until he no longer dared to raise his hand in class. （读后续写·挫折·成长）
Left unchecked, small acts of dishonesty gradually eat away at the trust that holds any community together. （议论文·诚信）

collocations.phrase: eat away at the foundations of sth
collocations.example: Rumours, once released, eat away at the very foundations of a friendship faster than any open conflict. （议论文·人际关系）

collocations.phrase: worry / doubt / regret eating away at sb
collocations.translation: 忧虑/疑虑/悔恨啃噬着某人
collocations.example: As the deadline neared, a nagging doubt kept eating away at her, whispering that all her effort would come to nothing. （读后续写·备考·焦虑）

synonyms.example: Constant criticism can erode even the strongest self-belief, wearing it down grain by grain. （议论文·成长·心理）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面，既指自然对地表的侵蚀，也常比喻性地"削弱"信任、价值观；eat away at 更口语生动，且更能表达对内心的"啃噬折磨"

synonyms.example: Years of resentment had corroded their once-close bond beyond any hope of repair. （读后续写·亲情·裂痕）
synonyms.usage: 本义指酸、锈对金属的化学腐蚀，比喻义偏"腐蚀关系、心灵"；eat away at 侵蚀对象更广，且强调"一点点吞噬"的过程感

synonyms.example: A gnawing fear that he had forgotten something crucial kept gnawing at him all the way to the airport. （读后续写·旅途·不安）
synonyms.usage: 特指焦虑、疑虑等情绪"持续啃噬内心"，画面感强，多用于心理层面；eat away at 既可用于心理，也可用于物质侵蚀，适用面更宽

advancedExpressions.expression: eat away at / eat into / eat up
advancedExpressions.example: The rust ate away at the hull, the medical bills ate into her savings, and worry ate her up. （三个 eat 短语区分：侵蚀腐蚀/耗费蚕食/(情绪)折磨吞噬）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"逐渐侵蚀/损害"
advancedExpressions.expression: eat away at = erode = corrode = wear away = gnaw at
advancedExpressions.example: Constant criticism can eat away at / erode / wear away even the firmest self-belief. （功能相同、可互替，erode/corrode 更书面，gnaw at 侧重心理）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·现在进行时表趋势
advancedExpressions.expression: sth. is eating away at sth. (be doing 表"正在持续发生的负面趋势")
advancedExpressions.example: The modern tools that keep us connected are eating away at the meaning of friendship. （现在进行时 + 定语从句 that keep us connected，进行时突出"当下正被一点点侵蚀"——考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. kept eating away at sb., until ...
advancedExpressions.example: The secret kept eating away at her, until one sleepless midnight she could bear it no longer and reached for the phone. （"折磨积累 + until 转折"推动情节，续写内心挣扎到行动的过渡）

advancedExpressions.expression: if left unchecked, ... will continue to eat away at ...
advancedExpressions.example: If left unchecked, this careless pollution will continue to eat away at the river that has nourished our town for generations. （呼吁信中警示后果，唤起紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from ..., it quietly eats away at ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from bringing us closer, an endless scroll of shallow "likes" quietly eats away at the deep, patient intimacy that true friendship demands. （far from 反转 + 抽象侵蚀，紧扣单元主题批判浅层社交）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He felt guilty for a long time and it made him unhappy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The guilt he refused to confess did not fade with time; instead it ate away at him from the inside, dimming his laughter and shadowing every quiet moment. （读后续写·内疚·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: instead 转折强化 + eat away at 替换平淡的 made him unhappy + 现在分词并列(dimming... shadowing) 呈现情绪蔓延

sentenceUpgrade.original: Social media is bad for real friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath its bright, connecting glow, social media is quietly eating away at the meaning of friendship, trading long conversations for fleeting taps and true presence for a hollow sense of being "online together". （议论文·社交媒体）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语让步开篇(Beneath its glow) + eat away at 生动化 + trading A for B 平行结构点出"交换的代价"，紧扣课文原句

classPractice.question: 他不断的批评使她逐渐丧失了自信心。His constant criticism ____ ____ ____ her self-confidence.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】eat away at = reduce or destroy sth gradually "逐渐破坏、侵蚀"；叙述过去用 ate

classPractice.question: 然而如今，这些让我们保持联系的现代工具正在侵蚀友谊的意义。Yet these days, the modern tools that keep us connected are ____ ____ ____ the meaning of friendship.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：现在进行时 be eating away at，突出当下正持续侵蚀的趋势

classPractice.question: Night after night, the guilt of the lie he had told his best friend ____ (eat) away at him, until he could no longer meet his own eyes in the mirror.
classPractice.note: eat 不规则变化 eat-ate-eaten；此处叙事用一般过去时 ate

classPractice.question: Rumours, once released, ____ (eat away at / take the place of) the very foundations of a friendship.
classPractice.note: eat away at "侵蚀根基"符合语境；take the place of "取代"语义不合

original_sentence: We may be able to make many friends online, but these friendships can be quite shallow.
readingExamples: We may be able to make many friends online, but these friendships can be quite shallow.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. not having much distance between the top surface and the bottom; not deep
(2) adj. not showing serious or careful thought; concerned only with unimportant things
(3) adj. (of breathing) taking in only a little air with each breath
(4) n. (usually plural: the shallows) an area of water that is not deep

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 浅水处，浅滩(常用复数 shallows)
uncommonMeanings.example: Wading through the sun-warmed shallows, the two children shrieked with delight as tiny silver fish darted between their bare ankles. （读后续写·童年·夏日戏水）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (呼吸)微弱的，短促的
uncommonMeanings.example: The rescued climber lay pale in the snow, his breathing so shallow that for one terrible moment we feared it had stopped altogether. （读后续写·救援·生死一线）

posExamples.sentence: The river here was deceptively shallow, and the little boy waded further and further from the bank, unaware of the sudden drop that waited just ahead. （读后续写·危险·悬念）
I would like to remind fellow students that friendships built solely on shallow online chatting rarely survive the first real test of life. （应用文·倡议信）
A generation raised on quick likes and endless scrolling risks growing shallow in its affections, mistaking constant contact for genuine connection. （议论文·社交媒体·人际关系）
For years I dismissed my cousin as shallow and vain, until the day I watched her sit through the night beside a dying stranger's bed. （读后续写·偏见反转·成长）

wordForms.other: the shallows (n. 浅滩)

collocations.example: His new book was criticized for being shallow. 他的新书因内容肤浅而受到批评。（课件原句·填空 being shallow）

collocations.phrase: shallow waters / shallow (not deep) 浅的
collocations.example: We found some strange fish in shallow waters around the coast. 我们在海边浅水区发现了一些奇特的鱼。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: these friendships can be quite shallow
collocations.translation: 这些友谊可能相当肤浅（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We may be able to make many friends online, but these friendships can be quite shallow. （课文原句）
The old fisherman warned us to keep the boat in shallow water, for the current beyond the reef could sweep a man out to sea in seconds. （读后续写·航海·警告）
They crossed the shallow stream on stepping stones worn smooth by a hundred summers of bare feet. （读后续写·乡村·怀旧）
Curled beneath the blanket, she took quick, shallow breaths, terrified that the slightest sound might give away her hiding place. （读后续写·紧张·躲藏）
It is unfair to write someone off as a shallow person simply because they are cheerful; joy is not the enemy of depth. （议论文·评判他人）
The countless shallow friendships she had collected online melted away the moment she truly needed a shoulder to cry on. （读后续写·友情·幻灭）
Judging people by their looks is a shallow and superficial habit that blinds us to the richness within. （议论文·偏见）
Too afraid to venture out, the timid boy clung to the rail in the shallow end while his friends splashed boldly in the deep. （读后续写·童年·怯懦）

synonyms.example: Her interest in the subject proved superficial, fading the moment the topic demanded real effort. （议论文·学习态度）
synonyms.usage: 书面、正式，强调"只停留在表面、缺乏深度"，多修饰知识、理解、关注；shallow 更口语，也可指物理上的"浅"，形容人时略带贬义

synonyms.example: The committee dismissed his frivolous complaint and turned to matters that truly mattered. （议论文·态度）
synonyms.usage: 强调"不严肃、爱玩闹、缺乏责任感"，语气更重；shallow 侧重"缺乏思想深度"，不一定含"轻浮胡闹"之意

synonyms.example: In the grand sweep of life, the trivial quarrels we cling to today will seem laughably small tomorrow. （议论文·人生感悟）
synonyms.usage: 修饰事物，指"不重要、无价值"；shallow 修饰人或想法时指"没深度"，二者角度不同，不可直接互换

advancedExpressions.expression: shallow (浅的/肤浅的) ↔ deep (深的/深厚的); a shallow / deep friendship
advancedExpressions.example: Online friendships are often shallow, while the bonds forged face to face run deep. （反义成对记忆：水的深浅 & 感情/思想的深浅）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"肤浅/表面"
advancedExpressions.expression: shallow = superficial = frivolous (指人/想法缺乏深度)
advancedExpressions.example: A generation raised on quick likes risks becoming shallow / superficial in its affections. （功能相近、可替换；superficial 更书面，frivolous 偏"轻浮"）

advancedExpressions.expression: shallow (adj.) → shallowness (n. 肤浅) / shallowly (adv.) / the shallows (n. 浅滩)
advancedExpressions.example: The shallowness of the quarrel became clear only years later, when both had grown wiser. （adj.加 -ness 变抽象名词，加 -ly 变副词）

advancedExpressions.expression: deceptively shallow, the ... concealed ...
advancedExpressions.example: Deceptively shallow near the bank, the pool concealed a sudden, treacherous depth that swallowed the sunlight whole. （形容词前置 + conceal 制造隐患，续写危险场景埋伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should not settle for shallow ..., but seek ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should not settle for shallow, screen-bound friendships, but seek the kind of bond that is forged face to face, in laughter and in tears. （建议信中提出主张，not...but 对比鲜明）

advancedExpressions.expression: what looks shallow on the surface may hide ...
advancedExpressions.example: What looks shallow on the surface may hide unexpected depths, just as the quietest stream often conceals the deepest current. （表里对比 + 类比升华，反对以貌取人）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The online friendships were not deep and did not last.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Like reflections on shallow water, those online friendships shimmered brightly for a season, then scattered at the first ripple of real trouble, leaving her lonelier than before. （读后续写·友情·幻灭）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like reflections on shallow water) + shimmered/scattered 动态对比 + leaving 分词状语收束孤独感

sentenceUpgrade.original: People today have shallow relationships because of the internet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an era where connection is measured in followers rather than friends, it is little wonder that so many relationships have grown shallow, wide as an ocean yet barely deep enough to wet the feet. （议论文·社交媒体）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an era where... 时代背景 + followers rather than friends 词义对比 + 隐喻(wide as an ocean yet...) 生动呈现"广而浅"

classPractice.question: 他的新书因内容肤浅而受到批评。His new book was criticized for ____ ____. (肤浅)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】shallow = superficial "浅薄的"；介词 for 后接动名词，be criticized for being shallow

classPractice.question: 【课件义】We found some strange fish in ____ ____ around the coast. (浅水区)
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】shallow "浅的"(not deep)；shallow waters 浅水区，与"肤浅"义对照

classPractice.question: 我们也许能在网上交到许多朋友，但这些友谊可能相当肤浅。We may be able to make many friends online, but these friendships can be quite ____.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句；shallow 形容友谊"肤浅"，与前文 make many friends 形成转折

classPractice.question: Online friendships are often ____, while the bonds forged face to face run ____. (shallow / deep)
classPractice.note: 反义对照 shallow↔deep；run deep "(感情)深厚"固定表达

classPractice.question: The ____ (shallow) of their online chatting became clear the moment she truly needed help but found no one.
classPractice.note: 空前有 The，需名词形式 shallowness "肤浅、浅薄"；adj.+ -ness 构词

original_sentence: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love.
readingExamples: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a website or webpage on which a person regularly records their opinions, experiences, or information about a particular subject
(2) n. a single entry or post on such a website
(3) vi. to write or maintain a blog; to add new posts to a blog

posExamples.sentence: Every night after her family fell asleep, the shy girl poured her secret dreams into a travel blog, never once imagining that thousands of strangers were quietly reading, and cheering, her on. （读后续写·成长·自我表达）
I am writing to recommend that our school set up an English blog, where students could share book reviews and practise writing for a real audience beyond the classroom. （应用文·建议信）
Some argue that people who constantly blog about their lives are seeking connection; others insist they are merely performing for an audience that scarcely knows them. （议论文·社交媒体）
When the earthquake cut off all phone lines, a teenager's simple blog became the village's only window to the outside world, and messages of hope poured in from across the country. （读后续写·灾难·希望）

wordForms.noun: blog / blogger (博主) / blogging (写博客) / blog post (博文)
wordForms.other: vlog (n./v. 视频博客，video+blog); blog 本身为 web+log 的混成词

collocations.translation: 像博客这样的社交媒体（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love. （课文原句）
A single honest blog post about her struggle with anxiety brought hundreds of lonely readers a sudden, healing sense of not being alone. （议论文·分享的力量）
For three quiet years she kept a blog about caring for stray cats, and slowly a scattered community of kind hearts gathered around it. （读后续写·善良·联结）
The moment he posted his honest apology on his blog, a wave of forgiving comments reminded him that people are kinder than we fear. （读后续写·和解·温暖）
Her travel blog, rich with vivid photos and heartfelt stories, inspired countless readers to step beyond their own front doors. （应用文·推荐）
Every student who follows the teacher's grammar blog receives one clear, well-chosen writing tip each morning. （应用文·通知）
Encouraged by his teacher, the once-silent boy launched a science blog that soon became the talk of the whole grade. （读后续写·自信·蜕变）
However busy she was, she updated her charity blog every Sunday, believing that consistency was itself a form of kindness. （应用文·坚持）

synonyms.example: In her worn leather diary she confided the fears she could never speak aloud, its pages the only listener she fully trusted. （读后续写·心事·私密）
synonyms.usage: 指私人日记，通常不公开、供自己保存；blog 是网络平台上公开或半公开的记录，面向读者、可互动

synonyms.example: The scientist kept a meticulous journal of every experiment, however small the result. （议论文·科学精神）
synonyms.usage: 偏正式，既指个人"日志、随笔"，也指"学术期刊"；blog 特指网络博客，语域更现代、更口语

synonyms.example: Within an hour her heartfelt post had been shared thousands of times across the city. （议论文·信息传播）
synonyms.usage: 指社交平台上的"单条帖子"，可以是文字、图片、视频；blog 通常指持续更新的整个网站，或其中一篇较完整的文章

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·blog 词族与混成词
advancedExpressions.expression: blog (n./v.) → blogger (博主) / blogging (写博客) / blog post (博文); web + log → blog; video + blog → vlog (视频博客)
advancedExpressions.example: The blogger updated her blog daily, and her blogging soon grew into a full vlog channel. （blog 本身是 web+log 的混成词；派生 blogger/blogging，衍生 vlog）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·blog 常用动词搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: start / keep / run / update / follow a blog; post on a blog; a blog post
advancedExpressions.example: She started a blog, kept it updated, and thousands followed it — one blog post at a time. （"开设-经营-更新-关注-发帖"动词群一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"个人记录/文章"
advancedExpressions.expression: blog ≈ online diary / journal; a blog post ≈ a post / an article / an entry
advancedExpressions.example: Her blog reads like an online diary, each blog post a heartfelt entry. （功能相近可替换；blog 公开可互动，diary 私密）

advancedExpressions.expression: through her blog, sb. found ...
advancedExpressions.example: Through her humble little blog, the lonely girl found not only her voice but a whole community of strangers who felt exactly as she did. （through + 媒介引出成长收获，not only...but 递进升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I strongly suggest we launch a ... blog so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I strongly suggest we launch a class reading blog so that everyone can share what they love and discover books they might otherwise never meet. （建议信主体，提议 + 目的清晰）

advancedExpressions.expression: a blog can either ... or ..., depending on ...
advancedExpressions.example: A blog can either deepen genuine connection or feed a hollow craving for attention, depending entirely on whether we write to share or merely to be seen. （either...or + depending on 辩证，紧扣社交媒体主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She wrote a blog and many people read it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Late one rainy night she pressed "publish" on her very first blog, hardly daring to hope — yet by morning, hundreds of strangers had found her words, and for the first time in years she no longer felt invisible. （读后续写·自我表达·蜕变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间环境铺垫(late one rainy night) + hardly daring to hope 心理 + yet 转折 + no longer felt invisible 情感升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Blogs and social media affect real friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For all the closeness they promise, blogs and other social media can quietly slip between us and the friends we love, replacing the warmth of a shared glance with the cold glow of a screen. （议论文·社交媒体）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: For all 让步开篇 + slip between us and 呼应课文 + 对比意象(warmth of a glance vs cold glow of a screen) 具象化升华

classPractice.question: 像博客这样的社交媒体已经离间了我们和我们所爱的朋友。Social media like ____ ____ come between us and the friends whom we love.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句；social media 作主语视为不可数/整体，谓语用单数 has come

classPractice.question: Some people who constantly ____ (blog) about their lives are seeking connection; others are merely performing for an audience.
classPractice.note: blog 可作不及物动词"写博客"；此处主语为复数 people who...，用原形 blog

classPractice.question: A single honest ____ ____ (一篇博文) about her anxiety made hundreds of lonely readers feel less alone.
classPractice.note: a blog post "一篇博文"，指博客上的单条文章，与整个 blog 网站区分

translation: 损害…之间的关系，离间；妨碍
original_sentence: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love. Texting and messaging cannot take the place of face-to-face chatting. "Sharing" our experiences on social media is not enough to express the values which matter most to us. "Liking" our friends' photos online does not develop the connection which we share. To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them in person.
readingExamples: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love. Texting and messaging cannot take the place of face-to-face chatting. "Sharing" our experiences on social media is not enough to express the values which matter most to us. "Liking" our friends' photos online does not develop the connection which we share. To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them in person.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to damage the relationship between two people; to cause a division or bad feeling between them
(2) phr. v. to prevent someone from giving full attention to something or someone; to interfere with or get in the way of
(3) phr. v. to physically place oneself in the space separating two people or things

posExamples.sentence: For twenty years the two brothers had shared everything, and Amy was determined that no foolish misunderstanding would ever come between them and the bond they had built since childhood. （读后续写·手足·守护亲情）
I sincerely hope this small disagreement will not come between our two clubs and the friendship we have worked so hard to build over the years. （应用文·和解/致歉信）
We must never let the glow of a screen come between us and the loved ones sitting right beside us, for no message can replace the warmth of a face turned toward our own. （议论文·社交媒体·亲情）
Jealousy, that quiet poison, had slowly come between the once-inseparable friends and the trust that had held them together for so many years. （读后续写·友情·裂痕）

collocations.phrase: come between us and the friends whom we love
collocations.translation: 离间我们和我们所爱的朋友（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love. （课文原句）
She refused to let idle gossip come between two friends who had stood by each other through every storm. （读后续写·友情·坚守）

collocations.phrase: let sth come between sb and sb
collocations.translation: 让某事损害某人之间的关系
collocations.example: Never let pride come between you and the people who love you, the old man whispered, for pride is a poor companion in old age. （读后续写·长辈·箴言）

collocations.phrase: come between sb and sth (妨碍某人与某物)
collocations.example: Nothing, not even his failing eyesight, could come between the old scholar and the books he had loved all his life. （读后续写·坚守热爱·执着）
They vowed that nothing on earth could ever come between them, and for fifty faithful years that vow held true. （读后续写·爱情/友情·坚贞）

collocations.translation: 金钱/嫉妒/距离造成的隔阂
collocations.example: It was not distance but silence that came between them, each waiting stubbornly for the other to speak first. （读后续写·矛盾·冷战）

collocations.phrase: refuse to let anything come between
collocations.example: However fierce their arguments grew, the two sisters refused to let anything come between them and the promise they had made to their dying mother. （读后续写·亲情·誓言）

synonyms.example: The cunning rival tried to drive a wedge between the captain and his loyal crew, but their trust proved too deep to break. （读后续写·团队·信任）
synonyms.usage: 比喻性强(wedge 楔子)，特指"蓄意挑拨、制造分裂"，多含恶意；come between 更中性，隔阂可由事物或误会自然造成，未必是故意

synonyms.example: Rumours have a cruel power to set friend against friend, turning yesterday's allies into today's strangers. （议论文·谣言）
synonyms.usage: 强调"使双方对立、敌对"，结果是彼此为敌；come between 侧重"破坏关系、造成疏远"，未必发展到正面冲突

synonyms.example: He never let his hobbies interfere with the duties he owed to his family. （议论文·责任与平衡）
synonyms.usage: 泛指"干扰、妨碍某事顺利进行"，对象多为事情、进程；come between...and... 特指插入"两者之间"造成隔阂或阻隔，结构更固定

advancedExpressions.expression: come between A and B (离间A与B / 妨碍A与B之间); let / allow sth come between ...; nothing can come between ...
advancedExpressions.example: Don't let a screen come between you and your family; let nothing come between true friends. （固定结构 come between...and... 后接两方，中间常插 let/allow/nothing）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"离间/破坏关系"
advancedExpressions.expression: come between = drive a wedge between = set sb against sb (制造隔阂/使对立)
advancedExpressions.example: Jealousy came between them / drove a wedge between them, turning old friends into strangers. （功能相近可替换；come between 中性，drive a wedge 强调蓄意）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·whom 引导定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: the friends whom we love (whom 作宾语，指人，可省略或用 who/that 替换)
advancedExpressions.example: Social media like blogs has come between us and the friends whom we love. （whom 引导定语从句作 love 的宾语；口语中常省略——考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. vowed that nothing would ever come between ...
advancedExpressions.example: Taking her trembling sister's hand, Amy vowed that nothing on earth would ever come between them again, whatever the years might bring. （伴随动作 + vow 誓言 + whatever 让步，续写和解升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I do hope this will not come between us and ...
advancedExpressions.example: I do hope this small misunderstanding will not come between us and a friendship I treasure far too much to lose. （致歉信中委婉挽回，do 强调 + treasure 情感真挚）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must not allow ... to come between us and ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must not allow the endless glow of our screens to come between us and the living, breathing people who need our full attention. （呼吁式主张 + 具象对比，紧扣社交媒体侵蚀亲密关系的主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Their argument hurt their friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Left unspoken and unhealed, that single bitter argument slowly came between the two old friends and the trust it had taken a lifetime to build, until only a cold, careful politeness remained. （读后续写·友情·裂痕）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词让步开篇(Left unspoken and unhealed) + come between...and 替换平淡的 hurt + until 引出疏离结局，情感层层递进

sentenceUpgrade.original: Social media harms our real relationships.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The very tools designed to keep us connected have, ironically, come between us and the friends we love, dissolving heartfelt conversation into a stream of hollow taps and fleeting emojis. （议论文·社交媒体）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The very tools designed to... ironically 反讽结构 + come between us and 呼应课文原句 + dissolving 分词状语具象化"浅层社交"的代价

classPractice.question: 像博客这样的社交媒体已经离间了我们和我们所爱的朋友。Social media like blogs has ____ ____ us ____ the friends ____ we love.
classPractice.answer: come between ... and ... whom / who / that
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：come between...and... 离间；the friends whom we love 中 whom 引导定语从句

classPractice.question: 我们绝不能让手机屏幕的光亮离间我们和身边所爱的人。(用 come between...and...)
classPractice.answer: We must never let the glow of our smartphones come between us and the loved ones (sitting right) beside us.
classPractice.note: let sth come between A and B；let 后接动词原形 come，紧扣单元"科技侵蚀亲密关系"主题

classPractice.question: The cunning rival tried to ____ the captain and his loyal crew. (come between / take the place of)
classPractice.note: come between "离间两方"接 A and B；take the place of "取代"语义不合

original_sentence: To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them in person.
readingExamples: To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them in person.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. by going somewhere and being present yourself, rather than sending someone else, phoning, or writing
(2) adv. seeing or meeting someone directly, in their actual physical presence (as opposed to on screen, in a photo, or in the media)
(3) adv. done or delivered by oneself, without the help of an agent or intermediary
