posExamples.sentence: When the letter finally arrived, she could not bear to reply on paper; she took the first train north, determined to thank the old woman in person and to see, at last, the face behind those years of kindness. （读后续写·久别重逢）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to invite you to attend our graduation ceremony in person, for no video call could ever convey how much your guidance has meant to us. （应用文·邀请信）

Although online communication is undeniably convenient, some conversations — an apology, a farewell, a declaration of gratitude — carry their true weight only when they are made in person. （议论文·科技与人际关系）
I hurried across the campus, my heart pounding, hoping to catch the professor and hand in my application in person before the office closed at five. （读后续写·紧张情节）

collocations.translation: 亲自去见他们（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them in person. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 亲自见到某人；当面见面
collocations.example: Having admired the author's novels for years, she finally got to meet him in person at the book fair, and words seemed to fail her. （读后续写·追星圆梦）
I felt that a mere message was not enough, so I decided to thank my teacher in person for staying late every evening to help me. （应用文·感谢信）
Swallowing his pride, he walked up to his old friend to apologize in person, his voice trembling with regret. （读后续写·和解）

collocations.phrase: collect / pick sth. up in person
collocations.example: The prize could not be posted, so the winner had to collect the certificate in person at the town hall. （应用文·通知）
Rather than mailing the gift, she chose to deliver it in person, wanting to watch her grandmother's eyes light up. （读后续写·温情）
Due to the importance of the occasion, the headmaster attended the charity event in person and addressed the volunteers warmly. （应用文·报道）

collocations.translation: 亲眼所见（对比照片／屏幕）
collocations.example: No photograph had prepared me for the Great Wall; seeing it in person, I stood speechless before the sheer scale of it. （读后续写·震撼）
The manager promised to come in person to make sure every complaint was properly addressed. （应用文·回复信）

synonyms.example: The principal personally handed each graduate their diploma, pausing to offer a quiet word of encouragement. （应用文·典礼报道）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：personally 是单个副词，位置灵活，语气更正式书面；in person 更强调"亲身到场／面对面"这一物理动作，口语和书面都常用。

synonyms.example: After months of texting, they finally sat down face to face, and the silence between them said more than any message ever had. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：face to face 更突出"面对面交流"的互动状态，常与 talk/meet/discuss 连用；in person 侧重"本人到场"，不一定强调双方对视。

synonyms.translation: 本人（亲眼所见，略带惊叹语气）
synonyms.example: I had only ever seen her on television, so meeting the champion in the flesh left me utterly star-struck. （读后续写·惊喜）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in the flesh 偏口语，多用于"亲眼见到名人／此前只在图像中见过的人"，带惊喜色彩，语气比 in person 更"活生生就在眼前"；in person 语体更中性、通用，且强调"本人办事/到场"这一动作。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"亲自/当面"
advancedExpressions.expression: in person = personally = face to face = in the flesh
advancedExpressions.example: I wanted to thank her in person / personally / face to face rather than through a text. （功能相近可替换；in the flesh 偏口语，多用于"亲眼见到名人"带惊叹）

advancedExpressions.expression: in person (当面/到场) ↔ online / remotely / by phone / via video call (线上/远程)
advancedExpressions.example: Some conversations lose their weight online and regain it only when held in person. （对照记忆：屏幕背后 vs 本人到场，呼应单元主题）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in person 作方式状语
advancedExpressions.expression: 介词短语 in person 作方式状语，修饰 meet / thank / attend 等动词，位置常在句末
advancedExpressions.example: We should put down our smartphones and meet them in person. （in person 作 meet 的方式状语，说明"以本人到场的方式"相见——考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: no screen / message could ever replace the warmth of ... in person
advancedExpressions.example: As I finally embraced her, I understood that no glowing screen could ever replace the warmth of a hand held in person. （对比升华+触觉细节，续写结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would be honoured if you could join us in person to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We would be truly honoured if you could join us in person to share your inspiring story with the students. （邀请信礼貌句式，honoured 提升正式度）

advancedExpressions.expression: however convenient ... may be, meeting in person remains irreplaceable when ...
advancedExpressions.example: However convenient instant messaging may be, meeting in person remains irreplaceable when trust and genuine understanding are at stake. （让步状语+核心论点，凸显思辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She went to thank the old man herself.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Unable to let a phone call carry the weight of her gratitude, she travelled three hours across the city to thank the old man in person, and the moment their eyes met, her carefully rehearsed words dissolved into a quiet, grateful smile. （读后续写·心理+动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Unable to do 现在分词状语作前置铺垫 + 具体化细节(travelled three hours) + 情节转折(rehearsed words dissolved) + in person 点明主题词

sentenceUpgrade.original: I think it is better to talk to people in person.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that, however advanced our communication technology becomes, certain conversations regain their true meaning only when they are conducted in person, where a glance and a pause can speak louder than a thousand emojis. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + however 引导让步从句 + only when 强调条件 + 对比修辞(a glance and a pause vs a thousand emojis)

classPractice.question: 为了让朋友真正成为我们生活的一部分，我们应该放下手机，亲自去见他们。To make friends a real part of our lives, we should put down our smartphones and meet them ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句；in person 作方式状语"亲自、当面"，与前文 put down smartphones 呼应

classPractice.question: She wanted to thank the old man personally. → She wanted to thank the old man ____ ____.
classPractice.note: personally = in person，均表"亲自、当面"；辨析 personally 更书面、in person 更强调本人到场

classPractice.question: I had only seen her on television, so meeting the champion ____ left me star-struck. (in person / in the flesh)
classPractice.note: 两者均可；in the flesh 更贴合"此前只在屏幕上见过、如今亲眼见到名人"的惊叹语气

original_sentence: In Mark Twain's Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the friendship forms between Huck Finn and Jim is an important theme of the book, though they appear to be an unlikely pair.
readingExamples: In Mark Twain's Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the friendship forms between Huck Finn and Jim is an important theme of the book, though they appear to be an unlikely pair.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, a speech, an artwork, or a discussion
(2) n. a particular idea or setting that connects and organizes an event, party, exhibition, or design
(3) n. a short melody or tune on which a longer piece of music is based; a recurring musical motif
(4) n. an idea or feeling that appears repeatedly throughout a work or a person's life

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 主旋律；主题曲（音乐）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the film's final scene faded, the familiar theme swelled once more, and half the audience found themselves humming it long after the lights came up. （读后续写·电影院·旋律记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （作定语）以某一主题为特色的，如 theme park 主题公园
uncommonMeanings.example: The disused factory had been transformed into a theme park of the imagination, where rusted machines now told stories to wide-eyed children. （读后续写·废墟重生·奇幻）

posExamples.sentence: As the old teacher turned the final page, he realized that loyalty had been the quiet theme running through his student's essay all along — a boy writing, without knowing it, about his own heart. （读后续写·师生·顿悟）
I am writing to propose that the theme of this year's English Festival be 'Bridges to the World', so that every performance can celebrate friendship across cultures. （应用文·建议信）

Throughout the great works of literature, the theme of the individual against an unjust society recurs again and again, reminding each generation that conscience must never bow to convenience. （议论文·文学与道德）
For our graduation party, we finally settled on a starry-night theme, and by dusk the hall shimmered with paper constellations we had spent a whole week folding. （读后续写·校园活动·温情）

wordForms.other: 作定语构成主题式复合词：theme park (主题公园) / theme song (主题曲) / theme party (主题派对)

collocations.phrase: an important theme of the book
collocations.translation: 这本书的一个重要主题（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In Mark Twain's Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the friendship between Huck Finn and Jim is an important theme of the book, though they appear to be an unlikely pair. （课文原句）
This year's essay competition centres on the theme of resilience in the face of hardship. （应用文·通知）
Our class trip to the science theme park turned an ordinary weekend into a day of wonder and laughter. （读后续写·校园生活）
The central theme of her speech — that kindness costs nothing yet changes everything — moved the entire hall to silence. （应用文·演讲）
Sacrifice for family is a recurring theme in Chinese literature, from ancient poems to modern novels. （议论文·文学分析）
In his final chapter the author explores the theme of forgiveness with startling tenderness. （读后续写·文学赏析）
The students staged a short play on the theme of environmental protection to mark Earth Day. （应用文·报道）
The moment the theme song began to play, memories of that unforgettable summer came flooding back. （读后续写·怀旧）
We organized a 1980s theme party, and even our reserved head teacher showed up in a pair of retro sunglasses. （读后续写·趣味情节）
The judges praised her article for staying firmly on theme while still surprising readers with fresh examples. （应用文·点评）

synonyms.example: The debate topic — whether social media brings us closer or drives us apart — sparked a lively exchange of views. （议论文·辩论）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：topic 指讨论或写作的“具体话题、题目”，范围较窄、较具体；theme 指贯穿全文／作品的“中心思想、主题”，层次更深、更抽象。

synonyms.example: Courage under pressure was the subject he returned to in almost every story he wrote. （读后续写·文学）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：subject 泛指“所讨论／描写的对象、题材”，中性宽泛；theme 更强调作者借题材要传达的深层意涵和思想内核。

synonyms.translation: （艺术、文学中反复出现的）主题元素，母题
synonyms.example: The image of a lone candle appears as a recurring motif, symbolizing hope in the darkest chapters. （议论文·文学分析）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：motif 指作品中反复出现的“具体意象或元素”（如颜色、物件），是构成 theme 的部件；theme 是由这些 motif 共同烘托出的整体思想。

advancedExpressions.expression: the theme of ... / on the theme of ... / the main (central / recurring) theme / a theme park (song / party)
advancedExpressions.example: On the theme of friendship, she wrote an essay whose central theme was loyalty. （"……的主题/以……为主题/主要主题/主题公园"一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.expression: theme (n.) → thematic (adj. 主题的) / thematically (adv. 从主题上); theme + 名词 = 主题式复合词 (theme park / theme song / theme party)
advancedExpressions.example: The exhibition was thematically arranged, each room built around one central theme. （n.加 -atic 变形容词 thematic，再加 -ally 变副词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"主题/中心思想"
advancedExpressions.expression: theme = subject = topic = motif (中心思想/题材/话题/母题)
advancedExpressions.example: Friendship is the theme / subject / topic that runs through the whole novel. （功能相近；theme 更深层抽象，topic 更具体，motif 指反复出现的意象元素）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp the theme that had quietly threaded through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she grasp the theme that had quietly threaded through every hardship of that year — that hope, once planted, refuses to die. （倒装+隐喻，续写结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: we have chosen ... as the theme, in the hope that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We have chosen 'Reaching Out' as the theme of this charity week, in the hope that every small act of kindness will ripple outward. （建议信/倡议句式，比喻升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the enduring theme of ... speaks to ... across generations
advancedExpressions.example: The enduring theme of perseverance speaks to readers across generations, precisely because struggle is written into the very fabric of human life. （中心论点句，abstract 名词化提升学术感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The theme of the book is friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath its adventures and its winding river, the book carries a single, unshakeable theme — that true friendship recognizes no barrier of race or fortune, and that loyalty, once given, is worth more than freedom itself. （读后续写·文学点评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beneath ... 介词短语前置渲染 + 破折号引出主题 + that 引导同位语从句解释主题 + 递进对比(race or fortune / loyalty vs freedom)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many stories talk about the theme of hope.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is no coincidence that the theme of hope surfaces again and again across the world's great literature, for storytelling has always been humanity's way of insisting that darkness is never the final word. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is no coincidence that 强调句式 + surfaces again and again 生动动词 + for 引导原因分句 + 拟人/隐喻(darkness is never the final word)

classPractice.question: 赫克·芬恩与吉姆之间的友谊是这本书的一个重要主题。The friendship between Huck Finn and Jim is an important ____ ____ the book.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句；the theme of the book "这本书的主题"，theme 后接 of 引出所属

classPractice.question: The exhibition was arranged ____ (theme), with each room built around one central idea.
classPractice.note: 空处修饰动词 arranged，需副词 thematically "从主题上"；theme→thematic→thematically 构词链

classPractice.question: Our class spent the whole weekend at the science ____ ____ (主题公园), and everyone came back full of wonder.
classPractice.note: theme park "主题公园"，theme 作定语构成复合名词；同类还有 theme song / theme party

original_sentence: Huck is a poor white boy father often beats him, while Jim is a black slave longs to be free.
readingExamples: Huck is a poor white boy father often beats him, while Jim is a black slave longs to be free.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who is legally owned by another person and forced to work for them without payment or freedom
(2) n. a person who is completely dominated by, or excessively devoted to, someone or something
(3) v. (usually 'slave away') to work extremely hard, often for long hours and with little reward

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拼命干活；苦干（常用 slave away）
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights she slaved over the design, fuelled by nothing but cold coffee and the stubborn belief that this time she would not fail. （读后续写·备赛·奋斗）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 受……支配的人；……的奴隶（比喻，常作 a slave to sth.）
uncommonMeanings.example: He had become a slave to other people's opinions, weighing every word he spoke against the fear of being judged. （读后续写·自我觉醒·心理）

posExamples.sentence: Born a slave and denied even the right to his own name, the old man had nonetheless kept alive, through every beating, a fierce and unbreakable dream of freedom. （读后续写·历史·人物）
I firmly believe that we should never become slaves to our smartphones; instead, we ought to be the masters of the technology we create. （应用文·演讲/倡议）
History reminds us, again and again, that no society can call itself civilized while it treats human beings as slaves, for the freedom of one is bound up with the freedom of all. （议论文·自由与人权）
While her classmates rested during the holiday, she slaved away in the school lab, convinced that opportunity favours only those who refuse to stop working. （读后续写·励志）

wordForms.other: 【构词法·前缀 en-】enslave (vt. 使奴役)＝en-(使…) + slave；【派生名词】slavery (n. 奴隶制/奴役)；【复合词】slave-driver (n. 苛刻的监工/工头)；slave trade (n. 奴隶贸易)。【贴士】slave 作名词表'奴隶'，作比喻时 a slave to sth.；作动词 slave away 表'拼命干活'。

idioms.translation: 赶时髦的人（贬义，指盲目追随潮流者）
idioms.example: She refused to be a slave to fashion, choosing instead the worn coat that carried her grandmother's memory. （读后续写·个性/亲情）
For weeks the volunteers worked like slaves to rebuild the flooded village, and not one of them uttered a word of complaint. （读后续写·集体·奉献）

collocations.phrase: a black slave (longs to be free)
collocations.translation: 一个（渴望自由的）黑奴（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Jim is a black slave who longs to be free. （课文原句词块，slave 作表语）
Don't be a slave to your phone. 别做手机的奴隶。
She worked like a slave to finish the project. 她拼命干活以完成项目。
He slaved away at his books all night. 他整夜埋头苦读。
Do not let yourself become a slave to your phone; put it down and truly look at the people around you. （应用文·倡议书）
The freed slaves gathered at dawn, blinking at a horizon that, for the first time, belonged to them. （读后续写·历史·自由时刻）
He slaved away at his experiments long after midnight, driven by a curiosity that no exhaustion could dampen. （读后续写·科研）
The runaway slave crept through the marshes by night, guided only by the North Star and an unquenchable hope. （读后续写·历史）
The museum's new exhibition traces the horrors of the slave trade so that no generation may forget them. （应用文·报道）
In that dark chapter of history, wealthy landowners bought and sold slaves as though they were mere property. （议论文·历史反思）

collocations.phrase: be a slave to one's emotions / habits
collocations.example: Once he learned to pause and breathe, he was no longer a slave to his own temper. （读后续写·成长）
Countless reformers devoted their lives to abolishing slavery, believing that liberty is the birthright of every human being. （议论文·社会变革）

synonyms.example: The loyal old servant had served three generations of the family, yet was treated with the warmth of a grandfather. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：servant 指“受雇为人服务的仆人”，享有人身自由、领取报酬；slave 指被他人合法拥有、毫无自由的奴隶，语义沉重得多。

synonyms.example: The captive was kept behind bars, but his spirit roamed as freely as ever. （读后续写·困境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：captive 强调“被抓获、被囚禁”的状态，常指战俘或人质，不一定被拥有；slave 强调“被作为财产拥有并强迫劳动”的身份。

advancedExpressions.expression: a slave to sth. / work like a slave / slave away / the slave trade
advancedExpressions.example: a slave to fashion 赶时髦的人；work like a slave 拼命干活；slave away at sth. 苦干；the slave trade 奴隶贸易。（一组高频短语，按语境选用）

advancedExpressions.expression: slave away = work like a slave = toil = work one's fingers to the bone
advancedExpressions.example: He slaved away / toiled / worked his fingers to the bone to support his family. 他拼命干活养家。（可互换替换，程度递增）

advancedExpressions.expression: slave → enslave (使奴役)
advancedExpressions.example: A society that reduces people to slaves ultimately enslaves itself. 奴役他人的社会终将奴役自身。（en-+名词=动词'使…'）

advancedExpressions.expression: no chain could bind the ... within sb.
advancedExpressions.example: They could brand him a slave, but no chain could bind the free spirit that burned within him. （对比转折+隐喻，续写升华人物尊严）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us be the masters, not the slaves, of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us be the masters, not the slaves, of the technology we hold in our hands. （对比排比句式，倡议信呼吁段，master/slave 对照有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: a society that reduces people to slaves ultimately enslaves itself
advancedExpressions.example: A society that reduces people to slaves ultimately enslaves itself, for injustice, once tolerated, corrodes the conscience of all. （警句式论点，enslave 动词呼应+因果论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The slave wanted to be free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Chained by day yet unchained in dream, the young slave clung to a single image — a wide, open river carrying him toward a shore where no man could ever be bought or sold. （读后续写·渴望自由·意象）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Chained ... yet unchained 对比分词状语前置 + 破折号引出核心意象 + 意象象征(open river/free shore) + 定语从句延展

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not be controlled by our phones.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we asked ourselves a sobering question: are we still the masters of our smartphones, or have we quietly become their slaves, surrendering our attention one notification at a time? （议论文/演讲·反思句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time (that) 虚拟语气 + 冒号引出核心问题 + master/slave 对照反问 + one ... at a time 具象化收束

classPractice.question: Jim is a black ____ (slave) who longs to be free.
classPractice.note: 考点：slave 作可数名词表'奴隶'，此处单数作表语，对应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 slave 的适当形式填空：Don't become a ____ to your smartphone; be its master instead.
classPractice.note: 考点：be a slave to sth.'成为……的奴隶'，to 为介词。

classPractice.question: 为了养家，他像奴隶一样拼命干活。To support his family, he ____ ____ ____ ____ (拼命苦干).
classPractice.note: 考点：work like a slave'像奴隶一样拼命干活'，四空对应 worked/like/a/slave；同义表达 slave away（不可数此四空）。

original_sentence: Then they leave the island together on a raft they find on the Mississippi River.
readingExamples: Then they leave the island together on a raft they find on the Mississippi River.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flat floating structure, usually made of logs, planks, or inflated material, used for travelling on or across water
(2) n. a small inflatable rubber or plastic boat, especially one used in emergencies or for water sports
(3) n. (a raft of sth.) a large number or amount of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大量，一批（a raft of sth.）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new headmaster arrived with a raft of ambitious reforms, and within a term the sleepy little school had come alive with clubs, contests and colour. （读后续写·校园变革·正能量）

posExamples.sentence: Lashing the last few logs together with trembling fingers, the two boys pushed their makeshift raft into the current and let the great river carry their friendship toward the unknown. （读后续写·冒险·友情）
During the summer camp, we will learn to build a raft from bamboo and ropes, an activity designed to teach teamwork and problem-solving in the wild. （应用文·活动通知）

When the floodwaters rose without warning, the villagers' hastily built rafts became the fragile boundary between survival and disaster — proof that human ingenuity shines brightest in crisis. （议论文·人类应对灾难）
As the storm swallowed the last strip of shore, they clung to the tiny rubber raft, four strangers now bound together by nothing but the will to see morning. （读后续写·海难·求生）

wordForms.verb: raft (v. 乘筏渡过；用筏运送)
wordForms.other: 【派生】rafting (n. 漂流运动)；white-water rafting (n. 激流漂流)；life raft (n. 救生筏)。【一词多义贴士】raft 常义为'筏子'(可数名词)；熟词僻义 a raft of sth.＝a large number of'大量的……'，等于 a host of / a range of，属高考写作/阅读高频。

collocations.phrase: on a raft (they find on the river)
collocations.translation: 乘（在河上找到的）筏子（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Then they leave the island together on a raft they find on the Mississippi River. （课文原句，on a raft 表'乘筏子'）

collocations.translation: 大量的……，一大批（熟词僻义，高频考点）
collocations.example: The government introduced a raft of new measures. 政府出台了大量新措施。
They built a raft from driftwood to escape the island. 他们用浮木造筏子逃离小岛。
Stranded on the island, they set about building a raft from driftwood, refusing to let despair take hold. （读后续写·荒岛求生）
The rescue team paddled an inflatable raft toward the overturned boat as the crowd on the bank held its breath. （读后续写·营救）
Drifting downstream on a raft, they watched the forest slide past in a green blur and felt, for once, entirely free. （读后续写·旅途）
When the ferry began to list, the crew calmly guided the passengers into the life rafts one by one. （应用文·事故报道）
Our club is organizing a white-water rafting trip this weekend, so please sign up early if you long for a thrill. （应用文·招募通知）
The government introduced a raft of measures to protect the endangered river dolphins. （议论文·环保政策）
He paddled the raft with steady, practised strokes, steering it clear of the jagged rocks ahead. （读后续写·河上历险）

synonyms.example: They rowed the little boat across the still lake as the first light of dawn gilded the water. （读后续写·清晨湖上）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：boat 泛指各种小船，通常有船身、船底；raft 是平底、无船体的“筏子”，多由圆木或充气材料拼成，更简陋原始。

synonyms.example: The battered vessel limped into harbour after weathering the fiercest storm of the decade. （读后续写·航海）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：vessel 是“船只、舰艇”的正式书面用词，多指较大船舶；raft 特指最简易的漂浮工具，二者体量与语体差别很大。

advancedExpressions.expression: build a raft / on a raft / a life raft / go (white-water) rafting / a raft of sth.
advancedExpressions.example: build a raft 造筏子；a life raft 救生筏；go white-water rafting 去激流漂流；a raft of measures 大量措施。（一词两用：具体物+抽象量词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'大量的'(a raft of)
advancedExpressions.expression: a raft of = a host of = a range of = a wealth of = an array of
advancedExpressions.example: a raft of / a host of / an array of new measures 大量新措施。（均接可数名词复数，表'一大批'，可互换）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·raft they find 的省略
advancedExpressions.expression: a raft (that/which) they find on the river
advancedExpressions.example: a raft they find on the Mississippi River＝a raft that they find...；先行词作从句宾语，关系代词 that/which 可省略。（课文语法点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the fragile raft was all that stood between them and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Now the fragile raft was all that stood between them and the hungry darkness of the sea. （对比反衬+拟人(hungry darkness)，续写渲染绝境）

advancedExpressions.expression: join us as we ... , learning to ... together
advancedExpressions.example: Join us this summer as we brave the rapids on a raft, learning to trust one another and to conquer fear together. （倡议/招募句式，动名词并列点明活动意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: much like a raft in a flood, ... keeps ... afloat when ...
advancedExpressions.example: Much like a raft in a flood, a resilient spirit keeps us afloat when the currents of misfortune threaten to pull us under. （明喻类比论证，raft 作喻体升华主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They left the island on a raft.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the first grey light crept over the water, they shoved off from the island on a raft lashed together from broken branches, two friends surrendering themselves to a river that would decide their fate. （读后续写·启程·氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语从句铺陈晨光 + 具体化(lashed from broken branches) + 拟人(a river that would decide their fate) + 分词短语收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The government made many new rules to protect rivers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to mounting public concern, the authorities rolled out a raft of stringent measures aimed at safeguarding the nation's rivers, signalling at last a determination to place ecology above short-term profit. （议论文·政策评述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In response to 状语引出背景 + a raft of 熟词僻义(大量) + aimed at 分词后置定语 + signalling 结果状语点明意义

classPractice.question: 然后他们乘着在密西西比河上找到的筏子一起离开了小岛。Then they leave the island together ____ ____ ____ they find on the Mississippi River.
classPractice.note: 考点：on a raft'乘筏子'，介词 on 表交通方式；对应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 raft 填空并注意熟词僻义：The new headmaster arrived with a ____ of reforms, and the school soon came alive.
classPractice.note: 考点：a raft of sth.＝大量的……(＝a host of/a range of)，此处非'筏子'义。

classPractice.question: 选词：In the storm they clung to a small rubber ____ (raft / vessel), the only thing keeping them afloat.
classPractice.note: 考点：raft 指平底、无船体的简易筏子/橡皮筏；vessel 指较大较正式的船只，此处橡皮'筏'用 raft。

translation: 最有意思（或最令人愉快、最好）的部分
original_sentence: The high point of the story comes when Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers.
readingExamples: The high point of the story comes when Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the best, most exciting, or most successful part of an event, experience, or period of time
(2) n. the climax or most memorable moment in a story, performance, or journey
(3) n. a moment of greatest achievement or intensity in someone's life or career

posExamples.sentence: Looking back, she knew the high point of that entire summer had not been winning the medal, but the moment her father, tears in his eyes, whispered that he had never been prouder. （读后续写·亲情·顿悟）
The high point of our school trip was undoubtedly the evening by the campfire, when strangers became friends and shy voices rose together in song. （应用文·游记/报道）
The high point of any truly great novel comes not from its grandest event, but from that quiet instant when a character must choose between comfort and conscience. （议论文·文学·观点）
For weeks the choir had rehearsed in secret, and the high point arrived when the curtain rose and the whole hall fell silent, waiting for their first note. （读后续写·演出·期待）

collocations.phrase: the high point of the story (comes when ...)
collocations.translation: 故事的高潮（出现在……时）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The high point of the story comes when Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers. （课文原句）
The high point of the trip was the sunrise on the summit. 此行的高潮是山顶日出。
Her career reached its high point at thirty. 她的事业在三十岁达到顶峰。
The high point of the ceremony was the moment the oldest graduate returned to hand the youngest student a single, symbolic candle. （读后续写·典礼）
In the play, the high point comes when the estranged brothers finally clasp hands, and the audience releases a breath it did not know it was holding. （读后续写·戏剧）
Her career reached its high point when her research was recognized on the world stage. （应用文·人物介绍）
That unforgettable duet marked the high point of the entire music festival. （应用文·报道）
The emotional high point of the film left not a single dry eye in the cinema. （读后续写·观影）
Volunteering at the shelter was, without question, a definite high point of my entire year. （应用文·感想）
Meeting my long-lost pen friend was one of the high points of the whole exchange programme. （应用文·交流总结）

synonyms.example: The highlight of the evening was a surprise song by the shy new boy. 当晚最精彩的是那个害羞新生的即兴演唱。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：highlight 与 high point 意思最接近，都指'最精彩之处'，highlight 更口语常用，也可指'节目集锦'；high point 常强调情感或情节的顶点。句法上都可作 the highlight/high point of sth.。

synonyms.example: The story builds toward its climax, where every secret is laid bare. 故事层层推进走向高潮，一切秘密被揭开。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：climax 特指叙事或事件层层推进后的'最高潮、转折顶点'，学术味更浓，reach/build to a climax；high point 泛指'最精彩／最愉快的部分'，不一定是结构上的顶点。

synonyms.translation: 顶峰，高峰（多指状态、成就）
synonyms.example: At the peak of her fame, she chose to teach in a mountain village. 名声鼎盛时，她却选择去山村任教。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：peak 常指能力、成就、事业'达到最高水平的顶峰状态'，at the peak of；high point 更侧重某段经历中'最精彩、最难忘的时刻或环节'。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'最精彩之处'
advancedExpressions.expression: the high point = the highlight = the climax = the peak (of sth.)
advancedExpressions.example: The high point / highlight / climax of the trip was ...。（叙事写作/游记/报道通用替换，避免重复用 the best part）

advancedExpressions.expression: the high point of sth. / the high point comes when ... / reach / mark a high point
advancedExpressions.example: The high point comes when ... 高潮出现在……时；reach its high point 达到顶点；mark the high point 标志最精彩时刻。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·comes when 引导时间状语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: The high point comes when + 从句
advancedExpressions.example: The high point of the story comes when Huck must decide whether to hand Jim over. when 引导时间状语从句，用于描述故事高潮出现的时刻。（课文句式，写读后续写点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true high point was not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true high point of that day was not the trophy in her hands, but the sight of her mother clapping through tears in the last row. （对比转折+画面定格，续写点睛，重心落在情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: the high point for me was undoubtedly ...
advancedExpressions.example: The high point for me was undoubtedly the moment we finished the mural together and stepped back to admire what teamwork had created. （感想信/总结句式，undoubtedly 强化真情实感）

advancedExpressions.expression: the high point of ... lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The high point of any education lies not in the grades we collect, but in the moment a student first thinks for himself. （对比论点句，抽象名词提升思辨深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The best part of the trip was climbing the mountain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The high point of the trip came at dawn on the summit, when the clouds parted like a curtain and the whole valley below glowed gold — a view so breathtaking that, for a long moment, no one dared to speak. （读后续写·登顶·景色）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: high point ... came at 时间地点铺陈 + 明喻(clouds parted like a curtain) + 感官细节(glowed gold) + so ... that 结果状语收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The most exciting moment of the story is when Huck decides to help Jim.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The high point of the story comes when Huck, torn between the law he has been taught and the friend he has come to love, tears up the letter and declares, 'All right, then, I'll go to hell' — a single act of conscience that redeems the entire novel. （议论文·文学点评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: high point comes when 引出高潮 + 插入分词短语渲染内心挣扎(torn between...) + 引语点睛 + 破折号后同位语升华主题意义

classPractice.question: 故事的高潮出现在哈克必须决定是否把吉姆交给奴隶捕手时。The ____ ____ of the story comes ____ Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers.
classPractice.note: 考点：high point of sth.'高潮/最精彩处'＋when 引导时间状语从句；对应课文原句。

classPractice.question: The best and most exciting part of the trip was the sunrise. → The ____ ____ of the trip was the sunrise. (用同义短语替换)
classPractice.note: 考点：high point＝highlight'最精彩部分'，替换 the best part 使表达更地道。

classPractice.question: 选词：At the ____ (high point / peak) of her career, she was invited to lead the research team.
classPractice.note: 考点：peak 侧重事业/成就达到的'顶峰状态'(at the peak of one's career)；high point 侧重某段经历的最精彩时刻。

translation: 不顾艰难险阻，同甘共苦
original_sentence: From this story we can see that friends are people support you through thick and thin.
readingExamples: From this story we can see that friends are people support you through thick and thin.
definitionEn:
(1) idiom. through both good times and bad; despite every difficulty, hardship, or obstacle
(2) idiom. remaining loyal, supportive, and steadfast no matter what happens
(3) idiom. under all circumstances, whatever the cost or challenge

posExamples.sentence: Through thick and thin they had stood side by side — through the failed harvests, the sleepless nights, the whispered doubts of neighbours — and now, at last, the little farm was blooming again. （读后续写·患难与共·收获）
On behalf of the graduating class, I want to thank the teachers who guided us through thick and thin and never once gave up on the students others had written off. （应用文·感谢信/致辞）

A true friend, as history and literature alike remind us, is not one who shares only our triumphs, but one who stands by us through thick and thin, when applause fades and hardship sets in. （议论文·友谊的本质）
The two climbers had promised to see it through together, and through thick and thin — the biting cold, the failing light, the treacherous ice — neither would let go of the other's rope. （读后续写·登山·信念）

idioms.idiom: stand by sb. through thick and thin
idioms.translation: 无论顺境逆境都陪伴／支持某人
idioms.example: No matter how the world turned against him, his old dog stood by him through thick and thin, a silent witness to every fall and every rise. （读后续写·忠诚·陪伴）

idioms.idiom: stick / stay together through thick and thin
idioms.example: The team had stuck together through thick and thin, and that unspoken bond was worth more than any trophy. （读后续写·团队）

collocations.phrase: support you through thick and thin
collocations.translation: 无论顺境逆境都支持你（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Friends are people who support you through thick and thin. （课文原句，support sb. through thick and thin）

collocations.phrase: stand by sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: A real friend stands by you through thick and thin. 真正的朋友无论顺逆都陪着你。

collocations.phrase: stick together through thick and thin
collocations.example: The team stuck together through thick and thin. 这支队伍同甘共苦。

collocations.phrase: support sb. through thick and thin
collocations.translation: 在任何情况下都支持某人
collocations.example: My parents supported me through thick and thin, believing in my dream even when I had almost stopped believing in it myself. （读后续写·亲情）

collocations.phrase: stand by sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: A real friend is someone who will stand by you through thick and thin, asking for nothing in return. （议论文·友谊）

collocations.phrase: stay / stick together through thick and thin
collocations.example: Having stuck together through thick and thin, the classmates parted at graduation with tears they no longer tried to hide. （读后续写·毕业）

collocations.phrase: remain loyal / faithful through thick and thin
collocations.example: The old servant remained loyal through thick and thin, long after wealth and fortune had deserted the family. （读后续写·忠诚）

collocations.phrase: see sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: It was her unshakeable optimism that saw the whole family through thick and thin during those lean years. （读后续写·家庭）

collocations.phrase: be with sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: I promise to be with you through thick and thin, whatever storms the future may bring. （应用文·信件/誓言）

synonyms.example: They had learned to love each other in good times and bad, and that, she realized, was what a family truly meant. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in good times and bad 直白平实，语气中性，书面口语皆可；through thick and thin 是固定习语，更凝练、更有文学感染力，尤宜作文亮点。

synonyms.translation: 无论风雨（不管发生什么）
synonyms.example: Come rain or shine, the old postman climbed that hill every morning to deliver a single letter to the lonely widow. （读后续写·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：come rain or shine 强调“不论天气／情况如何都坚持做某事”，多修饰持续的行为；through thick and thin 更强调“共渡患难、始终不离”的忠诚关系。

synonyms.example: No matter what happened, he vowed, he would keep the promise he had made to his dying grandfather. （读后续写·承诺）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：no matter what 通用灵活，可引导让步从句；through thick and thin 是名词性习语短语，作状语，语体更文雅、感情更浓。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'同甘共苦/无论顺逆'
advancedExpressions.expression: through thick and thin = in good times and bad = come rain or shine = no matter what
advancedExpressions.example: stand by sb. through thick and thin / in good times and bad / come rain or shine. 无论顺逆都陪着某人。（习语最凝练，作文亮点，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: stand by / support / stick together / see sb. / remain loyal + through thick and thin
advancedExpressions.example: stand by sb.、support sb.、stick together、see sb.、remain loyal 后接 through thick and thin 作状语，均表'共渡患难、始终不离'。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·作状语的名词性习语
advancedExpressions.expression: through thick and thin 作方式/让步状语
advancedExpressions.example: Friends support you through thick and thin. 该习语为固定短语，作状语，不可拆改词序（不能说 through thin and thick）。（考点：词序固定）

advancedExpressions.expression: having weathered ... through thick and thin, sb. finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: Having weathered every storm through thick and thin, the two old friends finally sat in silence beneath the same tree that had shaded their childhood. （现在分词状语+画面回环，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I owe more than words can say to those who stood by me through thick and thin
advancedExpressions.example: I owe more than words can say to the teachers and friends who stood by me through thick and thin over these three unforgettable years. （感谢信/毕业致辞句式，谦辞抬升情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: friendship proves its worth not in ..., but in standing firm through thick and thin
advancedExpressions.example: True friendship proves its worth not in the sunshine of success, but in standing firm through thick and thin when the storms of adversity arrive. （对比论点句，隐喻(sunshine/storms)强化思辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good friends help each other in hard times.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Real friends are not those who merely celebrate our victories from a comfortable distance, but those who walk beside us through thick and thin, holding out a steady hand precisely when the ground beneath us begins to give way. （议论文/读后续写·友谊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not ... but ... 对比结构 + through thick and thin 习语点题 + 时间状语从句(precisely when...) + 隐喻(the ground gives way) 具象化困境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Huck and Jim supported each other in difficult situations.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Down the great muddy river and through every danger it hid, Huck and Jim stood by each other through thick and thin, until an unlikely pair — a runaway boy and a hunted slave — had become, against all the world expected, the truest of friends. （读后续写·文学·友情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置(Down the river...) 铺陈旅程 + through thick and thin 习语 + 破折号同位语点明身份反差 + against all the world expected 强化主题反差

classPractice.question: 由此故事可见，朋友是无论顺境逆境都支持你的人。From this story we can see that friends are people who support you ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 考点：support sb. through thick and thin'无论顺逆都支持某人'；对应课文原句，习语词序固定。

classPractice.question: 无论发生什么，她都陪伴在他身边，同甘共苦。（用 stand by 和 through thick and thin）
classPractice.answer: She stood by him through thick and thin, no matter what happened. / No matter what happened, she stood by him through thick and thin.
classPractice.note: 考点：stand by sb. + through thick and thin 表'患难与共'；习语作状语。

classPractice.question: They stayed loyal to each other in good times and bad. → They stayed loyal to each other ____ ____ ____ ____. (用习语替换)
classPractice.note: 考点：through thick and thin＝in good times and bad'同甘共苦'，习语替换更凝练。

translation: 意见，看法；(群体的)观点，信仰
original_sentence: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
readingExamples: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) n. your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject, not necessarily based on facts or knowledge
(2) n. the beliefs or views of a group of people (usually 'public opinion' / 'opinion')
(3) n. a professional judgement given by an expert, especially a doctor or lawyer
(4) n. an estimation of the worth or quality of someone or something (usually 'have a high/low opinion of')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (专家的)专业评断、鉴定意见
uncommonMeanings.example: The trembling patient sought a second opinion, clinging to the faint hope that another doctor might read the same X-ray with kinder eyes. （读后续写·就医·抓住一线希望）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对某人/某事好坏的评价、看法(常用 have a high/low opinion of)
uncommonMeanings.example: Ever since he had cheated in the exam, his classmates had such a low opinion of him that even his apologies were met with cold, sidelong glances. （读后续写·信任崩塌）

posExamples.sentence: She kept her opinion locked behind tight lips throughout the heated debate, yet the fierce light in her eyes betrayed just how strongly she disagreed with every word being spoken. （读后续写·人物心理·沉默的反抗）
I am writing to share my honest opinion on the proposed change to our library opening hours, which I believe would greatly benefit students preparing for the coming examinations. （应用文·建议信）
Public opinion, once firmly against the new recycling scheme, gradually shifted as residents witnessed the visible transformation of their once littered streets. （议论文·环保·观点转变）
In my opinion, reading widely does more to sharpen a young mind than any amount of memorised facts, for it teaches us not merely what to think but how to think. （议论文·阅读价值）

wordForms.other: opinion poll (n. 民意测验)

idioms.example: The old fisherman was firmly of the opinion that the sea gives most generously to those who respect it most. （读后续写·哲理·人物观点）

idioms.translation: 见仁见智的事,看法因人而异
idioms.example: Whether the film is a masterpiece or a mess is, in the end, purely a matter of opinion. （议论文·艺术评价）

collocations.example: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship. 在我看来，以下这些品质构成了友谊的基础。（课件例·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: one's opinion about / on / of sth
collocations.example: What is your opinion on / about online friendship? 你对网上交友有什么看法？（课件例）

collocations.phrase: give / express an opinion；voice / state one's opinion (formal)
collocations.translation: 【课件】发表/表达观点；（正式）陈述观点
collocations.example: Everyone was invited to express an opinion, and even the shyest student finally voiced her own. 每个人都被邀请发表看法，就连最害羞的学生也终于说出了自己的观点。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: have / hold a good / bad / high / low opinion of
collocations.example: The teacher had a high opinion of him. 老师对他评价很高。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: public opinion / an expert opinion / scientific opinion
collocations.translation: 【课件】舆论、民意 / 专家观点 / 科学观点
collocations.example: Public opinion soon turned against the plan, and even expert opinion could not save it. 民意很快转而反对该计划，就连专家观点也无力回天。（课件搭配）
A difference of opinion, if handled with patience, can strengthen rather than sever a friendship. 意见分歧若以耐心处理，反能加固而非割裂友谊。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: have a high / low opinion of sb.
collocations.translation: 对某人评价很高／很低（高频考点）
collocations.example: The teacher had a high opinion of him. 老师对他评价很高。

collocations.translation: 见仁见智之事，看法因人而异
collocations.example: Whether the film is good is a matter of opinion. 这部电影好不好见仁见智。
For the first time in her life, the timid girl rose to her feet and voiced an opinion that silenced the entire classroom. （读后续写·人物成长·突破自我）
We should never form an opinion about a stranger based solely on a first, fleeting impression. （议论文·偏见）
In the opinion of most educators, encouragement works far better than criticism in nurturing a child's confidence. （议论文·教育）
According to a recent opinion poll conducted among senior students, over 80 percent long for more outdoor activities. （应用文·调查报告）

collocations.translation: 征求他人(尤指专家)的意见
collocations.example: Unsure whether to accept the offer, she wisely sought a second opinion from her most trusted teacher. （读后续写·抉择时刻）
In my opinion, genuine friendship is measured not by the good times shared but by the storms weathered together. （应用文·演讲稿）
The company was forced to withdraw the advertisement after a wave of public opinion condemned it as misleading and disrespectful. （议论文·媒体与社会）
A difference of opinion, if handled with patience, can strengthen rather than sever a friendship. （应用文·倡议书）

synonyms.example: From my point of view, the two friends had simply grown apart, each drawn toward a different vision of life. （读后续写·友情变化）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:view 更中性、常指经过思考的立场,常用于 'point of view / in view of';opinion 更口语,强调个人主观判断

synonyms.example: It is my firm belief that kindness, however small, never truly goes to waste. （议论文·道德）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:belief 语气更坚定、带信仰色彩,不易改变;opinion 相对随意、可讨论可改变

synonyms.example: His whole attitude toward failure changed the day his coach told him that falling was simply the first half of standing up. （读后续写·心态转变）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:attitude 强调对事物的整体倾向与情感立场;opinion 只是对具体问题的具体看法

synonyms.example: The government took a firm stance against pollution, vowing to shut down every factory that flouted the new rules. （议论文·政策）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:stance 指公开、明确、往往需要坚持的立场;opinion 私人化、随意得多

advancedExpressions.expression: in one's opinion · one's opinion about/on/of sth · give/express/voice/state an opinion · have a high/low opinion of · public/expert/scientific opinion · a difference of opinion
advancedExpressions.example: In my opinion 在我看来；my opinion on friendship 我对友谊的看法；express an opinion 发表看法；have a high opinion of sb. 对某人评价高；public opinion 民意；a difference of opinion 意见分歧。（【课件】Integrated skills 集中呈现的一组高频搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my opinion / have a high(low) opinion of / a matter of opinion / public opinion / a difference of opinion
advancedExpressions.example: in my opinion 在我看来；have a high opinion of sb. 对某人评价高；a matter of opinion 见仁见智；public opinion 民意。（一组高考高频搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my opinion = in my view = as far as I am concerned = to my mind = personally
advancedExpressions.example: In my opinion / In my view / As far as I am concerned, honesty matters most. 在我看来，诚实最重要。（作文亮明观点，可互换替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: opinion → opinionated (固执己见的) / opine (v. 认为)
advancedExpressions.example: an opinionated old man 一个固执己见的老人；He opined that ... 他认为……。（opinion 派生词，opine 较正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. betrayed just how strongly sb. felt / thought
advancedExpressions.example: Though she said not a word, the tremor in her hands betrayed just how strongly she opposed the decision. （用无声细节反衬内心强烈观点,续写显真情）

advancedExpressions.expression: if I may offer my humble opinion, ...

original_sentence: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.

definitionEn:

posExamples.sentence: In my opinion, the greatest lesson friendship ever taught me was that being heard matters far more than being agreed with. （读后续写·友情感悟·主题句）
In our opinion, the school should set aside a quiet reading corner in the library, a proposal that we believe most students would warmly welcome. （应用文·建议信）

idioms.translation: 在某人看来，依某人之见（习语，引出主观看法）

collocations.translation: 在我看来（下列品质……）（课文原句词块）

synonyms.example: In my view, honesty forms the very bedrock on which lasting trust is built. （议论文·诚信）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'在某人看来'

translation: 品德，素质；质量；特征 | adj. 优质的，高质量的
original_sentence: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
readingExamples: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) n. how good or bad something is; the standard of something when compared to other things
(2) n. a feature or characteristic that someone or something has, especially one that is part of their nature
(3) n. a high standard; excellence
(4) adj. very good; of a high standard (used before a noun)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 品质，品德，素质（人的内在特点，常用复数 qualities）
uncommonMeanings.example: Honesty and loyalty are the qualities we look for in a friend. 诚实与忠诚是我们在朋友身上寻找的品质。（课文义：the following qualities）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 特征，特性（事物或人的固有特点，中性）
uncommonMeanings.example: The material has a special quality that makes it both light and strong. 这种材料有一种既轻又坚固的特性。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (声音、光线的)独特音色、质感、特性
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a haunting quality to her voice as she sang the old lullaby, a warmth that seemed to reach across the years and gather every listener into a single, tender memory. （读后续写·音乐·氛围渲染）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优质的,高档的(作定语)
uncommonMeanings.example: The little café survived not by cutting corners but by serving quality coffee to customers who had learned, over the years, to taste the difference. （读后续写·匠心·坚守）

posExamples.sentence: The one quality that set my grandfather apart was his unshakeable calm; even as the flood waters rose around our home, his steady voice kept every one of us from despair. （读后续写·人物品质·危机中的镇定）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the volunteer position, as he possesses every quality the role demands — patience, reliability and a genuine love of helping others. （应用文·推荐信）
It is quality, not quantity, that ultimately defines a meaningful life; a single act of true kindness outweighs a hundred hollow gestures. （议论文·人生价值·对比论证）
Spending quality time with our parents, unhurried and undistracted by screens, may well be the most precious gift we can offer them. （议论文·亲情）

wordForms.other: 【易混辨析】quality (质量/品质) ↔ quantity (数量)，仅差一个 t，常对比使用 quality over quantity；【派生】qualitative (adj. 定性的) ↔ quantitative (adj. 定量的)；【复合】quality control (质量控制)、quality time (宝贵时光)、quality of life (生活质量)。【一词多义贴士】quality 作'品质/素质'时常用复数 qualities(课文义)；作'质量'时不可数；作定语时表'优质的'(quality coffee)。

idioms.translation: (与家人朋友共度的)宝贵时光
idioms.example: After years of chasing deadlines, he finally learned that no promotion was worth the quality time he had lost with his growing children. （读后续写·家庭·醒悟）
Planting trees along the once-barren streets did more than beautify the town; it lifted the quality of life for every family who now walked in their shade. （议论文·环保·民生）

collocations.translation: 【课件】品德、素质（常用复数）：personal qualities 个人品质 / leadership qualities 领导品质
collocations.example: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship. 在我看来，以下这些品质构成了友谊的基础。（课件例·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be of good / high quality；improve the quality of sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】质量、品质：高质量的；改善……的质量
collocations.example: The scarves were of high quality, and the workshop kept working to improve the quality of every stitch. 这些围巾质量上乘，作坊仍在不断改善每一针的质量。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: quality service / products；quality time (adj. 优质的)
collocations.translation: 【课件】（形容词）优质的、高质量的：优质服务/产品；宝贵时光
collocations.example: The most important thing is to spend quality time talking to their children. 最重要的是花优质的时间与孩子交谈。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: the following qualities (form the basis of ...)
collocations.translation: 下列（种种）品质（构成……的基础）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship. （课文原句，qualities 复数表'品质/素质'）

collocations.phrase: the qualities of a good friend
collocations.translation: 一个好朋友应有的品质
collocations.example: Honesty is one of the qualities of a good friend. 诚实是好朋友应有的品质之一。
The scarves were of high quality. 这些围巾质量上乘。

collocations.translation: （与家人朋友共度的）宝贵时光
collocations.example: We spent quality time together at the weekend. 周末我们共度了宝贵的时光。
A few minutes of quiet reflection each morning can remarkably improve the quality of an entire day. （议论文·生活方式）
Access to clean water and fresh air lies at the very heart of the quality of life. （议论文·民生）

collocations.translation: 领导才能/令人钦佩的品质
collocations.example: Under pressure, she revealed leadership qualities that none of us had ever suspected in so quiet a girl. （读后续写·人物成长）
Strict quality control ensured that not a single faulty toy ever left the factory. （应用文·说明文）
The exhibition featured paintings of superior quality, each one a quiet triumph of patience and skill. （应用文·活动报道）
In friendship, as in art, quality matters infinitely more than quantity. （议论文·辩证）
My mentor was, in every sense, a person of quality — humble in success and gracious in defeat. （读后续写·人物评价）
A wise craftsman never sacrifices quality for speed, however tempting the shortcut may seem. （议论文·工匠精神）

synonyms.example: It is quality, not quantity, that matters in true friendship. 真正的友谊重质不重量。
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析（易混）：quality 指'质量/品质'(好坏程度)，quantity 指'数量'(多少)。二者常成对出现作对比：quality over quantity 重质不重量；注意拼写只差一个 t，勿混。

synonyms.example: Generosity was the most striking characteristic of the old man, who gave away his last coins without a moment's hesitation. （读后续写·人物）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:characteristic 中性,指区别于他人的显著特点;quality(表品质时)偏褒义,多指值得称道的内在品德

synonyms.example: The teacher held her class to an exacting standard, and in time her students came to hold themselves to the same. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:standard 强调可衡量的水准/标准线;quality 是被衡量出来的'好坏程度',两者常一起出现

synonyms.example: Perseverance is a trait that cannot be taught in a classroom; it is forged only in the fire of repeated failure. （议论文·品格）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:trait 专指性格/性情特征,更学术;quality 范围更广,可指人也可指物,可褒可中

synonyms.example: Whatever his faults, the plan had one undeniable merit: it cost nothing and helped everyone. （议论文·评价）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:merit 明确指值得肯定的优点、功绩;quality 更中性,需靠 high/good 等修饰才带褒义

advancedExpressions.expression: quality = characteristic = trait = merit (指人时可替换)
advancedExpressions.example: Patience is a quality / trait / characteristic every good teacher needs. 耐心是每位好老师需要的品质。（描述人物内在特点时可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: high/low quality / quality time / quality of life / quality control / quality over quantity
advancedExpressions.example: high quality 高质量；quality time 宝贵时光；the quality of life 生活质量；quality control 质量把关。（覆盖'质量/品质/优质'多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: quality (质) / quantity (量)；qualitative (定性) / quantitative (定量)
advancedExpressions.example: It is quality, not quantity, that counts. 重要的是质而非量。（一对高频反义/易混词，写作辨证论点常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: the one quality that set sb. apart was ...
advancedExpressions.example: The one quality that set her apart was not her talent but her tireless willingness to help those who had far less. （用'非A而B'突出人物核心品质,续写点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. possesses every quality the role / task demands
advancedExpressions.example: I can say with confidence that she possesses every quality the position demands, from patience to unwavering integrity. （推荐信中概括+具体品质罗列）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is quality, not quantity, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is quality, not quantity, that gives life its meaning — one profound friendship is worth a thousand shallow acquaintances. （强调句+对比,议论文金句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He is a person with good qualities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He was a person of rare quality — the sort who returned every kindness twofold and forgave every wrong before it was even confessed. （读后续写·人物赞美）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a person of rare quality 名词化提升 + 破折号+the sort who 定语从句 + twofold/before it was confessed 用具体行为落实抽象品质

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should improve the quality of our study.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 状语引导对比 + would do well to 委婉建议 + for 引导原因 + one hour...what three hours cannot 数字对比强化论点

original_sentence: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
readingExamples: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the facts, ideas or things from which something can be developed; a foundation or starting point
(2) n. the principle or reason on which something is done, decided or judged
(3) n. the way in which something is organized, done or arranged (usually 'on a ... basis')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (用于 on a ... basis)……方式地、按……的规律
uncommonMeanings.example: The two old friends had promised to write to each other on a monthly basis, and for forty unbroken years neither of them ever let a single letter go unsent. （读后续写·友情·守信）

posExamples.sentence: Mutual trust, I have come to believe, is the very basis of every lasting friendship; without it, even the warmest bond will crack at the first cold wind of doubt. （读后续写·友情·主题句）
I am writing to suggest that our club select its members purely on the basis of enthusiasm rather than experience, so that every willing student may have a fair chance. （应用文·建议信）
A sound moral basis, rather than the fear of punishment, is what truly keeps a society honest; laws restrain the hand, but conscience restrains the heart. （议论文·道德与法律·对比论证）
The theory sounded impressive, yet it rested on no solid basis of evidence, and so collapsed the moment it was put to a serious test. （议论文·理性思辨）

wordForms.verb: base (vt. base sth on/upon 把……建立在……之上)
wordForms.other: 复数：bases /ˈbeɪsiːz/（注意与 base 的复数 bases /ˈbeɪsɪz/ 拼写相同但读音不同）。base 词族：base n.基地/vt.以……为基础，basis n.基础/依据（抽象），basic adj.基本的，basically adv.基本上。小贴士：base one's argument on facts＝把论点建立在事实上。

collocations.phrase: form the basis of sth（基础 foundation）
collocations.example: The basis of friendship is mutual trust. 友谊的基础是相互信任。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: on the basis of sth / on the basis that ...（根据 argument）
collocations.translation: 【课件】（2）根据、依据：以……为根据；基于……（理由）
collocations.example: She was promoted on the basis of her excellent performance. 她基于自己出色的表现而获得提拔。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: on a regular / monthly / daily / weekly basis（基准 condition）
collocations.translation: 【课件】（3）基准、方式：定期地/每月/每天/每周地
collocations.example: The two old friends wrote to each other on a monthly basis for forty years. 这两位老友四十年来每月都互通书信。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 构成（友谊）的基础（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In my opinion, the following qualities form the basis of a friendship. 在我看来，以下这些品质构成了友谊的基础。（课文原句）
We should never judge a person on the basis of a single mistake, for even the finest gold carries flaws. （议论文·宽容）

collocations.phrase: on a regular / daily / voluntary basis
collocations.example: On a voluntary basis, dozens of students now gather every weekend to clean the riverbank they once ignored. （应用文·活动报道）
The values our parents instil in childhood form the basis of the choices we make for the rest of our lives. （议论文·家庭教育）
Years of daily practice had given her a solid basis on which to build her extraordinary talent. （读后续写·励志）
The rumour that he had cheated had no basis in fact, yet it spread through the school like wildfire. （读后续写·误会）
True cooperation can only flourish when both sides work on an equal basis, each valuing the other's voice. （议论文·合作）
The kindness he showed a stranger that rainy night quietly laid the basis for a friendship that would last a lifetime. （读后续写·善意的回报）

synonyms.example: Trust is the foundation upon which every great relationship is patiently built, stone by careful stone. （议论文·信任）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:foundation 更具象、多用于比喻'根基/地基',强调稳固支撑;basis 更抽象,侧重'依据/出发点',常搭 on the basis of

synonyms.example: She refused the offer on the grounds that accepting it would mean betraying a friend. （读后续写·抉择）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:ground(s) 多指'理由/正当依据',常用 on the grounds that;basis 侧重'赖以建立/判断的基础'

synonyms.translation: 基础,立足点(常指关系状态)
synonyms.example: After a long and honest talk, the two rivals finally placed their relationship on a friendly footing. （读后续写·和解）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:footing 常指人际关系或事物所处的状态/立场(on a...footing);basis 更泛指根本依据

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·base 词族（课件归纳）
advancedExpressions.expression: base vt. 以……为根据 (base sth on/upon sth) · base n. 根基/根据 · basis n. 基础/依据(抽象) · basic adj. 基本的 · basically adv. 基本上
advancedExpressions.example: We should base our argument on facts (base sth on sth); facts are the very basis of a sound argument; the basic idea is basically the same. （【课件】base/basis/basic/basically 同族辨析，base sth on 把……建立在……之上）

advancedExpressions.expression: form / lay / provide the basis of · on the basis of · on a ... basis · have no basis in fact
advancedExpressions.example: On the basis of these shared values, honesty and loyalty gradually laid the basis of a friendship that had no need for daily words. （一次串起 on the basis of / lay the basis of，供课堂集中记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'基础/依据'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: the basis of ≈ the foundation of ≈ the ground(s) for ≈ the footing of
advancedExpressions.example: What forms the basis of true friendship — the foundation on which it stands — is not shared interests but shared trust. （在'基础'语义下 basis / foundation 互替，扩写可选）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., I have come to believe, is the very basis of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Forgiveness, I have come to believe, is the very basis of every friendship strong enough to survive time and distance. （插入语+the very basis 强调,续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: on the basis of ..., I would like to propose that ...
advancedExpressions.example: On the basis of the recent survey, I would like to propose that we extend the library's opening hours during the exam week. （建议信中'依据+主张'的规范结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sound ... forms the basis of ..., without which ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sound moral education forms the basis of a healthy society, without which no law, however strict, can guarantee justice. （without which 非限制定语从句,论证严密）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Trust is important in friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Trust, quiet and often unspoken, is the very basis of friendship — the invisible thread that holds two hearts together long after the words of promise have faded. （读后续写·友情·比喻升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the very basis of 强调核心 + 破折号+the invisible thread 比喻 + long after...have faded 时间状语延伸意境

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not judge people by their appearance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We ought never to judge a person on the basis of appearance alone, for beneath the plainest exterior may beat the noblest of hearts. （议论文·外表与内在）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: on the basis of 正式短语 + ought never to 加强语气 + for 引导原因 + beneath...may beat 倒装+对比升华

classPractice.question: 在我看来，以下这些品质构成了友谊的基础。In my opinion, the following qualities ____ ____ ____ of a friendship.
classPractice.note: 【课件·课文原句】form the basis of"构成……的基础"(义项1 foundation)，basis 单数用 the

classPractice.question: 【课件义·根据】她基于自己出色的表现而获得提拔。She was promoted ____ ____ ____ ____ her excellent performance.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】on the basis of sth"以……为根据"(义项2 argument)；亦可 on the basis that + 从句

classPractice.question: We should never judge a person ____ the basis ____ a single mistake.
classPractice.note: on the basis of 根据、以……为依据，介词固定搭配

classPractice.question: The volunteers meet to clean the park on a regular ____ (basis). (基准/方式义)
classPractice.note: 【课件义项3 condition】on a regular/monthly/daily basis"定期/每月/每天地"；单数不变，复数为 bases

translation: 尊重，尊敬 | n. 尊敬，敬意；重视
original_sentence: I must respect and support the choices he makes.
readingExamples: I must respect and support the choices he makes.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to admire someone because of their qualities or achievements, and treat them politely
(2) vt. to be careful about, and not break, a law, rule, wish or agreement
(3) n. admiration for someone because of their good qualities or achievements
(4) n. a particular feature, detail or point (as in 'in this respect' / 'in some respects')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（某一）方面（in this respect / with respect to = concerning 关于、就……而言）
uncommonMeanings.example: In this respect we are very fortunate. 在这方面，我们是很幸运的。 / The two groups were similar with respect to income and status. 这两组在收入和地位方面是相似的。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某一）方面、点、细节（in this / that / some respect(s)）
uncommonMeanings.example: In many respects the two brothers were alike, yet in the one respect that mattered most — courage — they could not have been more different. （读后续写·人物对比）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 遵守，不违背（法律/规则/意愿/协议）
uncommonMeanings.example: A good citizen respects the rules even when no one is watching. （议论文·公德）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 问候,敬意（pay one's respects,常用复数）
uncommonMeanings.example: On the eve of the festival, the whole village came to pay their respects to the old teacher who had taught three generations to read. （读后续写·尊师·集体致敬）

posExamples.sentence: I have learned that to respect my brother's choices, even the ones I cannot understand, is itself the deepest form of love I can offer him. （读后续写·亲情·成长感悟）
I am writing to express my sincere respect for the volunteers whose tireless efforts turned our neglected schoolyard into a garden the whole town now admires. （应用文·感谢信）
Mutual respect, rather than blind obedience, is what allows different cultures to coexist in genuine harmony. （议论文·多元文化·观点论证）
A truly civilised traveller respects the customs of every place he visits, treating each unfamiliar tradition with curiosity rather than contempt. （议论文·文明素养）

wordForms.adjective: respectful (尊重他人的) / respectable (体面的、可敬的) / respective (各自的)
wordForms.adverb: respectfully (恭敬地) / respectably (体面地) / respectively (分别地)
wordForms.other: respected (adj. 受尊敬的)。易混三形容词辨析：respectful 对他人恭敬的（be respectful to elders）；respectable 值得尊敬、体面像样的（a respectable job）；respective 各自的（took their respective seats）。副词同理：respectfully 恭敬地 / respectably 体面地 / respectively 分别地。

idioms.idiom: with respect to / in respect of
idioms.example: With respect to the choice of destination, the whole class was, for once, in perfect agreement. （应用文·活动方案）
Hundreds gathered in silence to pay their last respects to the doctor who had given forty years to their small town. （读后续写·缅怀）
He was stubborn, careless, often late; but in one respect he never failed us: he always told the truth. （读后续写·人物·欲扬先抑）

collocations.phrase: respect sb for sth（vt. 尊重）
collocations.example: She had always been honest with me, and I respect her for that. 她一直对我很诚实，我非常敬重她这一点。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: have (the greatest) respect for sb；treat sb with respect（n. 尊敬）
collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人（极为）尊敬；尊重地对待某人
collocations.example: I have the greatest respect for your brother. 我非常尊敬你的哥哥。 / Everyone should be treated with respect. 每个人都应该受尊重。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】恕我直言（表达不同意见前的礼貌语）
collocations.example: With all due respect, I think you've misunderstood what he said. 恕我直言，我觉得你误会了他说的话。（课件原句）
In this respect we are very fortunate. 在这方面，我们是很幸运的。（课件原句）
The two groups were similar with respect to income and status. 这两组在收入和地位方面是相似的。（课件原句）
a much loved and highly respected teacher 备受爱戴和尊敬的老师；We should be respectful to elders. 我们应当尊重长辈。（课件搭配）
Deep respect for nature lies at the heart of every culture that has learned to live in balance with the land. （议论文·人与自然）
The young captain earned the respect of every teammate not by giving orders but by working harder than them all. （读后续写·领导力）
We should treat every worker, however humble their job, with the same respect we show the powerful. （议论文·平等）
Their friendship survived every argument because it rested on a foundation of mutual respect. （读后续写·友情）
Out of respect for the sleeping baby, the whole room fell instantly, tenderly silent. （读后续写·温情细节）

collocations.translation: 尊重某人的意愿/隐私/意见
collocations.example: A good friend knows when to speak and, more importantly, when to respect your silence. （读后续写·友情）
The old headmaster never raised his voice, yet his quiet dignity commanded the respect of the entire school. （读后续写·人物气场）
In a single dishonest moment, he lost the respect it had taken him years to win. （读后续写·信任崩塌）
I must respect and support the choices my brother makes, even when my heart quietly wishes he would choose otherwise. （应用文·日记）

synonyms.example: I had always admired my sister's calm, but it was only in crisis that I truly understood the strength behind it. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：admire 因才华/成就而'欣赏、仰慕'，情感更热烈；respect 因品格/地位而'敬重'，含以礼相待。句法：admire sb (for sth)；respect sb (for sth)，皆及物。

synonyms.example: The professor was held in the highest esteem by students and colleagues alike. （议论文·人物评价）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：esteem 更正式、书面，程度更高。句法：常作名词用于 hold sb in high esteem；respect 通用，口笔皆宜，动名词皆可。

synonyms.example: We honour our teachers best not with flowers but by living out the lessons they taught us. （议论文·尊师）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：honour 带'给予荣誉、隆重敬重'之意，程度更庄重；respect 日常、语气平和。句法：honour sb (with sth) / in honour of sb。

synonyms.example: A wise leader values every voice in the room, especially the ones too timid to speak first. （议论文·领导力）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：value 强调'重视其价值'；respect 强调'因其可敬而敬重并礼待'，对象常为人及其权利/意愿。句法：value sth；respect sb/sth。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·respect 三形容词/副词辨析（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: respective adj. 各自的 / respectively adv. 分别地；respectful 恭敬的 (be respectful to elders) / respectable 体面可敬的
advancedExpressions.example: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields. 他们在各自的领域都被视为专家。 / Julie and Mark, aged 17 and 19 respectively. 朱莉和马克，年龄分别为17岁和19岁。（【课件】respective/respectively 原句，与 respectful/respectable 一并辨析）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in this respect / with respect to（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: in this / that / one respect（在这/那/某一方面）· with respect to = concerning（关于）
advancedExpressions.example: With respect to punctuality he was flawless; in this respect, no colleague could match him. 就守时而言他无可挑剔；在这一方面，无人能及。（【课件】respect 作"方面"讲，两个介词短语连用，语法填空高频）

advancedExpressions.expression: respect sb for sth · treat sb with respect · out of respect for · have / show / earn / command respect · in this respect · with respect to
advancedExpressions.example: Out of respect for her wishes, we kept the news to ourselves, and in this respect at least, the whole family finally acted as one. （一次串起 out of respect for / in this respect，课堂集中记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'尊重/敬重'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: respect sb ≈ look up to sb ≈ hold sb in high esteem ≈ think highly of sb
advancedExpressions.example: The students not only respected their old headmaster but looked up to him, holding him in the highest esteem. （'敬重'语义下四种表达可替换，写作换词用）

advancedExpressions.expression: to respect sb.'s ... is itself the deepest form of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I finally understood that to respect his silence was itself the deepest form of love — for love does not always mean rescuing; sometimes it means simply staying near. （抽象定义+破折号哲理，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to express my sincere respect for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to express my sincere respect for the firefighters whose courage that night saved not only our home but our faith in strangers. （感谢信/表扬信规范开头+情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: mutual respect, rather than ..., is what allows ...
advancedExpressions.example: Mutual respect, rather than mere tolerance, is what allows a diverse society to move from coexistence to genuine harmony. （rather than 对比+what 强调，论证有层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I respect my father very much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: My respect for my father ran deeper than words could carry — it was written in every value he had quietly passed to me, in every principle I now held without ever having been told to. （读后续写·亲情·内化升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: My respect for...ran deeper than words could carry 名词化+夸张 + 破折号+it was written in 隐喻 + without ever having been told 分词状语显潜移默化

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should respect each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we hope to build a society worth living in, we must first learn to treat one another with respect — not the hollow politeness of strangers, but the genuine regard that sees, in every face, a story as complex as our own. （议论文·尊重的真谛）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If we hope to..., we must first 条件+主张 + treat...with respect 正式搭配 + not...but 对比澄清概念 + sees...a story as complex as our own 共情升华

classPractice.question: 【课件·语境应用】我非常尊敬你的哥哥。（翻译）
classPractice.answer: I have the greatest respect for your brother. / I respect your brother very much.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】have the greatest respect for sb.（n. 尊敬）或 respect sb.（vt. 尊重）两种表达皆可

classPractice.question: 【课件·语境应用】露西一直对我很诚实，我非常敬重她这一点。（翻译）
classPractice.answer: Lucy had always been honest with me, and I respect her for that.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】respect sb. for sth."因某事敬重某人"，for that 指代前文"诚实"这一点

classPractice.question: 我必须尊重并支持他所做的选择。I must ____ and support the choices he ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；respect 及物动词直接接宾语，the choices (that) he makes 定语从句

classPractice.question: 在这一方面，两位老师的观点完全一致。____ (In this respect / With all due respect), the two teachers agreed completely.
classPractice.note: 【课件】in this respect＝在这一方面；respect 作'方面'讲(=aspect)，非'尊重'

classPractice.question: The students treated their old teacher with great ____ (respectful).
classPractice.note: 介词 with 后需名词 respect；treat sb with respect 尊重地对待某人，勿填形容词

original_sentence: I should also encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties.
readingExamples: I should also encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to become well again after an illness, or to feel better after an unpleasant experience
(2) phr. v. to deal with or gain control of a problem or difficulty; to overcome
(3) phr. v. to succeed in making an idea or feeling clear to someone (usually 'get sth. over to sb.')
(4) phr. v. (get sth. over with) to finish something difficult or unpleasant as quickly as possible

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把(想法/意思)讲清楚、传达给某人（get sth over to sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: However hard she tried, she simply could not get over to her stubborn father just how much this one chance meant to her. （读后续写·亲子沟通·无力感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (get sth over with)硬着头皮把(难事)做完、了结
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than dread the apology for another sleepless night, he decided to get it over with — and knocked on her door before his courage could fail. （读后续写·鼓起勇气）

posExamples.sentence: It took her the whole of that grey autumn to get over the loss of her grandmother, and even then, some small ache lingered quietly, like the last leaf refusing to fall. （读后续写·丧亲·情感描写）
I should encourage my brother to take action and get over these difficulties instead of letting them weigh silently on his heart. （应用文·日记）
History teaches us that no nation truly rises until it learns to get over the wounds of its past and turn its energy toward the future. （议论文·历史与发展·观点论证）
Slowly, painfully, he began to get over his fear of the water, and one bright morning he finally let go of the rail and swam. （读后续写·克服恐惧·成长）

idioms.translation: 克服这些困难（课文原句词块）
idioms.example: I should also encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties. 我还应该鼓励他采取行动去克服这些困难。（课文原句）

idioms.translation: 对某事惊讶不已,无法平静
idioms.example: She couldn't get over how much the shy boy had changed; the trembling newcomer had become the calm captain of the team. （读后续写·惊叹于人物蜕变）

collocations.phrase: take action to get over the difficulties
collocations.translation: 采取行动去克服困难（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I should encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties. 我应该鼓励他采取行动去克服这些困难。（课文原句改写自 original_sentence 词块）
It took my grandfather a long, patient month to get over the fever, but his spirit never once dimmed. （读后续写·亲情）
With his friends' encouragement, he found the strength to get over one difficulty after another. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: get over the loss / death of sb
collocations.translation: 从丧失/丧亲的痛苦中走出
collocations.example: Time alone rarely helps us get over the loss of a loved one; only love and gentle company truly can. （议论文·情感）
To get over her stage fright, she practised her speech before the mirror every single night for a month. （读后续写·励志）
What matters is not how quickly we get over a setback, but what we choose to become because of it. （议论文·挫折教育）
Take a deep breath, walk in, and get the interview over with — the fear is always larger than the moment itself. （读后续写·心理鼓励）
It took him a whole summer to get over the quarrel that had ended their long friendship. （读后续写·情感修复）

collocations.translation: 帮助某人克服/走出某事
collocations.example: A single kind word from a stranger helped her get over the darkest week of her life. （读后续写·善意的力量）

synonyms.example: Against every expectation, she overcame her disability and crossed the finish line to a roar of applause. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：overcome 更正式、力度更强，多用于战胜困难/情绪/敌人。句法：overcome 及物，overcome difficulties；get over 后直接接宾语（get over difficulties），更口语，兼指'康复'与'释怀'。

synonyms.example: It took the small town years to recover from the flood, yet its people rebuilt with unbroken hope. （读后续写·灾后重建）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：recover from 侧重'恢复健康/元气/常态'，较中性正式。句法：不及物+from，recover from an illness；get over 及物，get over an illness，更强调'情感上释怀'。

synonyms.translation: 接受并释怀(尤指痛苦事实)
synonyms.example: In time, she came to terms with the fact that some goodbyes are simply forever. （读后续写·丧亲·和解）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：come to terms with 强调'与痛苦事实达成和解、接受它'，情感更深沉，常接 the fact that；get over 侧重'彻底走出、不再难受'。

synonyms.example: Determined not to be defeated, the young climber finally conquered the peak that had turned back so many before him. （读后续写·挑战极限）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：conquer 语气最强，多指征服艰巨挑战/极限/敌人；get over 日常、平和，程度较轻。句法：均及物。

advancedExpressions.expression: get over 克服/康复 · get through 熬过/接通/完成 · get along (with) 相处 · get across 讲清楚 · get on with 继续做 · get away 逃离/脱身
advancedExpressions.example: He got through the hardest exam of his life, got over his fear of failure, and finally got on with the future he had once dreaded. （get 系列短语一网打尽，课堂集中辨记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'克服/走出'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: get over ≈ overcome ≈ recover from ≈ pull through ≈ come to terms with
advancedExpressions.example: With her friends beside her, she overcame the grief — pulled through, came to terms with the loss, and slowly got over it. （'克服/走出'语义下多词替换，续写换词用）

advancedExpressions.expression: it took sb ... to get over ..., and even then ...
advancedExpressions.example: It took me an entire winter to get over the falling-out with my closest friend, and even then, a quiet corner of my heart still kept the door ajar. （时间跨度+even then 转折，刻画余留情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I encourage you to take action and get over ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely encourage you to face the setback and get over it step by step, for I firmly believe brighter days lie just ahead. （安慰信/建议信中鼓励句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: what matters is not how quickly we get over ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What matters is not how quickly we get over failure, but what wisdom we carry forward from its bitter lessons. （not...but 转移焦点，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He finally got over his sadness.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Little by little, the way winter melts into spring, he got over the sadness that had shadowed him for months — until one ordinary morning he caught himself smiling, and did not know why. （读后续写·情感复苏·细节升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Little by little+比喻(winter melts into spring) 渐进节奏 + that had shadowed him 定语从句 + caught himself smiling, and did not know why 细节收束显自然疗愈

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should help students get over their difficulties.
