sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than shield students from every hardship, we would do better to stand beside them and help them get over their difficulties on their own — for the confidence born of a battle won is a lesson no textbook can teach. （议论文·教育理念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than...we would do better to 对比建议 + on their own 强调自主 + for 引导原因 + the confidence born of...no textbook can teach 抽象升华

classPractice.question: 我还应该鼓励他采取行动去克服这些困难。I should also encourage him to take action to ____ ____ these difficulties.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；get over 克服（困难），后直接接宾语，不加 from

classPractice.question: It took her a whole year to ____ (get over / recover from) the loss of her best friend, and even then the ache lingered.
classPractice.note: get over 及物直接接宾语；recover from 需加 from，本题两式均可但结构不同，故填 get over（无 from）最贴切；考搭配差异

classPractice.question: With everyone's help, he overcame his fear of speaking in public. → With everyone's help, he ____ ____ his fear of speaking in public.
classPractice.note: overcome ＝ get over（克服）；注意时态用过去式 got over

original_sentence: When he's struggling with his schoolwork, I should do all I can to help him become a more efficient learner.
readingExamples: When he's struggling with his schoolwork, I should do all I can to help him become a more efficient learner.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. working well and producing good results by using time, energy, or resources without wasting any
(2) adj. (of a person) skilful and competent, performing tasks in an organised and productive way
(3) adj. (of a machine, system, or process) achieving maximum output with minimum wasted effort or expense

posExamples.sentence: Watching the old craftsman work, I marvelled at how efficient his weathered hands were — not a single movement wasted, each stroke of the chisel landing exactly where it was meant to. （读后续写·人物观察）
I am writing to suggest that our school adopt a more efficient recycling system, so that the paper and plastic we discard each day can be sorted and reused rather than dumped. （应用文·建议信）
Far from making us lazy, an efficient use of technology frees the mind from tedious labour and channels our energy into creative thinking, where true value is created. （议论文·科技与效率）
When he was struggling with maths, I sat beside him each evening, patiently showing him how to become a more efficient learner rather than simply memorising answers. （读后续写·友谊/互助）

wordForms.adjective: efficient (高效的, opp. inefficient 低效的)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：efficient adj. → efficiently adv. → efficiency n.（with great efficiency 效率很高）。反义 inefficient / inefficiently / inefficiency。构词提示：ef-（=ex- 向外）+ -fic-（做，来自 facere）+ -ient＝'做出成效的'。小贴士：切勿与 effective（有效的）/ effect（效果）混淆。

collocations.example: She is efficient at organising large events, never letting a single detail slip through the cracks. （课件·efficient·主体搭配）
The volunteers formed a highly efficient team, clearing the flooded classroom within two hours. （课件·highly efficient）

collocations.phrase: improve efficiency (instead of extending working hours)
collocations.translation: 【课件】提升效率（而非延长工作时间）
collocations.example: We are aimed at improving efficiency, instead of extending working hours. 我们的目的是提升效率，而不是延长工作时间。（课件原句·efficiency 名词）

collocations.translation: 【课件】词族：反义 inefficient；副词 efficiently；名词 efficiency
collocations.example: An inefficient system wastes time; run efficiently, it saves both time and money — that is the value of efficiency. （课件·词族全家桶 efficient→efficiently→efficiency, opp. inefficient）

collocations.translation: 更高效的学习者（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I should do all I can to help him become a more efficient learner. 我应该尽我所能帮助他成为一个更高效的学习者。（课文原句）
To help him become a more efficient learner, I taught him to break each task into small, manageable steps. （读后续写·互助）
Switching to energy-efficient light bulbs across the campus would cut our electricity bills and reduce carbon emissions at the same time. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.phrase: an efficient way / method of doing sth
collocations.example: Group discussion proved to be a far more efficient way of revising than reading alone in silence. （议论文·学习方法）
The volunteers formed a highly efficient team, and within two hours the flooded classroom had been cleared and cleaned. （读后续写·集体行动）
A well-planned timetable can make your revision far more efficient and spare you the panic of last-minute cramming. （应用文·经验分享）

collocations.translation: 对时间／资源的高效利用
collocations.example: The efficient use of every spare minute between classes gradually transformed her from an average student into a top scholar. （读后续写·励志成长）
Buying stationery in bulk is a cost-efficient choice that leaves more funds for the charity event. （应用文·活动方案）
For the whole system to run efficiently, every member must know exactly what he or she is responsible for. （议论文·协作）

synonyms.example: The teacher's gentle encouragement proved far more effective than any punishment in motivating the shy boy. （读后续写·师生）
synonyms.usage: ★高考高频辨析：efficient 强调过程不浪费时间／资源（高效、省），主语可为人或系统；effective 强调结果达到了目的（有效、成），主语多为方法/措施。一句记忆：An efficient method saves time; an effective method solves the problem. 二者不可互换。

synonyms.example: By silencing my phone and focusing fully, I turned a normally distracted afternoon into a remarkably productive one. （应用文·经验分享）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：productive 侧重'产出多、成果丰'；efficient 侧重'投入少、不浪费'。同样的努力，productive 看收成，efficient 看性价比。句法：均可作表语/定语。

synonyms.example: Though only a trainee, she handled the emergency with the calm assurance of a competent professional. （读后续写·人物能力）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：competent 指人有能力把事做好，偏'胜任'；efficient 指人/系统做事又快又省。夸人能干可用 competent，夸做事利落用 efficient。

advancedExpressions.expression: efficient（高效、省时省力）↔ effective（有效、达到目的）
advancedExpressions.example: The new online form is not only efficient, saving hours of paperwork, but also effective, cutting registration errors to almost zero. （一句并置两词，凸显'省'与'成'的差别，写作/单选双用）

advancedExpressions.expression: efficient / efficiency / sufficient / proficient / deficient（-fic- = do/make）
advancedExpressions.example: An efficient student with sufficient practice soon grows proficient. （同根 -fic- 词串记，扩词量）

advancedExpressions.expression: with an efficiency that + 从句, sb. + 动作
advancedExpressions.example: With an efficiency that belied his years, the boy repacked the whole tent in under a minute, his hands moving as if guided by memory alone. （用 with an efficiency that... 抽象名词短语替代副词,画面更凝练）

advancedExpressions.expression: a more efficient approach would be to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than reminding students individually, a more efficient approach would be to display the schedule on a shared online board that everyone can check at a glance. （提出更优方案的委婉句式,礼貌而有说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: efficiency should never come at the expense of ...
advancedExpressions.example: In our relentless pursuit of efficiency, we must remember that efficiency should never come at the expense of kindness, patience, or the human touch that machines can never replicate. （让步-警示结构,升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked in an efficient way.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every task he touched dissolved into a series of clean, unhurried movements — no fuss, no wasted breath — as though efficiency were not a skill he had learned but a rhythm he had been born to. （读后续写·人物特写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入具体动作细节(no fuss, no wasted breath) + as though 虚拟比喻把"高效"升华为天性 + 抽象名词 efficiency 作主语

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use our time more efficiently.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that only by using our limited time efficiently — planning each day with purpose and cutting out aimless distractions — can we transform fleeting hours into lasting achievements. （议论文·时间管理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 正式主句 + only by + doing 引导的部分倒装 + 破折号补充具体做法 + 对比升华(fleeting hours → lasting achievements)

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·efficiency 原句）
classPractice.question: 我们的目的是提升效率，而不是延长工作时间。We are aimed at ____ ____, instead of extending working hours.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；aim at doing sth 后接动名词，efficiency 为 efficient 的名词形式

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·be efficient at doing）
classPractice.question: She is remarkably ____ (efficient) at handling several tasks at once, never wasting a minute.
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 be efficient at doing sth 做某事效率很高；此处作表语

classPractice.question: 我应该尽我所能帮助他成为一个更高效的学习者。I should do all I can to help him become a more ____ learner.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；efficient learner 高效的学习者，形容词作定语

classPractice.question: The medicine is ____ (efficient / effective) in relieving pain, though the delivery to remote villages is far from ____ (efficient / effective).
classPractice.note: 药'有效'用 effective（重结果）；配送流程'高效'用 efficient（重省时省力），高考高频辨析

classPractice.question: She managed the whole project with remarkable ____ (efficient), wasting neither time nor money.
classPractice.note: 介词 with 后接名词；efficient→efficiency 名词形式

translation: 额外的，分外的，附加的 | adv. 额外，另外；特别，格外
original_sentence: It'll take up some of my spare time, but this friendship is worth my extra time and effort.
readingExamples: It'll take up some of my spare time, but this friendship is worth my extra time and effort.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. more than the usual, expected, or necessary amount; additional
(2) adv. more than usually; especially, particularly
(3) adv. in addition to what is normal or included
(4) n. something added that is not part of the standard price or plan; a person hired for a minor background role in a film

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】格外地，特别地（修饰形容词/副词，＝especially，如 extra good）
uncommonMeanings.example: He is trying to be extra good. 他试图变得格外好。（课件原句·extra adv.）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】另外收费的事物；附加费（no hidden extras）
uncommonMeanings.example: The price includes all major charges — there are no hidden extras. 价格包含了所有主要费用，没有隐性的额外收费。（课件原句·extra n.）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（电影中的）临时演员，群众演员（an army of extras）
uncommonMeanings.example: The film used an army of extras. 这部电影动用了大批临时演员。（课件原句·extra n.）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 格外地，特别地（修饰形容词/副词，＝especially）
uncommonMeanings.example: Knowing the roads would be icy, my father drove extra carefully, his hands tight on the wheel. （读后续写·亲情·adv. 修饰 carefully）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电影中的）群众演员，临时演员
uncommonMeanings.example: For three whole days she stood in the crowd as an unnamed extra, but her eyes never left the leading actress, silently rehearsing the dream that one day the camera would find her too. （读后续写·追梦·小角色的野心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 额外收费的项目；附加物
uncommonMeanings.example: The room looked cheap online, yet every comfort — breakfast, Wi-Fi, even a towel — turned out to be a costly extra. （读后续写·旅途·意外的失望）

posExamples.sentence: It would take up some of my spare time, but I decided this friendship was worth every bit of the extra effort I would have to put in. （读后续写·友谊）
We are calling on all students to donate any extra books gathering dust on their shelves, so that children in remote mountain schools may share the joy of reading. （应用文·倡议书）
Knowing the roads would be icy after the storm, my father drove extra carefully, his hands tight on the wheel and his eyes fixed on the winding path ahead. （读后续写·亲情·紧张时刻）
Those who are willing to go the extra mile — to revise one more chapter, to check one more answer — are precisely the ones who reap the sweetest rewards in the end. （议论文·努力与回报）

wordForms.other: 一词四用：extra 可作 adj.（extra time）、adv.（extra carefully 格外小心）、n.（群众演员/附加费）。前缀 extra-＝'超出、以外'，构词：extraordinary 非凡的、extracurricular 课外的、extraterrestrial 外星的、extraordinarily 格外地。

idioms.translation: 付出额外努力，加倍尽力
idioms.example: It was her willingness to go the extra mile — staying behind to comfort a frightened classmate — that finally won her the trust of the whole team. （读后续写·品格·真诚待人）

collocations.phrase: extra expense / an extra chair (adj. 额外的)
collocations.translation: 【课件】额外的费用／（放在桌旁）多一张椅子
collocations.example: The trip meant an extra expense we had not planned for, so we needed an extra chair at the table for the unexpected guest. （课件·extra adj. extra expense / an extra chair at the table）
The hotel does not charge extra for breakfast, which made the whole family cheer. （课件·extra adv. 额外收费 charge extra）

collocations.phrase: be extra good / extra + adj./adv. (adv. 格外，特别)
collocations.translation: 【课件】格外好／格外……（副词修饰形容词、副词，＝especially）
collocations.example: He is trying to be extra good so that his parents will let him keep the puppy. （课件原句·extra adv. 特别、格外）

collocations.phrase: hidden extras / an army of extras (n. 附加费；临时演员)
collocations.translation: 【课件】另外收费的事物；（电影）临时演员／群众演员
collocations.example: The price includes all major charges — there are no hidden extras; on set, the film used an army of extras. （课件原句·extra n. 额外收费的事物／临时演员）

collocations.phrase: worth my extra time and effort
collocations.translation: 值得我额外的时间和精力（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: This friendship is worth my extra time and effort. 这份友谊值得我额外的时间和精力。（课文原句）
This friendship is worth my extra time and effort, however busy my schedule may be. （读后续写·友谊）
A little extra effort each morning, however small, adds up over a term into a difference no one can ignore. （议论文·积累）

collocations.phrase: an extra hand / pair of hands
collocations.example: Seeing the elderly farmer struggle with the heavy sacks, I ran over to lend an extra hand. （读后续写·助人）
The whole class put in extra hours after school, determined not to let a single teammate fall behind. （读后续写·集体）
The workshop is completely free, with no extra charge for the materials we provide. （应用文·通知）
Students who need extra help with their English are warmly encouraged to join our weekly reading club. （应用文·招募）

collocations.phrase: an extra bit of / a little extra
collocations.example: Just a little extra patience on my part turned our arguments into calm conversations. （读后续写·和解）
Handling the injured bird demanded extra care, and I cupped it in my palms as if it were made of glass. （读后续写·细节描写）
The two teams were still level at full time, so the match went into extra time. （读后续写·赛场·紧张）

synonyms.example: For additional information about the volunteer programme, please feel free to contact me at any time. （应用文·书信）
synonyms.usage: additional 更正式、书面,常用于应用文/说明中;extra 更口语、日常,也可作副词修饰动词/形容词。写正式通知选 additional,写记叙/对话选 extra。

synonyms.example: In my spare time I taught the migrant children to read, and their laughter became the highlight of my week. （读后续写·志愿）
synonyms.usage: spare 强调"备用、闲置"(spare time / a spare key);extra 强调"超出常量、额外增加"。两者都可指时间,但 spare 侧重"空出来的",extra 侧重"多加的"。

synonyms.example: The teacher handed out supplementary exercises for anyone eager to stretch beyond the textbook. （应用文·学习）
synonyms.usage: supplementary 学术味浓,指对已有内容的"补充完善"(supplementary reading);extra 更通用、口语化。写议论文或说明性文字用 supplementary 更显水平。

advancedExpressions.expression: go the extra mile 加倍努力 · put in extra hours 多花时间 · lend an extra hand 搭把手 · extra time and effort · a little extra ...
advancedExpressions.example: Willing to go the extra mile, she put in extra hours after class and lent an extra hand to whoever fell behind. （extra 短语连缀，课堂集中记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: extra-（超出/以外）：extraordinary / extracurricular / extraterrestrial / extraordinarily
advancedExpressions.example: Beyond his ordinary lessons, his extracurricular reading gave him an extraordinary breadth of mind. （extra- 前缀词串记，扩词量）

advancedExpressions.expression: willing to go the extra mile, sb. + 具体行动
advancedExpressions.example: Always willing to go the extra mile, she stayed long after the others had left, gently coaxing the last stray dog into the shelter's warmth. （用 go the extra mile 的分词状语开头,以具体善行体现品格）

advancedExpressions.expression: we sincerely hope everyone can spare a little extra ... for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely hope everyone can spare a little extra time and warmth for these lonely elderly people, for whom a single visit means more than we can imagine. （"spare a little extra... for..." 温暖的号召句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the extra ... that makes all the difference
advancedExpressions.example: Between success and failure often lies the thinnest of margins; more often than not, it is the extra hour of practice, the extra ounce of persistence, that makes all the difference. （强调句 + 排比 extra 短语,突出"多一分"的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I spent extra time helping my friend.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Evening after evening, I set aside the extra time I could ill afford, sitting shoulder to shoulder with him under the desk lamp until the hardest problems finally yielded and a shy smile crept across his tired face. （读后续写·友谊/互助）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语开头(Evening after evening)营造持续感 + 让步细节(I could ill afford)体现付出 + 环境描写(under the desk lamp) + 以对方神态收束(a shy smile crept across)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hard-working people do a little extra every day.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those who quietly do a little extra every day — one more page, one more revision, one more act of kindness — are, without knowing it, laying brick by brick the foundation of a future far grander than they dare to dream. （议论文·积累的力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Those who... 定语从句作主语 + 破折号内三项排比(one more...) + 建筑隐喻(laying brick by brick... foundation) + 升华收尾(a future far grander than they dare to dream)

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·extra adv. 格外）
classPractice.question: Hoping to win back their trust, he is trying to be ____ (extra) good these days.
classPractice.note: 课件原句 He is trying to be extra good；extra 作副词＝especially/格外地，修饰形容词 good，形式不变

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·extra adj. 额外的）
classPractice.question: 我们需要在桌旁多放一张椅子。We need an ____ ____ at the table.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；extra 作形容词修饰名词 chair，意为"额外的、附加的"

classPractice.type: 词义辨识（课件·extra n. 临时演员/附加费）
classPractice.question: There are no hidden ____ (extra) in the price; and on set, the film used an army of ____ (extra). 用 extra 的适当形式填空并说明词义。
classPractice.note: 课件原句；extra 作名词，复数 extras，前者指"另外收费的事物"，后者指"临时演员/群众演员"

classPractice.question: 这会占用我一些空闲时间，但这份友谊值得我额外的时间和精力。It'll take up some of my spare time, but this friendship is ____ my ____ time and effort.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be worth + n. 值得，extra 作形容词修饰 time and effort

classPractice.question: Knowing the ice was thin, the guide moved ____ (extra) carefully across the frozen lake.
classPractice.note: extra 作副词＝especially/格外地，修饰副词 carefully，形式不变

classPractice.question: Those who are willing to go the extra ____ are often the ones who reap the sweetest rewards.
classPractice.note: go the extra mile 加倍努力、多付出，固定习语

original_sentence: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person.
readingExamples: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to make a quality, feeling, or the best/worst in someone become noticeable or develop
(2) phr. v. to produce something and make it available to the public, such as a new product or book
(3) phr. v. to make something easier to see, taste, or understand; to emphasise or highlight it
(4) phr. v. to take something out from where it is kept and show it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】出版，生产，推出（＝produce；the press has brought out ...）
uncommonMeanings.example: The press has brought out five books on German history so far. 到目前为止，该出版社已经出版了五本关于德国历史的书。（课件原句·bring out 出版）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 出版，推出（新产品、书、专辑等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Two years after that rainy afternoon in the bookshop, the shy girl who had once hidden her poems in a drawer finally brought out a slim volume of verse — and the whole town lined up to buy it. （读后续写·追梦·从自卑到发光）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（味道/含义/要点）更突出、更清晰；强调
uncommonMeanings.example: A pinch of salt brings out the natural sweetness of the tomatoes. （生活/说明·提味）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（收藏/物品）取出来展示
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandpa brought out an old brass telescope from the attic and invited me to hunt for stars. （读后续写·温情画面）

posExamples.sentence: To me, a true friend is someone who brings out the best in you — who sees the courage you cannot see in yourself and quietly dares you to become it. （读后续写·友谊）
We firmly believe that team sports bring out qualities such as cooperation and perseverance, which no textbook alone can ever teach. （应用文·倡议书）
Adversity, far from crushing us, often brings out the resilience that lies dormant within — the very strength we never knew we possessed until life demanded it. （议论文·逆境与成长）
The moment the storm cleared, Grandpa brought out an old brass telescope from the attic and, wiping the dust from its lens, invited me to hunt for stars with him. （读后续写·亲情·温情画面）

idioms.idiom: bring out the best in sb
idioms.translation: 激发某人最好的一面（课文原句词块）
idioms.example: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person. 对我来说，一个好朋友能激发一个人最好的一面。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: bring out the best in a person / in sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】激发出一个人最好的一面（使显现，使表现出）
collocations.example: A good friend brings out the best in a person. 一个好朋友能激发出一个人最好的一面。（课件原句·bring out 使显现）

collocations.phrase: bring out sth (= make sth easier to see/taste/notice)
collocations.translation: 【课件】使某物更容易被看到／尝到／注意到，使显现
collocations.example: A pinch of salt can bring out the natural sweetness of the tomatoes. 一撮盐能把西红柿本身的甜味带出来。（课件·bring out=make sth easier to see, taste, notice）

collocations.phrase: bring out (= produce / publish) 出版，生产，推出
collocations.example: The press has brought out five books on German history so far. 到目前为止，该出版社已经出版了五本关于德国历史的书。（课件原句·bring out 出版）

collocations.phrase: bring out the best in a person
collocations.translation: 激发一个人最好的一面（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person. 对我来说，一个好朋友能激发一个人最好的一面。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: bring out the best in sb
collocations.example: Kindness has a quiet power: it brings out the best in even the most guarded of hearts. （读后续写·品格）

collocations.phrase: bring out the worst in sb
collocations.example: Pressure, if left unchecked, can bring out the worst in a team, turning friends into rivals overnight. （议论文·竞争）
A patient mentor can bring out the hidden talent that a harsh critic would only crush. （读后续写·师生）
A pinch of salt, my grandmother told me, brings out the sweetness in every dish — and, she added with a wink, in every person too. （读后续写·亲情·生活哲理）

collocations.phrase: bring out a new product / book / album
collocations.example: The young inventor promised to bring out an affordable version so that every rural school could own one. （应用文·报道）

collocations.translation: 使某种品质／情感显现出来
collocations.example: Volunteering at the shelter brought out a tenderness in my brother that none of us had ever seen. （读后续写·成长）
A well-chosen example can bring out the meaning of an abstract idea far better than pages of explanation. （议论文·论证方法）

synonyms.example: As the mask of composure slipped, her trembling voice revealed just how frightened she truly was. （读后续写·情感揭示）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：reveal 指'揭开、使显露'原本隐藏的东西，较正式；bring out 更强调'引发、使显现并发展'某种品质或潜能，含'激发'意味。句法：reveal sth (to sb)；bring out sth / bring sth out。

synonyms.example: The old photograph elicited a flood of memories neither of them had dared to speak of for years. （读后续写·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：elicit 学术色彩强，指'引出反应、回答、情感'；bring out 更口语、更常指'激发内在品质'。写议论文用 elicit 显水平，写记叙用 bring out 更自然。

synonyms.example: In my speech I wish to highlight the courage of ordinary volunteers whose names history rarely records. （应用文·演讲）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：highlight 侧重'使某点格外醒目'（信息/重点）；bring out 侧重'使内在特质显现'或'衬托味道'。强调要点用 highlight，激发品质用 bring out。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bring（课件·bring 短语归纳）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】bring out 使显现／出版 · bring up 抚养，养育；呕吐；提出 · bring in 引进；获利；赚钱 · bring about 引起；导致 · bring down 打垮；击败；减少；降低（价格、温度等） · bring an end to sth 使某事结束
advancedExpressions.example: The reform brought about real change: it brought in fresh ideas, brought down costs, and finally brought an end to years of confusion, while bringing out the best in every worker. （课件 bring 短语群·bring out/up/in/about/down/bring an end to 一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.expression: bring out 使显现/推出 · bring up 抚养/提出(话题) · bring about 引起/导致 · bring back 使回忆起/归还 · bring in 引进/带来(收入) · bring down 使下降/推翻
advancedExpressions.example: The reform brought about real change: it brought down costs, brought in fresh talent, and brought out the best in everyone. （bring 系列短语一网打尽，课堂集中辨记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'激发/使显现'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: bring out ≈ reveal ≈ draw out ≈ elicit ≈ tease out
advancedExpressions.example: A gentle teacher can draw out — and truly bring out — the courage a shy child hides even from himself. （'激发/使显现'语义下多词替换，写作换词用）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·友谊/品格升华
advancedExpressions.expression: a true friend is one who brings out the ... you cannot see in yourself
advancedExpressions.example: A true friend, I have come to understand, is one who brings out the strength you cannot see in yourself and holds up a mirror until you finally believe it is there. （下定义式升华句,适合续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: such activities can bring out qualities that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Such activities can bring out qualities of teamwork and responsibility that will benefit us long after our school days are over. （"bring out qualities that..." 论证活动价值,说服力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is often adversity, not comfort, that brings out ...
advancedExpressions.example: History teaches us a humbling truth: it is often adversity, not comfort, that brings out the finest qualities of the human spirit. （强调句 + 对比 not comfort,增强论辩张力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good friend brings out the best in you.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A good friend is like a still lake at dawn — standing before them, you see reflected the bravest, kindest version of yourself, and, almost without noticing, you begin to grow into it. （读后续写·友谊·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like a still lake at dawn)将"激发"具象化 + 倒装式地点状语(standing before them) + 渐进收尾(almost without noticing, you begin to grow)化"bring out"为诗意画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Difficulties can bring out our strength.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from breaking us, the hardships we dread most often serve to bring out reserves of strength we never knew we carried — much as fire, rather than destroying gold, only reveals its purity. （议论文·逆境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from + doing 让步开头扭转常识 + serve to 提升正式度 + much as 引导的类比(fire...gold)完成论证升华 + reserves of strength 高级名词化表达

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·bring out=出版）
classPractice.question: So far the press ____ (bring) out five books on German history.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；bring out＝出版、推出；so far 与现在完成时连用，主语 the press 用 has brought

classPractice.type: 用 bring 短语填空（课件·bring 短语群）
classPractice.question:
用 bring out / bring up / bring in / bring about / bring down 填空：
(1) A patient teacher can ____ ____ the best in a shy child.
(2) They were ____ ____ by their grandparents in the countryside.
(3) New technology has ____ ____ great changes to farming.
(4) The supermarket ____ ____ its prices to attract customers.
classPractice.answer: (1) bring out (2) brought up (3) brought about (4) brought down
classPractice.note: 课件 bring 短语群：bring out 使显现／出版；bring up 抚养；bring about 引起/导致；bring down 减少/降低（价格）

classPractice.question: 对我来说，一个好朋友能激发一个人最好的一面。To me, a good friend ____ ____ the best in a person.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；bring out the best in sb 激发某人最好的一面，主语第三人称单数用 brings

classPractice.question: Great pressure sometimes ____ (brings out / brings up) the worst in even the kindest people.
classPractice.note: bring out 使显现/激发；bring up 抚养、提出话题，此处语义为'激发（最坏一面）'

classPractice.question: After years of hard work, the young author finally ____ (bring) out her first novel last spring.
classPractice.note: bring out＝出版、推出；last spring 表过去，用过去式 brought

translation: 估量，判定；测量 | n. 措施；衡量
original_sentence: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship develops.
readingExamples: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship develops.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to find the exact size, amount, degree, or rate of something using standard units
(2) v. to judge or assess the importance, value, or quality of someone or something
(3) n. an official action taken to achieve a particular aim or deal with a problem
(4) n. a way of judging or measuring something; an amount or degree of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（量度）为……（系动词，后接尺寸/数值，无被动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The pond measures about 2 metres across. 这个池塘宽约2米。（课件原句·熟词生义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】度量单位（a measure of length 长度单位）
uncommonMeanings.example: A metre is a measure of length; a litre is a measure of volume. 米是长度单位，升是容量单位。（课件义项）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某种）程度，一定量（a measure of）
uncommonMeanings.example: After months of silence between us, even a small measure of forgiveness felt like the first warm ray of spring breaking through a long, hard winter. （读后续写·和解·抽象量度）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 措施，办法（常用复数 measures，take measures to do）
uncommonMeanings.example: The school took urgent measures to keep every student safe during the storm. （应用文·通知）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 衡量标准，尺度（the measure of sb/sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The true measure of a friend is how he stands by you when you have nothing to offer in return. （议论文·友谊）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （measure up to）达到（标准／期望）
uncommonMeanings.example: For years he feared he would never measure up to his father's towering reputation — until the night he saved a drowning child and understood that his own worth had never depended on comparison. （读后续写·自我认同·熟词僻义）

posExamples.sentence: I will always treasure these qualities of a true friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship deepens over the years. （读后续写·友谊/自省）
We urge the school to take immediate measures to reduce food waste in the canteen, such as offering smaller portions and rewarding students who finish their meals. （应用文·倡议书）
The true measure of a person, in my view, lies not in the wealth they accumulate but in the lives they quietly touch along the way. （议论文·人生价值）
With trembling hands the young tailor measured the fabric a third time, terrified that a single wrong cut would ruin the only silk his family could ever afford. （读后续写·细节/紧张）

wordForms.noun: measure (措施/程度/尺度) / measurement (测量结果、尺寸)
wordForms.adjective: measurable (可测量的) / immeasurable (不可估量的) / measured (a. 慎重的、有分寸的)
wordForms.other: 辨析 measure vs measurement：measure 指'措施/尺度/程度'，measurement 指'测量的动作或所得的具体数值尺寸'（take one's measurements 量尺寸）。

idioms.translation: 以这些标准衡量自己（课文原句词块）
idioms.example: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards. 我会一直珍视好朋友的这些品质，并努力以这些标准来衡量自己。（课文原句）
When she finally read my name on the list of winners, my mother's joy was beyond measure, and tears streamed silently down her weathered cheeks. （读后续写·亲情·喜悦）
The suit fitted him so perfectly it might have been made to measure. （读后续写·工匠·细节）

idioms.translation: 评判某人／某物的真正标准
idioms.example: The measure of a man, my grandfather always said, is how he treats those who can do nothing for him in return. （读后续写·家训·人生哲理）
He packed extra water, a first-aid kit, and, for good measure, a torch — for the mountain trail was famously unforgiving after dark. （读后续写·出行准备）
Deep down she wondered whether her humble little essay could ever measure up to the polished work of her classmates. （读后续写·自我怀疑）

collocations.translation: 【课件】长度单位（measure 作"度量单位"义）
collocations.example: A metre is a measure of length. 米是一种长度单位。（课件义项）

collocations.phrase: take (preventive / effective) measures to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】采取（预防／有效）措施做某事（measure 作"措施，方法"，常用复数）
collocations.example: We must take preventive measures to reduce crime in the area. 我们必须采取预防措施来减少这个地区的犯罪。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: measure + 数量（linking v. 量度"为"）
collocations.translation: 【课件】（量度）为……（系动词，后接量度数值）
collocations.example: The pond measures about 2 metres across. 这个池塘宽约2米。（课件原句）
It is difficult to measure the success of the campaign at this stage. 在现阶段还难以估量这场运动的成败。an instrument that measures the level of radiation 测量辐射强度的仪器（课件原句）
Is this test a good measure of reading comprehension? 这个测试是衡量阅读理解能力的好方法吗？（课件原句·Integrated）
He is a man who measures his words. 他是一个字斟句酌的人。（课件原句·Integrated）

collocations.translation: 以这些标准衡量自己（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship develops. 我会一直珍视好朋友的这些品质，并努力在友谊发展的过程中以这些标准来衡量自己。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a measure of success / trust / comfort
collocations.translation: 一定程度的成功／信任／安慰
collocations.example: Her kind words offered me a measure of comfort I had not felt since the accident. （读后续写·情感）
I try to measure myself by the standards of a true friend: honesty, patience, and unwavering loyalty. （读后续写·自省）
Strict safety measures were put in place before the students were allowed near the laboratory equipment. （应用文·通知）
The true measure of education is not how many facts we memorise but how wisely we learn to think. （议论文·教育）

collocations.translation: 严厉的／严格的／有效的措施
collocations.example: The government took drastic measures to curb pollution, and within a year the once-grey sky began to turn blue again. （议论文·治理）
Unless we take effective measures to protect them now, these ancient forests may vanish within a generation. （议论文·环保）
Carefully, the young scientist measured the temperature of the water every ten minutes and recorded each figure in her notebook. （读后续写·实验/专注）
The old tailor was famous for his made-to-measure suits, each stitched to fit its owner as if it were a second skin. （读后续写·工匠）

synonyms.example: Before offering advice, a wise teacher first pauses to assess what the student truly needs. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：assess 指经过判断给出'评估结论'，偏正式、书面；measure 作'衡量'时更强调'以某标准去量度'。评估价值/情况用 assess，以标准衡量用 measure。句法：均及物。

synonyms.example: From the silence on the other end of the line, I struggled to gauge how my father had taken the news. （读后续写·揣度）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：gauge 侧重'凭线索估量难以确定的东西'（情绪/反应），不确定性强；measure 侧重'精确量度'。摸不准时用 gauge，能量化时用 measure。

synonyms.example: Planting one tree may seem trivial, yet it is a concrete step towards a greener future. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别（作'措施'讲时）：step 指'为达目的迈出的一步'，较口语；measure 更正式，常指官方/系统的举措。写倡议用 step 亲切，写议论/公文用 measure 庄重。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·measure 作系动词"（量度）为"（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: sth measures + 尺寸/数值（linking v.，无被动、无进行时）
advancedExpressions.example: The pond measures about 2 metres across. / The room measures 5 metres by 4. 这个池塘宽约2米。／这个房间长5米宽4米。（课件语法点：measure 作系动词直接跟量度，不用 be measured）

advancedExpressions.expression: a measure of length 度量单位 · take measures to do 采取措施 · measure + 尺寸（量度为） · measure one's words 字斟句酌 · a good measure of 衡量……的好办法 · a measure of 一定程度的 · the true measure of ……的真正标准
advancedExpressions.example: The true measure of a leader is not the measures he announces but the words he measures before he speaks. （课件 measure 一词多义/多性串联记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'措施/举措'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: measure ≈ step ≈ action ≈ approach ≈ initiative
advancedExpressions.example: The city took bold measures — practical steps and long-term initiatives — to clear its polluted air. （'举措'语义下多词替换，作文换词用）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true measure of ... lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: That day I finally understood that the true measure of friendship lies not in the gifts we exchange but in the silences we can share without fear. （下定义+not...but...对比,续写点题金句）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is high time we took measures to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is high time we took concrete measures to protect our campus environment before litter buries the beauty we once took pride in. （it is high time + 虚拟过去式,呼吁力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should measure sth not by ... but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should measure progress not by the speed at which we advance, but by the number of people we manage to bring along with us. （measure...not by...but by... 平行结构,重塑评价标准）

advancedExpressions.expression: take measures to do 采取措施 · measure ... by (a standard) 以……衡量 · a measure of 一定程度的 · the true measure of ……的真正标准 · beyond measure 无法估量 · measure up (to) 达标 · made to measure 量身定做 · for good measure 另外补上
advancedExpressions.example: It is high time we took measures to act, for the true measure of a society is not its wealth but its kindness — a kindness beyond measure. （measure 一词多义短语串联，课堂集中记忆）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to measure myself by the standards of a good friend.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the years unfold, I have quietly vowed to hold myself up against the standards of a true friend — honesty, patience, loyalty — and to keep measuring, however painful the reckoning, until I grow worthy of the word. （读后续写·自省）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语开头(As the years unfold)拉开叙事纵深 + 破折号列举三品质 + 让步插入(however painful the reckoning) + 抽象升华收尾(grow worthy of the word)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The government should take measures to solve the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than lamenting the crisis in idle words, the authorities must take swift and decisive measures — tightening regulations, raising public awareness, and holding polluters firmly to account — before the damage becomes beyond repair. （议论文·治理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than + doing 对比开头 + swift and decisive 双形容词强化 + 破折号内三项动名词排比 + before 从句制造紧迫感(beyond repair)

classPractice.question: 【课件配套·measure 一词多义】用 measure 的适当形式或搭配填空：(1) He is a man who ____ his words, never speaking in haste. (2) We must take preventive ____ to reduce crime in the area. (3) Is this test a good ____ of reading comprehension?
classPractice.note: 【课件】(1) measure one's words 字斟句酌，主语 he 用 measures；(2) take measures 采取措施，用复数；(3) a good measure of 衡量……的好办法，单数名词

classPractice.question: 这个池塘宽约2米。The pond ____ about 2 metres across.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】measure 作系动词"（量度）为"，后接尺寸，无被动、无进行；主语 pond 用 measures

classPractice.question: 我会努力以这些标准来衡量自己。I'll try to ____ myself ____ these standards.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；measure sth by a standard 以某标准衡量……，介词用 by

classPractice.question: It is high time the government ____ effective ____ to control air pollution.
classPractice.note: it is high time + 虚拟过去式（took）；take measures 采取措施，measures 用复数

classPractice.question: Her kindness that day gave me a ____ (measure) of comfort I had never felt before.
classPractice.note: a measure of 一定程度的（+comfort/success/trust），measure 作名词，此处不变

original_sentence: As we walk the "path of life", we may sometimes wish to be alone with our own thoughts, for quiet periods of reflection can lead to personal improvement.
readingExamples: As we walk the "path of life", we may sometimes wish to be alone with our own thoughts, for quiet periods of reflection can lead to personal improvement.
definitionEn:
(1) n. serious and careful thought about something over a period of time
(2) n. an image that you can see in a mirror, water, or a shiny surface
(3) n. the throwing back of light, heat, or sound from a surface
(4) n. a sign, expression, or result that shows the true nature of a situation, quality, or feeling

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】沉思，深思熟虑（careful thought about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She decided on reflection to accept his advice. 经过深思熟虑，她决定接受他的提议。（课件·义项1）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】镜像，（镜中/光亮表面的）影像
uncommonMeanings.example: She saw her reflection in the window. 她在窗户上看到了自己的影子。（课件·义项2）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】反映，体现（a sign that shows the state or nature of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality. 穿着常常反映出一个人的个性。（课件·义项3）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（写下或说出的）想法，感想，回忆（= account, description）
uncommonMeanings.example: a book of her reflections on childhood 一本关于她童年的回忆录（课件·义项4）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反射；倒影，映像（reflection of light / one's reflection in the mirror）
uncommonMeanings.example: The still lake held a perfect reflection of the snow-capped peaks above. （读后续写·景物描写·基础义扩展）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映，体现（某状况／本质的表现）
uncommonMeanings.example: The messy sketches on his desk were a faithful reflection of the turmoil inside him. （读后续写·心理外化·熟词僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （a reflection on）对……的负面评价／有损名声之事
uncommonMeanings.example: Failing the exam was no reflection on her intelligence, only on cruel timing. （读后续写·为人辩护·僻义）

posExamples.sentence: As we walk the winding path of life, we sometimes long to be alone with our thoughts, for quiet moments of reflection can lead to real personal growth. （读后续写·人生感悟）
I would suggest setting aside ten minutes each evening for reflection, so that we may learn from the day's mistakes instead of repeating them tomorrow. （应用文·建议信）
Without honest reflection, experience teaches us nothing; it is only when we pause to examine our failures that they are transformed into wisdom. （议论文·反思与成长）
Kneeling by the still pond, the little girl reached out to touch her own reflection, and for the first time she smiled at the face rippling gently on the water. （读后续写·童真画面）

wordForms.verb: reflect (v. 反射；思考，反省 — reflect on/upon sth)
wordForms.other: reflector (n. 反射器)；构词法：re-(回) + flect(弯,弯回)→"光弯回来"= 反射,"思绪弯回内心"= 沉思。贴士：动词 reflect on sth = 思考某事；名词 on reflection = 仔细想来（作插入语）。

idioms.example: On reflection, I realised that the harsh words I had flung at my mother sprang not from anger but from a fear I could not yet name. （读后续写·顿悟）
The overflowing bins outside the classroom were a sad reflection of how little we cared for the space we shared. （议论文·环保/公德）

collocations.translation: 【课件】经过深思熟虑，仔细想来（un. 沉思）
collocations.example: She decided on reflection to accept his advice. 经过深思熟虑，她决定接受他的提议。（课件原句）
When we are alone with our own thoughts, quiet periods of reflection lead to personal improvement. 独自思考、静静沉思的时光有助于自我完善。（课件·独处使人成长）
Grandfather sat by the window, lost in reflection. 祖父坐在窗边，陷入沉思。（课件短语）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在……中看到自己的影子（cn. 镜像）
collocations.example: She could see her reflection in the window. 她在窗户上看到了自己的影子。（课件·镜像义）

collocations.translation: 【课件】……的反映（cn. 反映事物的状态/本质）
collocations.example: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality. 穿着常常反映出一个人的个性。（课件原句）
The article is an accurate reflection of events that day. 这篇文章准确地记录了那天发生的事。（课件原句；= account, description）

collocations.translation: 【课件】关于某事写下或表达的想法、回忆（cn. 想法）
collocations.example: a book of her reflections on childhood 一本关于她童年的回忆录（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 静静沉思的时光（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As we walk the "path of life", we may sometimes wish to be alone with our own thoughts, for quiet periods of reflection can lead to personal improvement. （课文原句·独处使人成长）
Quiet reflection by the lakeside slowly untangled the knots in my mind. （读后续写·内心平静）
After the funeral, the family sat together in a long moment of reflection. （读后续写·哀思）
On reflection, I decided that apologising in person was the only honest thing to do. （读后续写·决定）

collocations.translation: 在……中看到自己的倒影（反射义）
collocations.example: She caught her reflection in the shop window and barely recognised herself. （读后续写·蜕变）
True growth begins with honest self-reflection. （议论文·成长）
The warmth of a community is often a reflection of its members' small kindnesses. （议论文·社会）
Grandfather sat by the window, lost in reflection. （读后续写·画面/氛围）
The documentary's final image invited a reflection that no words could have forced. （议论文·艺术感染力）

synonyms.example: In the hush of the empty temple, hours of quiet contemplation washed the anger from his heart. （读后续写·平静）
synonyms.usage: contemplation 更文学、更庄重,常指长时间凝神冥想,多作不可数;reflection 更通用,可指对具体经历/错误的"反思"。写唯美意境用 contemplation,写反省总结用 reflection。

synonyms.example: It took painful introspection for him to admit that the failure had been his own doing. （议论文·自我审视）
synonyms.usage: introspection 学术、心理色彩强,专指"向内审视自己的内心/动机";reflection 范围更广,也可对外部事件。强调剖析内心用 introspection。

synonyms.translation: 沉思，冥想（常带精神/宗教意味）
synonyms.example: Each dawn she practised meditation on the hilltop, letting the rising sun still her thoughts. （读后续写·修心）
synonyms.usage: meditation 常指一种"静心练习/冥想活动",偏行为;reflection 侧重"就某事深思"这一思维过程。写练习/仪式用 meditation,写思考内容用 reflection。

advancedExpressions.expression: reflect on sth 认真考虑/沉思；reflect that ... 琢磨着……；reflect how ... 琢磨着……会怎样
advancedExpressions.example: She reflected on the child's future. 她认真考虑了孩子的未来。 She reflected that the interview had gone well, and reflected how different it could have been. 她琢磨着面试进行得不错，也琢磨着那件事本可以有多大的不同。（课件·reflect 沉思义三句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: reflect sth 映出、反射；反映（reflect the views of ...）
advancedExpressions.example: The windows reflected the bright afternoon sunlight. 窗户反射着午后明媚的阳光。 Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community. 本报力求反映当地人民的想法。（课件原句·reflect 及物用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: on reflection｜a moment of reflection｜quiet periods of reflection｜lost in reflection
advancedExpressions.example: On reflection, those quiet periods of reflection had taught me more than any classroom ever could. （四个高频短语串联·续写/议论过渡）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"仔细想想"
advancedExpressions.expression: on reflection ≈ on second thoughts ≈ come to think of it ≈ now that I think about it
advancedExpressions.example: On reflection, I realised I had judged him far too harshly. （四者均可替换,置句首作插入语引出反省）

advancedExpressions.expression: reflect (v.) → reflection (n.) → reflective (adj.) → reflectively (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: A reflective person reflects on the day and, in that reflection, grows wiser. （同根词一句循环记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·强调句 It was only in ... reflection that ...
advancedExpressions.expression: it was only in quiet reflection that sb. came to see ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was only in the quiet reflection of that starlit night that I came to see how my parents' silence had been a language of love. （强调句·续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was only in quiet reflection that sb. came to see ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was only in the quiet reflection of that long, starlit night that I came to see how much my parents' silence had, all along, been a language of love. （强调句 It was only in... that... + 环境烘托,续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would encourage everyone to make time for regular reflection on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would encourage everyone to make time for regular reflection on what we have learned, for a lesson unexamined is a lesson soon forgotten. （提出建议 + 谚语式收尾,说服力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: experience without reflection is merely ...
advancedExpressions.example: Experience without reflection is merely a series of things that happen to us; it is reflection that turns raw experience into lasting wisdom. （对比定义句 + 分号并列,凸显反思的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Being alone gives us time for reflection, which helps us improve.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In those rare hours of solitude, when the world falls quiet and even our own restlessness is stilled, reflection steals in like moonlight through a window — and in its soft, unhurried glow we begin, at last, to grow. （读后续写·独处/成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间/状语从句铺垫氛围(when the world falls quiet) + 明喻(like moonlight through a window) + 感官意象(soft, unhurried glow) + 副词延宕(at last)强化顿悟节奏

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should reflect on our mistakes to become better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only when we dare to turn honest reflection upon our own failures — however uncomfortable that gaze may be — do we transform stumbling blocks into stepping stones on the long road to becoming who we are meant to be. （议论文·反思与成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only when + 从句引导的部分倒装 + 破折号让步插入(however uncomfortable that gaze may be) + 对偶隐喻(stumbling blocks → stepping stones) + 升华收尾(who we are meant to be)

classPractice.question: 想了几天之后，她决定参加比赛。____ ____ ____ ____, she decided to take part in the competition.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；after days of reflection 沉思数日之后（reflection 不可数抽象义）

classPractice.question: 语言是人们生活方式的一种反映。Languages are ____ ____ ____ people's lifestyles. / People's lifestyles are ____ ____ languages.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a reflection of sth =……的反映（n.）；be reflected in =在……中被映出/反映（v.）

classPractice.question: 如果你养成反思自己学习方式的习惯，作为学生你的表现会很好。Your performance as a student will be excellent if you develop a habit of ____ (reflect) on how you learn.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a habit of doing sth，介词 of 后接动名词 reflecting on 反思

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原句）
classPractice.question: She could see her face ____ (reflect) in the car's rear-view mirror.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；see sth done 表被动，反射着的脸用过去分词 reflected

classPractice.question: As we walk the "path of life", quiet periods of ____ (reflect) can lead to personal improvement.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；periods of 后接名词 reflection（不可数抽象义）

classPractice.question: ____ ____, I realised that my harsh words had come from fear, not anger. （仔细想来）
classPractice.note: on reflection = 仔细想来，作插入语置句首

classPractice.question: Failing once was no ____ (reflection / contemplation) on his ability; it merely showed how nervous he had been.
classPractice.note: a reflection on sth = 对……的负面评价/有损之事；contemplation 无此义

translation: 试图；寻找；争取 | vt. 寻求；寻找
original_sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
readingExamples: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to try to find or obtain something, especially something abstract such as help, advice, or truth
(2) v. to try or attempt to do something
(3) v. to ask for something formally or officially
(4) v. (seek out) to look hard for a particular person or thing and find them

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （sought-after）广受追捧的，抢手的（常用过去分词作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Overnight, the once-ignored painter became the most sought-after artist in the city. （读后续写·逆袭·熟词僻义）

posExamples.sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful not to escape entirely into a world of our own and lose touch with those who love us. （读后续写·人生哲思）
Should you ever feel overwhelmed by your studies, I sincerely encourage you to seek help from your teachers rather than struggle in lonely silence. （应用文·建议信）
Those who seek success without effort are chasing a mirage; genuine achievement is granted only to hands willing to labour and hearts willing to endure. （议论文·努力与成功）
Lost in the vast crowd of the railway station, the little boy anxiously sought his mother's familiar face, his small heart pounding harder with every passing second. （读后续写·紧张/寻找）

wordForms.adjective: sought-after (a. 抢手的，广受追捧的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：seek + -er → seeker（求……者，如 job seeker 求职者、truth seeker 追求真理者）。特例：过去式/过去分词均为 sought（不加 -ed），务必牢记 seek-sought-sought。贴士：sought-after 由过去分词构成,作定语表"被争相寻求的"。

idioms.example: At just sixteen, he left his sleepy mountain village to seek his fortune in the dazzling, unforgiving city. （读后续写·离乡追梦）
As the storm broke, the frightened travellers sought shelter beneath an ancient oak, huddling together against the driving rain. （读后续写·环境/患难）
Her handmade lanterns soon became much sought-after, lighting up festivals in villages she had never even visited. （读后续写·手艺成名）

collocations.translation: 【课件】试图，设法做某事（try to do）
collocations.example: The little boy is seeking to make up with his elder sister. 那个小男孩正在试图和他的姐姐和好。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】寻找，谋求（look for sth; try to obtain sth）
collocations.example: She managed to calm him down and seek help from a neighbour. 她设法使他平静下来，然后向一位邻居求助。（课件原句）
When in difficulty, do not hesitate to seek expert advice. 遇到困难时，不要犹豫去寻求专业建议。（课件·seek expert advice / seek help）

collocations.translation: 【课件】博取关注的行为（-seeking 构成形容词）
collocations.example: The teacher soon saw through his attention-seeking behaviour. 老师很快看穿了他为引起注意而做出的行为。（课件·-seeking 构词：job-seeking 求职, a job-seeker 求职者）
An Olympic gold medal is the most sought-after prize in world sport. 奥运金牌是世界体坛最令人向往的奖项。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 试图独处（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world. （课文原句·独处的分寸）

collocations.translation: 试图做某事，力求做某事
collocations.example: Throughout his life he sought to bridge the gulf between rich and poor. （议论文·人物精神）
There is no shame in seeking advice; even the wisest once stood where you now stand. （应用文·鼓励）
She boldly sought out the professor after class to share her idea. （读后续写·主动争取）
A true scholar seeks the truth even when it overturns what he once believed. （议论文·治学）
Rather than seek revenge, he chose the harder path of forgiveness. （读后续写·宽恕）
We are writing to seek your permission to hold a charity concert next Friday. （应用文·请求信）
After the loss, she sought comfort in the worn pages of the books they had read together. （读后续写·慰藉）
Before we judge, we should first seek to understand the burdens others carry. （议论文·同理心）

synonyms.example: She spent the whole afternoon looking for the keys she had dropped in the park. （日常·找具体物）
synonyms.usage: look for 口语、中性,指"寻找具体的人/物",不含正式感;seek 更正式、书面,尤其可求 help/truth/advice 等抽象事物,且有 seek to do sth 句型。作文求抽象事物或表"力求做"用 seek。

synonyms.example: No matter how many doors slammed in her face, she refused to stop pursuing her dream. （读后续写·追梦）
synonyms.usage: pursue 强调"持续不懈地追逐"(目标/事业/梦想),有过程感和坚持;seek 更中性,泛指"寻求、试图得到"。写锲而不舍地追求用 pursue,泛指寻求用 seek。

synonyms.example: For three days the villagers searched for the missing child, combing every ditch. （读后续写·搜救）
synonyms.usage: search for 指"到处翻找具体的人／物",动作性强,常搭配地点;seek 更抽象、更正式,可求 help/truth 等抽象事物。找具体东西用 search for,求抽象事物用 seek。

synonyms.example: Every athlete on that track was striving for a glory only one could claim. （议论文·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: strive for 强调"竭尽全力去争取",含艰苦奋斗之意;seek to do 侧重"试图、设法"。突出拼搏用 strive for,平实表"设法"用 seek to。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·seek 不规则变化（sought-sought）
advancedExpressions.expression: seek — sought — sought；seek to do sth = try/attempt to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: For years he had sought to understand his father, and only now did he succeed. 多年来他一直设法理解父亲，直到现在才做到。（课件·过去式 sought 拼写考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: attention-seeking / job-seeking (adj.)；a job-seeker (n. 求职者)；sought-after (adj. 广受欢迎的)
advancedExpressions.example: The once-ignored painter soon became the most sought-after artist, and his old job-seeking days felt a world away. 曾被忽视的画家很快成了最抢手的艺术家，昔日求职的日子恍如隔世。（课件·seek 构词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: seek to do sth｜seek help / advice｜seek out sb｜seek comfort in sth
advancedExpressions.example: When we seek to be alone, we should still seek out those who love us and seek comfort in their company. （多短语串联·续写点题）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"寻求/试图"
advancedExpressions.expression: seek to do ≈ attempt to do ≈ try to do ≈ endeavour to do；seek help ≈ turn to sb for help ≈ ask for help
advancedExpressions.example: He sought to / attempted to / endeavoured to master the piece before the recital. （表"试图做"可互换,endeavour 最正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: seek (v.) → seeker (n.) → sought-after (adj., 过去分词转化)
advancedExpressions.example: The truth-seeker became the most sought-after speaker of his generation. （同根词一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·seek to do 与不规则变化
advancedExpressions.expression: seek to do sth = try/attempt to do sth；过去式 sought
advancedExpressions.example: For years she had sought to understand her father, and only now did she succeed. （seek to do 的完成时·sought 拼写考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: in seeking ..., sb. unexpectedly found ...
advancedExpressions.example: In seeking a place to hide from the world, she unexpectedly found the courage to face it — for solitude, she learned, is not a wall but a window. （in seeking..., 分词状语 + 意外转折 + 隐喻收束,续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would strongly urge you to seek ... rather than ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly urge you to seek support from those around you rather than shoulder every burden alone, for a trouble shared is a trouble halved. （seek...rather than... 对比 + 谚语收尾,劝慰力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who seek ... must first be willing to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who seek greatness must first be willing to embrace the loneliness, the doubt, and the countless quiet failures that inevitably pave the road towards it. （Those who seek...must first... 条件式论断 + 三项排比,增强论辩力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When we want to be alone, we should not escape from the world completely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When we seek the quiet company of our own thoughts, we must take care that solitude does not harden into a shell — for the soul that shuts out the world entirely soon forgets how to feel its warmth. （读后续写·独处/哲思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: seek 替换 want 提升文采 + 隐喻(harden into a shell) + for 引导原因说理 + 拟人升华(the soul...forgets how to feel its warmth)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Successful people work hard instead of seeking success without effort.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those who seek success without sweat are but chasing shadows on the wall; for genuine achievement, history reminds us again and again, has never once been handed to the idle, but earned inch by inch by the diligent. （议论文·努力与成功）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Those who... 主语从句 + 隐喻(chasing shadows on the wall) + 分号转折说理 + 插入语(history reminds us) + not...but... 对比 + inch by inch 强化艰辛

classPractice.question: 那个小男孩正在试图和他的姐姐和好。The little boy is ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ his elder sister.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；seek to do sth 试图做某事；make up with sb 与某人和好

classPractice.question: 她设法使他平静下来，然后向一位邻居求助。She managed to calm him down and ____ ____ ____ a neighbour.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；seek help from sb 向某人求助

classPractice.question: When we ____ (seek) to be alone, we must be careful not to escape into our own world.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；when 引导时间状语从句主句一般现在时，主语 we 用原形 seek

classPractice.question: 去年他曾力求理解父亲的沉默。Last year he had ____ ____ understand his father's silence.
classPractice.note: seek to do sth 表"力求做"；过去完成时用过去分词 sought（seek-sought-sought）

classPractice.question: There is no shame in ____ (seeking / looking for) advice from your teachers when you feel lost.
classPractice.note: 求抽象事物 advice 用 seek 更正式；look for 多指找具体物

translation: 逃脱，躲避；逃跑；避开，避免；被遗忘 | n. 逃离，逃脱
original_sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
readingExamples: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to get away from a place where you are in danger, or from a person or situation you want to avoid
(2) v. to avoid something unpleasant, dangerous, or difficult
(3) n. an act of getting away from a dangerous or unpleasant place or situation
(4) v. (of gas, liquid, etc.) to leak out from a pipe or container

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 逃跑，逃脱（脱离危险/囚禁：escape from prison）
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the alarm shrieked, the trapped hikers scrambled up the cliff, desperate to escape. （读后续写·险境求生·基础义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 逃避，避免（不愉快之事：escape punishment / escape reality）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one can escape the consequences of careless waste. （议论文·倡议·避免义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （气体、液体等）泄漏，漏出
uncommonMeanings.example: A faint hiss warned them that gas was escaping from the cracked pipe under the sink. （读后续写·危险预警·僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 被（某人）忘记；不被注意到（escape sb's notice/memory）
uncommonMeanings.example: Try as she might, the name of that old song escaped her, hovering just beyond memory. （读后续写·怅然若失·熟词僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对现实的）逃避，消遣
uncommonMeanings.example: For the overworked clerk, those detective novels were his only escape from a grey life. （读后续写·精神慰藉）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the alarm shrieked, the trapped hikers scrambled up the cliff, desperate to escape before the rising flood swallowed the narrow gorge whole. （读后续写·险境求生）
I am writing to remind fellow students that no one can escape the consequences of careless waste; every drop of water we save today secures a greener tomorrow for all. （应用文·倡议书）
For many teenagers buried under mountains of homework, sport is not merely exercise but a much-needed escape that restores both body and spirit. （议论文·青少年成长）
As the smoke curled under the door, she pressed a wet towel to her face and crawled towards the window, refusing to let panic rob her of the one chance to escape. （读后续写·火灾脱险）

wordForms.other: escapism (n. 逃避现实) / escapist (adj./n. 逃避现实的（人）)。构词法：in- + escap(e) + -able → inescapable"无法逃脱的";escape + -ism → escapism"逃避现实主义"。特例：动名词句式 there is no escaping the fact/truth that ..."无法回避……的事实"（escaping 后不接宾语时省略,接名词时直接跟宾语）。

idioms.example: It was a narrow escape; had the driver braked a second later, the child chasing the ball would surely have been struck. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
The subtle tremor in his voice did not escape the attention of the seasoned teacher, who gently asked what was troubling him. （读后续写·师生·细节洞察）

collocations.example: You were lucky to escape punishment (= escape being punished). 你很幸运地逃脱了惩罚。（课件原句）
She managed to escape from the burning car. 她设法从燃烧的汽车里逃了出来。（课件原句）
When the quarrels grew loud, the boy would escape into a world of his own. 争吵声大起来时，男孩便遁入自己的世界。（课件·escape to/into）

collocations.translation: 【课件】逃脱惩罚（= escape being punished）
collocations.example: You were lucky to escape punishment. 你很幸运地逃脱了惩罚。（课件原句）
You cannot expect that something may escape the teacher's attention. 你不能指望有什么事能逃过老师的注意。（课件原句）
I'm afraid your name escapes me. 我恐怕忘了你的名字。（课件原句·vt. 熟词僻义）
The thief jumped into a car and made his escape. 那小偷跳上一辆车逃走了。（课件原句）
I had a narrow escape. 我侥幸逃生。（课件原句）
For her, travel was an escape from the boredom of her everyday life. 对她来说，旅行是从乏味的日常生活中暂时解脱出来。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 遁入自己的世界（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world. （课文原句·独处不等于逃避）
The prisoners dug for months before they managed to escape from the guarded camp. （读后续写·越狱）
Whenever the quarrels grew too loud, the boy would escape into a world of his own. （读后续写·心理避难）
Every household should plan a clear route of escape before an emergency arises. （应用文·安全须知）
Those who wrong others may escape punishment for a while, but never forever. （议论文·正义）
By some miracle, all the passengers escaped unhurt from the overturned bus. （读后续写·万幸）
Looking back on that lucky escape, the mountaineer never again set off without checking the forecast. （读后续写·反思）
Some students bury themselves in games to escape reality, yet the problems only pile higher. （议论文·沉迷网络）
There is no escape from the fact that hard work paves the road to success. （议论文·奋斗）

synonyms.example: As the flames leapt higher, the villagers fled towards the river. （读后续写·逃难）
synonyms.usage: flee(过去式 fled)书面色彩浓,强调因恐惧或危险而匆忙逃走的"动作本身";escape 更强调成功摆脱束缚或危险的"结果"。写慌乱逃跑用 flee,写脱险成功用 escape。

synonyms.example: By setting off an hour earlier, we managed to avoid the worst of the traffic. （应用文·经验分享）
synonyms.usage: avoid 指主动预防、绕开某种不愉快的事物,语气中性,后接名词或动名词(avoid doing);escape 常含"本已陷入或面临危险,最终得以脱身"之意。事前防范用 avoid,事中脱身用 escape。

synonyms.example: The politician skilfully evaded the reporter's sharp question. （议论文·公共话题）
synonyms.usage: evade 常含贬义,强调用手段狡猾地规避责任、问题或追捕;escape 中性,可指纯粹的脱险。写"逃避责任/搪塞"用 evade。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·escape 的两种及物用法辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: escape (doing) sth 避免/逃脱做某事；escape sb's attention/notice 未被某人注意；sb's name escapes me 想不起名字
advancedExpressions.example: You cannot expect that something may escape the teacher's attention, and even the guilty rarely escape being punished forever. 你别指望有什么能逃过老师的注意，就连有过错的人也很少能永远逃脱惩罚。（课件·escape 及物僻义串讲）

advancedExpressions.expression: there's gas / water escaping ...（气体、液体等泄漏、漏出）
advancedExpressions.example: There's gas escaping somewhere — can you smell it? 什么地方有煤气泄漏——你闻到了吗？（课件原句·escape 泄漏义）

advancedExpressions.expression: escape from a place｜escape into one's own world｜escape sb's notice｜a narrow escape｜no escape from
advancedExpressions.example: It was a narrow escape, yet the small detail did not escape her notice as she fled from the ruins. （多短语串联·续写惊险段）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"逃避/避免"
advancedExpressions.expression: escape (from) ≈ get away from ≈ flee ≈ break free from；escape doing 不可,"避免做"用 avoid doing
advancedExpressions.example: He longed to escape from / get away from / break free from the noisy city. （表"逃离"三者可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: escape → inescapable (adj.) → escapism (n.) → escapist (n./adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: For a true escapist, novels are an inescapable form of escapism. （同根词一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·there is no escaping + n./the fact that ...
advancedExpressions.expression: there is no escaping the truth/fact that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is no escaping the truth that a nation's strength rests on the education of its young. （动名词固定句式引出不可回避的论点,加强语气）

advancedExpressions.expression: with a final desperate effort, sb. escaped ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a final desperate effort, he heaved himself over the ledge and escaped the churning waters below, collapsing onto solid ground with a heart that would not stop pounding. （动作链+环境烘托+心理余悸,续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us not wait until ... to plan our escape
advancedExpressions.example: Let us not wait until disaster strikes to plan our escape; a few minutes of preparation today may save a lifetime tomorrow. （倡议信呼吁+对比时间状语,增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no escaping the truth that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is no escaping the truth that a nation's strength rests ultimately on the education of its young. （动名词固定句式引出不可回避的论点,加强语气）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He escaped from the burning house.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Coughing and half-blinded by the smoke, he groped along the scorching wall, threw himself through the shattered window, and escaped the burning house just as the roof caved in behind him with a deafening roar. （读后续写·火灾脱险）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语（Coughing and half-blinded）铺垫状态 + 三动词动作链（groped, threw, escaped）推进节奏 + just as 时间从句制造千钧一发的画面 + 拟声（deafening roar）营造临场感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We cannot escape our duty.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: However we may wish to look the other way, there is no escaping the duty that history has laid upon our shoulders — to protect this planet for the generations yet to come. （议论文·责任担当）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: However 引导让步状语从句 + there is no escaping 动名词强调句式 + 破折号补充说明升华主题 + 隐喻（laid upon our shoulders）具象化抽象责任

classPractice.question: 你很幸运地逃脱了惩罚。You were lucky to ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；escape punishment = escape being punished 逃脱惩罚

classPractice.question: 那小偷跳上一辆车逃走了；对她来说，旅行是从乏味日常中暂时解脱。The thief jumped into a car and ____ ____ ____. For her, travel was ____ ____ ____ the boredom of her everyday life.
classPractice.answer: made his escape; an escape from
classPractice.note: 课件原句；make one's escape 逃走；an escape from sth 从……中的解脱（n.）

classPractice.question: 我侥幸逃生。I ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；have a narrow escape 死里逃生

classPractice.question: When we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always ____ (escape) into our own world.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；情态动词 do not 后接动词原形 escape

classPractice.question: By leaving early, we hoped to ____ (escape / avoid) the rush-hour traffic altogether.
classPractice.note: 事前主动绕开某事用 avoid；escape 多指从已陷入的危险中脱身

classPractice.question: 他侥幸脱险，但那件小事并未逃过老师的注意。He had ____ ____ ____, but the small detail did not ____ the teacher's notice.

original_sentence: More often than not, close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel.
readingExamples: More often than not, close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to get rid of difficulties or problems and make a process go more easily
(2) v. to make a surface flat and even by pressing or spreading it
(3) v. to remove wrinkles, folds, or creases from something such as cloth or paper

posExamples.sentence: Sensing the new boy's unease, the class monitor stayed behind to smooth out every little misunderstanding, and by nightfall two strangers had become firm friends. （读后续写·校园·化解隔阂）
I am confident that, working hand in hand, our committee can smooth out the remaining problems and ensure the charity concert runs without a hitch. （应用文·活动筹备信）
A wise leader does not pretend that difficulties do not exist; rather, he faces them squarely and patiently smooths out the obstacles that stand in the team's way. （议论文·领导力主题）
She knelt by the bed and gently smoothed out the crumpled blanket, tucking her little brother in as their mother had once tucked her. （读后续写·亲情·温情细节）

wordForms.other: 构词法：smooth(平滑的) + out(彻底,使消除)→ smooth out"把不平之处彻底抚平/消除"。同结构短语群：iron out(熨平/解决)、sort out(整理好/解决)、work out(想出/解决)、straighten out(理顺)。特例：smooth out 为可分动词短语,代词作宾语须放中间——smooth it out（不可 smooth out it）。

collocations.phrase: smooth out the sometimes rocky road
collocations.example: ...smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel. 踏平时而坎坷却又注定要经过的道路。（课件原句）
Smoothing out the paper, Frank began to write. 弗兰克把纸抚平，开始写字。 Nancy smoothed out the wrinkles in her son's shirt and waved him goodbye. 南希抚平儿子衬衫上的褶皱，向他挥手告别。（课件原句）
They sat down together to smooth out their differences. 他们坐下来一起消除分歧。（课件·smooth out differences；smooth out the impact of sth 消除某事物的影响）

collocations.phrase: smooth the path / way for sth
collocations.example: Julie left some notes about her work routine to smooth the way for whoever would replace her. 朱莉留下了一些关于日常工作的笔记，以帮助后来者顺利接手她的工作。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: smooth out the sometimes rocky road
collocations.translation: 抚平那时而坎坷的道路（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel. （课文原句·友谊使坎坷变平坦）
A single honest conversation was enough to smooth out the problems between the two boys. （读后续写·和解）
They sat down together and patiently smoothed out their differences over a pot of tea. （读后续写·和好）
Before the interview, he smoothed out the creases in his only good shirt. （读后续写·求职）
The guide quickly smoothed things out with the local officials, and the trip set off. （读后续写·转机）
An online sign-up system greatly smoothed out the registration process. （应用文·活动通知）

synonyms.example: The two departments met for an afternoon to iron out the last details. （应用文·工作协调）
synonyms.usage: iron out 与 smooth out 几乎同义,同源于"熨平"的意象,多用于解决具体的小分歧、小问题,两者可互换,iron out 略更口语。

synonyms.example: It takes courage to resolve a long-standing conflict between old friends. （议论文·人际关系）
synonyms.usage: resolve 更正式、书面,强调彻底、圆满地解决重大问题或矛盾;smooth out 更强调过程中逐步抚平、使之顺畅,语气更柔和。

synonyms.example: With perseverance she overcame every obstacle that once seemed insurmountable. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: overcome 强调凭借努力战胜、征服困难;smooth out 侧重把不平的地方磨平使其顺利,不含"征服"的力度。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·smooth adj.（平滑/平静/顺利）与 smoothly adv.
advancedExpressions.expression: smooth adj. 平滑的(a smooth voice/fabric) / 平静的(smooth sea/river) / 顺利的(a smooth journey/ride)；smoothness n.；smoothly adv. 平滑地、顺利地
advancedExpressions.example: After a smooth journey along the calm river, everything went smoothly. 沿着平静的河流顺利地走了一程后，一切都进行得很顺利。（课件·smooth 词族）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·smooth 与 -out 系动词
advancedExpressions.expression: smooth out difficulties｜iron out differences｜sort out problems｜work out a solution｜straighten things out
advancedExpressions.example: Before the event, our team met to iron out, sort out and smooth out every last difficulty. （同功能"解决/理顺"短语群串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"解决/化解"
advancedExpressions.expression: smooth out ≈ iron out ≈ resolve ≈ settle ≈ work out
advancedExpressions.example: They finally smoothed out / ironed out / resolved / settled their differences. （表"化解分歧"可替换,resolve/settle 更正式）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·可分动词短语 + go smoothly
advancedExpressions.expression: smooth sth out / smooth it out；run/go smoothly (顺利进行)
advancedExpressions.example: Once we had smoothed the last problems out, the whole event ran smoothly. （代词置中间 + 派生副词 smoothly 呼应）

advancedExpressions.expression: help smooth out the rocky road that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true friend cannot spare us the storms of life, but their steady presence helps smooth out the rocky road that we must all, sooner or later, travel alone. （比喻+对比,续写主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: work together to smooth out any ... that may arise
advancedExpressions.example: If we work together to smooth out any difficulties that may arise, I have every confidence that the event will be a resounding success. （条件句+集体号召,倡议信收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than avoid ..., we should smooth out ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than avoid the tensions between tradition and progress, a mature society should patiently smooth out the frictions and let both flourish side by side. （对比结构引出主张）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good friends help us solve problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: More often than not, it is our closest friends who quietly smooth out the rocky roads before us, turning what once seemed an impassable path into a journey we can bear. （读后续写·友谊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: More often than not 高级频率状语开头 + 强调句 it is ... who + 比喻（rocky roads / impassable path）+ turning 分词状语承接结果，画面感与哲理并存

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should deal with the difficulties together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that, so long as we join hands to smooth out the difficulties that lie ahead, no challenge will prove too great for our united efforts. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + so long as 条件状语从句 + smooth out the difficulties that lie ahead 定语从句 + no ... will prove too great 双重否定强化信心

classPractice.question: 她成为地球上跑得最快女性的旅程一帆风顺。Her journey to becoming the fastest woman on Earth has been nothing but ____ (一帆风顺).

classPractice.question: 朱莉留下一些关于日常工作的笔记，以帮助后来者顺利接手她的工作。Julie left some notes about her work routine to ____ ____ ____ ____ whoever would replace her.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；smooth the way for sb 为某人铺平道路

classPractice.question: 从某种意义上来说，阅读可以帮我们克服困难。Reading, in a sense, helps to ____ ____ the difficulties.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；smooth out the difficulties 克服/消除困难

classPractice.question: 亲密的友谊会帮我们抚平那条我们注定要走的坎坷之路。Close friendships will help ____ ____ the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；help (to) do sth，smooth out 意为抚平/消除

classPractice.question: A single honest talk was enough to ____ ____ the misunderstanding between the two old friends. （消除）
classPractice.note: smooth out a misunderstanding 消除误会；≈ iron out

classPractice.question: The car ran ____ (smooth / smoothly) along the newly paved mountain road.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 ran 用副词 smoothly；smooth 为形容词

translation: 注定要做某事，应做某事
original_sentence: More often than not, close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel.
readingExamples: More often than not, close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to be intended or designed to do something; to be supposed to do something
(2) v. to be destined or fated to do something; to be the right person or thing for a particular purpose or situation
(3) v. to be required by rules, duty, or expectation to do something

posExamples.sentence: As she read his letter for the tenth time, a quiet certainty settled over her: perhaps some people are simply meant to walk into our lives and change them forever. （读后续写·缘分·情感升华）
The volunteers are meant to arrive at the nursing home by nine o'clock, so please gather at the school gate no later than half past eight. （应用文·活动通知）
Reading is not merely meant to fill our minds with facts; it is meant to open windows onto worlds we could never otherwise enter. （议论文·阅读的意义）
The rocky road we are all meant to travel may be long and hard, yet it is precisely the climbing that shapes who we become. （读后续写·人生·哲理）

wordForms.other: 构词法/句法：be meant to 为"be + 过去分词 meant + 不定式"的被动结构,字面"被意图去做"→ 引申为"应该/注定/旨在"。特例：三种含义靠语境区分——①注定(some are meant to meet)②应该/照理(you are meant to knock first)③旨在(this is meant to help)。相关：mean to do sth"打算做某事"(主动,mean doing = 意味着)。

idioms.example: When their eyes met across the crowded platform, both felt, without a word, that this meeting was somehow meant to be. （读后续写·邂逅·命运感）

idioms.idiom: what is meant to be will be
idioms.translation: 该来的总会来，命中注定的事无法违背
idioms.example: She stopped worrying about the results and told herself calmly that what was meant to be would be. （读后续写·释然·心理）

collocations.translation: 【课件】注定要做某事，应做某事（= be supposed to）
collocations.example: Capable and responsible, he is meant to be a monitor. 能力强又有责任心，他应该当班长。 You are meant to take off your shoes before entering the house. 你进门前应该先脱鞋子。（课件原句）
I meant to mow the lawn in the yard yesterday, but I forgot. 我昨天本打算修剪院子里的草坪，但忘了。 I'm sorry I hurt you. I didn't mean to. 对不起我伤到你了，我不是故意的。（课件·mean to do 对比义）
Finishing the exam quickly does not necessarily mean achieving high grades. 考试完成得快不一定意味着成绩好。（课件原句·mean doing 意味着）

collocations.phrase: the rocky road that we are all meant to travel
collocations.translation: 我们都注定要走的坎坷之路（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Close friendships will help smooth out the sometimes rocky road that we are all meant to travel. （课文原句·人生注定的旅程）
The reunion was meant to be a joyful one, yet an empty chair reminded everyone of the friend they had lost. （读后续写·遗憾）

collocations.phrase: not be meant to do sth
collocations.example: You were not meant to see this letter until your eighteenth birthday. （读后续写·转折）

collocations.translation: 是为某人准备的；命中注定属于某人
collocations.example: The old violin, gathering dust in the attic, seemed to have been meant for her hands alone. （读后续写·宿命）

collocations.translation: 如其应有的那样，如预期般
collocations.example: Everything unfolded exactly as it was meant to, and the surprise party went off without a hitch. （读后续写·惊喜）
The single candle on the cake was meant to symbolize the family's hope for a new beginning. （读后续写·象征）

synonyms.translation: 应该做某事，被期望做某事
synonyms.example: Students are supposed to hand in their essays before Friday, or they will lose the chance. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: be supposed to 口语化,强调按规定、按预期"应当"做某事,常含实际未做到的暗示;be meant to 除"应当"外还可表"注定、天意"。表"本应/照理应"两者近义。

synonyms.translation: 旨在做某事，其目的是做某事
synonyms.example: This campaign is intended to raise awareness of plastic pollution among young people. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: be intended to 更书面、正式,强调设计或行为背后的"意图、目的";不含"命运、注定"的意味。说明设计目的用 be intended to。

synonyms.example: From the day she first picked up a brush, she seemed destined to become an artist. （读后续写·宿命）
synonyms.usage: be destined to 文学色彩浓,强调不可改变的命运;与 be meant to 表"注定"时义近,但语气更庄重、更强烈。写宿命感用 be destined to。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·mean 三大用法辨析（课件核心）
advancedExpressions.expression: be meant to do 注定/应该做(= be supposed to)｜mean to do 打算做(= intend)｜mean (doing) sth 意味着……
advancedExpressions.example: He is meant to be a monitor, but yesterday he meant to skip the meeting — which would mean letting everyone down. 他本应当班长，可昨天却打算翘掉会议——那意味着让大家失望。（课件·be meant to / mean to / mean doing 三义一句串讲）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·I mean it / I didn't mean to（口语强调）
advancedExpressions.expression: I mean it 我是认真的；I didn't mean to 我不是故意的
advancedExpressions.example: Don't laugh! I mean it. 别笑，我是认真的。 I'm sorry I hurt you — I didn't mean to. 对不起伤到你了，我不是故意的。（课件原句·mean 口语固定表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: be meant to do sth｜be meant to be (命中注定)｜be meant for sb｜what is meant to be will be
advancedExpressions.example: Some people are simply meant to walk into our lives; what is meant to be will be. （多短语串联·续写缘分主题）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"应该/被期望"
advancedExpressions.expression: be meant to do ≈ be supposed to do ≈ be expected to do ≈ ought to do
advancedExpressions.example: You are meant to / supposed to / expected to sign in before entering the lab. （表"照规定应当"可替换）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·被动结构 be + p.p. + to do
