advancedExpressions.expression: be meant to do sth / be meant to be sth
advancedExpressions.example: The rocky road we are all meant to travel may be long, yet the climbing shapes who we become. （课文句式化用·定语从句 that/which we are meant to travel）

advancedExpressions.expression: some ... are simply meant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Some journeys, she now understood, are simply meant to be walked slowly — for it is in the wandering, not the arriving, that we truly find ourselves. （哲理性抽象名词+破折号补充升华,续写结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: as members ... , we are meant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As members of this community, we are meant to look out for one another; a small act of kindness today may light someone's darkest hour. （身份+职责陈述,倡议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: education is meant not merely to ... but to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Education is meant not merely to sharpen the mind but to nourish the heart, cultivating citizens who think deeply and feel keenly. （not merely ... but ... 递进对比句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We all have to walk a hard road in life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sooner or later, each of us must set foot on the rocky road we are all meant to travel, and it is there, amid the stumbles and the climbs, that our true character is forged. （读后续写·人生哲理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Sooner or later 时间状语开头制造宿命感 + 教材原句 meant to travel 定语从句化用 + 强调句 it is there ... that + 隐喻（forged）将成长具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: This activity is for helping the elderly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This visit is meant not simply to fill an afternoon, but to bring warmth and companionship to those who have given so much and now ask for so little. （应用文·公益活动介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be meant not simply ... but ... 递进句式 + 对比（given so much / ask for so little）触动情感 + 定语从句 who have given ... 强化道德感召

classPractice.question: 能力强又有责任心，他应该当班长。Capable and responsible, he ____ ____ ____ ____ a monitor.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be meant to be sth 应该/注定成为……（= be supposed to be）

classPractice.question: I ____ (meant / mean) to mow the lawn yesterday, but I forgot. 我昨天本打算修剪草坪，但忘了。
classPractice.note: 课件对比；mean to do sth 打算做某事(= intend)，此处叙述昨天的打算用过去式 meant

classPractice.type: 翻译/完成句子（课件对比点）
classPractice.question: 考试完成得快不一定意味着成绩好。Finishing the exam quickly does not necessarily ____ ____ high grades.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；mean (doing) sth 意味着……，后接动名词 achieving

classPractice.question: Close friendships help smooth out the rocky road that we are all ____ (mean) to travel.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be meant to do 用过去分词 meant（mean-meant-meant）

classPractice.question: This visit is ____ (meant / intended) to bring warmth to the elderly, but it also teaches us gratitude.
classPractice.note: 两者均可表"旨在"；be meant to 兼表"注定/应该"，be intended to 仅强调意图目的

classPractice.question: 有些人注定会走进我们的生命并永远改变它。Some people are simply ____ ____ walk into our lives and change them forever.
classPractice.note: be meant to do sth 此处表"注定要"；语境定命运义

translation: 优势，益处，成效 | vt. 使受益 | vi. 得益于
original_sentence: As we live in social groups, there are many benefits of friendship that we can enjoy.
readingExamples: As we live in social groups, there are many benefits of friendship that we can enjoy.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an advantage or improvement that you get from something; something that helps you or is useful to you
(2) v. to be helpful or useful to someone, or to be helped by something
(3) n. money provided by a government or organization to people who need financial help
(4) n. a public event held to raise money for a good cause

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 益处，好处（可数，the benefits of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: There are many benefits of friendship that we can enjoy. （课文·基础义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使受益（vt.）／受益、得益于（vi. benefit from）
uncommonMeanings.example: This reading programme will benefit every one of us, and we will all benefit from it. （议论文·一句含 vt./vi. 两用）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （政府发放的）福利金，救济金
uncommonMeanings.example: Having lost his job, the old man queued in the freezing wind for the benefit that stood between his family and hunger. （读后续写·困境·熟词僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 慈善义演，募捐活动
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole town turned out for the benefit, and enough was raised to rebuild the burnt-down library. （读后续写·社区温情·僻义）

posExamples.sentence: Only after years abroad did he grasp the quiet benefit of his mother's strict upbringing — the discipline that now carried him through every storm. （读后续写·成长·感悟）
I firmly believe that this reading programme will benefit every one of us, broadening our horizons and enriching our inner world day by day. （应用文·倡议书）
Students who take part in volunteer work benefit greatly from it, for they gain not only skills but also a deeper sense of social responsibility. （议论文·青少年·公益）
As we live in social groups, there are countless benefits of friendship that money can never buy, from a listening ear to a shoulder in times of grief. （议论文·友谊）

wordForms.noun: benefit / beneficiary (n. 受益人) / benefactor (n. 捐助者，恩人)
wordForms.adjective: beneficial (a. 有益的 — be beneficial to sb)
wordForms.other: 构词法：bene-(拉丁词根"好、善") + fit/fact(做)→"做好事、带来好处"。同根家族：beneficial(有益的)、beneficiary(受益人)、benefactor(施惠者/恩人)、benevolent(仁慈的)、benefit(益处)。特例：动词过去式常写作 benefited/benefiting(英式亦可 benefitted)。搭配辨析：benefit from sth = 从……获益（主动获益）；be beneficial/of benefit to sb = 对某人有益。

idioms.example: Every rule in this camp was drawn up for the benefit of the children, not for the convenience of the staff. （应用文·规则说明）

idioms.idiom: give sb the benefit of the doubt
idioms.translation: （在证据不足时）姑且相信某人，作善意的推断
idioms.example: Though the excuse sounded feeble, she chose to give the new boy the benefit of the doubt and welcomed him with a warm smile. （读后续写·宽容·善意）
A balanced diet and regular exercise are of lasting benefit to growing teenagers. （议论文·健康）

collocations.example: The new regulations will be of benefit to everyone concerned. 新规章将对所有有关人员有益。（课件原句）
It will be to your benefit to arrive early. 早到对你有益。（课件原句）
It was good to see her finally reaping the benefits of all her hard work. 看到她终于收获辛勤劳动的成果令人欣慰。（课件原句）
The new road will benefit the city and the nearby towns. 这条新路会使这座城市和周边的城镇受益。（课件原句）
Both of them have benefited from the talks so far. 到目前为止，双方都受益于这些会谈。（课件原句）
Would the stress be of real benefit to her? / Regular exercise is beneficial to growing teenagers. 这些压力真对她有好处吗？／规律锻炼对成长中的青少年有益。（课件·beneficial 归纳）

collocations.translation: 友谊的许多益处（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As we live in social groups, there are many benefits of friendship that we can enjoy. （课文原句·友谊之益）
Children who read widely from an early age benefit from a richer vocabulary for life. （议论文·阅读）
The lecture opened our eyes to the benefits of keeping a daily journal. （应用文·活动感悟）
Regular exchanges with foreign students proved to be of great benefit to our spoken English. （应用文·交流报告）
Only those willing to endure daily practice will one day reap the benefits of true mastery. （议论文·坚持）
The new footbridge was built for the benefit of every pupil who once crossed the busy road in fear. （应用文·社区）
Genuine friendship rests on mutual benefit and mutual respect. （议论文·友谊）
Before any big decision, a wise person weighs the cost and benefit with a cool mind. （议论文·理性决策）
The health benefits of walking to school far outweigh the few extra minutes. （议论文·生活方式）

synonyms.example: Being fluent in two languages gave her a clear advantage when she applied for the exchange. （应用文·个人陈述）
synonyms.usage: advantage 侧重相对于他人或他物的"有利地位、优势",常搭 have an advantage over sb;benefit 侧重某事带来的具体"好处、益处",常与 from 搭配(benefit from)。比优势用 advantage,谈好处用 benefit。

synonyms.example: The company's profit soared after it invested in greener technology. （议论文·可持续发展）
synonyms.usage: profit 首义为金钱上的"利润",也可指抽象"教益"(profit from);benefit 更广,泛指一切好处,不限于金钱。谈商业盈利用 profit,泛指益处用 benefit。

synonyms.example: What we gain from failure is often worth more than what we gain from easy success. （议论文·挫折教育）
synonyms.usage: gain 强调"获得、增加"的动作或所得之物,可正可负(如 weight gain);benefit 一般指积极的好处。中性获得用 gain,积极益处用 benefit。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·benefit 一词三性（课件归纳）
advancedExpressions.expression: n. be of benefit to sb / to sb's benefit｜vt. sth benefit(s) sb/sth｜vi. sb benefit(s) from sth｜adj. beneficial: be beneficial to sb/sth
advancedExpressions.example: The new policy is of benefit to us all; it benefits the whole city, we benefit from it, and it is beneficial to future generations. 新政策对我们所有人有益：它使整座城市受益，我们从中获益，也有益于子孙后代。（课件·benefit 名/动/形一句归纳）

advancedExpressions.expression: benefit from sth｜the benefits of sth｜be of benefit to sb｜reap the benefits｜for the benefit of
advancedExpressions.example: Given the benefits of teamwork, all of us benefit from it and are of real benefit to one another. （多短语串联·议论论证）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"从……获益/有益"
advancedExpressions.expression: benefit from ≈ profit from ≈ gain from ≈ draw on；be beneficial to ≈ be of benefit to ≈ do sb good
advancedExpressions.example: Students benefit from / profit from / gain from wide reading. （表"从……获益"三者可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: benefit (n./v.) → beneficial (adj.) → beneficiary (n. 受益人) → benefactor (n. 恩人)
advancedExpressions.example: A generous benefactor's gift proved beneficial to every beneficiary of the fund. （bene- 词族一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be of benefit to = be beneficial to
advancedExpressions.expression: be of (great) benefit to sb = be (highly) beneficial to sb
advancedExpressions.example: Daily exercise is of great benefit to / is highly beneficial to growing teenagers. （"of + 抽象名词 = 形容词"结构·同义替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb realize the benefit of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did he realize the true benefit of his father's silence — that some lessons are meant to be understood, not spoken. （倒装+破折号升华,续写结尾段）

advancedExpressions.expression: given the countless benefits of ..., it is high time that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given the countless benefits of physical exercise, it is high time that every student set aside an hour a day to move, breathe, and grow stronger. （given 引出理由 + it is high time that 虚拟语气,倡议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the benefits of ... far outweigh the drawbacks
advancedExpressions.example: The benefits of embracing new technology in the classroom far outweigh the drawbacks, provided that teachers remain firmly at the heart of learning. （far outweigh 比较结构 + provided that 条件让步）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Friendship has many benefits.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As we live in social groups, there flow from friendship countless benefits — a listening ear in sorrow, a steadying hand in doubt, and a shared laugh that halves every burden and doubles every joy. （议论文·友谊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There flow from ... 倒装引出主语 + 破折号列举三重意象 + 排比（a listening ear / a steadying hand / a shared laugh）+ halves ... doubles ... 对比修辞增强感染力

sentenceUpgrade.original: Doing volunteer work is good for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that few pursuits benefit students more profoundly than volunteer work, which quietly cultivates in them the compassion and responsibility that no textbook could ever teach. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + few ... more ... than 比较级表最高级 + which 非限定定语从句 + 抽象名词并列（compassion and responsibility）提升立意

classPractice.question: 这些压力真对她有好处吗？Would the stress be ____ ____ ____ to her?
classPractice.note: 课件原题；be of (real) benefit to sb 对某人（真的）有益

classPractice.question: 到目前为止，双方都受益于这些会谈。Both of them ____ ____ ____ the talks so far.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；benefit from sth 受益于……；so far 与现在完成时 have benefited 连用

classPractice.question: 这条新路会使这座城市和周边的城镇受益。The new road will ____ ____ ____ and the nearby towns.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；benefit sb/sth 使……受益（vt.，直接跟宾语，不加 from）

classPractice.question: As we live in social groups, there are many ____ (benefit) of friendship that we can enjoy.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处 benefit 作可数名词"益处"，many 后用复数 benefits

classPractice.question: 从小广泛阅读的孩子会终身受益于更丰富的词汇。Children who read widely from an early age ____ ____ a richer vocabulary for life.
classPractice.note: benefit from sth = 从……中获益（vi.）

classPractice.question: Daily exercise is highly ____ (beneficial / benefit) to growing teenagers.
classPractice.note: be beneficial to sb 对某人有益；此处需形容词，benefit 是名词/动词

translation: 宽慰，抚慰 | n. 舒服；安慰
original_sentence: Generally speaking, close friendships have three "fruits": they may comfort the heart, advise the head and help us achieve the goals we set for ourselves.
readingExamples: Generally speaking, close friendships have three "fruits": they may comfort the heart, advise the head and help us achieve the goals we set for ourselves.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to make someone feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them
(2) n. a feeling of being physically relaxed and free from pain or worry
(3) n. a person or thing that makes you feel calmer or happier when you are worried or sad
(4) n. a pleasant and easy way of life, with everything you need

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 安慰，抚慰（comfort sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: Kneeling beside the sobbing child, she comforted him with words as soft as falling snow. （读后续写·基础义·动词）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 安慰；舒适（不可数，a feeling of comfort）
uncommonMeanings.example: I hope these few lines will bring you some comfort in this difficult time. （应用文·慰问信·基础义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数 comforts）令生活舒适的事物，安逸的享受
uncommonMeanings.example: Having grown up surrounded by every comfort money could buy, the young man was ill-prepared for hardship. （读后续写·娇生惯养·熟词僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: cold comfort 聊胜于无的安慰，起不了作用的安慰
uncommonMeanings.example: That his rival had also failed was cold comfort to a boy who had staked everything on winning. （读后续写·失落·僻义）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling beside the sobbing child, she wrapped him in her arms and comforted him with words as soft as the falling snow, until his trembling slowly stilled. （读后续写·安慰·温情）
I hope these few lines will bring you some comfort in this difficult time, and remind you that you are never, ever alone. （应用文·慰问信）
In an age of ceaseless competition, a close friend is the greatest comfort of all, a harbour in which our weary hearts may safely rest. （议论文·友谊）
Close friendships may comfort the heart, advise the head and help us reach the goals we set — three quiet gifts that money can never purchase. （议论文·友谊·教材化用）

wordForms.adjective: comfortable (a. 舒适的) / comforting (a. 令人安慰的) / comfortless (a. 无慰藉的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：dis-(否定) + comfort → discomfort"不适"。形容词辨析：comfortable 指"（人感到）舒适的"或"（物）舒服的"(a comfortable chair)；comforting 指"（事物）给人安慰的、令人宽心的"(a comforting smile / comforting words)。特例：comforts(复数) = 生活享受；cold comfort = 无济于事的安慰。

idioms.translation: 聊胜于无的安慰，无济于事的安慰
idioms.example: The promise of better luck next time was cold comfort to the exhausted runner who had trained a whole year for this one race. （读后续写·失败·心理）
The car swerved past them a little too closely for comfort, and both boys stood frozen on the kerb, hearts hammering. （读后续写·惊险）
On that grey, rainy evening, a bowl of her grandmother's noodle soup was the comfort food that thawed her homesick heart. （读后续写·思乡·温情）

collocations.phrase: comfort oneself with / be comforted by (the thought that ...)
collocations.translation: 【课件】用……宽慰自己／因……而得到安慰
collocations.example: She comforted herself with the thought that it would soon be spring. 她想到春天很快就要来临，以此来宽慰自己。（= She was comforted by the thought that it would soon be spring.）（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】安慰性食品（吃了让人心情变好的食物）
collocations.example: On that grey, rainy evening, a bowl of her grandmother's noodle soup was the comfort food that thawed her homesick heart. 在那个阴雨的傍晚，祖母的一碗面汤是抚慰她思乡之心的安慰性食品。（课件义项）

collocations.phrase: take / draw comfort from sb's words
collocations.translation: 【课件】从某人的话中得到安慰
collocations.example: She took comfort from her teacher's gentle words and slowly stopped trembling. 她从老师温柔的话语中得到安慰，慢慢不再发抖。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: offer / say a few words of comfort
collocations.example: I tried to offer a few words of comfort. 我试着说上几句安慰的话。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be of little / great comfort to sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人没什么／有很大的安慰作用
collocations.example: His words were of little comfort to me in this situation. 在这种情况下，他的话对我起不了什么安慰作用。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be a great comfort to sb / be of great comfort to sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】是某人莫大的安慰（单数名词，指安慰的人或事）
collocations.example: The children have been a great comfort to me through all of this. 在我经历这一切的日子里，孩子们一直是我的莫大安慰。（= The children have been of great comfort to me.）（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: It's a comfort to know that ...
collocations.example: It's a comfort to know that she is safe. 知道她安然无恙是令人宽慰的事。（课件原句）
Real growth begins the moment we dare to step outside our comfort zone. 真正的成长始于我们敢于走出舒适区的那一刻。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: in the comfort of (one's own home)
collocations.translation: 【课件】舒舒服服地（在自己家里）
collocations.example: You can now watch the latest movies in the comfort of your own home. 你现在可以在自己家里舒舒服服地看最新电影。（课件原句）
They had enough money to live in comfort in their old age. 他们有足够的钱舒舒服服地安度晚年。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: modern comforts / home comforts (comforts 复数)
collocations.translation: 【课件】现代化的舒适设施／家里舒适的条件（复数指舒适的设施）
collocations.example: The hotel has all modern comforts. 这家旅馆拥有各种现代化的舒适设施。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 抚慰心灵（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Close friendships may comfort the heart, advise the head and help us achieve the goals we set for ourselves. （课文原句·友谊的三种"果实"）
Throughout those long hospital nights, her friends' letters were a constant source of comfort. （读后续写·友情）
When the old dog passed away, it was her little brother who comforted her. （读后续写·亲情）
A single kind message can bring comfort to someone quietly battling loneliness. （议论文·善意）
She took comfort in the thought that the same moon watched over her family too. （读后续写·思念）
In moments of despair, the comfort and support of loved ones can rekindle lost hope. （议论文·亲情）
He gladly gave up the creature comforts of city life to teach in a mountain village. （读后续写·奉献）

synonyms.example: No words could console the mother, so he simply sat beside her in silence. （读后续写·丧亲）
synonyms.usage: console 更正式、书面,专指安慰因失去、悲伤而痛苦的人;comfort 更常用、更口语,范围也更广(既可安慰悲伤,也可给舒适)。写沉痛哀悼用 console。

synonyms.translation: 抚慰，使平静（情绪或疼痛）
synonyms.example: Her gentle voice soothed the frightened child until his sobs gave way to sleepy hiccups. （读后续写·安抚孩子）
synonyms.usage: soothe 强调使激动的情绪或身体的疼痛平息下来,语气轻柔,可搭 soothe the pain/nerves;comfort 侧重给予精神上的宽慰。平息情绪/疼痛用 soothe。

synonyms.example: The captain reassured the passengers that the storm would soon pass and all would be well. （应用文·广播通知）
synonyms.usage: reassure 侧重通过话语消除对方的担忧、恐惧,使其恢复信心,常接 that 从句(reassure sb that ...);comfort 侧重减轻其痛苦、悲伤。消除疑虑用 reassure。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·comfortable 与 comforting 辨析（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: sb feel comfortable（人／物舒适的）vs. sth be comforting（事物令人宽慰的）
advancedExpressions.example: Wrapped in a comfortable blanket, she found his comforting words even warmer. 裹着舒适的毯子，她觉得他那令人宽慰的话语更加温暖。（-able 修饰"舒适的"、-ing 修饰"令人安慰的"·课件高频考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: comfort → comfortable (舒适的) / comforting (令人宽慰的) → comfortably；反义 discomfort（不舒服，不自在）
advancedExpressions.example: A comfortable seat and a comforting word turned her discomfort into ease. 一把舒适的座椅和一句安慰的话，把她的不适化为了自在。（课件同根词串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: comfort sb｜bring comfort to sb｜take comfort in sth｜a source of comfort｜comfort zone
advancedExpressions.example: Her letters were a source of comfort that brought comfort to me whenever I stepped outside my comfort zone. （多短语串联·续写/议论）

advancedExpressions.expression: comfort sb ≈ console sb ≈ soothe sb ≈ reassure sb ≈ bring comfort to sb
advancedExpressions.example: She comforted / consoled / soothed the weeping girl until the trembling stilled. （表"安慰痛苦者"可替换,reassure 偏"消除疑虑"）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb wrapped sb in sth and comforted ...
advancedExpressions.example: She wrapped the shivering boy in her own coat and comforted him with a whispered promise that morning always comes, no matter how long the night. （动作+隐喻式对白,续写温情段）

advancedExpressions.expression: may these words bring you a measure of comfort ...
advancedExpressions.example: May these humble words bring you a measure of comfort, and may you find, even in this darkest hour, the quiet strength to carry on. （may 引导祝愿句式,慰问信收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: true comfort lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True comfort lies not in the softness of our beds, but in the warmth of the hearts that stand beside us. （not ... but ... 对比句式,物质与精神之辨）

advancedExpressions.expression: comfort → comfortable (舒适的) / comforting (令人宽慰的) → comfortably；反义 discomfort
advancedExpressions.example: A comfortable seat and a comforting word turned her discomfort into ease. （同根词一句辨析串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·comfortable 与 comforting 辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: sb feel comfortable (人舒适) vs. sth be comforting (物令人宽慰)
advancedExpressions.example: Wrapped in a comfortable blanket, she found his comforting words even warmer. （-able 修饰"舒适的"、-ing 修饰"令人安慰的"·高考高频考点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She comforted the crying boy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Drawing the crying boy gently against her, she comforted him with soft, unhurried words, and little by little the storm within his small chest began to subside. （读后续写·安慰）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语（Drawing ... against her）铺垫动作 + comforted with soft, unhurried words 副词修饰增添画面 + little by little 渐进副词 + 隐喻（the storm within his small chest）将情绪具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Friends can comfort us when we are sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Generally speaking, it is in our darkest hours that friends prove their worth, for a true companion can comfort the aching heart with nothing more than a steady, wordless presence. （议论文·友谊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Generally speaking 议论文过渡语 + 强调句 it is ... that + for 引导原因状语 + comfort the aching heart 拟人化搭配 + nothing more than 突出“无声胜有声”的力量

classPractice.question: 青少年可以舒舒服服地在自己的卧室里用电脑程序创作音乐。A teenager can write and make music using a computer program ____ ____ ____ ____ their own bedroom.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】in the comfort of one's own ... 舒舒服服地在自己的……里；comfort 此处为不可数名词"安逸"义

classPractice.question: 知道没有房租要付，真是一件安慰的事。It ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ that there was no rent to pay.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】It is a comfort to know that ... 知道……是令人宽慰的事；此处过去时 was

classPractice.question: 这里有足够的空间躺下，舒适地睡觉。There is plenty of room to lie down and sleep ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】in comfort 舒适地、安逸地；comfort 作不可数名词

classPractice.question: 亲密的友谊会抚慰心灵、开导头脑，并帮助我们实现目标。Close friendships may ____ the heart, advise the head and help us achieve the goals we set.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处 comfort 作及物动词"抚慰"，与 advise、help 并列

classPractice.question: His ____ (comforting / comfortable) words gave the anxious girl the courage to try again.
classPractice.note: -ing 修饰"令人安慰的（事物）"；comfortable 指人/物"舒适的"

classPractice.question: As the ship sailed away, she ____ ____ ____ the thought that the same moon watched over her family. （从……中获得安慰）
classPractice.note: take comfort in sth 从某事中得到安慰；此处过去时 took

translation: 高兴，愉快；令人高兴的人（或事），乐趣
original_sentence: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure.
readingExamples: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a feeling of great happiness and pleasure
(2) n. something or someone that gives you great pleasure or happiness
(3) n. (British English, informal) success in achieving or getting something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式口语）成功，收获，好结果（多用于否定句）
uncommonMeanings.example: He rang round every shop in town looking for the rare book, but had no joy — not a single copy was left. （读后续写·寻觅·失落）

posExamples.sentence: The moment her name was called as the winner, a wave of pure joy swept over her, and tears she could no longer hold back streamed freely down her cheeks. （读后续写·获奖·喜悦）
It is my great joy to invite you all to our school's charity concert this Saturday, where music and kindness will fill the evening air. （应用文·邀请信）
The truest joy in life springs not from what we receive, but from what we give away to those in need. （议论文·奉献·幸福）
The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, our sadness, our triumphs and our failures alike. （议论文·友谊·教材化用）

wordForms.verb: rejoice (vi. 欢欣，喜悦；rejoice at / in / over sth)
wordForms.other: 构词法：enjoy = en-(使…) + joy(乐)→使…享有乐趣→『享受』；joyless (adj. 无乐趣的)。小贴士：joy 作『喜悦』义不可数（great joy）；表『令人高兴的人或事』时可数（a joy to teach 教起来是种乐趣）。辨析记忆：joy 强调外显的瞬间狂喜，happiness 强调持久平稳的满足。

idioms.translation: 高兴得跳起来，欣喜若狂
idioms.example: When the acceptance letter finally arrived, the whole family jumped for joy, and even the old grandfather danced a clumsy little step. （读后续写·喜讯·全家欢庆）
To her great joy, the stray kitten she had fed all winter was waiting on the doorstep the morning she returned. （读后续写·重逢·惊喜）
True friends are those who stay beside us through all the joys and sorrows that life may bring. （议论文·友谊）

idioms.translation: 引以为傲、无比珍爱的人或物
idioms.example: The little garden was the old woman's pride and joy, tended lovingly from dawn till dusk. （读后续写·老人·热爱）

collocations.phrase: share ... our joy, sadness, success and failure
collocations.translation: 分享我们的喜悦、悲伤、成功与失败（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure. 友谊的第一个果实，就是与朋友分享喜悦、悲伤、成功与失败所带来的安宁。（课文原句）
For lonely elders, a volunteer's daily visit is the greatest source of joy. 对孤独的老人来说，志愿者每天的探访是最大的快乐源泉。
To her great joy, the lost kitten was waiting on the doorstep. 令她大为高兴的是，走失的小猫正等在门口。
A surge of joy ran through the stadium as the home team scored. 主队进球时，一阵喜悦传遍了整个体育场。
A few kind words can bring more joy to a lonely heart than any gift. 几句善言给孤独者带来的快乐胜过任何礼物。
After passing the exam, she called her teacher to share her joy. 考试通过后，她打电话给老师分享喜悦。
As the soldier stepped off the train, tears of joy ran down his mother's face. 士兵下火车时，喜悦的泪水淌下他母亲的脸颊。
The children were filled with joy when the first snow began to fall. 第一场雪飘落时，孩子们满心欢喜。
Only those who have struggled understand the joy of overcoming an obstacle. 只有奋斗过的人才懂得克服障碍的乐趣。
The moment the results appeared, the whole class leaped with joy. 结果一出，全班欢欣雀跃。

synonyms.example: True happiness is found not in wealth but in the love of those around us. 真正的幸福不在财富，而在身边人的爱。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：happiness 指较持久、稳定的幸福满足『状态』，程度平缓、可持续；joy 指瞬间迸发的强烈喜悦，情感更外显、更短暂。句法/搭配：happiness 常作抽象主语/宾语（find happiness, true happiness），joy 多与 wave / surge / burst 及 to one's joy 搭配。

synonyms.example: To her delight, the long-awaited letter finally slipped through the door. 令她欣喜的是，久盼的信终于从门缝塞了进来。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：delight 指因某具体之事而生的强烈而当下的愉悦，事件驱动；joy 指更深沉、持久的内心喜悦。句法/搭配：delight 高频用于 to one's delight 结构，也可作可数（a delight）；joy 该结构为 to one's joy。

synonyms.example: Lying under a sky full of stars, they felt a moment of perfect bliss. 躺在满天繁星之下，他们感到片刻的极致幸福。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：bliss 语气最强，指完美无缺、飘飘欲仙的极致幸福，文学色彩浓；joy 程度略轻、使用更普遍。句法/搭配：bliss 不可数，常 sheer / perfect bliss；joy 可与更多动词/介词短语搭配。

advancedExpressions.expression: to one's joy / a wave of joy / tears of joy / bring joy to sb / share one's joy / jump for joy
advancedExpressions.example: To her joy, a wave of joy swept over her and tears of joy filled her eyes; she longed to share her joy and could have jumped for joy. （集中记忆 joy 的高频短语群，读后续写喜悦场景一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『非常高兴』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be filled with joy / be overjoyed / be delighted / be thrilled / one's heart leaps with joy
advancedExpressions.example: On hearing the news, she was overjoyed / filled with joy / thrilled, her heart leaping with joy. （表『极其高兴』的可替换表达，避免总用 very happy）

advancedExpressions.expression: joy(n.) → joyful/joyous(adj.) → joyfully(adv.) → enjoy(vt.) / rejoice(vi.) / joyless(adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: We rejoiced at the joyful news and joyfully enjoyed the evening. （一根 joy 拉出全词族，写作换词更灵活）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of joy swept over sb, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wave of pure joy swept over her, and before she knew it she was laughing and crying all at once, her heart too full for words. （比喻式情绪描写+动作连锁，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is with great joy that I ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is with great joy that I invite you to join our celebration, for no happiness feels complete until it is shared with friends. （强调句式 It is ... that，正式邀请）

advancedExpressions.expression: the truest joy springs not from ..., but from ...
advancedExpressions.example: The truest joy springs not from what we take, but from what we give — for in lightening another's load, we find our own hearts strangely lifted. （not ... but ... 对比 + 破折号说理升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very happy when she won.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant her victory was announced, a wave of joy so fierce and sudden swept over her that she could neither speak nor move, and for one shining moment the whole world seemed to hold its breath with her. （读后续写·获奖）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant ... 时间状语从句制造瞬间感 + so ... that 结果状语从句 + 比喻式情绪（wave of joy）+ neither ... nor ... 并列否定 + 环境拟人（the world held its breath）烘托

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should share our joy with friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Generally speaking, joy that is shared is joy that is doubled; for the first fruit of true friendship is the quiet peace of laying bare before one another our joys and our sorrows alike. （议论文·友谊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Generally speaking 议论文过渡 + joy that is shared is joy that is doubled 顶真＋对偶格言式表达 + for 引导原因 + 化用教材 fruit of friendship 意象 + our joys and our sorrows 排比收束

classPractice.question: To her great ____ (joy), the stray kitten she had fed all winter was waiting on the doorstep.
classPractice.note: to one's joy 令某人高兴的是；此处需名词 joy，不填形容词

classPractice.question: 选词填空（joy / happiness）：A ____ swept over her the instant her name was called as the winner.
classPractice.note: 辨析 joy/happiness：此处指获奖瞬间迸发的强烈喜悦，用 joy（常与 a wave/surge of 搭配）；happiness 多指持久稳定的幸福状态

classPractice.question: 对孤独的老人来说，志愿者每天的探访是最大的快乐源泉。For lonely elders, a volunteer's daily visit is the greatest ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: a source of joy 快乐的源泉；joy 此义不可数，前不加冠词

translation: 失败；失败的人（或事）；未履行；故障
original_sentence: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure.
readingExamples: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a lack of success in achieving or doing something
(2) n. someone or something that is not successful
(3) n. an act of not doing something, especially something that you are expected to do
(4) n. an occasion when a machine or part of the body stops working properly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 失败的人（或事）；不成功的东西（可数：a failure）
uncommonMeanings.example: Once regarded as the school's hopeless failure, Tom now stood clutching the science prize. （读后续写·逆袭人物）曾被视为学校无可救药的失败者的汤姆，如今手捧科学奖站着。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （机器、器官等的）故障，衰竭；失灵（power / heart / engine failure）
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway up the mountain, an engine failure left the old jeep coughing and dead on the narrow track. （读后续写·登山遇险）上山半途，引擎故障使这辆旧吉普在窄道上熄火抛锚。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 未做（该做之事）；未能履行（failure to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: His failure to reply to a single one of her letters was, she finally understood, an answer in itself. （读后续写·无声的拒绝）他一封回信都没有，她终于明白，这本身就是答复。

posExamples.sentence: The rejection letter slipped from her trembling fingers, and for one crushing moment failure seemed to fill the whole room; then she squared her shoulders and began, quietly, to rewrite the very first page. （读后续写·挫折后重振）

I am writing to assure our members that a single failure in the regional contest is by no means the end of the road, and that our club will offer extra training sessions to everyone willing to try again. （应用文·倡议信）
Far from being something to be ashamed of, failure is arguably the most honest teacher a young person can have, for it exposes weaknesses that success would happily conceal. （议论文·成长与挫折）
Once regarded as the school's hopeless failure, Tom now stood on the podium clutching the science prize, and even the teachers who had written him off found themselves clapping. （读后续写·逆袭人物）

wordForms.verb: fail (vi./vt. 失败；不及格；辜负；衰退)
wordForms.adjective: failed (adj. 失败了的，如 a failed attempt)
wordForms.other: 构词法：fail(v.) + -ure(名词后缀)→failure(n.)。特例：failure 表『失败』这一抽象义不可数（end in failure）；表『失败的人/物、一次故障』时可数（a failure, an engine failure）。搭配对照：fail to do sth 未能做某事 ↔ failure to do sth；fail an exam 考试不及格。failing (n. 缺点 / prep. 如果没有)。

collocations.translation: 成功与失败（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The first fruit of friendship is the peace that comes from sharing with friends our joy, sadness, success and failure. 友谊的第一个果实，就是与朋友分享喜悦、悲伤、成功与失败所带来的安宁。（课文原句）
Your repeated failure to hand in the report on time has forced us to reconsider your place. 你屡次未能按时交报告，迫使我们重新考虑你的位置。
The first three experiments ended in failure, yet each taught the team something new. 前三次实验以失败告终，但每次都让团队学到新东西。
A crushing sense of failure washed over him as the last runner overtook him. 最后一名选手超过他时，一阵沉重的挫败感袭来。
It is the fear of failure, rather than failure itself, that most often paralyses a student. 常使学生瘫痪的，是对失败的恐惧，而非失败本身。
Great inventors learn from failure faster than others give up. 伟大的发明家从失败中学习的速度快过旁人放弃的速度。
Everyone expected the concert to be a complete failure, but the hall overflowed. 人人都以为音乐会会彻底失败，可大厅却座无虚席。

collocations.translation: 停电／心力衰竭／作物歉收
collocations.example: A sudden power failure plunged the ward into darkness. 突然停电使病房陷入黑暗。
Any plan built on dishonesty is doomed to failure from the start. 任何建立在不诚实之上的计划从一开始就注定失败。

synonyms.example: The narrow defeat stung, but it lit a fire in the whole team. 这场惜败刺痛人心，却点燃了全队的斗志。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：defeat 多指在竞争、比赛或战斗中被对手『打败』，强调对抗性结果；failure 侧重事情本身『没做成』，范围更广。句法/搭配：defeat 常 suffer/admit a defeat；failure 常 end in / a sense of failure。

synonyms.example: Treat this rejection as a temporary setback, not a verdict on your worth. 把这次拒绝当作暂时的挫折，而非对你价值的判决。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：setback 指进程中『暂时性』的阻碍或倒退，语气比 failure 轻，暗含尚可恢复；failure 可指最终的失败。句法/搭配：常 a temporary / major setback, suffer a setback。

synonyms.example: The sudden collapse of the family business forced the twins to grow up overnight. 家族生意骤然垮台，迫使这对双胞胎一夜长大。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：collapse 强调（结构、体系、企业）突然而彻底地『崩塌瓦解』，比 failure 更剧烈、更具画面感；failure 更中性、程度弹性大。句法/搭配：the collapse of sth, financial collapse。

advancedExpressions.expression: end in failure / a sense of failure / the fear of failure / learn from failure / doomed to failure / failure to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: His fear of failure once doomed every plan to failure, until he learned from failure and turned that sense of failure into fuel. （failure 高频短语一串带出，写作即取即用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『失败／挫折』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: failure / defeat / setback / a lack of success / fall short / come to nothing
advancedExpressions.example: What looked like a total failure was in truth a mere setback; the attempt fell short but never came to nothing. （表『失败/受挫』的可替换表达，避免重复 failure）

advancedExpressions.expression: fail(v.) → failure(n.) → failed(adj.) / failing(n. 缺点; prep. 如果没有)
advancedExpressions.example: A single failed attempt is not a failure; failing patience, few ever succeed. （由 fail 一词拉出词族，注意 failing 的介词用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: not the failure but the courage to rise from it that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the end, it was not the failure but the courage to rise from it that defined the boy she had once dismissed as ordinary. （强调句 not...but... + 化挫折为成长的结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us not view failure as ..., but rather as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us not view failure as a full stop, but rather as a comma that invites us to try one more time. （倡议信中比喻+对比，号召同学正确看待失败）

advancedExpressions.expression: behind every ... lies a string of failures that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Behind every dazzling success story lies a string of quiet failures that the applauding crowd never bothers to count. （抽象名词作主语 + 倒装引出被忽视的真相）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He failed, but he did not give up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The failure knocked him flat, yet where others would have stayed down, he pressed his palms against the cold floor, pushed himself up, and reached once more for the rope he had let slip. （读后续写·动作+意志描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词 failure 作主语拟人化(knocked him flat) + where 让步状语从句对比 + 连续动词特写(pressed, pushed, reached)呈现坚持的画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Failure teaches us a lot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely in the ashes of failure, rather than in the glow of easy triumph, that the most enduring lessons are quietly forged. （议论文·正式书面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that 强调句锁定核心 + 隐喻(ashes / glow)形成对比意象 + rather than 插入结构强化论点 + 被动语态 are forged 提升书面感

classPractice.question: His repeated ____ (fail) to hand in the report on time forced us to reconsider his place on the team.
classPractice.note: failure to do sth 未能做某事；作主语需名词 failure，不填动词 fail

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（failure / defeat / setback）：This rejection is only a temporary ____; you can still bounce back next year.
classPractice.note: setback 指暂时性、可恢复的挫折，与 temporary、bounce back 语境吻合；failure/defeat 语气更重、更终局

classPractice.question: 前三次实验以失败告终，但每次都教会了团队一些新东西。The first three experiments ____ ____ ____, yet each taught the team something new.
classPractice.note: end in failure 以失败告终；failure 此处不可数，前不加冠词

original_sentence: Here, friendship has a double advantage — happiness takes on a greater meaning and a trouble shared becomes a trouble halved!
readingExamples: Here, friendship has a double advantage — happiness takes on a greater meaning and a trouble shared becomes a trouble halved!
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to begin to have a particular quality, appearance or meaning
(2) phr. v. to agree to do some work or be responsible for something
(3) phr. v. to employ someone; to start to employ someone
(4) phr. v. to compete against or oppose someone, especially someone stronger

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 接纳（乘客、货物）；开始搭载
uncommonMeanings.example: The old ferry paused at the misty dock to take on a handful of latecomers before slipping back into the grey river. （读后续写·渡口离别·环境渲染）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与……较量，向……挑战（尤指强者）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one believed the frail-looking newcomer would dare take on the reigning champion, least of all the champion himself. （读后续写·比赛对决·蓄势）

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke over the quiet valley, the familiar fields she had walked a thousand times suddenly took on a strange, golden beauty, as if the world were seeing her off. （读后续写·离乡·借景抒情）
I am writing to volunteer to take on the role of team leader for our upcoming charity sale, as I am confident I can coordinate the members and keep everyone motivated. （应用文·申请/自荐信）
When young people are willing to take on responsibilities beyond their comfort zone, they grow in ways that no classroom lecture could ever achieve. （议论文·青年担当）
Determined to prove the doubters wrong, the small county team travelled hundreds of miles to take on the city's finest, and refused to be intimidated by the roaring crowd. （读后续写·体育励志）

idioms.idiom: take on a new meaning / a life of its own
idioms.translation: 具有新的含义／变得自成一体、不受掌控
idioms.example: After that summer, the simple word "home" took on a new meaning she would spend her life protecting. （读后续写·情感升华）那个夏天之后，简单的『家』字有了她愿用一生守护的新含义。

collocations.phrase: take on a greater meaning / a new look / a life of its own
collocations.translation: 【课件】呈现出更深的含义／新的面貌／自成一体（后跟表特点、面貌的抽象名词，意为"呈现，具有"）
collocations.example: Here, friendship has a double advantage — happiness takes on a greater meaning and a trouble shared becomes a trouble halved! 在此，友谊有双重益处——幸福有了更深的含义，而分担的烦恼便减半了！（课文/课件原句）The small town took on a new look. 这座小镇呈现出新的面貌。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: take on the responsibility / the job
collocations.example: The moment his father fell ill, the boy quietly took on the responsibility of the shop. 父亲一病倒，男孩便悄悄承担起看店的责任。（课件搭配）
As orders poured in, the small bakery had to take on three extra hands. 订单涌来，小面包店不得不多雇三个人手。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: happiness takes on a greater meaning
collocations.translation: 幸福具有了更深的含义（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Here, friendship has a double advantage — happiness takes on a greater meaning and a trouble shared becomes a trouble halved! 在此，友谊有双重益处——幸福有了更深的含义，而分担的烦恼便减半了！（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: take on a form / shape / colour / an air of ...
collocations.translation: 呈现某种形态／形状／颜色／神态
collocations.example: Under the potter's hands, the clay slowly took on the shape of a swan. 在陶工手中，泥团慢慢呈现出天鹅的形状。
She chose to take on the challenge everyone else had been too afraid to touch. 她选择接受人人都不敢碰的挑战。
In her eagerness to please, she took on far too much and was soon buried in work. 她急于讨好，承担太多，很快忙得不可开交。

collocations.translation: 与……较量，向……挑战（尤指强者）
collocations.example: The small county team travelled far to take on the city's finest. 这支小县城球队远道而来，向城里最强的队伍挑战。

collocations.phrase: take on responsibility / a task / a role
collocations.translation: 承担责任／任务／担任角色
collocations.example: The moment his father fell ill, the boy quietly took on the responsibility of the shop. 父亲一病倒，男孩便悄悄承担起看店的责任。
As orders poured in, the small bakery had to take on three extra hands. 订单涌来，小面包店不得不多雇三个人手。

synonyms.example: As the storm approached, the calm sea assumed a menacing shade of iron grey. 暴风将至，平静的海面泛起骇人的铁灰色。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：assume 是较正式、书面的等义词，可替换 take on 表『呈现（外观、性质）』或『承担（责任）』，语域更高。句法/搭配：assume responsibility / control / an air of ...；take on 更口语、可跨『雇用/较量』义。

synonyms.example: She undertook the daunting project without a word of complaint. 她一声不抱怨地承担起这项艰巨工程。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：仅对应 take on『承担任务/工作』一义，强调正式地接下并着手做一件（通常较重大的）事；不能表『呈现外观』。句法/搭配：undertake a task / to do sth。

synonyms.example: The factory employs over two hundred local villagers. 这家工厂雇用了两百多名当地村民。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：仅对应 take on『雇用』一义，为其正式、中性的替换词，不含 take on 那种『新招进来』的口语色彩；hire 更偏美式/短期。句法/搭配：employ / hire sb (as ...)。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·take on 后跟抽象名词表"呈现，具有"（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: take on + 表特点/面貌的抽象名词（meaning / look / colour / a life of its own）= 呈现，具有
advancedExpressions.example: Happiness takes on a greater meaning; the small town took on a new look; the story took on a life of its own. 幸福有了更深的含义；小镇呈现出新面貌；故事变得自成一体、不受掌控。（课件语法点·take on 的核心义项）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·take 短语群（课件对照）
advancedExpressions.expression: take on 承担/呈现/雇用 · take up 开始从事/占用 · take over 接管/取代 · take off 起飞/脱下/走红/起色
advancedExpressions.example: He took on the project, took up coding, took over the team, and watched his career take off. （课件填空题集中考查的四个 take 短语，最易混）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『呈现/具有（性质）』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: take on / assume / acquire / come to have / be imbued with
advancedExpressions.example: In the golden dusk, the old street took on / assumed / acquired a strange, dreamlike beauty. （表『呈现某种性质/外观』的可替换表达）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『承担（责任/任务）』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: take on / undertake / assume / shoulder / take charge of
advancedExpressions.example: She was ready to take on / shoulder / undertake the heavy responsibility no one else would touch. （表『承担责任』的可替换表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that instant, everything ... took on a meaning far deeper than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that instant, the worn photograph in her palm took on a meaning far deeper than any words could hold. （时间状语提前 + take on 抽象含义，收束情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would be honoured to take on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would be honoured to take on this position and devote my whole heart to serving our community. （谦辞+承诺，自荐信收尾套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: a generation willing to take on ... is a generation that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A generation willing to take on the burdens others avoid is a generation that will shape, rather than merely inherit, the future. （同词根重复 take on + 对比 shape/inherit 强化论点）

advancedExpressions.expression: take on 承担/呈现/雇用 · take up 开始从事/占用 · take over 接管 · take in 领会/收留/欺骗 · take off 起飞/脱下/走红 · take to 喜欢上/养成
advancedExpressions.example: He took on the project, took up coding, took over the team, took in every detail and watched the plan take off. （take 短语群集中对照记忆，考试最易混）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The sky became red.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the sun sank behind the hills, the whole sky took on a deep, burning red, as though the day itself were reluctant to let go. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: take on a colour 替换平淡的 became + as 时间状语从句铺垫 + as though 拟人比喻(the day reluctant to let go)注入情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: He decided to accept the difficult job.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Undaunted by the risks that had scared off everyone before him, he resolved to take on the very task the whole department had quietly abandoned. （议论文/记叙·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语 Undaunted by... 前置状语增添气势 + resolve to 替换 decide 提升语域 + 定语从句 that had scared off... 突出难度对比

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】He left a job in the city to ____ ____ farming. （他辞去城市的工作，开始务农。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·take 短语辨析】take up (doing) sth 开始从事……；此处指"开始务农"，非"承担/呈现"，故用 take up

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】Some insects ____ ____ the colour of their surroundings to protect themselves. （一些昆虫通过呈现出与周围环境相同的颜色来保护自己。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】take on a colour 呈现某种颜色（=assume）；主语 insects 复数用 take on

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】Her career ____ ____ when she began to devote herself wholeheartedly to it. （她开始全身心投入工作后，她的事业有了起色。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】take off 迅速发展、"起飞"、有了起色；此处过去式 took off

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】The aim was not to ____ ____ valuable time with the usual boring pictures. （目的在于不要用常见的无聊图片占用宝贵时间。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】take up 占用（时间、空间）；此处指"占用宝贵时间"，用 take up

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】A British newspaper says British Airways plan to ____ ____ Trans World Airways. （一家英国报纸称，英国航空公司计划接管环球航空公司。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】take over 接管、接手（公司、职责等）

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】Cars gradually ____ ____ from horses. （汽车逐渐替代了马匹。）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】take over from sb/sth 接替、取代；此处过去式 took over

classPractice.question: 选词填空（take on / take up / take over）：As dawn broke, the familiar fields suddenly ____ a strange, golden beauty.
classPractice.note: take on a beauty/colour 呈现某种外观（=assume）；take up 开始从事、take over 接管，均不通

classPractice.question: 在此，友谊有双重益处——幸福有了更深的含义。Here, friendship has a double advantage — happiness ____ ____ a greater meaning.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；take on a meaning 具有…含义；主语 happiness 第三人称单数，用 takes

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（take on / undertake）：As orders poured in, the small bakery had to ____ three extra workers overnight.
classPractice.note: 此处为『雇用』义，只能用 take on；undertake 仅表『承担任务』，不能表雇用

translation: 最大程度地，最大限度地
original_sentence: With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness in full measure.
readingExamples: With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness in full measure.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to the greatest possible degree; completely and generously
(2) phr. in an amount that is as large or as full as possible, holding nothing back

posExamples.sentence: When at last she reached the summit and the whole valley opened beneath her, she let herself feel, in full measure, the joy she had rationed so carefully all these years. （读后续写·登顶释放情感）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to thank our teachers who, in full measure, gave us their patience, their time and their unwavering faith. （应用文·感谢信）
A society flourishes only when every citizen enjoys, in full measure, both the freedom to speak and the duty to listen. （议论文·社会与责任）
The old fisherman repaid the boy's kindness in full measure, teaching him not only how to mend a net but how to read the moods of the sea. （读后续写·师徒/善意回报）

idioms.translation: 充分地，最大限度地，毫无保留地
idioms.example: With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness in full measure. （课文原句）有了真正的朋友，我们才能毫无保留地尽情分享喜悦与悲伤。

idioms.idiom: give / repay sth in full measure
idioms.example: Whatever trust his friends had placed in him, he was determined to repay it in full measure. （读后续写·友情/信义）无论朋友给予他多少信任，他都决心加倍回报。

collocations.phrase: in full measure (= to the greatest degree)
collocations.translation: 【课件】最大程度地，充分地，毫无保留地
collocations.example: With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness in full measure. 有了真正的朋友，我们才能毫无保留地尽情分享喜悦与悲伤。（课文/课件原句）The horror returned in full measure, however, on the following morning. 然而，到了第二天早晨，这种恐慌又全都回来了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 毫无保留地尽情分享（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness in full measure. 有了真正的朋友，我们才能毫无保留地尽情分享喜悦与悲伤。（课文原句）
Only those who have known hardship can enjoy simple happiness in full measure. 只有历过艰辛的人才能充分享受简单的幸福。

collocations.phrase: experience / feel sth in full measure
collocations.example: Standing on that windswept shore, she experienced freedom in full measure. 站在那风扫的海岸上，她淋漓尽致地体会到了自由。

collocations.phrase: repay / return sth in full measure
collocations.example: The kindness of strangers had saved him, and he vowed to return it in full measure. 陌生人的善意救了他，他发誓要充分回报。
Those who give generously often receive gratitude in full measure. 慷慨付出的人往往能充分收获感激。

synonyms.example: She was determined to live every remaining day to the full. 她决心把余下的每一天都过得充实尽兴。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：to the full 更口语、更常用，强调『尽情、不留遗憾』；in full measure 更书面、典雅，带古典文学色彩，适合升格作文。句法/搭配：多修饰 live / enjoy，置于句末。

synonyms.example: We should use our talents to the fullest extent. 我们应最大限度地发挥才能。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：偏正式、逻辑化，常见于议论文，语气客观；缺少 in full measure 那种情感饱满、慷慨给予的意味。句法/搭配：常修饰 use / develop / exploit，句末状语。

synonyms.example: He threw himself wholeheartedly into the rescue. 他全心全意地投入到营救之中。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：wholeheartedly 为副词，侧重『投入的态度真诚不保留』，修饰动作；in full measure 侧重『数量/程度上的完全、充分』。句法/搭配：副词直接修饰动词（throw oneself wholeheartedly into）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『充分地、尽情地』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: in full measure / to the full / to the fullest (extent) / without holding anything back / to one's heart's content
advancedExpressions.example: For once she let herself feel joy in full measure — to the full, to her heart's content, holding nothing back. （表『充分/尽情』的可替换书面短语群）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in full measure 作方式状语
advancedExpressions.expression: share / enjoy / feel / repay + sth + in full measure（介词短语作方式状语，可置句中或句末）
advancedExpressions.example: We shared our joys and sorrows, in full measure, holding nothing back. （in full measure 是介词短语作方式状语，非从句；可用逗号插入句中加强语气）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, sb. allowed themselves to feel ... in full measure
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time, she allowed herself to feel her grief in full measure, and, strangely, it set her free. （情感释放句式，结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we thank you in full measure for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We thank you in full measure for the countless evenings you spent lighting our path. （感谢信中饱满真挚的致谢）

advancedExpressions.expression: only when ... can sb. enjoy ... in full measure
advancedExpressions.example: Only when rights and responsibilities go hand in hand can a citizen enjoy true freedom in full measure. （only 倒装 + 条件收束，强化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They shared everything with each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Between them there were no locked doors and no half-truths; they shared their joys and their fears in full measure, and in that sharing each burden grew lighter. （读后续写·友情描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 先以“no locked doors, no half-truths”意象铺垫 + in full measure 提升语域 + and 收束句点明“分担减负”的主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should enjoy life fully.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is only by embracing both its triumphs and its trials that we come to taste life in full measure. （议论文·哲理升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is only by...that 强调句 + embracing both...and... 平行结构 + taste life 隐喻 + in full measure 书面短语收尾

classPractice.question: 有了真正的朋友，我们才能毫无保留地尽情分享喜悦与悲伤。With true friends, we feel free to share our joy and sadness ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；in full measure 充分地、毫无保留地，介词短语作方式状语

classPractice.question: The kindness of strangers had saved him, and he vowed to repay it ____ ____ ____ — holding nothing back.
classPractice.note: repay sth in full measure 充分/全额回报；与后文 holding nothing back 呼应

classPractice.question: 同义句转换：She enjoyed her new-found freedom to the full. →  She enjoyed her new-found freedom ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: to the full = in full measure 充分地、尽情地；后者更书面典雅，适合升格

translation: 时光，时机；瞬间；某个时刻
original_sentence: We know that our friends will both respect our feelings and treasure these moments of closeness.
readingExamples: We know that our friends will both respect our feelings and treasure these moments of closeness.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a very short period of time; an instant
(2) n. a particular point in time
(3) n. a suitable or appropriate time for doing something
(4) n. importance or significance (formal)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 重要，重大（正式用法，常见于 of great moment）
uncommonMeanings.example: The letter that lay unopened on the table was, though she did not yet know it, a matter of the greatest moment. （读后续写·悬念铺垫·命运转折）

posExamples.sentence: For one breathless moment the whole gymnasium fell silent; then the ball dropped cleanly through the net and the crowd erupted like a bursting dam. （读后续写·比赛高潮·由静到动）
I still cherish the moment when our teacher, eyes shining, told us that our small class had won the national reading award. （应用文·回忆/感谢信）
Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away — and it is up to us to create them. （议论文·人生价值）
At the very moment she was about to give up, a warm hand landed on her shoulder, and her grandfather's steady voice whispered, "Not yet, my dear." （读后续写·关键时刻·转机）

wordForms.adjective: momentary (adj. 短暂的，瞬间的) / momentous (adj. 重大的，重要的)
wordForms.other: 构词法/辨析：momentary(短暂的) 与 momentous(重大的) 一字之差、意思迥异，勿混——a momentary pause 片刻停顿 vs a momentous decision 重大决定。momentum (n. 势头，动量) 与 moment 同根但已独立成词。熟词僻义提示：moment 作『重要，重大』讲（正式）常见于 of great / the greatest moment。

idioms.translation: 关键时刻，见真章的时刻
idioms.example: The moment of truth had arrived: the envelope in his hand held either a scholarship or the end of a dream. （读后续写·揭晓时刻）

idioms.translation: 偶尔也有出色（或精彩）的时候
idioms.example: The shy boy rarely spoke in class, but on the debate stage he certainly had his moments. （读后续写·人物闪光点）

idioms.idiom: on the spur of the moment
idioms.example: On the spur of the moment, she boarded the wrong train — and it turned out to be the best mistake of her life. （读后续写·意外转折）

idioms.idiom: in the heat of the moment
idioms.example: Words spoken in the heat of the moment can wound a friendship that took years to build. （议论文·情绪管理）

collocations.phrase: the moment (that) ... （连词，引导时间状语从句，= as soon as）
collocations.translation: 【课件】一……就……（the moment 用作连词引导时间状语从句，相当于 as soon as；类似还有 the minute, the second）
collocations.example: The moment he saw his mother, he burst into tears. 看到母亲的那一刻，他泪流满面。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】此刻，目前（用于现在时态）
collocations.example: I would like a job which pays more, but on the other hand, I enjoy the work I'm doing at the moment. 我想要一份薪水更高的工作，但另一方面，我又喜欢目前正在做的工作。（课件原句）
They are living with their parents for the moment because their own house is being built. 他们暂时和父母住在一起，因为自己的房子正在建。（课件原句）
I'll come back for dinner in a moment. 我一会儿就回来吃晚饭。（课件原句）
From that moment on, we have been best friends. 从那一刻起，我们就成了最好的朋友。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 珍惜这些亲密的时刻（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We know that our friends will both respect our feelings and treasure these moments of closeness. 我们知道朋友既会尊重我们的感受，又会珍惜这些亲密的时刻。（课文原句）
At that moment, everything she had rehearsed vanished from her mind. 在那一刻，她排练过的一切都从脑中消失了。
For a moment he hesitated at the door before pushing it open. 他在门前迟疑了片刻，才推门而入。
The climbers knew the fragile ledge might give way at any moment. 登山者知道那脆弱的岩架随时可能坍塌。
Without a moment's hesitation, he plunged into the icy river. 他毫不犹豫地跳进冰冷的河里。
A wise person learns to seize the moment when it comes. 智者懂得在时机来临时抓住它。
That failure became the defining moment that set him on a new path. 那次失败成了让他走上新路的决定性时刻。
We should learn to treasure the quiet moments of closeness with those we love, for they never come twice. （议论文·亲情）

collocations.phrase: the moment (that) ... （连词，引导时间状语从句）
collocations.example: The moment the results were announced, tears of relief streamed down her face. 结果一宣布，宽慰的泪水便淌下她的脸颊。

synonyms.example: In an instant the smile froze on his face. 转瞬间，他脸上的笑容凝固了。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：instant 强调『极短的一刹那』，比 moment 更短、更突然；moment 时间跨度略长，也可指『时机、时刻』。句法/搭配：in an instant / the instant (that)... = the moment (that)...。

synonyms.example: Their wedding was an occasion the whole village would remember. 他们的婚礼是全村都会铭记的一个场合。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：occasion 指『（有特定意义的）时刻、场合』，常与事件相连；不能像 moment 那样表示『极短的瞬间』。句法/搭配：on this occasion, a special occasion。

synonyms.example: At one point she almost gave up entirely. 有那么一刻，她几乎彻底放弃了。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：point 指进程中的『某一点、某一关头』，抽象且中性；moment 更具画面感与情感张力。句法/搭配：at one point, at this point, a turning point。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the moment 引导时间状语从句（课件核心）
advancedExpressions.expression: The moment (that) + 从句, 主句（= as soon as，"一……就……"；类似 the minute / the second；主将从现）
advancedExpressions.example: The moment he saw his mother, he burst into tears. / The moment the bell rings, the children rush out. 看到母亲的那一刻，他泪流满面。／铃声一响，孩子们就冲了出去。（课件语法点：the moment 作从属连词，等同 as soon as）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·moment 时间短语群（课件对照）
advancedExpressions.expression: at the moment 此刻 · for the moment 暂时 · in a moment 过一会儿/马上 · from that moment on 从那一刻起 · at that moment 那一刻 · for a moment 片刻
advancedExpressions.example: At the moment I'm busy; for the moment let it wait; I'll call in a moment — and from that moment on, all was well. （课件填空题集中考查的 moment 时间短语，介词一变意思全变）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『关键/决定性时刻』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: a defining moment / a turning point / a critical moment / the moment of truth / a make-or-break moment
advancedExpressions.example: That failure was a defining moment / a turning point / the moment of truth in his life. （表『决定性时刻』的可替换表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that single moment, sb. understood ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that single moment, watching her mother's tired smile, she understood at last what all those silent sacrifices had meant. （时间凝固式句式，用于顿悟升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us seize this moment to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us seize this precious moment to plant a tree, so that future generations may sit in its shade. （倡议信号召句）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is in such fleeting moments that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is in such fleeting moments of choice, not in grand declarations, that a person's true character is revealed. （It is...that 强调句锁定核心论点）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·moment 时间短语群
advancedExpressions.expression: at the moment 此刻 · for the moment 暂时 · at that moment 那一刻 · for a moment 片刻 · at any moment 随时 · the moment (that)... 一…就…
advancedExpressions.example: At the moment I'm busy; for the moment let it wait — but the moment I'm free, I'll call. （moment 时间短语群集中对照，介词一变意思全变）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the moment (that) 引导时间状语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: The moment (that) + 从句, 主句（= as soon as，『一…就…』；从句用一般现在时表将来）
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the bell rings, the children rush out. / The moment she saw him, she knew. （the moment 作从属连词，等同 as soon as；主将从现原则）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When she heard the news, she was very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment the news reached her, a wave of pure joy surged through her chest, and before she knew it she was spinning across the kitchen with tears glittering in her eyes. （读后续写·喜悦爆发）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment 引导时间状语从句替换 when + 隐喻(a wave of joy surged) + before she knew it 表不自觉的动作 + 细节特写(tears glittering)增强画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: This is an important time for our country.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This is a moment of profound significance for our nation, a crossroads at which the choices we make today will echo through the decades to come. （议论文·正式书面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: moment of profound significance 升级 important time + 同位语 a crossroads 补充意象 + 定语从句 at which... + echo through the decades 隐喻延展时间感

classPractice.question: 【课件原题·填介词/连词】用适当的词填空：(1) I would like a job which pays more, but on the other hand, I enjoy the work I'm doing ____ the moment. (2) They are living with their parents for ____ moment because their own house is being built. (3) I was so tired from climbing the hill that I fell asleep ____ moment my head touched the pillow. (4) I'll come back for dinner ____ a moment. (5) ____ that moment on, we have been best friends.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】(1) at the moment 此刻；(2) for the moment 暂时；(3) the moment (that)... 一……就……（引导时间状从）；(4) in a moment 过一会儿；(5) from that moment on 从那一刻起

classPractice.question: ____ the moment the results were announced, tears of relief streamed down her face. （填一词使 the moment 引导时间状语从句）
classPractice.note: The moment (that)... = as soon as 一…就…；句首首字母大写，the moment 作从属连词

classPractice.question: 选词填空（at the moment / for the moment / at that moment）：I'm rather busy ____; could we talk this evening?
classPractice.note: at the moment 此刻、目前（现在时态）；for the moment 暂时、at that moment 在那一刻（过去某点）

classPractice.question: 我们知道朋友会珍惜这些亲密的时刻。We know that our friends will treasure these ____ of closeness.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；these 后接可数名词复数 moments

translation: 其实，实际上；的确；真正地
original_sentence: Indeed, the human heart depends on such opportunities for comfort and protection.
readingExamples: Indeed, the human heart depends on such opportunities for comfort and protection.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. used to add emphasis to a positive statement or answer
(2) adv. used to introduce a further and stronger point in support of what has just been said
(3) adv. used after 'very' and an adjective or adverb to emphasise a statement, description, etc.
(4) adv. used to show that you are surprised by something or to express contempt or scorn

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于 very + 形容词/副词之后）确实，非常（加强程度）
uncommonMeanings.example: The road ahead was long indeed, but the thought of home gave her tired legs a strength she did not know she had. （读后续写·归途·加强程度）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （表惊讶、怀疑或轻蔑）真的吗；居然（反问语气）
uncommonMeanings.example: "A gift for me? Indeed!" she scoffed, arms folded, unwilling to believe the man who had wronged her could change. （读后续写·人物态度·讽刺）

posExamples.sentence: The stranger did not merely point the way; indeed, he walked the whole muddy mile beside the lost child until the lights of home came into view. （读后续写·善意深化·递进）
I am indeed grateful for the opportunity your school has offered me, and I promise to make the very most of it. （应用文·感谢/申请信）
Reading broadens the mind; indeed, a good book can carry a reader to places that no aeroplane could ever reach. （议论文·阅读的价值·递进论证）
"Are you really the boy who once failed every subject?" the teacher asked. "Indeed I am," he replied, holding up the university offer with quiet pride. （读后续写·逆袭·肯定强调）

idioms.idiom: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
idioms.example: When illness emptied his savings and his so-called friends melted away, one quiet classmate stayed — a friend in need is a friend indeed. （读后续写·友情主题·点题谚语）

collocations.phrase: Indeed, ... （句首递进，加强/递进上文）
collocations.translation: 的确，而且……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Indeed, the human heart depends on such opportunities for comfort and protection. 的确，人心正是依赖这样的机会来获得慰藉与庇护。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 确实非常……（加强程度，indeed 置于其后）
collocations.example: The little bookshop was a very special place indeed. 那家小书店确实是个非常特别的地方。
"Was it worth all the effort?" "Yes indeed." “这一切努力值得吗？”“确实值得。”
The plan will succeed, if indeed we all pull together. 只要我们确实齐心协力，计划就会成功。
"This town has changed so much." "Indeed it has." “这镇子变化真大。”“的确如此。”

synonyms.example: The task looked impossible; in fact, it turned out to be the easiest thing she had ever done. 这任务看似不可能，事实上却是她做过最容易的事。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：in fact 既可表递进（进一步说明），也可表『转折』（引出与预期相反的事实）；indeed 主要用于强调或同向递进，通常不表转折。句法/搭配：多置于句首，后接逗号。

synonyms.example: Certainly, hard work alone does not guarantee success, but it makes success far more likely. 当然，仅靠努力不能保证成功，但会让成功更有可能。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：certainly 侧重表达『确信、无疑』的态度，也常用于让步（certainly...but...）；indeed 更侧重对已说内容的加强与递进。句法/搭配：句首作评注状语，或答语表肯定。

synonyms.example: She was truly moved by the strangers' generosity. 她真的被陌生人的慷慨打动了。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：truly 作程度/真实性副词，修饰形容词或动词，语气真诚；indeed 更多用于句首递进或句末强调整句。句法/搭配：truly 紧贴所修饰的词（truly moved）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『的确/确实』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: indeed / in fact / as a matter of fact / to be sure / without doubt / it is true that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Kindness costs nothing; indeed / in fact / as a matter of fact, it often returns to the giver many times over. （句首递进/强调的可替换表达，注意 in fact 亦可转折）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·indeed 的三种位置与功能
advancedExpressions.expression: ① 句首递进：Indeed, ... ② very+adj./adv.+indeed 加强程度 ③ 答语/句末整句强调：Yes indeed. / ..., indeed.
advancedExpressions.example: It was cold — very cold indeed; indeed, the river had frozen solid. Was it dangerous? Indeed it was. （一词三用：程度加强 / 句首递进 / 答语强调，位置不同功能不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and indeed, ... beyond anything sb. had imagined
advancedExpressions.example: The reunion was joyful, and indeed, it healed wounds far deeper than anyone had imagined. （indeed 递进 + 比较结构，放大情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am indeed honoured / grateful to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am indeed honoured to stand before you today and share what our small team has achieved. （演讲/致辞开场，indeed 增强真挚感）

advancedExpressions.expression: A is true; indeed, B goes even further to show that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Perseverance matters; indeed, history goes even further to show that it is often the last, unglamorous attempt that changes everything. （indeed 引出更强论据，层层加码）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was very brave.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He was a brave boy indeed — the kind who would step in front of a bully not once, but every single time, no matter the cost to himself. （读后续写·人物刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: very...形容词...indeed 结构提升语气 + 破折号引出补充说明 + not once, but every single time 对比强调 + no matter... 让步彰显品格

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is helpful. It can also change how we think.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Reading enriches us; indeed, it does far more than fill idle hours — it quietly reshapes the very way we see the world. （议论文·递进升格）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接 + indeed 引出递进论点 + far more than... 比较结构否定浅层理解 + 破折号引出核心(reshapes the way we see the world)

classPractice.question: The road ahead was long ____, but the thought of home gave her tired legs new strength.
classPractice.note: very/程度形容词 + indeed 加强程度；此处 long indeed『确实漫长』，indeed 置于形容词后

classPractice.question: 的确，人心正是依赖这样的机会来获得慰藉与庇护。____, the human heart depends on such opportunities for comfort and protection.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；Indeed 置于句首作递进/强调，后接逗号，首字母大写

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（indeed / in fact）：The task looked impossible; ____, it turned out to be the easiest thing she had ever done. （引出与预期相反的事实）
classPractice.note: 此处表转折（与预期相反），只能用 in fact；indeed 一般只作同向强调/递进，不表转折

original_sentence: The second fruit of friendship is the better understanding and judgement that may be achieved through conversations with well-meaning and wise friends.
readingExamples: The second fruit of friendship is the better understanding and judgement that may be achieved through conversations with well-meaning and wise friends.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having good and kind intentions, even if the effect is not always helpful
(2) adj. wanting to be helpful or to do the right thing, though sometimes lacking judgement or skill

posExamples.sentence: A well-meaning neighbour had left a pot of warm soup on the doorstep, and the sight of it, steaming in the cold dusk, brought sudden tears to the widow's eyes. （读后续写·邻里善意·细节感人）
I would like to thank all the well-meaning volunteers whose patience and warmth turned a small charity sale into an unforgettable community event. （应用文·感谢信）
Well-meaning advice, however sincere, can sometimes do more harm than good if it ignores what the other person truly needs. （议论文·善意与智慧）
Though his father's well-meaning lectures often made him roll his eyes, the boy would, years later, hear that same steady voice guiding his own choices. （读后续写·亲情·多年后的领悟）

wordForms.adjective: well-meaning (善意的，多修饰人) / well-meant (出于好意的，多指行为、话语)
wordForms.other: 构词法·well- 合成形容词系列（well + 过去分词/现在分词，连字符连接，作定语）：well-known 著名的 · well-behaved 举止规矩的 · well-educated 受过良好教育的 · well-informed 消息灵通的 · well-organized 组织有序的 · well-dressed 衣着讲究的 · well-off 富裕的。近义：well-intentioned (adj. 用意良好的)。小贴士：well-meaning 常暗含『好心未必办好事』的转折意味，写作里常接 but。

collocations.phrase: conversations with well-meaning and wise friends
collocations.translation: 与善意而明智的朋友交谈（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The second fruit of friendship is the better understanding and judgement that may be achieved through conversations with well-meaning and wise friends. 友谊的第二个果实，是通过与善意而明智的朋友交谈所获得的更佳理解与判断。（课文原句）
It was a well-meaning friend who first pushed her, gently but firmly, to enter the contest. 是一位好心的朋友最先温和而坚定地推她去参赛。
She listened politely to the well-meaning advice, though she had already made up her mind. 她礼貌地听着那善意的建议，尽管早已下定决心。
His well-meaning but clumsy attempt to comfort her only made the girl cry harder. 他出于好意却笨拙的安慰只让女孩哭得更凶。
Despite the committee's well-meaning efforts, the new rule confused more students than it helped. 尽管委员会用心良苦，新规定却让更多学生困惑。
True guidance comes from friends who are both well-meaning and wise. 真正的指引来自既善意又明智的朋友。
Her grandmother's well-meaning words, though old-fashioned, carried a wisdom the girl would only understand much later. （读后续写·代际理解）

synonyms.example: The reform, however well-intentioned, failed to consider the villagers' real needs. 这项改革无论用意多好，都未考虑村民的真实需求。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：与 well-meaning 几乎同义，更正式、偏书面，常用于评价政策、行为或计划；well-meaning 更常修饰『人』。句法/搭配：a well-intentioned policy / reform；两者均可 however + adj. 让步。

synonyms.example: The kind-hearted old man never turned away a hungry traveller. 那位好心肠的老人从不拒绝饥饿的旅人。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：kind-hearted 侧重内在心地善良、有同情心，是纯褒义；well-meaning 常暗含『心是好的，但效果未必好』的微妙意味。句法/搭配：作定语/表语修饰人。

synonyms.example: It was considerate of her to keep her voice low while the baby slept. 她在婴儿睡觉时压低嗓音，真是体贴。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：considerate 侧重『为他人着想、行为周到得体』，强调行动贴心；well-meaning 侧重『出发点好』，不保证方式得当。句法/搭配：It is considerate of sb to do sth。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·well- 合成形容词群
advancedExpressions.expression: well-meaning · well-known · well-behaved · well-educated · well-informed · well-organized · well-off · well-intentioned
advancedExpressions.example: A well-known, well-educated and well-meaning teacher can shape a well-behaved class. （well- + 分词/形容词构成合成词群，作定语，连字符不可少）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『善意的、好心的』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: well-meaning / well-intentioned / kind-hearted / good-natured / with the best of intentions
advancedExpressions.example: The advice, well-meaning / well-intentioned / offered with the best of intentions, still missed the mark. （表『善意的』的可替换表达，注意褒贬微差）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·合成形容词的连字符与位置
advancedExpressions.expression: well- 类合成形容词作定语时须加连字符（a well-meaning friend）；作表语时连字符可省（The friend is well meaning / well-meaning）
advancedExpressions.example: a well-behaved child（定语连字符）→ The child is well behaved.（表语常省）（复合形容词位置与连字符规则）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was a well-meaning ... that first ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was a well-meaning stranger's single word of encouragement that first made her believe she might be worth something. （强调句 It was...that... 突出善意的力量）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ..., I thank every well-meaning ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the whole neighbourhood, I sincerely thank every well-meaning soul who gave up a Sunday to clean our park. （感谢信正式致谢句）

advancedExpressions.expression: well-meaning as it may be, ... unless ...
advancedExpressions.example: Well-meaning as it may be, generosity can become a burden unless it is guided by a genuine understanding of the receiver. （as 让步倒装 + unless 条件，辩证看待善意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A kind neighbour helped her, but it made things worse.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A well-meaning neighbour, eager to help, rearranged the whole kitchen for her — and it was only when the frail old woman could no longer find her own teacup that anyone realised how unwelcome such kindness could be. （读后续写·好心办坏事）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: well-meaning 替换 kind + 分词短语 eager to help 补充动机 + it was only when...that 强调句延迟揭示后果 + 细节(could not find her own teacup)让“帮倒忙”具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good intentions are not always enough.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: However well-meaning our intentions, they are of little worth unless matched by the wisdom to act rightly. （议论文·辩证升格）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: However + adj. 让步状语从句提升语气 + be of little worth 正式表达替换 not enough + unless matched by... 过去分词条件状语 + wisdom to act rightly 点出辩证核心

classPractice.question: The second fruit of friendship may be achieved through conversations with ____-meaning and wise friends. （填一词构成『善意的』）
classPractice.note: 课文原句；well-meaning 由 well- 与 meaning 构成合成形容词，作定语须加连字符

classPractice.question: 他出于好意却笨拙的安慰只让女孩哭得更凶。His ____ but clumsy attempt to comfort her only made the girl cry harder.
classPractice.note: well-meaning but ... 出于好意却…；点出『好心未必办好事』的转折

classPractice.question: 选词填空（well-known / well-behaved / well-meaning）：Their son is so ____ that guests never hear a single complaint from him.
classPractice.note: well- 合成形容词群辨析：此处指『举止规矩』用 well-behaved；well-known 著名的、well-meaning 善意的均不通

translation: 承认，意识到；认出，辨别出
original_sentence: We often find it easier to recognize other people's weaknesses than our own.
readingExamples: We often find it easier to recognize other people's weaknesses than our own.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to know someone or something because you have seen, heard, or experienced them before
(2) vt. to accept or be aware that something is true, important, or exists
(3) vt. to officially accept that an organization, government, or achievement has a legal or valid status
(4) vt. to show official appreciation of someone's work, effort, or qualities

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 承认（某事属实、重要或存在）；意识到（= admit / acknowledge，常接 that 从句）
uncommonMeanings.example: We often find it easier to recognize other people's weaknesses than our own. （课文原句）我们往往觉得，认清别人的弱点比认清自己的弱点更容易。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）承认……的资格/合法地位；认可（学历、政权等）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was not until the new policy came into effect that her overseas qualifications were finally recognized nationwide. （读后续写·迟来的认可）直到新政策生效，她的海外学历才在全国范围内获得承认。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （公开）表彰，嘉奖（某人的贡献）
uncommonMeanings.example: At the closing ceremony, the headmaster recognized the volunteers by name. （读后续写·颁奖场面）在闭幕式上，校长逐一点名表彰志愿者。

posExamples.sentence: The instant the old dog caught his scent at the gate, it recognized the boy who had left ten years ago, and, whimpering with joy, it hurled itself into his arms. （读后续写·久别重逢·动作画面）
I am writing to suggest that our school formally recognize the outstanding efforts of the cleaning staff, whose quiet dedication keeps our campus spotless yet so often goes unnoticed. （应用文·建议信）
We must first recognize that failure is not the opposite of success but an indispensable part of it; only by acknowledging this truth can we cultivate genuine resilience. （议论文·成长与挫折）
So absorbed was she in the melody that she failed to recognize her own mother waving frantically from the crowd. （读后续写·倒装·舞台专注）

wordForms.noun: recognition (n. 认出；承认；赏识，表彰)
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-(反复/回) + cogn-(知，认知，同 cognition) + -ize(动词后缀)→『重新认知→认出/承认』。派生：recognized (adj. 公认的) / unrecognized (adj. 未被承认的) / beyond recognition 面目全非。熟词僻义提示：recognize 除『认出』外，可作『承认（=admit/acknowledge）』，接 that 从句，如课文 recognize other people's weaknesses。

collocations.translation: 【课件】凭……认出某人（vt. 认出，辨别出）
collocations.example: I recognized her by her red hair. 我通过她的红头发认出了她。I recognized him as soon as he came in the room. 他一进屋我就认出了他。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】被承认／看作是……（认为……有价值/重要）
collocations.example: Drugs were not recognized as a problem then. 那时候还没有把毒品看成是一个问题加以重视。He is recognized as one of the greatest living painters. 他被公认为在世最伟大的画家之一。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: recognize that ... / It is (widely) recognized that ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】承认／意识到……；人们（普遍）公认……
collocations.example: We recognized that this solution could only be temporary. 我们意识到这只是个临时的解决方案。= It was recognized that this solution could only be temporary. 人们意识到这只是个临时的解决方案。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为了表彰／以肯定……（recognition n. 认出；承认；赏识，赞誉）
collocations.example: He received the award in recognition of his success over the past year. 他受到了奖励，以肯定他过去一年的成绩。（课件原句）There is a growing recognition that older people have potential too. 越来越多的人认识到老年人也是有潜力的。（课件原句）
The town has changed beyond recognition since I was last here. 自从我上次离开这里以来，这座小镇已经变得让人认不出来了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 认清别人的弱点（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We often find it easier to recognize other people's weaknesses than our own. 我们往往觉得，认清别人的弱点比认清自己的弱点更容易。（课文原句）
The moment the lights came up, the audience instantly recognized the shy boy. 灯光一亮，观众立刻认出了那个腼腆的男孩。
Blinded by pride, he failed to recognize the value of the advice. 骄傲蒙蔽了他，使他没能意识到那建议的价值。

collocations.phrase: recognize the importance / value of sth
collocations.example: It is high time that we recognized the importance of mental health. 我们早该认识到心理健康的重要性了。
Her research is now widely recognized as a milestone in science. 她的研究如今被广泛公认为科学界的里程碑。
The teenager was recognized for his bravery after the rescue. 那名少年因营救中的勇敢而受到表彰。
As the years slipped by, she came to recognize her grandmother's silence as a form of love. 岁月流逝，她逐渐认识到祖母的沉默是一种爱。
We must first recognize that failure is not the opposite of success but part of it. 我们首先必须认识到，失败不是成功的反面，而是成功的一部分。
Even in the dim light, she recognized him by the faint scar above his eyebrow. 即便光线昏暗，她也凭他眉上淡淡的疤认出了他。

collocations.phrase: recognize the importance / value of sth.
collocations.example: It is high time that we recognized the importance of mental health. 我们早该认识到心理健康的重要性了。
The teenager was recognized for his bravery after the rescue. 那名少年因营救中的勇敢而受到表彰。
Any thoughtful reader will readily recognize that the pursuit of knowledge demands both curiosity and perseverance. （议论文·治学态度）
The committee recognized a pressing need for wheelchair access and promptly redesigned the library entrance. （应用文·报告）

synonyms.example: He finally acknowledged that his harsh words had wounded his best friend. 他终于承认，自己的厉言伤了挚友的心。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：acknowledge 侧重公开或勉强地『承认』某事实/错误/情感，常带道德或态度色彩；recognize 在此义上侧重经辨别后的『确认』，更中性。句法/搭配：两者都可接 that 从句；在『承认某事属实』义上 recognize 可与 admit / acknowledge 互换（熟词僻义）。

synonyms.example: The witness was asked to identify the man she had seen fleeing. 证人被要求指认她看到逃跑的那个男子。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：identify 强调从若干对象中『指认、确定』身份，常用于正式/侦查语境；recognize 强调因熟悉而『认出』，情感和记忆色彩更浓。句法/搭配：identify sb as ...；recognize sb by ...。

synonyms.example: Only when the door clicked shut did she realize how much she would miss the room. 直到门咔哒关上，她才意识到自己会多想念这房间。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：realize 强调内心突然『醒悟、想通』某事实；recognize 在『意识到』义上更强调经辨别后的『确认』，常带 that 从句表客观承认。句法/搭配：realize / recognize + that 从句。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·It is (widely) recognized that ... 形式主语（课件）
