advancedExpressions.expression: It is (widely) recognized that + 从句（= sb recognize that... 的被动形式主语句）
advancedExpressions.example: It is widely recognized that friendship, like a plant, must be watered by time and honesty. 人们普遍承认，友谊如同植物，须以时间与真诚浇灌。（课件原句结构：recognize that 的形式主语被动，正式书面）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·recognize 搭配群（课件对照）
advancedExpressions.expression: recognize sb by sth 凭…认出 · recognize sb as 认出/承认…是 · recognize that... 承认/认识到 · be recognized as 被公认为 · in recognition of 为表彰… · beyond recognition 面目全非
advancedExpressions.example: She came to recognize that, though widely recognized as a hero, he still failed to recognize his own worth. （课件 recognize 一词多搭配，一句串起）

advancedExpressions.expression: recognize(v.) → recognition(n. 认出/承认/赏识) → recognizable(adj.) / recognized(adj. 公认的) / unrecognized(adj. 未被承认的)
advancedExpressions.example: His talent, long unrecognized, at last won public recognition and became instantly recognizable. 他长期不为人知的才华终获公众认可，变得一眼可辨。（课件词族串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: It was in that instant that sb. recognized ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was in that instant, amid the deafening cheers, that he recognized how far a single act of kindness had carried him. （强调句 It was ... that，凝固关键顿悟时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should recognize and reward ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should recognize and reward those unsung heroes among us, for their selfless deeds deserve far more than silent gratitude. （建议信呼吁段，recognize and reward 并列增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: to recognize ... is the first step towards ...
advancedExpressions.example: To recognize one's own limitations is the first step towards genuine self-improvement, for no one can mend a fault he refuses to see. （不定式作主语，提炼哲理并衔接后文论证）

advancedExpressions.expression: recognize sb by sth 凭…认出 · recognize that... 承认/认识到 · recognize sb for sth 因…表彰 · fail to recognize 没认出/未意识到 · be widely recognized as 被公认为 · come to recognize 逐渐认识到
advancedExpressions.example: She came to recognize that, though widely recognized as a hero, he still failed to recognize his own worth. （recognize 一词多搭配，一句串起）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·『承认/认识到』（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: recognize (that) / acknowledge / admit / accept / concede / be aware that
advancedExpressions.example: We must recognize / acknowledge / admit that failure is part of success. （表『承认某事属实』的可替换表达，recognize=admit 是熟词僻义）

advancedExpressions.expression: recognize(v.) → recognition(n.) → recognizable(adj.) → recognizably(adv.) / recognized(adj. 公认的) / unrecognized(adj. 未被承认的)
advancedExpressions.example: His talent, long unrecognized, at last won public recognition and became instantly recognizable. （由 recognize 拉出全词族，写作换形式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She recognized her old teacher in the crowd.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Scanning the sea of unfamiliar faces, she suddenly froze — there, beneath the flickering station lights, stood the frail figure of her old teacher, and in a heartbeat all the years between them dissolved. （读后续写·环境+心理+重逢）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词伴随状语(Scanning...)营造搜寻感 + 破折号制造停顿 + there 引导倒装聚焦 + 隐喻(all the years dissolved)升华情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should recognize the value of teamwork.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is imperative that we recognize the true value of teamwork, for it is not the brilliance of a single mind but the harmony of many that ultimately moves mountains. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is imperative that + 虚拟语气(should)提升正式度 + not...but 对比句式突出重点 + 谚语式意象(move mountains)收束有力

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】(1) He is recognized ____ one of the greatest living painters. (2) The film star wears sunglasses. Therefore, he can go shopping without ____ (recognize). (3) 她一转过身，妈妈就认出她了：Her mum ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: (1) as (2) being recognized (3) recognized her the moment she turned around
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】(1) be recognized as 被公认为，介词 as；(2) without 后接动名词，被动 being recognized 不被认出；(3) the moment 引导时间状从=as soon as，主句 recognized her

classPractice.note: 从若干人中『指认、确定身份』用 identify；recognize 侧重因熟悉而认出，realize 侧重内心醒悟

classPractice.question: 汉译英：我们首先必须承认，失败不是成功的反面，而是成功的一部分。（用 recognize that；recognize=admit 熟词僻义）
classPractice.answer: We must first recognize that failure is not the opposite of success but (a) part of it.
classPractice.note: recognize that... 此处=admit/acknowledge『承认』；not ... but ... 对比结构

original_sentence: This alone helps make our thoughts clearer and brings us a more thorough understanding of our problems.
readingExamples: This alone helps make our thoughts clearer and brings us a more thorough understanding of our problems.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. done carefully and completely, with great attention to every detail
(2) adj. (of a person) careful to do things properly and pay attention to detail
(3) adj. complete in every way; absolute (used before a noun for emphasis)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于名词前加强语气）十足的，彻头彻尾的
uncommonMeanings.example: What had begun as a harmless prank soon turned into a thorough disaster, leaving the whole class staring at one another in stunned silence. （读后续写·恶作剧失控）

posExamples.sentence: Before the storm hit, the old fisherman made a thorough inspection of every rope and plank, running his weathered hands along the hull as if bidding the boat good luck. （读后续写·出海准备·动作细节）
To ensure the safety of all participants, we will carry out a thorough check of the equipment the day before the hiking trip. （应用文·通知）
A thorough understanding of a problem, rather than a hasty glance at its surface, is what separates a wise decision from a reckless one. （议论文·理性思考）
Her mother was so thorough that not a single speck of dust dared to settle on the windowsill, and the whole house smelt forever of soap and sunlight. （读后续写·母亲形象·细致）

wordForms.other: 形近词四兄弟辨析(高考高频):thorough /ˈθʌrə/ adj.彻底的; through /θruː/ prep./adv.穿过,自始至终; though /ðəʊ/ conj.虽然(=although); thought /θɔːt/ n.想法 & think 的过去式。口诀:thorough有ou+gh且读/ʌrə/, through是'穿过'少一个o, though'虽然', thought'想/想法'。构词:thorough- 源于 through, 引申为'从头到尾、彻底'。

collocations.translation: 对……的透彻理解（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: This alone helps make our thoughts clearer and brings us a more thorough understanding of our problems. （课文原句）
The authorities promised a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident, leaving no stone unturned. （应用文·报道）

collocations.phrase: make / carry out a thorough search
collocations.example: Rescuers made a thorough search of every collapsed room, refusing to give up until the last survivor was found. （读后续写·救援）
A thorough knowledge of the local customs helped the young volunteer win the villagers' trust within days. （读后续写·支教）
Thanks to weeks of thorough preparation, she walked onto the debate stage with quiet, unshakable confidence. （读后续写·比赛）
Every Spring Festival, the whole family would give the house a thorough clean, sweeping out the old year to welcome the new. （读后续写·传统节日）
The judges praised the team for being remarkably thorough in analysing every possible outcome. （应用文·评语）
A thorough review of the survey data revealed a trend that no one had anticipated. （议论文·数据论证）

synonyms.example: The report offered a comprehensive overview of the city's air quality over the past decade. （应用文·报告）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:comprehensive 侧重『覆盖面广、包含所有方面』,强调范围之全;thorough 侧重『深入到每个细节、做得彻底』,强调程度之深。

synonyms.translation: 一丝不苟的，极其细致的
synonyms.example: With meticulous care, the restorer removed centuries of grime from the fading masterpiece, stroke by patient stroke. （读后续写·工匠精神）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:meticulous 语气更强,突出对微小细节近乎苛求的严谨,多形容人或工作方式;thorough 更常用、语气略平,可形容人也可形容行为/理解。

synonyms.example: She kept a detailed record of every experiment, noting even the tiniest change in temperature. （应用文·记录）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:detailed 只强调『内容详尽、细节多』,是客观描述;thorough 还含『不遗漏、做到底』的彻底性,带有做事态度的评价。

advancedExpressions.expression: with a thoroughness that ...
advancedExpressions.example: He cleaned the wound with a thoroughness that betrayed years of training on the battlefield. （名词 thoroughness + that 定语从句,借做事之细透露人物过往）

advancedExpressions.expression: we will ensure a thorough ...
advancedExpressions.example: We will ensure a thorough inspection of every safety facility so that all visitors may enjoy the exhibition with complete peace of mind. （通知/说明,承诺句式增强可信度）

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing short of a thorough ... can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing short of a thorough reform of our study habits can free us from the tyranny of last-minute cramming. （nothing short of 强调唯有彻底之举方能奏效,加强论点力度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He checked the car carefully before the trip.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before setting off, he gave the battered old car a thorough check, tapping each tyre, testing every light, and murmuring reassurances as though the vehicle could hear his worry. （读后续写·出发前·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: before doing 时间状语开头 + 三个并列现在分词(tapping, testing, murmuring)铺陈动作 + as though 从句注入拟人化情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need to understand the problem completely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What we need is not a fleeting glance but a thorough understanding of the problem, for only when its roots are laid bare can a lasting solution take shape. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What we need is 强调结构 + not...but 对比 + only when 引导的部分倒装,层层推进论证

classPractice.question: This alone helps make our thoughts clearer and brings us a more ____ (thorough / through / though / thought) understanding of our problems.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;此处作定语修饰名词 understanding,需形容词'彻底的' thorough,勿与介词 through/连词 though/名词 thought 混淆。

classPractice.note: carry out a ____ check,空格作定语,用形容词原级 thorough。

classPractice.answer: a thorough understanding / a thorough knowledge
classPractice.note: '透彻的理解'= a thorough understanding of sth.,呼应课文核心词块;句首 Only+状语引起部分倒装 did he gain。

original_sentence: They can help us achieve what we want during life and, perhaps, even after death.
readingExamples: They can help us achieve what we want during life and, perhaps, even after death.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the permanent end of the life of a person, animal, or plant
(2) n. a particular case or instance of someone dying
(3) n. the end or destruction of something (such as a hope, idea, or way of life)
(4) n. (the death) the state of being dead

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）（希望、传统、事业等的）终结，消亡
uncommonMeanings.example: The closing of the last small bookshop felt like the death of an entire era, and the old town seemed to grow a little quieter, a little greyer, overnight. （读后续写·时代变迁·感伤）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语，用于加强语气）the death of sb.：把某人烦死/急死/笑死的根源
uncommonMeanings.example: That endless paperwork will be the death of me, he groaned, burying his face in a mountain of forms. （读后续写·抱怨·幽默口吻）

posExamples.sentence: The news of his grandfather's death reached him at dawn, and for a long moment he simply stood there, the phone pressed to his ear, unable to believe the silence on the other end. （读后续写·噩耗·心理定格）
On behalf of the whole class, I write to express our deepest sorrow over the death of our beloved teacher, whose warmth and wisdom will stay with us forever. （应用文·唁函/慰问信）
The fear of death, far from paralysing us, can awaken in us a fiercer love for life and a resolve to make every fleeting day count. （议论文·生命价值）
She clung to the frozen cliff, her fingers numb, knowing that a single slip meant certain death — yet somewhere deep inside, a stubborn voice refused to let go. （读后续写·绝境求生）

wordForms.adjective: dead (死的); dying (垂死的); deadly (致命的); deathly (死一般的)
wordForms.adverb: deathly (死一般地); deadly (口语:极其)
wordForms.other: 词族拼写全家桶(易错):die(动词原形,现在分词 dying,过去式/分词 died)→ dead(形容词'死的')→ death(名词'死亡')→ deadly(形容词'致命的',如 a deadly weapon)。注意拼写:die→dying(去e加ying), 名词是 death 不是 deathe; dead 无 -th。deathbed(n.临终床榻)。

idioms.translation: （用于动词/形容词后）极其……，……得要命
idioms.example: Alone in the creaking house, the little girl was frightened to death by every gust of wind rattling the shutters. （读后续写·独处·恐惧）
In the legend, the tyrant threatened to put anyone who defied him to death, yet still the villagers refused to bow. （读后续写·民间传说）

idioms.idiom: a matter of life and death
idioms.example: To the stranded climbers, a working radio was no mere convenience — it was a matter of life and death. （读后续写·遇险）
The old soldier vowed to defend his homeland to the death, and no hardship could ever bend his iron will. （读后续写·家国情怀）

collocations.phrase: during life and even after death
collocations.translation: 在生前，甚至在死后（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: They can help us achieve what we want during life and, perhaps, even after death. （课文原句）
The death of her mentor left a void in her life that no achievement could ever quite fill. （读后续写·失去引路人）

collocations.phrase: die a ... death / meet one's death
collocations.example: The brave firefighter met his death saving a family of five, and the whole city mourned a hero it had never known. （读后续写·英雄）
Hovering between life and death, the patient heard the faint, steady beep of the monitor as if it were the drumbeat of hope. （读后续写·抢救）
Lost in the blizzard, the young shepherd feared he would freeze to death before dawn, and he pressed his shivering lamb close for warmth. （读后续写·风雪求生）
In the classic tale, the innocent man was wrongly sentenced to death, and only at the last hour did the truth come to light. （读后续写·冤案昭雪）
After a thorough examination, the doctors finally determined the true cause of death. （应用文·报道）
The poet's untimely death robbed the world of countless verses that would never now be written. （议论文·文学感慨）
Having narrowly escaped death in the collapse, she vowed to devote the rest of her life to helping others. （读后续写·浴火重生）

synonyms.example: The village fell silent at the news of the old teacher's passing, and lamps burned late in every window that night. （读后续写·哀悼）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the face of death, sb. ...

readingExamples: Finally, it should be pointed out that enjoying the company of a crowd is not the same as being with friends.
definitionEn:

(2) n. a business organization that makes or sells goods or services
(3) n. the people you spend time with or the group you are part of

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 陪伴，作伴（不可数,此为课文义;enjoy the company of a crowd）

posExamples.sentence: When her parents worked late, the stray cat curled on the windowsill was her only company, and its soft purring somehow made the empty flat feel less like a cage. （读后续写·留守儿童·陪伴）

Good books are the finest company, for they neither flatter us in prosperity nor abandon us in hardship. （议论文·读书的意义）
After graduation, she turned down a comfortable job at a large company and chose instead to teach in a remote mountain village. （读后续写·择业·奉献）

wordForms.noun: company; companion (同伴); companionship (友谊,陪伴)
wordForms.other: accompaniment (n. 伴奏,伴随物)

idioms.example: Sensing her loneliness, the little boy quietly sat down to keep the old widow company, and together they watched the sun sink behind the hills. （读后续写·陪伴·温情）

idioms.translation: 在某人的陪同下，与某人一起
idioms.example: In the company of seasoned climbers, the nervous beginner gradually found his footing and, step by step, his courage. （读后续写·成长）
After years of shared struggle, the two old friends finally parted company, each chasing a dream the other could no longer follow. （读后续写·离别）

idioms.translation: 并不孤单（有名人/众人同样如此，用以安慰）
idioms.example: If you have ever failed an important exam, take heart — you are in good company, for many great minds stumbled long before they soared. （议论文·励志）

idioms.translation: 两人成伴，三人添乱（谚语）
idioms.example: As the third friend tagged along on their quiet stroll, the old saying 'two's company, three's a crowd' drifted awkwardly through the air. （读后续写·微妙气氛）

collocations.translation: 【课件】享受某人的陪伴，喜欢与某人相处（company un. 陪伴）
collocations.example: I enjoy Jo's company. 我喜欢和乔在一起。（= I enjoy being with her.）（课件原句）
I'll keep you company while you're waiting. 你等的时候我陪你。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人一起，在某人的陪伴下

collocations.phrase: found / establish / operate / run a company
collocations.translation: 【课件】创立／经营公司（company 作"公司"义，可数）
collocations.example: At just twenty-three, she founded a small company and ran it from her cramped dormitory. 年仅二十三岁，她创立了一家小公司，就在拥挤的宿舍里经营。（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: enjoy the company of a crowd / sb
collocations.translation: 享受人群/某人的陪伴（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Finally, it should be pointed out that enjoying the company of a crowd is not the same as being with friends. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: enjoy the company of a crowd / sb.
collocations.translation: 享受人群/某人的陪伴（课文原句词块）

Sensing her loneliness, the boy sat down to keep the old widow company. （读后续写·陪伴）

collocations.translation: 在某人的陪同下，与某人一起
collocations.example: In the company of seasoned climbers, the nervous beginner gradually found his courage. （读后续写·成长）

collocations.phrase: the company of a crowd / friends
collocations.example: He soon learned that the company of a noisy crowd could never fill the quiet ache that only a true friend could soothe. （议论文·友谊与孤独）

collocations.translation: 益友/损友；好的/坏的伙伴
collocations.example: His grandmother often warned him to choose good company, for the friends we keep quietly shape the people we become. （议论文·交友之道）

synonyms.example: What the lonely old man craved was not money but companionship — someone to share a pot of tea and a long, unhurried afternoon. （读后续写·孤独老人）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:companionship 强调陪伴所带来的『情感联结与温暖』,较抽象、书面;company 更口语、通用,既指陪伴这一状态,也可指同伴、公司等具体所指。

synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:presence 强调某人『在场、存在』所产生的影响或安定感,较正式;company 强调『相伴、作伴』这一行为与关系,日常性更强。

translation: 一伙人，一帮人；人群 | vt. 挤满，使拥挤 | vi. 聚集；挤，涌
original_sentence: Finally, it should be pointed out that enjoying the company of a crowd is not the same as being with friends.
readingExamples: Finally, it should be pointed out that enjoying the company of a crowd is not the same as being with friends.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large number of people gathered together in one place
(2) n. (informal) a particular group of people who spend time together or share interests
(3) vt. to fill a place so that it is very full; to move somewhere in large numbers
(4) vi. to gather closely together in large numbers; to push forward in a mass

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】一伙人，一帮人（有共同交往的圈子，one's usual crowd）
uncommonMeanings.example: Lily introduced me to some of her usual crowd. 莉莉把我介绍给她经常见面的一些朋友们。（课件原句·非"人群"义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（回忆、念头）涌上（心头）；挤满

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）一伙人，一帮人（有共同兴趣或交往的圈子）
uncommonMeanings.example: Ever since he fell in with the wrong crowd, his marks had slipped and the light in his eyes had somehow dimmed. （读后续写·误入歧途）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 挤满，使拥挤；（回忆、念头）涌上（心头）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the winning goal flew in, the crowd erupted into a roar that seemed to shake the very stands, and strangers hugged one another like lifelong friends. （读后续写·赛场·集体狂欢）
To avoid the crowds and ensure everyone's safety, we kindly ask all visitors to enter the exhibition in small groups according to the posted schedule. （应用文·通知）
Curious onlookers crowded around the street artist, craning their necks and holding their breath as the blank canvas slowly bloomed into a field of sunflowers. （读后续写·街头艺术）

wordForms.other: 同形词性变化:crowd 名词'人群'↔ 动词'挤满/聚集',词形不变。派生:crowded(adj.拥挤的,be crowded with 挤满); overcrowded(adj.过度拥挤的); crowdfunding(n.众筹)。注意:crowd 作集合名词,谓语可用单数(整体)或复数(强调个体)。

idioms.example: Instead of following the crowd, she trusted her own judgement and chose the road no one else had dared to take. （读后续写·坚持自我）

idioms.translation: 喧嚣的人群，尘世的喧闹（文学表达）

collocations.translation: 【课件】某人（经常来往的）一伙人，一帮朋友（crowd n. 一伙人）

collocations.phrase: the crowd cheered / roared / fell silent

synonyms.example: Whipped up by rumours, the angry mob surged towards the gates, and the guards braced themselves for the worst. （读后续写·骚乱·紧张）

synonyms.translation: （拥挤的）人群，一大群（文学色彩）

synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:throng 偏书面、文学化,强调人多且熙攘涌动的动态感,常用于渲染气氛;crowd 是最通用的中性词,口语书面皆可。

synonyms.example: The young violinist bowed shyly, and the audience rose as one, applause washing over her like a warm tide. （读后续写·演出）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:audience 特指为观看/聆听演出、演讲而聚集的『观众/听众』,有明确对象;crowd 泛指任何聚集的人群,不限定目的。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·crowd 一词多性（课件对照）
advancedExpressions.expression: one's usual crowd 一伙人 · crowds of 成群的… · crowd the streets 挤满(vt.) · be crowded with 挤满 · a crowded schedule 满满的日程 · crowd into one's mind 涌上心头 · crowd sb out 把…排挤在外
advancedExpressions.example: Crowds of memories crowded into her mind as she pushed through the crowd of her old usual crowd. （课件 crowd 名词/动词/形容词一词多性、多搭配串联记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: a hush fell over the crowd
advancedExpressions.example: As the champion stepped forward, a hush fell over the crowd, and a thousand held breaths hung in the electric air. （a hush fell over... 定格紧张瞬间,以静衬动）

advancedExpressions.expression: to ease the crowd, we suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To ease the crowd during peak hours, we suggest that students visit the reading room by turns according to their class schedule. （倡议/通知句式,给出可操作方案）

advancedExpressions.expression: to rise above the crowd is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To rise above the crowd is not to look down on others, but to have the courage to think for oneself when all around are content merely to follow. （不定式主语 + not...but 澄清概念,深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many people at the square and they were very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The square overflowed with a jubilant crowd; children perched on their fathers' shoulders, red lanterns swayed overhead, and wave upon wave of laughter rolled through the frosty night air. （读后续写·节日·群像描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: overflow with 动态动词替代 there be + 分号连接三组并列画面(children / lanterns / laughter) + wave upon wave 叠词渲染声势 + 环境细节(frosty night air)营造氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not just do what everyone else does.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age when it is all too easy to be swept along by the crowd, the rarest and most valuable courage is the courage to pause, to question, and to chart one's own course. （议论文·独立思考）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age when... 定语从句拉开时代背景 + be swept along by the crowd 比喻从众之势 + 三个不定式(to pause, to question, to chart)排比收束,层层递进

classPractice.question: Finally, it should be pointed out that enjoying the company of a ____ (crowd) is not the same as being with friends.

original_sentence: songs stories poems films books ...
readingExamples: songs stories poems films books ...
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who writes poems
(2) n. a person who has great imagination or a special ability to express beauty or deep feeling (used figuratively)

posExamples.sentence: By day he was a quiet clerk stamping endless forms, but by night, under a single flickering lamp, he became a poet who poured his loneliness into verse. （读后续写·平凡人的诗意）
In our coming culture week, we are honoured to invite a well-known local poet to share how a single line of verse can capture a lifetime of feeling. （应用文·活动通知）
A true poet does more than arrange pretty words; he teaches us to see the wonder hidden in an ordinary raindrop or a fading sunset. （议论文·艺术的意义）

wordForms.noun: poet (诗人); poem (一首诗); poetry (诗歌,总称,不可数); poetess (女诗人,旧)
wordForms.other: 词族辨析(高考易混):poet(人,诗人)｜poem(可数,一首诗,two poems)｜poetry(不可数,诗歌总称,love poetry)｜poetic(adj.有诗意的)。口诀:写诗的是 poet, 一首诗是 poem, 诗歌总称是 poetry。poet laureate(桂冠诗人)。

collocations.example: The museum devoted an entire hall to a renowned poet whose verses had comforted a nation through its darkest years. （读后续写·文化记忆）
Even as a child she was a gifted poet, scribbling tiny verses on the backs of her homework sheets. （读后续写·天赋初显）

collocations.translation: 骨子里是个诗人；富有诗意情怀的人
collocations.example: Though he never published a single line, my grandfather was a poet at heart, finding music in the rustle of autumn leaves. （读后续写·祖父·诗意人生）
Reading the works of that ancient poet, she felt as though a hand had reached across a thousand years to touch her own. （议论文·经典的力量）
Li Bai, one of China's greatest poets, turned wine, moonlight and homesickness into lines that still echo today. （议论文·文化自信）

synonyms.example: The young writer stayed up night after night, coaxing a stubborn story onto the page. （读后续写·创作）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:writer 泛指从事各类文字创作的『作家、写作者』,范围最广;poet 专指写诗的人,是 writer 的一个具体类别。

synonyms.example: In the old tales, a wandering bard would trade a night's song for a warm meal and a place by the fire. （读后续写·古风·吟游）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bard 带古雅、文学色彩,原指边弹唱边作诗的『吟游诗人』,现多用于修辞或指代大诗人(the Bard 指莎士比亚);poet 是中性通用词。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the soul of a poet, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the soul of a poet, the old gardener spoke to his roses as if they could understand every tender word. （with the soul of a poet 前置,一笔勾勒人物的诗意气质）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are privileged to welcome the poet ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are privileged to welcome the acclaimed poet to our school, where she will unveil the quiet magic that lies behind every great poem. （宣传/邀请敬语,营造隆重感）

advancedExpressions.expression: a poet reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an age obsessed with speed and profit, a poet gently reminds us that some of life's deepest truths can only be spoken in a whisper. （借诗人之口引出论点,呼应快节奏时代反思）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He liked writing poems and was a good poet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Words seemed to bloom beneath his pen; a poet to the marrow, he could distil an entire rainy afternoon into a single trembling line that lingered long after the page was turned. （读后续写·才华·诗意）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 隐喻(words bloom beneath his pen)化抽象为具象 + a poet to the marrow 同位语强化人物特质 + distil...into a single line 提炼意象 + linger 收尾余韵悠长

sentenceUpgrade.original: Poets help us understand the world better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is the poet, perhaps more than any scientist, who teaches us to pause and marvel — to find in a falling leaf a whole philosophy of time and change. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...who 强调句突出主体 + more than any scientist 对比抬升诗人价值 + 破折号引出解释 + 以具体意象(a falling leaf)承载抽象哲思

classPractice.question: 用 poet / poem / poetry 填空:(1) Li Bai was one of China's greatest ____s. (2) She wrote a short ____ about the autumn moon. (3) He has loved classical Chinese ____ since childhood.
classPractice.note: poet 指'诗人'(人);poem 可数'一首诗';poetry 不可数'诗歌总称'。考同根名词辨析。

classPractice.question: Though he never published a single line, my grandfather was a ____ (poet) at heart, finding music in the rustle of autumn leaves.
classPractice.note: a poet at heart'骨子里是个诗人';此处指人,用 poet 而非 poem/poetry。

original_sentence: They admired each other and quickly became friends.
readingExamples: They admired each other and quickly became friends.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to respect and approve of someone or something because of their good qualities or achievements
(2) vt. to look at something and enjoy it because you think it is beautiful or impressive
(3) vt. to express your respect and approval of someone or something (often in speech)

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the mountain top, we admired the sea of clouds rolling beneath our feet, its silver waves glowing softly in the first light of dawn. （读后续写·登山写景）
I have long admired your unwavering dedication to protecting stray animals, and I am writing to ask whether I might join your volunteer team this summer. （应用文·申请信）
We admire scientists not merely for their brilliant discoveries, but for the patience and integrity with which they pursue the truth, however inconvenient it may be. （议论文·科学精神）
The boy paused before the old craftsman's stall, admiring the way his weathered hands coaxed a shapeless lump of clay into a graceful vase. （读后续写·人物观察）

wordForms.noun: admiration (钦佩,赞赏); admirer (仰慕者,崇拜者)
wordForms.adjective: admirable (令人钦佩的,值得赞赏的)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶:admire(v.)→ admiration(n.钦佩,in admiration/have admiration for)→ admirer(n.仰慕者)→ admirable(adj.令人钦佩的,重音在首音节 /ˈædmərəbl/)→ admirably(adv.)→ admiring(现在分词作形容词'钦佩的',an admiring look)。注意:admirable 重音前移,勿读成 admire+able。

collocations.translation: 彼此钦佩，互相欣赏（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: They admired each other and quickly became friends. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: admire sb. for sth. / for doing sth.
collocations.example: I admire my grandmother for never once complaining, even in the hardest of years. （读后续写·亲情）
The whole nation deeply admired the firefighters who rushed into the blaze while others fled. （议论文·英雄主义）
Too often we hurry past beauty; how seldom do we stop to admire a blossom clinging to a crack in the pavement. （读后续写·哲思）

collocations.phrase: admire sb. from a distance / afar
collocations.example: For years the shy student had admired the champion debater from afar, never daring to speak to her. （读后续写·青春心理）

collocations.translation: 备受钦佩的，广受赞赏的
collocations.example: Her quiet courage during the crisis made her a widely admired figure in our community. （应用文·人物介绍）
We lingered on the wooden bridge to admire the scenery, reluctant to break the spell of that golden autumn afternoon. （读后续写·写景）

collocations.translation: 对某人怀有极大的钦佩
collocations.example: I have nothing but great admiration for the teachers who devote their lives to remote mountain schools. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: look at sb. in / with admiration
collocations.translation: 以钦佩的目光看着某人
collocations.example: The younger players looked at their captain in admiration as he lifted the trophy above his head. （读后续写·团队荣耀）
His honesty in owning up to the mistake won the admiration of everyone present. （议论文·品格）

collocations.translation: 暗中的仰慕者；热切的崇拜者
collocations.example: On her desk lay an unsigned note from a secret admirer, the ink still fresh. （读后续写·情节铺垫）

synonyms.example: We respect him not for his wealth, but for the humility with which he carries it. （议论文·品德）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:respect 侧重理性的尊重与认可,对'品德/地位/规则'的敬重,语气克制,常搭 respect sb. for sth.;admire 更带情感色彩,含由衷赞叹、想效仿之意,可用于人也可用于风景、品质。句法上二者都可接 sb. for (doing) sth.,但 admire 还常与 the view/scenery 搭配表'欣赏'。

synonyms.example: Every young apprentice in the workshop looked up to the old master carpenter. （读后续写·师徒）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:look up to 强调把对方视为榜样、地位仰视,多用于对长辈/权威,只接人作宾语;admire 可用于人也可用于风景、品质等,范围更广。

synonyms.example: The visitors marvelled at the intricate carvings that had survived a thousand winters. （读后续写·惊叹写景）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:marvel at 突出'惊奇、叹为观止'的瞬间反应,不及物+at;admire 更持久、更含情感认同,可反复地欣赏,及物直接接宾语。

synonyms.example: She was held in high esteem by colleagues and rivals alike. （应用文·书面正式语体）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:esteem 为正式、书面用词,多见于 hold sb. in high esteem 结构;admire 更口语化、更日常。

advancedExpressions.expression: It was then that sb. came to admire not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was then that I came to admire in my father not the strength of his arms, but the tenderness he had hidden behind them all my life. （否定对比+抽象升华，续写点题段）

advancedExpressions.expression: What I admire most about sb. is the way ...
advancedExpressions.example: What I admire most about our headmaster is the way he remembers every student's name and greets each of us as an equal. （the way引导表语从句，具体化钦佩之点）

advancedExpressions.expression: We admire sb. not so much for ... as for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We admire true pioneers not so much for the summits they reach as for the courage to set out when the path is still shrouded in fog. （not so much...as...权衡结构，论证价值取向）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I admired her courage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Watching her rise, dust her knees, and step to the starting line once more, I felt a wave of admiration surge through me — this was courage stripped of all applause, the kind that answers only to itself. （读后续写·心理+破折号升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语铺陈动作(Watching her rise, dust, step) + 名词化 admiration + 破折号补充定义 + 抽象升华(courage that answers only to itself)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people admire this scientist.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a truth few would dispute that this scientist commands the admiration of the world — not for the prizes lining her shelves, but for the quiet decades she spent in the laboratory when no one was watching. （议论文·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a truth few would dispute that...让步式开篇 + command the admiration of 高级搭配 + not for...but for...对比论证 + 细节意象(quiet decades, no one was watching)

classPractice.question: They ____ (admire) each other and quickly became friends.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;记叙过去,用一般过去式 admired;admire each other'彼此钦佩'。

classPractice.question: I ____ my grandmother ____ never once complaining, even in the hardest of years.
classPractice.note: admire sb. for (doing) sth.'因某事钦佩某人';for 后接名词或动名词(complaining)。

classPractice.question: We ____ (admire / respect) the scenery from the mountain top, watching the sea of clouds glow in the dawn light.
classPractice.note: '欣赏风景'用 admire the scenery/view;respect 侧重理性尊重人/规则,不用于欣赏风景。考 admire 与 respect 辨析及'欣赏'义。

original_sentence: When can we again hold a cup of wine, And chat about poem-writing line by line?
readingExamples: When can we again hold a cup of wine, And chat about poem-writing line by line?
definitionEn:
(1) n. an alcoholic drink made from the fermented juice of grapes
(2) n. an alcoholic drink made from the fermented juice of other fruits or plants (e.g. rice wine, plum wine)
(3) n. a particular type, brand, or glass of this drink
(4) vt./vi. (formal) to entertain or be entertained with wine (usually in 'wine and dine')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 深红色，酒红色（用作颜色词）
uncommonMeanings.example: She wore a dress of deep wine, the colour of the last leaves before they fall, and the whole room seemed to warm at her entrance. （读后续写·人物出场·色彩描写）

posExamples.sentence: By the fireside the old poet raised a cup of wine, and for a moment the sorrow of a hundred autumns softened into a quiet, contented smile. （读后续写·古典意境）
The Mid-Autumn banquet will feature traditional rice wine, mooncakes and a lantern show, so please let me know if you would like to reserve a seat at our table. （应用文·邀请信）
Some argue that a glass of red wine benefits the heart, yet moderation, not the drink itself, is what truly safeguards our health. （议论文·健康话题）
Grandfather kept a jar of homemade plum wine buried beneath the pear tree, saving it, he said, for the day I would finally come home. （读后续写·亲情·伏笔）

idioms.example: The company wined and dined its foreign guests, hoping to seal the long-awaited partnership before nightfall. （应用文/记叙·商务社交）

idioms.translation: 旧瓶装新酒（用旧形式承载新内容，常含不协调之意）
idioms.example: Simply adding screens to the classroom is new wine in old bottles unless the teaching itself is reimagined. （议论文·教育改革）

idioms.idiom: in vino veritas / wine speaks the truth
idioms.example: As the toasts went round, his guarded words gave way to honest ones — wine, they say, speaks the truth. （读后续写·情节转折）

collocations.translation: 举/持一杯酒（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When can we again hold a cup of wine, And chat about poem-writing line by line? （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a glass / cup / bottle of wine
collocations.translation: 一杯/一瓶葡萄酒（wine 不可数,靠容器计量）
collocations.example: He poured two glasses of wine and set one before the empty chair, as he had done every evening since she left. （读后续写·孤独与思念）
The waiter recommended a light white wine to accompany the seafood. （应用文·情景对话）
In our village, brewing rice wine is a craft handed down through generations. （读后续写·乡土文化）

collocations.phrase: raise / hold a cup of wine
collocations.example: The friends raised a cup of wine to the moon, promising to meet again when the plum blossoms returned. （读后续写·古典送别）
She sipped her wine slowly, letting the warmth spread through her chilled fingers. （读后续写·细节动作）
They wined and dined late into the night, and old grievances quietly dissolved. （记叙·和解）
Before the meal, our host proposed a toast with wine to the health of every guest. （应用文·宴会致辞）

collocations.phrase: a wine glass / wine bottle / wine cellar
collocations.example: Down in the cool wine cellar, rows of dusty bottles lay like sleeping years. （读后续写·环境描写）
Friendship, like aged wine, only grows richer with the passing of time. （议论文·比喻论证）

synonyms.example: The old sailor preferred strong liquor to any delicate wine. （读后续写·人物性格）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：liquor 泛指烈性蒸馏酒（如威士忌、白酒），酒精度高；wine 特指果实发酵酒，度数较低，语体更文雅。

synonyms.example: Doctors warn that alcohol in any form should be avoided before driving. （议论文/应用文·安全提示）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：alcohol 是统称，涵盖一切含酒精饮品，也指化学物质酒精；wine 只是其中一类，且带文化、审美联想。

synonyms.example: A range of hot and cold beverages will be served throughout the conference. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：beverage 为正式书面统称，含义最广，多用于菜单/通知；wine 具体而含情境色彩，不能互换于正式清单。

advancedExpressions.expression: over a cup of wine, ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Over a cup of wine shared beneath the harvest moon, a lifetime of unspoken words seemed at last to find their voice. （介词短语开篇+拟人 words find their voice，古典抒情）

advancedExpressions.expression: no ... would be complete without ...

advancedExpressions.expression: like fine wine, ... improves with ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: They drank wine and talked about poems.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Old friendship is good, like wine.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: much like 插入明喻 + 分号对比(不惊艳↔渐显深度) + rather 转折 + 独立主格(each year adding...)层层递进
